tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 27 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'bur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 5 dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'khrug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bldengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor zung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas zung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces bsgyus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mesapo mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig ༵//sa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs ngo nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjed kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying zung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs nib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2—

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyesabu rnams kyis/ po gad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang ma rtsed de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa lta/ra/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang changs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ zhakhru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'gyung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhye/na mkhra/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/7 spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal nga yand/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshu'/ phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du sbyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brta myo du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzode khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rjo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mas rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed sbyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song prin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis kla bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod btso lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

gnyos / rdo hūm̐ /kha rag sgom chu rdo ༵gas lha tsang skyes ga myos che can ma /rmi /༵ sgi gyis ༵༵ṭā/ shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chi rdo ༵dhi dang ni ga/rde ༵ ge'i sna~X/ ba~X rdo/ kā/ḍā sdu ༵༵ ༵ sa~X dī rjo sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /༵༷ /bye bye ༵ sgi na / / rta ( 1 5 de the / du ) 9 5 / rje zhes / ngo mtshamatshan ga ra bsola~X/ dzhai~X dhi gab cas /rjo ḍi sna dang / da/dro ༵ dhi/ tsam na ༵ rgyad thegs/ ༵ rnyi ḍi bla sdu /sna dhi~X ༵/ mchog rnyi / ba / nga glo /rdo/ rtseX khri ༷ sngi / r+ghaṃX rtse/ /tram̐ sh+lau/ ༵ sog tha te/dī //rde lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1—

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lto phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhud drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bzhas gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

dzhai/phyi ltar tso smi 1 ga gi~X sngu ༵ paba~X rdo /༵ sbyo~X ༵ ༵ dzin ༵/ sem sngag hūm̐ / chen po / chang rdo rje /ga tha'adzi sgyu ༵ /two rgi/ sdo kyi spya ba gan sna ༵sngu dī rnyi~X ༵'i de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can rnyi s+ho lbā /kau/ ma dpa brten kri sni ༷ rderdebye phy-i/ hūm̐ | nas / phabang / rdul tshon yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khore lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i ge bsdo/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'du/sa 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshi/na rje gshe/da dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/sang dnga~X/ rgyas grub thod pa pa sde 1 phyogab du// pyu gzhung po sko rimang po 1 tshor drug hūṃ/ /snru tai hūm̐hūm̐ / rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /dhi rnyi rlo dho / rngo ༵ ༵dhi gzhung ma / ga sdo khyi ( yug steX ༵ sab bsti sdu~X smra ba'i dhi snro pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhas bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu rte nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lu sa —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/ dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis da/nga / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang ṣ+ka chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

rnam rgyal lha dgu'i sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 1rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 20dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdul tshon klu la gtod pa'i lag len bzhugs/ 32rab gnas kyi cho ga 'gro phan rgyas byed bzhugs/ 36rab gnas 'gro phan rgyas byed kyi lhan thabs ches rgyas pa bzhugs/ 73sma ts+tsha dang khang bu brtsegs pa sogs la rab gnas mdor bsdus bzhugs/ 102'chi med 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 105rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rnam par 'byed pa gsang ba'i sgrol ma bzhugs/ 109bla med dang bya rgyud kyi sngags spyi'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad yod/ 143—1—

bkod pa ngag 'don rab gsal bzhugs/ 149sgrol dkar jo bo lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshe sgrub dang rnga / sgyu kyi ba5 pa rnga/sdo kyib/bsdo/ 185gsang ba spyi'i cho ga zhi ba las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'bring po bzhugs/ 187bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mchod pa'i gter bzhugs/ 194bla ma mchod pa bde legs rab rgyas bzhugs/ 209sku skyes bcu bzhi'i bkra shis bzhugs/ 220bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bzhugs/ 222bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs/ 225gdon 'grol gyi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs/ 229klu gtor ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga bzhugs/ 241gtor ma brgya rtsa'i ngag 'don bzhugs/ 249bsdo/ra gri/ 95ga shwa pen bsdo/gas/ 254chu ga rta tor 'jam dpal ma bzhugs/ 255dkar ga|tor cha bzhi bzhu kyigs/ 259gtor ma chen po'i cho ga bar chad kun sel bzhugs/ 266—2—

ja mchod bdud rtsi'i ཿnga gnas dang rigs kun 9pha ba bdag bsdo kyig tha5// 281bsangs ma ces da bsdo kyigs/ 283seng gdong ma'i bzlog pa bzhugs/ 285bar do'i ngo sprod mdo tsam brjod pa bzhugs/ 286gsol 'debs dang brtan bzhugs sna tshogs kyi skor/ 297rje btsun dam pa kun dga' snying po'i brtan bzhugs zhe thag/ bya ba bsdo kyi gzug// 300las dang po pa'i rim pa phan bde'i khu5rgyu/rdeng gan thag/ bde kyi gza5rde/ 302gso sbyong gi cho ga dus bzang mchod pa dang bcas pa bzhugs/ 354

bcas pa bzhugs tre rgo /oṃ rdza sti/ gu ru brnya bo dhi satwa na mo na maX ye shes lha mo ngo mtshar cha shas ni// rnam pa du mas yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ /nang gi mun sel bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar can/ /gang khyod 'dir ni rnam par rgyal gyur cig /de la gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rig sngags 'di/ gang gā'i klung khrag khrig chen po brgyad cu rtsa brgyad snyed kyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs shing / byin gyis brlabs pas/ ngan 'gro dang las kyi sgrib pa mtha' dag yongs su sbyong ba/ bde 'gro dang bde ba'i lam ston pa/ 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par byed pa yin par gsungs pas/ blo ldan sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyis/ mchog tu nan tan du bya ba'i 'os so/ /de la 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas pa gzhan du 'bri bar 'gyur la/ lha dgu'i rnal 'byor la brten nas khrus chog dang stong mchod sogs/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len du mdzad pa gang yin pa de bri bar bya'o/ /'di la cho ga'i sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ bum pa'i steng du gzungs 'di'i snying po can gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten bzhugs su gsol/ mañdzi sogs stegs mtho ba la/ dung chos sam/ zangs chos su mchod yon chu gtsang la 'o ma dang me tog dkar po btang pa ba theg /mchod pa gzhan rnams gshom tshul ni/ phyis kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gi phyag len lhar/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang mchod yon nas/ zhal zas kyi bar bdun po/ shar nas byang gi bar du g.yas rdo/ra du byed pa'i lugs bzhin bshams kyang chog/

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/mdun du mchod yon zhabs bsil/ g.yas su me tog bdug spos mar me gsum/ g.yon du zhal zas dri zlang/ yang mar me de gsum/ rgyab tu mtshams 'dzin gshom pa'am/ yang na g.yas su nyer spyod lnga dang / g.yon du chu gnyis sogs bshams pas chog pas/ gcig tu nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma dang /cha gsum rnams spyir phyogs la nges pa med kyang / 'das gtor dkyil 'khor gyi mdun gyi phyogs dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi/ cha gsum ji ltar bde bar sgrig /yang de ltar mi bde na/ shar du 'jig rten 'das gtor gyi sne mthud nas rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma sgrigs/cha gsum ci bde ba'i phyogs su bzhag pas chog gi /lho nyid du dgos zer ba la ni lung rigs med do/ /spyir btang la bum pa dang rten gyi zhal yang 'jig rten shar la blta/ ci ste stong mchod byed na/lha bsgos stong dang / mar me stong dang / bdug spos stong rnams nges par dgos shing / gzhan yang gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa 'grub na stong du tshang ba dgos shing / ma 'grub na ji ltar rigs pa bya ba las/ ras sam dar gyi tshal ba phra mos kyang rung mod/ dug can gyi shog bu la 'bri ba dang /ras bris rnying pa dri ma can gyis ni go mi chod do/ /de 'dra byed pa de ni/ gang la bya ba'i bsgrub bya la phan mi thogs pa dang / dkyil 'bor gyi lha la brnyas par 'gyur ba dang / lag len ngan pas lag len bzang po sun 'byin pa'i spyod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ring du dor bar bya'o/ /mchod pa de rnams ni bum pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la bskor kyang rung / stegs bu gzhan la bkod nas/ phyogs bzhi nas bskor kyang rung ngo / /gtor ma stong phrag kyang de ltar bkod na rung mod gyi/ gtor snod gzhan du sgrig pa'i lag len gtso che la/gzhan yang rol mo sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar byas te/ de rnams lag len mthong ba las kyang shes par bya'o/ /de nas thams cad khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas byang —2—

sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sogs nam mkha' gang ba la dmigs nas/ phyag 'tshal rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba re bya ste/ de yang las dang po pa'i rim pa chos spyod khrigs chags su bshad zin to/ /de nas bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya ste/ me tog dam pa zhes sogs mchod pa'i tshigs gcad gsum la rol chen byed/ de nas bsnyen gnas rang gi blang ba'i cho ga byed pa zhig snang ba la/ cho ga byed pa po thams cad dge tshul yan chad kyi sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa yin na/ bsnyen gnas blang dgos pa ma yin zhing / dge tshul dge slong gi sdom pa ma thob pa sha stag yin na/ nges par blang bar bya la/ rab byung gi sdom pa thob ma thob 'dres ma yin na/len pa dang mi len pa'i dbye ba so sor byed dgos pa yin kyang / dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur/ lag len ltar snang gi cho ga gra sgrig dgos pa 'di 'dra'i rigs la/ rab byung gi sdom pa ma thob pa rnams kyis bsnyen gnas len pa'i zhor la/ dge tshul dang dge slong rnams kyang ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rang rang gi sdom pa brtan por dam 'cha' ba'i bsam pas/ cho ga de kha ton du byed pa tsam la 'gal ba med do/ /de la cho ga ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sa ngas rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing /byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun du sbyar ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de rnams kyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang /—3—

byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya —ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ gso spyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /g.yin gyi nor ni blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri gdan che mtho mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang 'phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni//srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang //bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang dkrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ a mo gha shī la sam+bha ra/ sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ mahā shudha/ satwa pad+ma bi bhu ṣi ta/ bhu dza dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a ba shwe1 ki te huX phaṭa/ ces tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs/ bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /zhes sogs kyi smon lam gdab/ de dag ni cho ga'i sngon du grub na legs pa'i yan lag yin gyi/ ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas mchod pa byin brlab ni/ oṃ a mra ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa ṭa khri/ sarba 'a swa bhā wa shuzlo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/—4—

dri mchog zhal zas rnams dang / g.yin yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/oṃ badz+ra ngu khyuX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra put+paX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dh+wa paX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dī paX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai be r+yaX swāhā/ oṃ badzo shasta swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs dang / rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol byas te byin dbab/ 'di ma gtogs pa'i mchod pa byin rlabs 'og ma rnams la dharma ra ṇi dang rol chen mi dgos so/ /dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed sgom bzlas/ mdun bskyed sgrub ma rdzo/ gtor ma dbul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la: dam pa'i chos rnams la: 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la: zhes gsum nas nyi shu rtsa rtag gi bar ci rigs kyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgaX dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs

thams cad kyis bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX dpal ldan lha mo ston ga'i zla ba'i mdog / zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta urdzi ṣa bi dza ya sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra ca swāhā/ de bzhi du/ pu duX/ pulgedhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ ni be du/ sha lta pra ca swāhā/ phyag gyo yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de nasathal mo sbyar te rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ 'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang / /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dag/de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /tshe rabs gang yang rung ba na/ /bdag gis r+shasdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan dag dang / /tshe rabs 'di dang 'khor ba na/ /'dod chags dbang dang blun pa dang / khro ba dag gis 'khrugs gyur te/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nam/ /bla ma dag dang pha ma dang / /dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sbyin gnas gang yang rung ba dang / /de las gzhan pa'i sems can dag /yon tan ldan dang mi ldan la/ /sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis dang / /gang yang bgyid du rtsal ba dang / /gang yang cung zad yi rang ba/ /bag med pas ni phra mo yang / /lus ngag yid kyis bgyis pa rnams/ /de dag ma lus blos bsdus nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /bdag gis da ni mngon sum bzhin/ /rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ /skyo ba'i yid du gyur pa yis/ /thal mo sbyar te nongs pa rnams/ /yang dang yang du so sor bshags/ /bdag gi mi dge bgyis pa rnams/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen pa bzhin/ /de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags/ /slan chad de ltar —6—

yongs mi bgyid/ /mi rtog blo gros bskyed pa'i phyir//chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dang / /gdul bya ji srid tshim bar du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs//srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi ji srid 'tsho yi bar/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gus pas yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i/ /sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang / /ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang / /nyon mongs rnams las dgrol ba'i phyir/ /srid pa mi bde dogs pa na/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs ci mchis pa/ /de ltar yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /sems can 'phongs pa thams cad kyi/ /skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu shog /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /rten med rnams kyi rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing / /sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang / /bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang / /'di dang gzhan du bsags pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes zhes bya yi/ /tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug sgo nas/ /bdag gis brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa/ /de yang sems can ma lus pa/ /thams cad la ni phan par shog /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su/ /de bzhin du ni smos lam 'debs/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang / /thams cad nad kyang med par shog /bdag ni bya ba kun nus shing / /yon to dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can/ /bzod ldan dge la dad pa dang / /sems can —7—

tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog ces lan gsum/ shin tu bsdus pa la dga' na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags byed/ de nas tshad med bzhi sgom ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ shā n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du dh+waX las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten du gyur pa ni/ rin po che'i rang ba|na seng khri'i steng du pad+ma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim gsum brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ steng du rin po che'i khri/ gdugs bcu gsum/ char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi 'phreng ba/ dar gyi lda ldi sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i bum pa'i nang du/ /pad+ma dang zla ba'i gnad la/ bhāX las sna tshogs rdo rje zlaX gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma/ sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas pad+ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa bsnams pa/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/g.yon dang po zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/—8—

gsum pas skyabs spyin gyi phyag rgya/ bzhi pas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ phyogs g.yas rnga yab dang / g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong po 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ phyag g.yas rnga yab dang / g.yon ut+pal la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po 'dzin pa/ de gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho la bab pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i skur gyur/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi phyogs bzhir khro bo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing kha rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod cing / spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs su byas pa/ stag lpags dang / sprul gyi brgyan can/ rol ba'i khro bo chen po ste/me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso mo'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po/ snying khar huX sngon po/ dpral bar traX ser po/lte bar sdiXdamar po/ brla gnyis la aX aXljang khu/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor —9—

rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba thā ta ga ta urdzi ṣa bi dza ya sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaX de bzhin du sbyar/ ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaXhūX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gis lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khore dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ nas/shasta pra titsā sruhwa'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye huX/ zhes gsungs shing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta urdzi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri snya ra badz+ra ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ nas/badz+ra sha lta pra titsā grwa spyo bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdogazhes sogs kyis bstod/ snying khar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la/ zlaX yig bsrung bya sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ lkoX huX traX khyiX.aXḍi a/ bdag dang bsgrub bya la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes cung zad bzlas/ lag pa gnyis thal mo mnyam par sbyar ba'i mdzub mo'i tshigs bar pa bcag /mtheb mdzub rtse sprad de/ gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod la dam la bzhag /de rjes gzungs ring nyid gtso bor bzla zhing / sngags thung gnyis kyang ci rigs su bzla'o/ /oṃ a mra te/ a mṛ to ta bha be/ a mṛ ta bi grwan te/ a mṛ ta ga —10—

tre/ a mṛ ta gā mi ni/ a mṛ ta ā yur dad te/ ga ga na/ kir ti ka re/ sarba karma kle sha k+ṣa yaX ka rī ye swāhā/ zhes pa'ang tshe spel ba'i don du ci nus bzla'o/ /mthar/snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas yongs su drangs te/ bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying khar thim/ zhes brjod/ ye shes pa gshegs 'dod cing bdag bskyed kho na yin na/'og nas 'chad pa'i rjes bsdu ba de bya zhing / mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/ rjes chog gi mthar byas pas rung ba yin la/ spyir bya rgyud kyi lha sngags la/ rgyud sde gong ma'i thun mong gi cho ga sbyar ba ‘ji sna/ rigs la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs pa mtha' gcig tu yang mi dgos la/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar de ltar byed pa yang mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba / lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du/ gaX las rin po che las grub pa'i zhes pa nas/ bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaX༄zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma/ zhes pa'i rang nyid ces pa dor/ sa mā dzaX'i rjes la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes pa nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ zhes spro na dbyangs dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ yang mchod pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan gyi bar yang gong dang 'dra ba las/ bdag la mngon par zhes ba/ 'di la mngon par zhes —11—

par spo/ de nas mchod pa gsar pa'ang bshams shing / snga ma rnams kyang kha gsos la/ gong bzhen byin rlabs bya/ chu bo ga d+ma'i rgyun bzhin du/ /a rgyu'i rgyun yang mi 'chad de/ /bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul na/ /thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u sgri ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro snya hā/ dri zhim reg na bde ba yi//zhabs bsil rgyun yang sogs/ pu duX/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam nyid kyis//de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba/ /de ltar bdag gis lha rnams la/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba de ba ta a rtsi ta a mṛ ta swāhā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la rig na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ sarba sogs/ badz+ra pa sta ye: 'phreng ba rin chen se mo do shal dang / /rgyan gyi dam pa ma lus phul pa yis/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyan dang ldan gyur nas/ /bla med thar pa mchog la gnas par shog/theg mchog bla re mgon skyabs gdugs dang ldan/ /bdud bcom rgyal mtshan ba dan ting 'dzin 'phan/ /bdag dang 'gro ba'i don du 'bul lags kyi/ /dbang mchog dam pa dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ /u bsta na: sna tshogs rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dag dang / /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par rab brgyan pa/ /theg pa mchog gi nges pas bgrod par shogaspa ra na da: gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag/bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par —mdzod/ /ga rnye: ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bi sde dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ gtsang zhing gtsang —12—

mar skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di/ /bdag ni sogs/ pu 〉 ā ha ra dri yi rgyas pa lha yis rdzas/ /nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di/ /bdag la : dh+wa ba ā ha ra/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas rme mig 'di dag /bdag: ni be du: ā ha ra/ gnod pa 'joms shing bkra shis pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di/ bdag: ā lo ke: ā lo kā ā lo kā biṅgā dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/ zhes pa ni mchod pa dkyus so/ /stong mchod kyi skabs ni/ zhal zas sogs stong phrag du spel ba la/ mchod pa sgos su bsngo bar 'dod na/ stong tshan lnga po la/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta smyoXbi shwa mu khe khyuX sarba thā khaX ud ga te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhal zas/ mar me/ spos rnams la sngags spyi 'gro dang / gdugs la tsha tre ka /ba dan la pa taX ka zhes sbyar ba lan mang du bzlas pas mchod/ snga ma'am/ stong mchod gang yin yang drang / mthar/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang / /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag las/ /nges par kun du 'byung gyur cig /tshigs bcad bzhi ngo de dag re re'i mthar rol chen dang / rol mo byin 'bebs kyi sngags dang / mchod pa'i sprin gyi —13—

gzungs gang wo re brjod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ slob dpon tsan+t+ra go mis mdzad pa 'di bya ste/gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma ni/ /puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i me tog ltar/ /skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /zhal gsum phyag brgyad spyan gsum mnga'/ /dbu rgyan mgul rgyan snyan cha'i tshogs/ /rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pas brgyan/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dbus dkar g.yas ser g.yon zhal sngo/ khro mo'i zhal ni mche ba gtsigs/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rje rje dang / /pad steng rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /mda' dang mchog sbyin phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /gzhu dang mi 'jigs phyag rgya can/ /rin chen bum pa legs par bsnams/ /be+e ro tsa nas dbu rgyan zhing / /'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du//stod g.yogs lha yi na bza' can/ /mchod rten nang na legs par bzhugs//blo dang tshe 'phel mdzad pa mo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma nyid la bstod/ /g.yas na rje btsun sbyan ras gzigs/ /sku mdog dkar po skyon ma gos/ /g.yon pas pad+ma g.yas pa na/ /rnga yab 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon na gsang ba'i bdag po ni/ /ut+pal mdog 'dra rdo rje g.yon/ /g.yas pas rin chen rnga yab 'dzin/ /mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ khar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/khro bo'i rgyal po bzhi po ni/ /mdun na khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon/ /sngo sangs g.yas pa ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad pa yis/ /ma rungs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni/ /sngo sangs lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams/ /ma rung 'dul ba'i cha lugs can/ /thams cad 'gugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro chen dgrag pa sngon po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa na//—14—

dbyug tho g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /sngo sangs kun 'dul khyod la bstod/khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che/ /ut+pal mdog 'dra phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa rjo rje sdigs mdzub g.yon/ /bdud 'dul drag po khyod la bstod/ /kun kyang sbrul dang stag lpags rgyan/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ /g.yon brkyang pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs/ /steng gi phyogs su bzhugs pa yi/ /gnas gtsang lha yi bu gnyis po/ /lha yi rgyan dang na bza' 'dzin/ /phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun kun la snyoms/ /dag pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/gang zhig nang par sngar langs nas/ /bstod pa 'di yis dus kun tu/ /'khor dang bcas la bstod byas na/ /blo dang tshe rnams 'phel par 'gyur/ /dpal dang 'byor ba'i dngos grub ster/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ gus pa'i yid kyis bsam bya zhing / /rtse gcig sems kyis bstod pa bya/ /bdag bskyed kyi dmigs pa mdun bskyed la go brje zhing / sngar gyi phyag rgya des me tog bzung ste gzungs ring tshar gcig bton nas/ swāhā zhes brjod pa'i me tog mdun bskyed la dor ro/ /de nas bzlas pa byed pa yin la/ de la gzungs ring spo/ rtsa sngags ni/ lkoX na mo bha ga wa te sa spru tri lo kya pra ti bi shis ya/ bzhi ya te na maX ta bya thā/ oṃ bhāX bhāX gaX/ sho dha ya/ sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a sa ma sa man+ta a ba bhā sa spo re rje ga ti ga ga na su bhā wa bi shudhe/ a bhi khiñtsa tu māX/ sarba ta thā ga tāX su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na/ a tsho ta a bhi ṣe kai ra/mahā mu drwa man+t+ra pa deX ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ma ma ā yus nā ra ṇi/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na swa bhā wa bi shudhe/ urdzi ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shudhe sa ha sra ra smi sa nyo di te/ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ni/ khug ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi/—15—

sarba ta thā ga ta mā te/ da sha bhā mi pra ti nyi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a rnge na a dhiṣ+ṭha te/ mu dre mu dre/ mahā hūṃ dre/ badz+ra kā ya saX ha ta na pa ri shudhe sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shudhe/ pra ti ni brta ya/ ma ma ā yurmi shudhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya a lnga na adhi spyi te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ mahā mu ni bi mu ni bi mu ni/ mahā bi mu ni/ ma ti ma ti/ mahā ma ti/ ma ma ti/ su ma ti/ ta thā tā/ bhā ta ko ṭi pa ri shudhe/ bi spru ṭa/bu rnye shudhe/ he he dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma re sma ra/ spa ra spa ra/ spa ra ya spa ra ya/ sarba bud+dhā a 'a dha ṣ+ṭha na a dhi nyi te/ shudhe shudhe/ budhe chu/ badz+re badz+re mahā badz+re/ su badz+re/ badz+ra gar+bhe/ dza ya gar+bhe/ bi dza ya gar+bhe/ badz+ra dz+wa lā gar+bhe/ badzo dha be/badz+ra sam+bha be/ badz+re badzi ṇi/ badz+re nga ri/ ma ma shā rī raX/ sarba satwa nāñtsa kā ya/pa ri sdo ( 4 / wan+tu me sa dā/ sarba ga ti pa ri shu rmi shu/ sarba ta thā ga tā rtu māX/ sarba sa twaXlga sa mā shā sa ya skye/ bu bh+yo bu spyo/ siju si rgyu/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bi bo dha ya bi bo bha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ sa ma nā mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ sa man+ta ra smi/ pa ri shudhe/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a nga na a dha nyi te/ mu dre mu dre/ mahā mu dre mahā mu drwa ma spro pa diXswāhā/zhes pa'o/ /de ltar na/ de nyid bzlas pa'i gtso bor bya zhing / gong du bshad pa ltar tshe sgrub kyi gzungs dang / tseX( bhuX swāhā/ zhes pa dang / glu tshe a mṛ ta ā yur da dhe swāhā/ /zhes pa'ang ci nus su bzla'o/ /de yang / thugs dam bskul ba'i gzungs tshar gcig brjod rjes su/ bzlas pa byed pa tsam dkyus ma'i lugs yin la/ stong mchong kyi skabs yin na/ slar yang tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ /dpal ldan lha mo sogs kyis bstod/bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ bum pa yongs su —16—

gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas pa dngos la/ o na mo zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ thob thang la phyag dngos su 'tshal ba yin na'ang / lag len la thal mo sbyar nas mgo 'dud par re byed/gzungs bzla mkhan bcu yod pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzungs ring tshar bcu song ba'i rjes su mchod bstod bsdus pa re bya/ de ltar lan bcus gzungs stong phrag gcig 'gro ba yin pa las/ gzungs bcu tshan lnga tsam song ba/ gzungs re re la bskor ba gnyis gnyis 'gro bar byas pas/ bskor ba yang stong 'gro/ 'di'i rigs sgres te/ gzungs bzlas mkhan mang nyung gi rtsis gdab ma 'khrugs par bya dgos te/ dper na bzlas pa byed mkhan nyi shu yod na lnga tshan bcu dang / bzlas pa byed mkhan lnga las med na nyi shu tshan bcu byed dgos pa bzhin no/ /gtor ma stong phrag bsngo ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hu lan gsum/ de nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad la dmigs nas/ /a kā ro'i sngags kho na stong phrag gcig gis bsngo ba las/ sngags brgya brgya song ba'i mtshams su/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig/dam can thugs dam skong gyur cig /rigs drug gtor mas tshim gyur nas/ /lan chags bu lon khyer ba dang / /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /de rjes 'bud dkrol gyi sgra dang bcas/ 'dod don gang yin pa de gsol ba drag tu gdab bo/ /gsum pa ni/ gtor ma dang po/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hu gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañtsa ra ṇa hū phaṭa kyis sbyangs/ oṃ ā kā ro mu kha/ sarba dharma ṇa/ a du nu tra sno twa ta kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /gzungs ring tshar gcig gi mthar/ u : ṣa —17—

bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra khyuX oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis gsol ba btab/rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma'ang gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ dha ta ra ga ya oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum/ oṃ bi ru lha kā ya dang / oṃ bi ru sbi k+ṣu ya dang / oṃ be+e shra ba ṇa ya zhes pa rnams la'ang / a kā ro sbyar ba lan gsum gyis phul/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /mar gad mdog can pi waX 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba//yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i//'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig/mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sprul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub phyogs su: ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin//gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang phyogs su mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don zhu/ de nas bar 'dir gtor ma cha gsum btang / /rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ ma cer yon phal cher sogs kyis tshigs bcad dang spel ba'am/ ma spel kyang rung ste/ ar+ghaX nas sha sna'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang yo gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ bdag —18—

cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang zhing dag nas/'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod don gsol btab/ bdag bskyed kyi lha gshegs su gsol bar 'dod na/ rjes chog gi sngon du bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ mchod bstod man chad lhan gcig tu byas na zor yang zhing so sor byed na mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams gshegs su gsol ba'i rjes la byed pa yin kyang / rgyud sde gong ma'i sgrub pa pos ni/ gshegs su mi gsol ba nyid bzang bar mthong ngo / /de nas yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs kyis mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ /mchod rten dang ras bris la dmigs nas brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba bsngo ba dang shis brjod rol mo dang bcas pa bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu zhing bum chus sems can la phan gdags par bya ba las bsgrub bya dmigs gsal can la/ /khrus kyis rjes su bzung dgos na/ dang por zhi ba dang /zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag po'i sgo nas bgegs sbyangs/ de rjes til lam nyungs kar gyis sdig sgrib sbyang ba yang byas na legs/ de nas snying kha'i 'od zer gyis/ dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis spyan drangs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang / bsgrub bya'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa tsam byas nas/ nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis cho ga mdzad par mos nas/ dngos su bkru byab bsrung gsum/ bkra shis dang bcas pa bya/ nam mkha'i lha mchod nas rang bzhin gyi gnas su bzhugs par sgom/ bkru byab bsrung gsum gyi bya ba 'di gzhan dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ 'dir zhib par ma smos so/ /byin rlabs mchog gi gzi byin zla bral bas/ /sdig 'phrog mi 'gyur tshe yi dpal ster ba//gang —19—

gi cho ga'i lag len gsal por bshad/ /dge rgya 'dis tshe dpag med pa'i gnas thob shog/ //ces pa'ang shin tu nyer mkhor mthong nas/ 7 rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// bkra shis//༄khya/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bum chog dang bcas pa bzhu/gas/oṃ snya sti/ na mo gu ru ba ṅgā bo dhi sa te khyoX srid gsum las rgyal sgrub pa'i dga' ston can / /rab 'bar 'od zer stong gi gzi brjid kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms gang der phyag gi gnas/ /sngags kyi 'phrin las cung zad tsam zhig spel/ /'dir rdo rje rnam 'joms ljang khu dpa' bo gcig pa'i bum chog nyer mkho ni/ stegs bu'am gzhi gtsang ma la/ rdul tshon nam ras bris pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ bum pa mgul bcings kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ steng du dung chos mchod yon dang bcas pa dang / gzungs thag rdo rje yang bshams/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa dang / 'jig rten 'das gtor gcig /cha gsum dang bcas pa rnams kyang lag len bzhin bshams/ khrus sngon du 'gro bas/ gtsang sbra'i spyod pa la gnas bzhin du/ spro na rnam rgyal lha dgu'i bum chog tu bshad pa ltar/ phyag 'tshal dang yan lag bdun pa bya/ khyim pa zhig yin na bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa yang bzung ngo / /mdor bsdus pa'i tshe de dag mi dgos la/ mchod pa byin brlab ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta kun li ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ me ta bo/ bdug spos/ mar me/ dri myong/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang —20—

rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ oX badz+ra pu duX swāhā/ oX badz+ra put+paX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dh+wa paX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dī paX swāhā/ oX badz+ra ga rnye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi t+ya swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ro / ga spru hā/ oX badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs dang / so so'i phyag rgya bya/ mthar rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol byas ste byin dbab/ de dag ni sngon 'gro yin no/ /bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes gsum nas nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar ci rigs kyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bya'o/ /lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying khar pad nyi la hūX ljang sngon/ de las 'od 'phros/ lus gang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sna bug nas phyir spros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaX grub pa rigs sngags kun gyi gtso/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dkyil 'khor ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems —21—

tshogs dang / /bla mar bcas pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaX pra ca swāhā/ nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sogs3 med bzhi bsgom/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba dra ba/ gur bla re/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la huX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i nye ba la huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/zhal khro ma 'dzu5 gyi rnam pa can/ mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu skra ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa mnga' zhing / ma lus pa'i sprul pa 'chang ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX ar+ghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra aX ku sha dzaX oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūX/ oṃ badz+ra spo ṭa baX/ oX —22—

badz+ra ā be sha a/ slar yang snying kha'i hu las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khore dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra zhes pa sbyar te/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi khri nyu tu ma/ zhes/ gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hū/ zhes dbang bskur/sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/slar yang / ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi/ /rdo rje rin chen kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba'i nang du/ hū gi tha mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs nas/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa: nas/rab tu smras rbe'i bar tshar gcig /dngos gzhi sngags gsum po ci nus su bzla ba las/ gsum kar sbrags te tshar gcig nges par 'don la/ de nas rang gi mos pa dang sbyar te/ gsum kar sbrags pa kho na bzla ba'am/ gsum po gang rung gcig bzla bar bya'o/ /de la na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ dang po nas/ dz+wa la grwahwa'i bar rtsa sngags/ na mo rat+na dra yā ya/ 'og ma nas/ dhin+ta dhin+ta badz+ra hu phaṭa kyi bar snying po'o/ /na ma shu hā badz+ra kro dha ya hu lu hu lu man chad nye snying ngo / /rtsa sngags kyi a mu ka ma ra ya:lko pa ni/ gnod byed 'byung po ma ra ya:spyo 'don pa spo/ bzlas pa'i mthar/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ zhes pa man chad phan yon tshar gcig 'don/bdag bskyed kho na byed na/ skabs 'dir lha 'od gsal du bsdu ba'am/ mchod cing bstod nas gshegs su gsol ba gang rung byed pa yin na'ang / mdun bskyed dang sbrel nas byed pa la/ skabs 'dir de gnyis ka mi bya'o/ /de dag ni bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'o/ /—23

de nas bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhāX las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhus pa/ rme grin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul ba bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i nang du/ paX las pad+ma dang / raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la huX las/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis spyan drangs/ yang ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod pa sogs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan gyi bar yang bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil la sogs shasta'i bar du sbyor/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs gcig tu gyur pa ni/ /rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis/ /mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /kun nas 'bar ba'i me dpung gi/bskor ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rgyas pa pad+ma yi/ /snying po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'gyings pa'i tshul gyis legs bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la 'dud/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sku ma/dog mar gad ltar gsal ba/ /rgyun rnams kun gyis rnam par spras/ /sprul pa'i 'eng —24—

zer 'phro la 'dud/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa dang / /dpal dang brtse ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /dbang phyug dam pa khyod la 'dud/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phyag g.yas kyis/ /nyid kyi thugs kar 'gyings nas bsnams/ /g.yon pa dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ /rnam rol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi rigs sngags nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug sgra stong bzhin rab bsgrags pas/ /bdud dpung ma lus rnam gnon zhing / /'dod dgu spyin par mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zab pas nyer zhi yang / /rgya che rol bas kun khyab mdzad/ /mi g.yo kun khyab rtag brtan pa/ /ye shes dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan 'phrin las rin chen gyi/ /mi mdzad gter gyur mgon khyod la/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/zhes bstod/ bum bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sna tshogs rdo rje sbub stong du yod pa'i nang du/ bsgrub bya gang yin de gsal btab la/ thugs kha'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las spros pa'i 'od zer bsgrub bya'i lus la phog pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib mtha' dag zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gzungs mdo 'don ṣ+ka / sngags bzla tshul ni bdag bskyed dang 'dra bas/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying rnams rim pas phyi ma mang bar bzla'o/ /mthar ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ gang thugs sogs kyis bstod/ gzungs thag bsdu/ gtor ma dang po rdo rje gnod spyin gyis phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hu gis bgegs sbyangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang / hu badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañtsa ra ṇa —25—

hūX phaṭa kyis ma dag pa bsregs shing / gzi brjid rgyas par byas/rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs tshul bya zhing / oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX a du shukra na rwad/ oṃ āXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ zhesapas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho byin gyis brlabs/ nye snying gi mthar/ a kā ro sbyar ba lan bdun gyis phul/ yang gong bzhin mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grus 3|ga gi bar gyis gsol ba 'debs te/mdun bskyed 'khor dang bcas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas cha gsum gyi cho gas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma btang / mchod pa kha gso/ byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs par 'dod na/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ ar+ghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod pa byed dgos pa las/ spro na/ rab 'jums rgya mtsho dpag med na/ zhes sogs kyang brjod/ bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib dang nad gdon dang 'khon grib dang / mi gtsang ba thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis —26—

ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par ma ljadi/ /lan gsum/ oṃ u hu/ zhes pas dung chos kyi chu bum par blug /bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur/oṃ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra mu zhes gtor mgron rnams gshegs shing / bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa yang gshegs par 'dod na/ de rnams dang lhan cig tu'o/ /smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'tshams pa bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma man chad de rnams rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /'dir yang rgyas pa la mos na/ legs grub las 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor bsngo yang bya ste/ rnam rgyal lha dgu'i bum chog tu bkod zin to/ /'di dag tu rten sku gzhan yod na/ bum pa'i (〈spo〉 )lha 'od du )zhu zin pa'i skabs der/ rten la brtan bzhugs bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du 〈spo〉 rtse rtag tu ) rgyal ba rnams myang ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi 'am/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs 'di rnams thams cad/ ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlud gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du —27—

gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can:zhes sogs bya'o/ /de nas bsgrub bya 'ga' zhig la/ bkru byab bsrung gsum bya dgos na/ mtheb rgyu ting lo dang changs bu gsum gsum la/ lag len bzhin chab btang / badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs sngags shaṃ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma bskor zhing / oṃ sarba spre khyuXn maXsarba ta thā ga ta sbyoXbi shwa mu khe khyoX sarba thā khaX ut+na/ te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX gro ste daX ba ling ta ye swāhā/ se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi zhi ba'i sbyang ba dang /ting lo dang / 'cha bu sbyar la bskor zhing rdo rje gsor bzhi pas/ /oṃ nga ni nga ni huX/gro hā gro hā huX/ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX/ ā na ya ho bha wān bi du rā dza huX phaṭa swāhā/lan gsum gyi mthar/ tshe dang ldan pa'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ rdo rje slob ma'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'am/ bsgrub bya 'di zhes bgyi ba la bar du gcod par brtson pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma 'di lam brngan/ ting lo 'di lam sgron/ 'chang bu 'di lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /ces brjod de zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang / rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX hūX ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ces pa nas/ 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra e hre hi/ zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya/stuX gyis gdan phul/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX nas/ ni we rkye'i bar phul/spros pa la dga' na/ chos nyid stong pa sogs kyi yang bstod/ bsdu na/ 'jigs pa'i huX sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma —28—

lus stso'i/ pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hu mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas te/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas: chos kyi: dge 'dun gyi: gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kya gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyingubaden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs gyis/ bsgrub bya 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin rdo rje khro bo'i bka' thos pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lha'i nga rgyal shugs drag pos rdo rje gsor zhing yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul sogs kyis bdug cing / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring thung rnams drag tu bzla la/ spros pa la dga' na rol mo'i sgra byed cing / rnam 'joms kyi snying po dang / nye snying bzla ba'i srol snang ba yang 'gal ba med par sems/ rgyas pa la dga' bas khro bo la mchod bstod bden brdar bgegs bskrad rnams lan gsum byed pa'i srol yang snang ngo / /de nas til lam yungs kar gyi sbyang ba ni/ bsgrub bya rang nyid kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad/ snying gar yi ge ka yig nag po'i rnam par gnas pa/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas/ mdun gyi til lam yungs kar la thims/ de nyid g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor bar 'gyur/ oṃ —29—
