sarba pā paX da ha na bhasmi ku ru ye swāhā/ lan gsum bzlas/ til lam yungs kar bskor zhing me dang chur dor/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sma ma dzaX mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa nas/ a mṛ te hūX phaṭa kyi bar tshar cig brjod la/ sarba pā paX khyuX shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ sarba sda khyu: sarba ྅jin: sarba gra he sarba dz+wa re:sarba byā ti sarba u pa drwa be: sarba a ka la spi t+pa: sarba du ra so ba ni: sarba du ra mi te: sarba tsit+ta ku le khyuXtshan sto ku ru snya hā/ zhes brjod cing khrus byar gzhug /nad pa'i rigs 'ga' zhig sogs dngos su khrus bya mi 'dod na/ me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru'o/ /byabs pa ni/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba la sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'khod/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad rdo khab len gyi lcags phye len pa ltar blangs te phyir dor bar mos la/ gzungs yongs rdzogs sam nye snying gi mthar/ sarba pā paX khyuXsogs la/ shan+ti ku dra'u tshab tu/ a pa na ya swāhā/ zhes pa btags la byab/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs de rnams slar mi ldog par bya ba'i ched du bsrung ba bya ba ni/ bsgrub bya'i spyi bo dang / mdun rgyab dang / dpung pa g.yas g.yon dang / dpyi g.yas g.yon te/ gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram re re/de las de 'dra ba'i rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros nas/ lus la rdo rje'i go bskon par gyur/ gzungs yongs rdzogs sam nye snying gi mthar/ sarba pā paX khyuX sogs la/ rak+ṣaXrak+ṣaX zhes btagasal bsgrub bya'i gnas bdun dang / spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag /mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i nus mthu yis/ /—30—

'gro ba 'di ni bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis/ /'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /de nas/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas te/ /zhes man chad tshar cig ston la/nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams la dmigs nas mchod bstod cig byas te/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can sogs/ gshegs su gsol/ bsgrub bya la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod do/ /yang bsgrub bya dbang bskur thob pa sogs 'ga' zhig la/las kyi rjes ma bsdus par/ bum pa'i lha zhu zin ma thag tu/ bsgrub bya'i bya ba rnams byas la/mgron dang khrus kyi lha lhan cig tu gshegs/ de nas las rjes bsdus te/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas pa brjod pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /kun la grags shing yig ge mang yod kyang / /gzhan gyi bskul phyir mdo tsam bris pa yin/ /gang des dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo thob par shog /ces pa 'di yang don gnyer ba mang po'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ dpal jo mo nang gi ri khrod du'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis/ skos byed dge slong mchi med sor rtses skrun/ /dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang myur du thob pa dang / rgyal khams kun du dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /maṅgal//—31—

༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdul rdzo klu la gtod pa'i lag len bzhugs tre sto /oṃ spru sti/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdul tshon klu la gtong pa'i lag len ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad sogs tshogs par byas nas/ rdul tshon bkur sti dang bcas te/ chu rgyun rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo'am/ mtsho sogs gting zab cing skam par mi 'gyur ba'i chu 'gram du rdo leb bam maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyis pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad legs par 'bri ba'am spar btab kyang rung ste/ lte ba dang 'dab ma la rdul tshon nam me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod yon la sogs pa'i chu dang / g.yas su nyer spyod lnga/ mdun nas 'go brtsams te rgyab kyi bar du zug ma/ g.yon du dkar gtor 'o mas bran pa dang / snod gcig tu 'o thug gam/ ma 'byor na 'o ma phal pa blug /de'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gang bde ba zhig tu cung zad stegs bu mtho bar bum pa la sogs pa'i snod bzang por rdul tshon bzhugs su gsol/ gla rtsi sogs klu la gnod par 'gyur ba spangs pa'i bdug spos brtul zhing / las bum gyi lha'i sngags bdun tsam bzlas la/ mchod pa sogs/ a mṛ ta'am su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āXhuX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhes pa nas/ rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon to bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā nas/ sha lta āXhūX/yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/paX las byung ba'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar po rin po che dang / me tog gis gang ba/—32—

rlabs 'phreng dang bcas pa'i dbus su pa las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ hū las rdo rje dkar po hu gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang snang gi yum gyis 'byud pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgya mtsho chen po nas klu chen po brgyad la sogs pa klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza su myu'am a mṛ tas bsangs/dza / ba ho gdan la 'khod par gyur pa ni 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mtha' yas/ lhor ni pad+ma dang / nub tu 'jog po/ byang du nor rgyas dang / me ru dung skyong bden bral karko ṭa/ rlung du rigs ldan dbang ldan pad+ma che/ thams cad kyang lha'i lus can sku mdog dkar po sprul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ sbrul mjug 'khyil zhing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag thal mo sbyar zhing rang rang gi rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor du klu'i rigs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ sarba nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra tisnro swāhā nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mtho/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing //bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lag pa g.yon pa gdengs ka'i tshul dang / g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang / /lha mo lha mo chen po dang //zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang hu 'u lto/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' 'o/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po —33—

dang / /tsha ba tsha ba wo po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin wo 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /gzugs mdzes chen po sprul bzang dang //lto 'phye chen po shī li dang / shwe li chen po rnam dag go /oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa a ga smo ā ga tsā mahā nā ga a dhi pa ti sarba sgyi wa phru phru swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lnga'am/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ gong bzhi mchod bstod bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ deng de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdul tshon rin po che 'di rnams bdag gir mdzad nas/ yang dag par mchod pa byed pa sogs mdor na sa phyogs 'di nyid nas brtsams te/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting mthar thug pa'i bar du gnas pa'i sems can rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / sa phyogs 'di skor du lo legs shing nad med pa la sogs pa/ dge zhing bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi zhes pa'am/ gtsug lag khang na gnas pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi/ zhes sogs ji ltar skabs su bab pa'i tshig sbyar la/ chos spyod 'phel ba dang / bar chad zhi ba dang / bstan pa rgyas pa dang / yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad gegs med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba —34—

rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /yig brgya'i mthar/ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas sogs dang /oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyi mthar/ ga smo rte swas+thā nā/ oṃ ā hū mu zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas klu rnams gshegs par mos/ dza hu ba ho zhes rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bsdu ba'am mi dmigs par sbyangs/ thog mar rdul tshon chu bor blug /mchod pa yang zhal zas nas mchod yon gyi bar rim gyis bsdus nas chu bor dor/ de ma thag klu brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor nyid kyang chu la dor/ gzhi ma maṇ+ḍal yod na der 'khru zhing / rdul tshon gyi snod bum pa'ang legs par bkrus nas chu gtsang mas dgang ste/ tse( ru ru sbu ru sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags bzla bzhin du dkyil 'khor khang par 'ong bar bya'o/ /'di la klu brgyad po rang rang gi kha dog so sor byed pa'ang yod de/ mtha' yas sngo la pad+ma dkar/ /'jog po nor rgyas dmar dang ljang / /dung skyong dung mdog stobs rgyu'ang ljang / /rigs ldan sngo la pad chen ser/ /zhes 'dod pa ltar byas kyang rung / gsang 'dus skor dang gshin rje gshed skor nas khro bo'i rgyan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar yang rung / phyogs dang sku mdog rnams dur khrod kyi skabs 'byung ba ltar byas na'ang 'gal ba med/ gzhan yang rdo rje gur las gtor ma'i skabs su gsungs pa lta bu la sogs pa ji ltar 'os par sbyar yang rung ngo / /phyogs g.yon skor du byed na/dbang por mtha' yas byang phyogs nor rgyas dang / /chu bdag 'jog po gshin rjer pad+ma 'o/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ gzhan yang mtshams kyi skor lugs dbang ldan thog mar byed pa'ang yod pas/ ji ltar 'os pa rig pas dpyad do/ /dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' mi byed par/ chu lha dkar po sbrul zhags dang ut+pal 'dzin pa/rig ma dang bcas pa sgom pa'ang yod cing / phu yig brgyad las klu brgyad bskyed pa sogs sna —35—

tshogs yod de/ de dag ji ltar 'os pa skabs su gang bab tu sbyor shes na so sor sbyar bar bya la/min na yang gong dkyus su bshad pa nyid gsang ba spyi'i cho ga yin pas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gang la yang spyor du rung bar shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul pa'i ngor/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// gcig zhus/ maṅgalaX/ /༄༅/ /rab gnas kyi cho ga 'gro phan rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhu/gas tre rgo /na mo badz+ra dha ra ya/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi thun mong du spyod pa gsang ba spyi'i cho ga las brtsams pa'i rab gnas 'bring po 'gro phan rgyas byed ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma mchog dang lhag pa'i lha/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la gus btud nas/ /sku gzugs la sogs byin rlabs pa'i/ /cho ga bsdus pa bri bar bya/ /de la slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dus gza' tshes skar ma sbyor ba byed pa sogs bzang ba la rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi 'byung bar bya ste/ de la rdul tshon nam/ ras bris sam/ blos bslang la sogs pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor la rten pa'am/ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig la rten pa yin yang rung ste/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa gcig la rten na nges par bzang zhing / lha dpa' bo gcig pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor la rten pas kyang rung ba tsam ni yin no/ /de yang skabs 'dir bsdus pa la mos pa'i lugs phyi'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa mi byed pa ltar na/ sa phyogs gang yang rung bar stegs bu'i steng du maṇ+ḍal/ /dbus su me tog gi tshom bu dgu tshom/ de'i phyi rol du/ phyogs bzhir tshom bu gnyis gnyis dang / mtshams bzhin re re/de'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir cung zad che ba'o/ /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na mtshams bzhir chung —36—

ba re yang 'god/ steng 'og gi khro bo'i tshom bu de'i shar nub tu bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la rbem rgyal bum pa bca' ba'am/ yang na de'i g.yas g.yon gang rung du bcas kyang rung / las bum ni maṇ+ḍal bcas phyin chad de'i g.yon du nges par 'cha'/ de'i mdun du mchod gtor yang spyi dang mthun par bshams/ go skabs yangs pa'i phyogs gang yang rung ba gcig tu gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yin yang bzhag /de yang ma 'byor na gzhi gtsang ma ji ltar 'os pas chog /de'i steng du 'byor zhing spro na khrus kyi bum pa brgyad phyogs mtshams brgyad du bshams shing / dbus su malji'i steng khrus gzhong dang / me long gos zung dri bzang sogs kyang bzhug par bya/ brgyad ma 'byor na bum pa bzhi'am/ de yang ma 'byor na gcig gis kyang rung ste/ bzhi yod na phyogs bzhir bum pa dang / dbus su mañdzi 'god/ gcig las med na dbus su bum pa 'god do/ /sku gzugs la sogs pa gang rab tu gnas par bya ba rnams kyang mngon du phyogs par bya'o//de la rab gnas nyin gcig pa'i cho ga la spyi sdom ni/ yo byad tshogs dang bkod pa legs par bshams/ /sngon 'gro gnyis dang bdag bskyed bum pa sgrub/ /sbyang ba khrus gsol rten bskyed ye shes dgug /dbang bskur mchod pa spyan dbye mnga' dbul bya/ /gsol gdab rjes mchog gtor ma yon bdag bsgo/ khres brjod rjes bsdu sbyin sreg zhes pa ste/ /cho ga'i rim pa bco brgyad nyid du 'dus/ /dang por bya ba gnyis dang nyi shu'o/ /mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yod na bsnan//med na bum pa maṇ+ḍal lhan cig sgrub/ /sbyang ba la gsum khrus gsol gnyis su nga shad/ /ye shes dgug la spyan 'dren bgegs bskrad dang / /mchod dang gsol btab sre (〈ram̐〉 ste ) ba zhes te lnga//mchod pa'i skabs su mchog gyur sbyin sreg yin/ /zas mchog byug pa so rtsi mchod bstod dang / /yo byad sngags kyi mnga' dbul zhes pa bdun/ /brtan bzhugs gnyis dang sngags dang ched brjod de//gsol btab yan lag bcas la rnam pa bzhi/ /mdun bskyed mchod dang bzod gsol gshegs —37—

gsol te/ /rjes mchog rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ba yin/ /yo byad bsdu dang lha bstim bdag nyid srung / /smon lam bkra shis rjes bsdu'i bya ba bzhi/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa la/ /cho ga'i yan lag lnga bdun drug tu bshad/ /de lta na/ cho ga spyi'i sngon 'gro gnyis dang / bdag bskyed dang / bum bskyed dang / brten sbyang ba dang / khrus gsol te sngon 'gro lnga'o/ /rten dam tshig par bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dgug pa/ dbang bskur ba/ mchod pa/ spyan dbye/ mnga' dbul/ gsol btab ste/ dngos gzhi cho ga bdun no/ /rjes chog /gtor 'bul/ yon bdag bsgo ba/ shis brjod rgyas pa/ rjes bsdu/ sbyin sreg ni rjes kyi bya ba drug ste/ de ltar bco brgyad do/ /dang po cho ga spyi'i sngon 'gro gnyis ni/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang / gnas dang yo byad byin 'bebs pa ste/ bdag bskyed gang byed pa'i cho ga de'i lugs sam/ yang na spyi 'gro yin pa'i phyir/mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / oṃ āXbighān+ta krita huX huX/ oṃ sā bhā wa5 stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang bhuX las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang huX zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ pu duX/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āXhūX nas shasta'i bar/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta spyo bi shwa nas/ khaX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaX/oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs rol chen bya/gnyis pa bdag bskyed ni/ de nas gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar rdzogs par bya/ dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa'i rigs yin na rang la bsdu/ lha rkyang re bsgoms pa yin na bsdu ba mi dgos so/ /

gsum pa bum bskyed ni/ lha'i bum pa la rdo rje gzungs thag dung chos sogs lag len spyi dang mthun pa bshams/ maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa la dmigs nas/ skye( āX'u krita hūX hūX gis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gnas su paX las pad+ma/raX las nyi ma/ huX las sna tshogs rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang ra gur phyi nang thams cad du ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur/de'i dbus su bhuX las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa'i gnas su paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcing dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang lha'i chu bo dang bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar gyur/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhal med khang dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa na/dbus su hūX las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol bas/rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdor dbyings dbang phyug ma'am/ reg bya rdo rje ma la 'byud pa/ shar du oṃ las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu/ lho ru swā las rin 'byung ser po nor bu dang dril bu/ nub tu āX las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu/ byang du hā las don grub ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu de rnams phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing rig sngags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i cha lugs can/ shar lhor laX las sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu maX las mā ma —39—

gī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du pa las gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du tā las sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ de rnams phyag g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ de'i phyi rol kyi shar gyi g.yas su d+ma las byams pa dang / g.yon du k+ṣi las sa'i snying po gnyis dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho ru dzi las phyag na rdo rje dang / rngo las nam mkha'i snying po ser po rin po che 'dzin pa/ nub tu ma las 'jam dpal dang / ga las 'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du sa las kun tu bzang po dang /ska las sgrib pa rnam sel gnyis ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de ltar brgyad po ni g.yas phyag mtshan thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon khu tshur dkur brten pa/shar lhor hū las sgeg mo dkar mo/ lho nub tu tra las 'phreng ba ma ser mo/ nub byang du sdi las glu ma dmar mo/ byang shar du u las gar ma ljang khu/ de lta na spyan ma la sogs pa de rnams thams cad sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /yang na sgeg mo la sogs pa'i dod du/rdo rje ma bzhi bskyed kyang shin tu legs so/ /gzhal yas khang gi sgo bzhi'am/ sgo bzhi sogs phyogs bcu dang / rnam rgyal bum/ pa'i nang gi phyogs bzhi'am/ phyogs bcur hu las khro bo bzhi'am bcur gyur pa ni/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lho ru shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje rwa gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na/shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon —40—

po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can nag po gshin rje'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che dud kha rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug gtor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'bor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po ga dzin shing 'dzin pa/ de rnams thams cad kyang khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad cing / zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /las bum gyi nang du hu las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa nag po g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon sbrul gyi zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can spyan gsum dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing / stag lpags dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ pad nyi la g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa ā thugs kar hu/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa dang / gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo'i lha tshogs thams cad dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzadza / ba ho yang snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' badz+ra sa mā dza ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi tiñtsa hwa/ ma sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hu/zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid dang /—41—

bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis ma rdzo/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs kyis bstod/ gzungs thag las bzung ste/ bum bzlas kyi dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ āXbadz+ra dhika huX huX/ oṃ āXdzi na dzika oṃ huX/tsho( ā:rat+na dhika swa huX/ h+ma( āX.a ro tsho lika āXhūX/ skye rna āXpradzñā dhika hā huX/ zhes pa rnams so/ /so sor brgya rtsa re las mi nyung ba bzla/ glu( āXlaX huX/ glu( āXmaX hūX/ glu sto āXpaX huX/ 8( āXtāX huX/ tsho( āXd+ma huX/ tso( āXsto huX/ glu6 āXdzi hūX/ tseX( gisaXkhaX hūX/ skye( āXmaX huX/ skye( gi/༷༷gaX huX/ skye( gi/༷༷skaX huX/ skye( gi/༷༷saX hūX/ glu( gi/༷༷hūX huX/ glu( gi/༷༷traX hūX/ tso( gi/༷༷lha / ༷༷huX/ tso( āX.aXhuraX/ zhes pa rnams kyang so sor bdun bdun tsam bzla/ skye( āXya mun+ta krita huX hūX/ tso( āXpratswa na krita hūX huX/ tsho( āXpad+man+ta krita huX hūX/ skye( āXspre krita hūX huX/ zhes pa rnams nyer gcig re bzla/ khro bo gas rnams kyi sngags bzla mi dgos shing / bzla bar spro na'ang 'di bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir/ oṃ āXhūX huX zhes pa kho na bdun bdun re bzlas pas chog go/las bum la dmigs nas de krita 'am/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ brgya rtsa sogs ci rigs bzla/shes shing spro na/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rtsa sngags kyang bzla'o/ /mthar oX āXsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūX swāhā/ zhes pa lan nyer gcig tsam bzla/gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ yaX las rlung / raX las me/ a las thod pa/ de'i nang du huX bhuX aX hri khaX las bdud rtsi lnga dang / baX bhuX hūX hri taX las sha lnga/ ha ho sdiXde rnams zhu ba las dam tshig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te gnyis su med par 'dres pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ lan gsum/ spro na gong du smos pa'i bzlas pa'i sngags re re'i mthar/a kā ro: btags pas 'bul/ de tsam mi lcogs na/ a kā ro lan bdun gyis dkyil 'bor —42—

snye———dang / rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha dang / lan gsum gyis las bum gyi lha la 'bul/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che: sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /bum bskyed kyi lha la dmigs nas yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byore pa dang sogs bzod gsol/ o ā hu/zhes mchod yon phul/ lha rnams rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su yongs su zhu ste/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi rnam par gyur/ dri ma khrus kyi bum pa rnams la dmigs/ he/bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bhu las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa lho ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcing dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan kla /nang dri ma sbyong ba'i mthu dang ldan pa'i lha'i chu bos gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hū/ zhes pa nyid brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus su bzla zhing mthar sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags brgya rtsa'am/ gtsug gtor rngam rgyal gyi gzungs lan bdun sogs ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /brtan par bya ba'i don du rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa dang / las thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i don du rten 'brel snying po'ang cung zad bzlas te khrus bum gyi gzungs thag bsdu'o/ /yang lag len bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed kho na la brten pas kyang drang bas/ maṇ+ḍal bshams pa dang / bskyed chog mchod pa 'di kun bor kyang chos pa tsam yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub mchod rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ lha bum dang las bum sgrub tshul so so'i lugs bzhin du grub na mchog yin mod/ gong du bshad pa de yang gsang ba spyi'i cho ga yin pas/ 'di kho na sbyar na yang shin tu legs par 'gyur ro/ /g.yin yang skabs 'dir dkyil —43

'khor rgyas pa dang 'brel na/ rten rnams dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pas 'jug dgos par gsungs kyang / cho ga rgyas pa'i dbang du byas nas de ltar byas na shin tu legs mod/ mtha' gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin la/ khyad par phyi dkyil rgyas pa med na 'jug pa'i cho ga mi dgos so/ /gzhan yang 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'di yan du tshags su chud par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rten sbyang ba ni rnam pa gsum las/ dang por bgegs sbyang ba ni/ skabs 'dir rten la rma chod pa cung zad bshams/ sngags tsam gyi phul/ mtheb kyu gsum dang / chang bu ting lor bcas pa gsum lag len bzhin bshams/ mtheb kyu rten la bskor ba'i tshul du byas te/ slob dpon gyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sbyo bi shwa mu khe khyu sarba tha kha ut+pa| te spa ra ṇa i ma ga ga na kha gro hā da ba ling ta ye swāhā/lan gsum/ 'dir rab tu gnas par bgyid pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad gtor ma rgya chen po 'dir tshim par gyis la phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /ting lo 4 bur bcas par bstor zhing / oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hu/gro hā gro hā hu/ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya hū/ ā na yi ho/ bha ga wān bi du rā dza hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ brjod cing rdo rje gsor/ deng 'dir rab tu gnas par bgyid pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i rigs gang yin pa thams cad ga rtang ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ myong bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dza ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i —44—

mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gzhan rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren gyi/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e hre hi/ oṃ badz+ra ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ hu chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa'i/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du bsdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol ba ston mdzad cing / /sdigs pa'i mtsho ni cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /sprul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stang stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i hu sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi sgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal —45—

ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / lung dang rtogs pas bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi: gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi: gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khrom mo rnams kyi: chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab cing rnam par dag pa'i:kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen pos byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir rab tu gnas par bgyid pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i bka' thos pas phyogs 'dir ma gnas par myur ba nyid du gzhan du songs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de thams cad dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba khro bo'i rdo rje'i me lce 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba shin tu lhag par 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par tsor ro/ /su bha ni dang / a mṛ ta sogs drag sngags drag tu 'don zhing /rdo rje gsor/ yungs kar brdegs/ gu gul dang bdud rtsi lnga sogs dud pas bdug rol chen dang bcas te bgegs gtor bzhi mdor dor/ de nas sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad snying khar yi ge ka nag po'i rnam par gnas pa/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam —46—

par gyur te/ mdun gyi til la thim/ de nyid g.yas su ye shes kyi mes sreg cing / g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor bar gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paX da ha na bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de dag ni bgegs sbyang ba dang sdig pa sbyang ba ste/ bod kyi slob dpon rnying pa rnams kyi lag len yin no/ /de nas byur bsal ba ni/ yungs kar dang chu lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis bzung ste bskor/ gzhan rnams lag pa gcig gis skor nas rten dang yon bdag gi byur bsal bar bsam ste/ de yang / tseX( sarba pā paX da ha na badz+ra ya swāhā/ zhes pas yungs kar me nang du dor/ de phyin chad rdzas 'di rnams la bsdu na sngags bisnrun+ta krita kho nas kyang rung la/ spros pa la dga' na sngags tha dad du bya ste/ oṃ hūX ḍa dhi ta phaṭa/ ces chu yang me nang du dor/ oX sarba saX sho dha ni swāhā/ spyo kham phor dkar po dang / oṃ sarba ma la a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya swāhā/ zhes dur ba dang bcas pa'i lci chang dang / oX pu n+ya dzñā na dha ra ṇa saX bha ra rdo pa ka ya swāhā/ zhes pas ting lo zan chang dang bcas pa dang / oṃ saX sho sogs sam/ oṃ bha ra bha ra saX bha ra swāhā/ zhes pas seng ras sam/ zan ril rnams te/ kham phor man chad snod du gsog gi me la mi dor ro/ /de lta na rdzas sngags drug po de rnams lan bzhi bzhi dgos pas drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba zhes bya'o/ /'dir yang mthar gong bzhin bden pa bdar/ rol mo dang bcas pas phyi rol tu 'dor ro/ /rten gyi mdun du dung chos kyi chu bzed zhal du sdugs bzhin pas/ oṃ ā hri pra ba ra sa t+pa ra ar thaX badz+ra añtsa ma naX pra titsā swāhā/ añtsa ma naX gyi gnas su pro k+ṣa ṇaX/ pā r+yaX/ar+ghaX/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye āXhūṃ gis dri bzang sku gzugs kyi thugs kar byug oX badz+ra pur+sha āXhūX gis dbu la me tog dkar po bzhag oṃ badz+ra a lo ke āXhuX gis mar me g.yas su bskor/ hūX bdun gyis sa rdza rā dza bdug spos g.yon du bskor/ rab tu gnas par bya ba'i —47—

rten de sku gzugs yin cing spro na nye reg kyang bya/ glegs bam mchod rten sogs la mi dgos shing /sku gzugs la'ang mtha' gcig tu ni ma yin no/ /de rnams ni byur bsal ba'i cho ga rgyas pa gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin yin te/ cung zad lag len rgyas pa'i skabs yin na/ gong gi sbyang ba gnyisasong ba'i rjes su byur bsal ba 'di yang bya zhing / bsdus pa la mos na/ sbyang ba gnyis po tsam bya ba'am/ byur bsal gdon (〈j-i〉gong na )byas pas rung ngo / / lnga pa khrus gsol ba ni/ thog mar rten gyi mchod pa snga ma bsal/ gsar pa cung zad bshams la/ yid kyis byin rlabs tsam bya/de nas las kyi rdo rjes khrus chal gyi snod dang / bsku mnye'i snod dang / dril phyis kyi snod rnams mtshar du dngar zhing / me long dang / chu gtsang gi bum pa dang / sku phyi ba'i ras gtsang ma rnams thogs la/ thog mar dman pa'i khrus bya'o/ /de yang khrus45 ni rnam pa lnga ste/ bdud rtsi lnga dang / ba byung lnga dang / dri bzang dang / skyu ru ra'i phye ma dang / yung ba'i phye ma rnams te/ de rlar ca thams cad 'dzom na rab/ thams cad ma 'dzom na ji i rnyed pa de tsam gyis rdzo go /bdud rtsi lnga ni/ 'o ma/ zho/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ ka ra dkar po rnams yin la/ ba byung lnga ni/ ba dmar zal gyi 'o ma/ zho/ mar/ lci ba/ chu rnams so/ /'di rnams thog mar byug rgyu mi gtsang ba gzhom pa'i phyir gyi 'dag rdzas la khrus chal zhes bya ba yin/ bsku mnye ni byug pa ste dri bzang gi til la mar ro/ /dril phyis ni shun lpags lnga'i phye ma la bshad kyang / bod du ma rnyed pas sran phyes bya la/ 'di yang 'dag chal lo/ / de'i lag len ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ ces pa'am/ oṃ birtswan+ta krita hūX huX/ zhes pa tshar gcig oṃ huX truX hriX.a/ zhes bzla zhing me long la khrus chal gyis byugs/ kā ya bi rbe('i sngags kyis drud/ yang a mṛ ta sogs kyi chu gtsang gis bkrus/ glu tshe huX bhāX khyiXkhaX kha zhes bzlas pas til mar gyis byugs/ tsod sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya —48—

bi sho dha ni ye swāhā/ zhes pas dur ba'i pir gyis drud/ sngags de nyid kyis dril phyis bto/yang sngags de nyid kyis drud/ a mṛ ta'i sngags dang / kā ya sogs sbyar bas chu gtsang gis bkru'o/ /de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /o hu t+yā hru a kā ya bi sho dha ni ye swāhā/ de ltar bsdu na tshar gcig po desachog la/ rdzas rnams 'dzom zhing long skabs yod na/ khrus chal rim pa lnga'i dbye bas de nyid tshar lnga bya'o/ /de rnams bsal la/ de ma thag tu bzang khrus bya ba ni/ sku phyis kyang bzang ba gcig ltar la/slob dpon gyis bum pa brgyad kyi bum chu dung chos sam snod gtsang mar bsdus la/ lag tu thogs te/ khrus gsol gyi tshe 'thor tshul tsam byed/ de yang / oṃ hū tru khyi a lan gsum dri bzang byugs/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo khro mo bcu la sogs pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rten la khrus gsol ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rten 'di rnams kyi dri ma sbyang ba dang / sku khrus gsol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ ri bo ltar ni mdzesapa yi/ /yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa/ /mchod gnas rin chen 'di dag la/ /bdag gis khrus 'di gsol bar bgyis/ /zhes snyan mnan zhing / khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ zhel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba ltar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bris pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu//yid 'od legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus —49—

gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a sna na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa mā ya swāhā/rol wo bya/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar//lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hū/ zhes dri ma khrus kyi bum pas khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hu t+yā hi a kā ya bi sho dha ni ye swāhā/ bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog la/ spro na/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba nas/ shrī hū/ de dag sku la nas/ dha ni ye swāhā/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang tshigs bcad re re'i bar du/ nges par khrus sngags dang / sku phyis sbyar dgos la/ rgyas pa la dga' na khrus kyi khang pa zhes sogs kyang re re'i mgor sbyar na shin tu legs so/ /'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ nas swāhā/ 'di ni tshul khrims: khrims 'chal/ tshul khrims dri yis/ oṃ sogs/ bzod pa/ khong khro'i/ bzod pa dri yis/ brtson 'grus/ le lo'i/ brtson par/ bsam gtan/ rnam g.yengs/ bsam gtan/shes rab/ shes 'chal/ shes rab dri/ khrus legs/ oṃ nas sruhā/ de ltar tshigasabacad tshan pa brgyad la/ bum pa brgyad yod na rim pas sbyar/ bzhi yod na lan gnyis sbyar/ gcig las med na/ de kas thams cad la sbyar ro/ /de nas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su khrus re gsol zhing / 'di skad ces/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /gang la nyes pa mi —50

mnga' zhing / khrus legs mdzad la phyas 'tshal lo/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa/ khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /de ltar khrus gsol ba rnams kyi dus/ las kyi rdo rje g.yin zhig gis las bum nas kyang yal 'dab kyis gtor bas bgegs dang mi shis pa thams cad sbyangs par bsam/mthar de dag sku la sogs snga ma bzhin sku phyis bya'o/ /de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri myi/ dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag rnams kyang de la 'bul/ /stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi//dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /o u badz+ra wa sa se swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a bha ra ṇa bi bhu ṣa ṇi swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye swāhā/ 'di gsum gyi go rim la/ byug pa na bza'/brgyan zhes pa'i tshul du sbyar na'ang rung ngo / khren tu spro na rab gnas rgyas pa nas byung ba ltar shis brjod rgyas par bya mod kyi/ gong du spyod pa'i phar phyin drug pho tshigs bcad nyid shis brjod yin pas de tsam gyis chog go /de ltar khrus gsol grub ma thag tu ye shes pa spyan 'dren par gzhung nas bshad cing / bod kyi slob dpon rnyeng pa rnams kyi lag len ltar na skabs 'dir rjes dran gsol bto dang / sems bskyed bzung ba byed pa'i srol yod pa/ byed par spro na cho ga rgyas pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ /drug pa rten dam tshig pa'i lhar bskyed pa ni/ slar yang / a mṛ tasabasangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sku gzugs rnams kyi gnas su pa —51—

las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du / hu las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs mnyam pa nyid kyi rdo rje dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'cha chen po dang po'i mgon po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje snyems ma la yang dag par 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan gdangs shing dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs chen po'i cod pan can/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang / rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/dpung rgyan/ do shal/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ 'og pag se mo do la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong at+pa la'i gdengs ka dang dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ /zhes brjod/ ma rdzo rten yin na/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/bhu las 'khor lo bhu gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma rang dang mtshungs pa la 'byud pa/ zhabs rdo rje sogs gong bzhi/ po ti yin na/ dzi las pad+ma dzi gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum —52—

gos dkar mo dmar mo sogs phyag 'phro yin na/ hu las rdo rje sngon po hū gis mtshan pa las/ mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum mā ma gī sngon mo/sogs/ yang na mchod rten ni rnam snang yongs su gyur pa las mchod rten nyid du gyur te/ de'i dbus su rnam snang gi gzugs brnyan shar bar bsgom pa yang bshad do/ /gang ltar yang de ltar bskyed zin pas rjes su/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hu bhu a dzi kha rnams dang / mig tu k+ṣi dkar po/ rna bar dzi sngon po/ sna la kha ser po/ lce la ga dmar po/ skra mtshams su ska ljang khu/ lte bar sa sngon po/ dpral par oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/mgrin par u las pad+ma dmar po zhwas mtshan pa/ snying khar rigs lnga'i sa bon gyi 'og tu hu las rdo rje nag po hu gis mtshan pa rnams su gyur/bdun pa ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ ye shes sems dpa' la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dza ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma sa /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad —53—

cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drangs bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rjes che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ /oṃ tshur byon tshur byon zhing dag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ khren tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod par 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /o badz+ra sa mā dza zhes brjod/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du song zhig /nga bzlas te rol mo'i sgra bsgrags la bgegs bskrad/ ye shes pa la ar+gha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse don dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod phyir dang / /sems can bsod nams spel don dang / /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ khyod kyi rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang —54—

'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga'/ /gang gzhan rdo rje'i spyan ldan dag /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /lha 'di rab tu gnas pa ni/ /bgyi 'o des na khyed rnams kyis/ /nye bar gnas par mdzad par 'os//spyo lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ oṃ badz+ra a ku sha dza oṃ badz+ra pā sha hu/ oṃ badz+ra sgro ṭa ba/ o badz+ra ā be sha a/ zhes mang du brjod la dam ye bsre'o/ /gzhung nas gsal bar bshad pa med kyang / yang snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros te ye shes pa sngon bzhin spyan drangs te bstim pa'i bar lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/bdun la sogs par byed par 'dod de/ dmigs pa gsal zhing yid ches pa'i phyir yin pas mi 'gal zhing legs par mngon la/ spyir cho ga ma tshang ba med pa'i yan lag tu ni tshar gcig po des chog go /brgyad pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug /khro bo khro mo bcu la sogs pa dkyil 'khor pa thams cad lha la dbang bskur ba'i don du mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tsho ni bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yod na ni/ sngar sbyang ba'i sngon du 'jug pa'i cho ga rgyas pa zin na des chog cing min na skabs —55—

'dir na bza' dmar po gsol/ me tog gi 'phreng ba btags te/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa bsdus pa tsam mam/ shin tu bsdus pa/ ā kha skyi ra hū/ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs par mos/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa med cing / gong du bshad pa'i maṇ+ḍal tsam la brten pa yin na'ang / dpa' bo 'bru lngas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa de dang 'dra zhing / ci ste maṇ+ḍal bshams pa de'ang med na dbang lha rnams gzhal yas khang bzung 'khor dang bcas par spyan drangs la/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs par mos pa tsam gyis chog go /gang ltar yang de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la stsa'/ du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal du sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rten rnams rab tu bcug ste/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi pad+ma ra phyin pa rang gi lha'i gzugs kyi rnam par gnas pa la/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rnams bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis yongs su bkrus pas rten gyi dri ma sbyangs shing /shes rab kyi pad+ma'i mtha' las spros nas dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod par gyur/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab mtha' dag rnams kyang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' yas par gyur pa pad+ma las phyir spros te/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang bar bzhugs pa rnams rten la dbang bskrar bar mngon du phyogs pas shis pa brjod par gyur/ bkra shis gang zhig sems —56—

can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng 'dir dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oṃ phun gsum tshogs pa sogs shisabarjod ji ltar 'os pa bya/ huX las byung ba mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin rnam rgyal bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ ā/༷༷sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī ye hūX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi khiñtsa huX/ oX las byung ba rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rnam pa can dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur/ oṃ āXbadz+ra a bhi tiñtsa hūX/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na aX/ oṃ huX truX sdi āX dzi ngam hriXlas byung ba 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur//'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir bzung / khaX las byung ba don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin dril bu dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ba ti stuX/ a bhi khiñtsa maX/ taṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bdag nyid ming gi dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa stuX/ a bhi khri3 maX/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rab tu gnas bya'i lha rnams rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gis rig ma la 'byud par gyur/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye huX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis rten rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha —57—

badz+re swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor zhing sngags de lan brgya phrag sogs bzla'o/ /oṃ huX khyi hūṃ khaX badzi bha wa ḍi khyu tiṣ+ṭha bhuX khaX swāhā/ zhes pa dang / oṃ hūX sdi tāX zhes pa rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i ṣ+ka nge 'dzin dang bos pas/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de bzhin khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āXskyoX/ de bzhi du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang cas pas/ shes rab sbyor bas dpal ldan ni/ /'di nyid yang dag mtshon par bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas/ zhes brjod/ sku gzugs la sogs pa rang bzhin zung 'jug gnyis su med pa bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su mos nas/ 'di nyid ye shes chen po ste/ /thams cad lus la rnam par gnas/ /gnyis med gnyis su med pa'i tshul/ /brtan dang g.yo ba khyab nas gnas/ /zhes brjod cing cung zad mnyam par bzhag ste/ lha la dbang bskur ba'o/ /de ltar na lha rnams dam tshig par bskyed pa dang / ye shes pa bstim pa dang / dbang bskur ba gsum po de ni rab gnas dngos yin la/ gong 'og gi cho ga gzhan rnams ni yan lag yin no/ /dgu pa mchod pa rgyas pa ni/ de ma thag tu lha so so'i snying pos na bza' 'bul bar bshad/snying po ngos zin pa dka' na/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa brjod bzhin du na bza' la sogs pa mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'bul/ oX āXbadz+ra ba sa se huX swāhā/ oX āXbadz+ra pulpe huX swā hā/ oṃ āXbadz+ra dhu pe hūX khyu hā/ oX āXbadz+ra dī pe huX swāhā/glu tshe āXbadz+ra ga rnye huX khyu hā/ skye( āXbadz+ra ni wi rkye huX swāhā/ tseX( āXsarba a bha ra ṇa bi bhu ṣa ṇi swāhā/ zhes pas nyer spyod dang rgyan la sogs pa phul/ oṃ āXsarba saX sho dha ṇi hūX phaṭa/—58—

ces bzlas pas 'bras bu dang / me tog la sogs pa mchod pa rnams bsangs/ oṃ( dzi swāhā/ zhes pas 'bras bu la sogs pa phul/ skye( badz+ra satwa a/ zhes sku gzugs kyi mdun du me long gtsang ma zhig bzhag go/de nas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gong gi gnas yo byin rlabs dang 'dra ba las/ gnas khang bhu las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su zhes pa dor ba'o/ /mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dbyangs dang 4sa pa med kyang wo ste/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod/ /oṃ u hri pra wa ra sa t+pa ra ar tha badz+ra añtsa ma na pra tismo swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhabs bsil/ pā du/'thor 'thung / pro k+ṣa ṇa/ mchod yon/ ar+gha/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyod la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra pu spre u hu/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas khyod la 'bul/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /dhu pe/ mun pa 'joms byed snang ba'i mchog /mar dang til gyi mar me 'di/ /yang dag ye shes spel ba'i phyir/ /bdag ni dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ /ā lo ke /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung / /mchog tu gyur pa'i dri chab 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /ci bde bar ni so sor bzhes/ /ga rnye/ bza' dang bca' ba phun sum tshogs/ kha dog dri ro rnams dang ldan/ /thams cad ldan pa lha yi bshos/ /bdag gis 'bul gyis so sor bzhes/ /nai wi rkye/ bla med theg pa chen po'i don ston zhing / khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra/ /bdud kyi 'bor lo gzhom phyir dbul bar bgyi//—59—

don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra shasta u hu/ dharma ra ṇi ta sogs rol wo bya/ de nas bstod pa ni/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad//yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub mchog rnams sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bsgrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don grub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid bdag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa yi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yongs mi 'gyur/ /e ma ho shin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang nas go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/ khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsole/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya chen ldan/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhesaso/ /nus shing spro na skabs 'dir sbyin sreg 'bul/—60—

bcu pa spyan dbye ni/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan nyid thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing /sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa mnga' brnyes par gyur cig spyan dbye 'di ni bsdus pa yin la/ rgyas par na sku'i sgo thams cad dag par bya ba'i tshul gyis dbye bar bya ba yin no/ / bcu gcig pa mnga' dbul ni/ 'dir gzhung las/ 'o thug sgrub pa'i mnga' dbul sogs cung zad las ma gsungs kyang / mchod pa'i bye brag ji tsam rgyas kyin bzang bas/ bod kyi bla ma snga ma rnams kyi lag len mnga' dbul rgyas pa byed pa yang skabs 'dir sbyar na legs pa yin no/ /de yang 'o thug gam zas mchog na maXsarba ta thā ga ta spyo bi shwa mu khe khyuX sarba tha khaX ut+na te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ di bya a rnye sa ma dhi khyu na pri ṇa ne swāhā/ zhes lan nyer gcig las mi nyung ba bzlas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i sogs brjod/oṃ badz+ra li spru swāhā/ tsan+dan gyi lde gu byug oṃ taX bo lwa ya swāhā/ zhes pas so rtsi phul/slar yang mchod pa rgya cher 4nams/ gong bzhi byin gyis bsas nas/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang / /mchod yon bkod pas 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /oṃ gu ru brnya bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hū ཾ ༷ swāhā/ de bzhi du rol mo'i bar du sbyar/ de nas bstod pa ni/ ji tsam mang yo bzang /bsdu na/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sngug bsngal 'khrul 'khor —61—

gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can smin zhing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang / /chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyi 'phongs gyur pa//ma rig thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams / /'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa rnams/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bcug nas/ /zhi ba rin chen gling mchog skyel mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can las kyi chu bor nub gyur rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing / /'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa//zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang / /skur bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus —62—

btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/de nas mngal dbul gyi rdzas rnams dngos sam/ gzugs ri mor bris pa'am/ 'bur du brkos pa sogs rim gyis star la/ sa gzhi sbos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis//'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra re ge u hu swāhā/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ /gser sbyangs gtso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi/ /oṃ badz+re ga rnye u hu swāhā/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi/ /na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bsgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra wasta ye swāhā/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin brgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang / /rin chen brgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a la ka ra bi bhu ṣa ni u hū swāhā/rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' bsgyur yang / /'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yis/ /mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra pū dza me gha u hu swāhā/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bsams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ mahā sa bha rat+na pū dza me gha ā hu swāhā/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyi lham mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa —63—

la/ /lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pañtsa pañtsa bi ma la pū dza me gha ā hu swāhā/ brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang / /ting 'dzin bla re spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par sgo(ga /oṃ badz+ra mahā pū dza me gha gis hu swāhā/ 'di rnams la bod snga ma rnams la spyi'i mnga' dbul zhes grags pa yin zhing / 'di dag mnga' dbul du 'os pa'i mchod rdzas bzang por sna nga ba'i phyir shin tu 'thad la/ bye brag gi mnga' dbul du grags pa rnams ni lugs 'di la mi sbyor te/ sbu gri la sogs pa mnga' dbul ba'i rdzas su mi 'os shing / na bza' la sogs pa sngar phul ba'i nang du tshang ba dang / mchod rten gyi ni srog shing 'khor lo gdugs la sogs pa mchod rten bzhengs pa'i dus kyi cho ga yin gyi/ skabs 'dir dgos pa'i mnga' dbul ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang sku gzugs la 'dreg bcad la sogs pa rnams dang / glegs bam la glegs shing sogs spyan dbye'i skabs dang cung zad 'brel ba yin pas na/ lag len shin tu spros pa la dga' bas spyan dbye'i skabs der phul na cung zad legs pa yin no/ /de nas sngags kyi mnga' dbul te/ oṃ hu tru hi a zhes pa dang / ye dharma dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha rnams mang du bzla zhing rab tu gnas bya'i lha de nyid kyi sngags shes shing bzla bar spro na ci nus su bzla'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir zhal bsgyur dgos pa'i rigs yod na bya ste/ po ti rnams la/'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i glegs bam du gyur/ de bzhi du/ mi bskyod pa zhu ba las byung pa'i phyag mtshan du gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten du gyur/ zhes pa lta bu'am/ mchod rten la sogs pa'i dbus su lha bskyed pa rnams ni de nyid de la thim par mos/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha so so'i bskyed chog shes nas/ so so'i bskyed —64—

chog byas pa yin na zhal bsgyur mi dgos la/ gong du bstan pa ltar thun mong du rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa yin na/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhu ba las byung ba'i lha so so rang rang gi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /bcu gnyis pa gsol btab ni yang mchod pa tshar gcig bshams la/ sngon bzhin byin gyis 7brlabs/ ar+gha nas shabha'i bar sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis phul/ mgon po thugs rje sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bstod pas bstod/ me tog la rten 'brel snying po mang du bzlas nas/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhug nas kyang / bdag dang yon bdag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang / dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ gnas dang rten dang gling mdzad de/ phan bde ma lus pa'i bka' drin stsal du gsol/ mdor na 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du 'gro ba sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ go rol tsho sgra bsgrags/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang / ye dharma bzlas shing rten la me tog dor/ de ltar lan gsum gyi rjes su/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /dga' ldan du ni rab bzhugs rnams/ /lha mo sgyu 'phru/la lhum bzhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/ /'di ru —65—

mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /sems can kun gyi don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor ba nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa bshams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin rlabs shing //'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /zhes pas lan gsum du gsol ba btab/a mṛ ta'am/ birtswan+ta krita kyi sngags bzlos shing sku gzugs kyi steng 'og bar gyi cha thams cad du g.yas pas rdo rje lan gsum du bskor zhing gsor bas byin rlabs shin tu brtan par byas par bsam/ de nas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ min kyang drang ste/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che//rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med//rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ched du brjod do/ /bcu gsum pa rjes chog ni dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang 'brel na/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzod gsol gyi bar byed dgos pa yin la/ bsdus pa maṇ+ḍal bca' ba dang 'brel ba'i tshe na yang /mchod pa kha gsos/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ ar+gha nas sha lta' bar gyis phul/ mnyam —66—

nyid mi g.yo ma'am/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bum pa tsam las ma bcas na yang mchod bstod 'di dgos te/ rten dang mgron la dmigs nas bya'o/ /mdun bskyed dang / rab tu gnas pa'i lha dang mgron gyi lha thams cad la dmigs nas yig brgya lan mang du bzlas/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang / /sogs bzod gsol ci nus su byas la/ mgron rnams gshegs su gsol te/rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dag/gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la/ /nongs gyur de dag bzod mdzad rigs/ /kun tu zhi dang rgyas pa sa /yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad su gsol/ /zhes pa tsam mam spro na/ sa dang chu dang me rlud las/ /lha rnams kyi ni sku gzugs la/ /bskal pa brgyar ni bsrung ba dang / /mchod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ /dgyes shing yid bzang gyur nas su/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi/ /bu dang tsha bo bsrung ba dang / /gang gnas dge bar gshe/gas su gsol/ /oṃ u hu mu zhes brjod/bcu bzhi pa gtor chog ni/ bar 'dir sgos kyi chos skyong rnams kyi gtor bsngo sogs kyang bya la/ cho ga rgyas pa dang 'brel zhing phyi rol gtor ma'i bya ba yod na'ang skabs 'dir bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel yang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ram/ phyogs skyong bcu' gtor ma sogs gnas khang de'i phyi rol tu song ste btang na shin tu legs so/ /chos skyong bsgo ba byed na'ang jude'i gtor ma la sogs su zug mas te gtor chog ltar phul la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa ha/ nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /'jig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /oṃ mahā sa ma ya ha na hu phaṭa/ rab tu gnas pa legs —67—

par byas pa'i rten 'di la khyod kyi bsrung ba dang / mchod pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzod cig /bdag dang yon bdag sogs la mi mthun pa'i phyogs las bsrung ba dang / bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cigaces brjod/ /bco lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ de nas yon bdag rten la phyag 'tshal du bcug /gdan bzang po la bzhag nas/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i/ /sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du/ /de dag don ni ngas byas te/ /de rnams don ni grub zin gyis/ /ci bde bar ni mchod par gyis/ khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btang pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyis/ rten 'di la zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya cher gyis shig /de nas kyang ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pas mchod par gyis shig /bcu drug pa shis brjod rgyas pa ni/ yon bdag dang / rdzas dang / gnas khang rnams la lasabum gyi chu nas cung zad gtor te/ a mṛ ta'i sngags lan mang du brjod/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad rim can du star la/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ste/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchoge tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib par dag gyur cig /gi ha dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi//bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste//snying po rnam dag ye shes rnams rtogs te/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /dur ba'i tshe ni 'phel bar byed —68—

pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas/ /nyon mongs skye zhi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun grub gyur cig /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te//chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus byas nas/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi gyur cig /rgyal srid sna bdun rim gyis star la/ lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang / /sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pa'i bkra shis shog /rin r+ṣa ngo bo lha rdzas biḍar+ya/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing / /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan ji bzhin/ /nor bu rin chen dam pa'i bkra shis shog /gzugs mdzes blta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/ /pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan//yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ /btsun mo gang yang rgyal la mu tig dang ldan pa'i/ /gser sogs mang po thub la phul pa ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan pa'i/ /blon po: yan lag thams cad —69—

legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che/ /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i/ /glang po rin chen: tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog nus shing / /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i sbu ltar yid 'ong pa'i/ /rta mchog rin chen 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ongs gyur pa'i/ /ma lus bdud dpung 'jig par byed pa ste/ /dpa' brtan 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ /dmag mi rin chen dam pa'i bkra shis shog /gas yang / oṃ phun sum tshogs pa:sogs dang / che ba'i che mchog sogs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs/ sbyin pa gtong zhing sogs/ ston pa 'jig rten khams su sogs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu zhi ba dang sogs/ lo brgya thub cing sogs/ 'bad dang sogs/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das sogs/ zab cing rgya che sogs/ nyin mo bde legs sogs/ rol wo dang bcas shis pa brjod do/ /de dag ni mtshon pa tsam ste/shis brjod 'tsham zhing rgyas pa ji ltar rigs pa brjod do/ /bar 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am/ tsā rle'i bza' ba sogs dga' ston rgya cher btang / rab gnas kyi slob dpon la yon yang dbul bar bya'o/ /bcu bdun pa rjes bsdu ni/ de rjes su dkyil 'khor ram maṇ+ḍal yang rjes bsdu'i cho gas bsdus nas/ smon lam dang bkra shis cung zad bya/bco brgyad pa sbyin sreg ni 'grub na slar yang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga la 'jug par bya'o/ /de ltar sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis rab gnas nyin gcig ma'i cho ga bshad zin to/ /cho ga 'di nyid la brten te nyin gnyis pa byed na/ khru gsol yan chad sngar bzhis byas nas/ snying kha'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam —70—

mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ mchod bstod rgyas pa phul/ lce hu las byung ba'i rdo rjer mos nas/bcom ldan rdo rje nas mdzad par 'os kyi bar gyis snyan gsan phab/ yang mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas nas/ skye( badz+ra pū ṇa rā ga ma nā ya myu zhes gshegs su gsol nas/ sku gzugs kyi spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka spyi gtsug phyag rnams la dri bzang gis byug /a mṛ ta bzla zhing rdo rjes sku la reg pas bsrung ba byas par mos la khebs kyis g.yogs/ phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs la spyi gtor bto / mdun bskyed yod na rjes chog skabs 'dir bya ste sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /nang par bum bskyed yan chad bskyar nas bya zhing / bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang ba de ma byas kyang chog /byed par spro na sta gon gyi skabs bzhin song mtshams dam tshig pa bskyed pa sngar bstan pa ltar byas nas/ de rjes byur bsal ba dang / khrus gsol bya/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa man rbad sngar ltar byas pas/ lugs 'di nyid kyi cho ga nyin gnyis pa legs par 'grub pa yin zhing / ci ste nyin gsum pa byed na/dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi nyin mo gnyis la sbyin sreg nges par bya zhing / de'i cho ga yang 'od kyi snye ma'i dgongs pa kho na las/ mdor bsdus su sbyar ba zhig yod pas der shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na brtan bzhugs yan chad nyin ma gnyis pa la tshar (〈pho〉 tshang ) bar byas nas/ dkyil 'khor ram maṇ+ḍal gyi rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar du'ang bya'o/ /nyin ma gsum pa la snga bar langs te/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed/ mchod gtor rnams sngar bzhin bya/ bum pa'i bya ba med kyang mchod pa'i don yin pas/ bum pa yang sngar bzhin sgrub na legs/ rab tu gnas zin pa'i rten lha sku dngos su gsal bar dmigs nas/ so so'i snying po ci rigs pa bzla/ so so'i sngags bzla bar spro na rdo rje sems pa'i yi ge brgya pa nyid lan mang du bzla'o/ /de nas mchod bstod rgyas pa zhig byed dgos pas/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ sngon bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par

bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /o gu ru bud+dhā bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra titsā pū dza me gha sa mu dra sla ra ṇa sa mā ya hu/ de bzhin du rol mo dang /sha lta'i bar du sbyar la/ dharma ra ṇi ta la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs rnams bzla zhing rol chen dang / bdug spos rgya cher 'bul ba sogs bya/ bstod pa yang de/ nyid lnga pa sogs gong du bstan pa ltar ram/ gzhan yang ji ltar 'os pas bstod/ shes na sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor nas 'byung ba'i rigs drug gi bstod pa sogs kyi klu dbyangs blangs na shin tu legs pa yin no/ /de'i rjes su mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa sogs bya ste/ de man chad sngar dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar na 'phags yul gyi shing rta chen po/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa mchog tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i gzhung las 'gyung ba'i lag leg rnams go rim ma 'khrugs par sbyar zhing / bod kyi lag len dang bstun nas/ tshigs bcad sogs dbyangs —su gyer dgos pa dang / mchod pa dang / shis brjod la sogs pa gzhung dang mi 'gal ba rnams ci rigs par kha bskang ba yin no/ /mi 'jigs pa'i lugs 'dir rab gnas kyi rgyud dang / bla med rgyud sde rnams las rab gnas thor bur gsungs pa rnams dang / 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa yin pas don thams cad tshang zhing rgyas la/ mchog tu legs shing / spros pa la dga' ba'i blo bzos kun nas blangs pa'i lhad dang bral ba'ang yin pas/ rgyud dang tshad ldan gyi gzhung thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos re re tsam yod pa rnams bsnan na legs par 'gyur ba'ang srid/ gzhan cho ga'i lus 'di kho na ltar byas na legs pa yin no/ /cho ga rgyas pa ni gzhan du 'bri bar 'dod do/ /tshad ldan gzhung gi rjes 'brang zhing / /rang —72—

bzo spangs las dge thob pa/ /des ni ‘'jig rten ma lus kun/ /myur du sangs rgyas sar 'khod shogaces pa rab gnas kyi cho ga 'gro phan rgyas byed ces bya ba 'di ya nga don gnyer mang po'i bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis//༄༅/ /rab gnas 'gro phan rgyas byed kyi lhan thabs ches rgyas pa bzhugs tre du /shri yu sdu/ spros la dga' ba dgyes pa'i phyir/ /'gro la phan pa rgyas byeng pa'i//cho ga'i rgyan gyur 'di na ko /'brel med ma yin khungs dang ldan/ /de la sbyang ba'i sngon du/ rgyab chog dkyi‘la 'khor gang byed dang 'brel ba'i khro bo'i rgyal por bskyed cing go cha 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod/yang bde dgyes sdom chen sogs khro rgyal mchog rang yin pas khro bo gzhan du bsgyur mi dgos/dper na rang dpal sdom pa'i skur skyed na/ go cha'i mchog lus dkyil yin/ dus 'khor gyi khro bor skyed na/ phyag rgya rgyan bkod dang / 'phreng sngags gnyis mkha' 'gro ma'i sa bon gyi sngags sogs bzlas na yang dgos don dang 'brel bas legs pa yin/ kha skongs dang po'o/ khrus phal pa'i skabs su 'di skad ces bya ste/ oṃ mi mthun bgegs dang log 'dren bsal byas nas/ /byur dang skal ngan ma lus zhi gyur te/ /srid gsum sgrib gnyis mi gtsang sbyang ba'i phyir/ khrul chal rnams kyi dril phyis sku la 'bul/ /oṃ hūX truX hiX.āX lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi lha( dha na ye swāhā/ gsum/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ gsum/ oX hūX bhāX hiXkhaX kha/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs slad du/ /chu gtsang sman spos —73—

'dag chal 'di phul bas/ /bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shoga.oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swāhā/ gsum/ dge byed lha dang lha mo'i tshogs/ /dag byed bdud rtsi bum pa'i chus/ /dge zhing bkra shis glu dbyangs bcas/ /mi bskyod myong kyis sku khrus gsol/ /oX a mṛ te hūX phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swāhā/ de dag sku la sogs bya'o/ khrus chal gyi dbye bas lan lnga byed na/ thog ma'i sngags/ a my-i ta'i dod du/ ya mun+ta krita dang / prarnyornya krita dang / pa dhan+ta krita dang / oṃ āXbadz+ra hūX ka ra huX huX/ zhes sbyar gzhan 'dra/ phal khrus dang bzang khrus kyi mtshams su/ bod snga ma rnams rten gsum rnying pa la sku khrus re mdzad kyin 'dug pa'ang shin tu spros pa la dga' na 'gal ba med do/ /de ltar na de'i khrus chu yang bum pa brgyad du ldugs so/ /de nas bzang khrus kyi skabs la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sku khrus gsol/ oṃ āXbe+e ro tsa na hūX swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ de bzhin du/'di ni khrus mchog la/ oṃ āXrat+na sam+bha wa huX swāhā/ dang / 'di ni sbyin pa'i la/ oṃ aX.a mi ta bhā huX swāhā/ 'di ni tshul khrims/ la/ oṃ āX.a mo gha sirnyi hūX swāhā/'di ni bzod pa/ la/ oX āXlo tsa ni hūX swāhā/ 'di ni brtson 'grus/ la/ oṃ āXmā ma gī huX swāhā/ 'di ni bsam gtan/ la/ oṃ āXpaṇ+ḍa ra ba si nī hūX swāhā/ 'di ni shes rab/ la/ oṃ āXtā re tā ra ṇi huX swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā: dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o rjes la/ oṃ āX.ak+ṣi khyo hūX swāhā/ gsum/ oṃ sarba ta thā zhes sogs brjod/gzhan yang khrus gsol gyi tshigs bcad sna tshogs brjod pas rung ngo / de nas de ma thag tu slob dpon nam las byed kyis las bum gyi chu nas cung zad 'thor stangs byed cing / sho lo ka re re'i mthar rol chen thung ba re byed bzhin du gzhan rnams kyis me tog 'thor zhing / yangs pa'i grong —74—

khyer du wog pa'i mdo nas gsungs pa'i shis brjod 'di bya'o/ /gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la 'jug mdzad cing / /chos rmams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang zhig bde bar mnga' mdzad des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur zhing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' yang / /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas/ /phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing / /dom grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ khyed la bde legs mjad par gyur/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur zhing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na//'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs pas/ /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /—75—

———— thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing / /chos kun dbang du mdzad pa des / khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kyis ni bsam pa yi/ khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs gyur/ /rkang bzhi khyed la bde legs shogakhyed cag lam 'gro bde gyur cig /phyir 'ongs rnams kyang bde legs gyur/ /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing /khyed la kun tu bde legs shog khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /de nas slar yang las bum gyis sku khrus gsol te/ ji ltar bltams pa: 'di ni khrus mchog: de bzhin gshegs dang: sku khrus gsol/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hu/ de dag sku la: de'i rjes su/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ da grwahwa'i bar bya'o/ /spros pa 'dod pa la rang gnas nyin gang la byed na dngos gzhi las gzhan thabs med/ nyin gnyis ma dang / nyin gsum ma la sbyang khrus rgyas pa 'di/ sta gon gyi nyen mo byed pa thob thang yin no/ /de nas yid kyis bsrung ba bya'o/ kha skongs gnyis pa'o/ /dngos gzhi khrus gsol grub nas rjes dran gsol btab dang sems bskyed bya ste/ so so'i lag tu me tog thogs / thal mo sbyar la/ bdug spos 'bul bzhin du/ gang 'dir bco ma ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs —76—

rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis/ rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa dang /stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa/ de'i skyon gyi nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing / bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa dang cho 'phrul gsum dang / ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / bslab pa gsum dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pa/ de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes dang / shes bya'i yul thams cad brnyes nga sa/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa rnams ma lus par spangs pa dang / bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang /skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus rnam par mdzes pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i sku lta

bas chog mi shes pa dang / mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor ba mthar thug pa/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod cing / rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i skabs su thams cad kyi tshigs mthun par brjod la/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten la me tog gi char dbab/ spos kyis bdug rol mo dbul zhing /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te/ sa mya ka saX ba khyu ya/ta du thā/ oX mu ne mu ne mahā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes pa dang / rab tu gnas bya'i lha gang yin gyi sngags dang 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i sngags bzla ba ni/ tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar bya'o/ /de nas sems bskyed pa ni/ mnyam par bzhag nas chos thams cad la mi gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas/ 'gro ba mtha' dag dang gang gi don du bya ba de la byams pa dang / snying rje byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgoms la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyis pas de'i mthus/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi dbugs dbyung ngo / /'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rtogs pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil par bgyi'o/ /sems —78—
