can rnams kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas bcad do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang phyi rol pa dag dang / lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag nga'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro/ /las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgron me sbar bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bzod pa dang des pa la btsud do/ /bsam gtan gyi bde ba la cher stsal to/ /'dod chags kyi me dpung zhi bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon cha rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ bden pa la gzud do//phrag dog gi 'tshub ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang / bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsal zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab cing / mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i dus su tshogs pa thams cad kyis kyang / de skad brjod cing me tog dor bar bya'o/ kha 'gengs gsum pa'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ ma lus sem/sa can sogs sho lo ka gsum dang / ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon sum mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /ces pa'i sho lo ka gcig gang byed 'dam ka yin/ rab gnas nyi ma sbrel ma byed na/ sta gon gyi nyin mo/ ma lus sems can sogs/ dngos gzhi'i nyin mo/ ma lus 'gro ba 'a sogs bya/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa'i rjes la/ ye —79—

shes pa la mchod pa rgyas pa byed na/ 'di skad ces/ dza hū ba ho bha ga wān e hre hi mahā kā ru ṇi ka dri lja ho/ sa ma ya sta/ sa ma ya ho bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal ba ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hū swāhā/ mchod yon dbu' / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni//lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hū/ zhes nga sa khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /o pad+ma ka ma la ya stu/ zhes pas gdan phul/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas//phyogs dus kun na ci yod pa/ /tshims byed yid 'ong dang ldan pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /o badz+ra ga rnye u hā/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing rnams na/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang skyes yid byung rnams//dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /o badz+ra spu〉 phyogs dus kun na bdug spos dang / /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /o badz+ra dhu pa: 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /o badz+ra ā lo ge:—80—

'jig rten 'di'am zhing gzhan na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zas / /yon tan kun ldan gang yod pa/ /dkyil 'khore lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra ni we du/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs o badz+ra sha lta/ rol mo bya/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bstod dbyangs yon tan rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag las/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /yang rol chen bya/ de rjes/ bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' mchog: so sas sbre la lo/ kha 'gengs bzhi pa'o /lha la dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ chu dbang gi thog ma/ra brjod pa'i bkra shis ni/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ /sdang bas zil mnan skye bo rnam par sbyong byed pa//mi bskyod mgon po zhes byar mtshan gsol de yis ni/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing / /rmongs pas zil mnan skye bo yongs su sbyong byed pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan/ /'phongs pa'i sdug bsngal sgrol bar yongs su rab brtson zhing /khengs pas zil ma nan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shes des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang —81—

ldan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa po/ /chags pas zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spong / /de sbyongs thabs ston de ni kun nas sel mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /zhes pa 'di 'jus par bya'o/ kha skongs lnga pa'o//spyan dbye ba'i skabs su/ dang por mchod pa bsdus pa zhig sngags dang phyag rgyas phul/ de nas gser thur dbu pa gyi kong bur bzhag nas/ mar dang sbrang rtsi bskus pa thogs la/ thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis lha tshogs kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / mig sman gyis spyan phye nas rdo rje'i mig tu byin gyis bsas la/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ dī bya ne tra ya swāhā/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing / sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa na/ snyan sogs dbye ba'i tshig sngags dang bcas pa rgya gzhung ji lta ba'i mthar/ bod sngon rabs pa'i gsung las 'byung ba'i smon la che/ sngags bcas kyi tshig kyang sbyar ba ni 'di ltar/ gser ram dngul gyi rna brud thogs la/ 'gro rnams chos kyis 'phongs pa la/ /rgyal bas chos kyi dung bud ltar/ /de bzhin sems can don gyi phyir/ /rgyal ba'i snyan ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ —82—

dī bya ka rje ya swāhā/ zhes snyan phye nas/rdo rje'i snyan du byin gyis brlabs la/ bsnyen bsring mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan/ /thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bos dag na yang / /dag byed 'di ni bdag gis 'bul lags kyis/ /skye bos rtag tu dam chos thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra kaṇi sho dha ya u hu swāhā/ zhes bya'o/ /des ma' te/ ca sto thogasal/ zag bcas phung po'i dri spangs bas/ /'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir/ /rnam par dag pa'i dri brnyes ltar/ /rgyal ba'i shangs ni dbye bar bgyi/ oṃ dī bya gha ṇa ya swāhā/ dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa/ /dge ba sgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang / /mos pas 'dzin bcad dam pa phul ba stu/si / /'gro bas ye shes bla med thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra ro ma dha ra ṇa u hu swāhā/ zhes bya'o/ /spyo thur thogs la/ chos kyis ro mchog dga' ba yis/ /'gro ba thams cad tshim mdzad ltar/ /ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas rnams/ /'bul phyir rgyal ba'i zhal dbye'o/ /oṃ dī bya mu kha ya swāhā/ 'od zer stong gis phye ba'i pad+ma dang / /bi spa ltar dmar yid 'ong zhal gyi sgros/ /legs/ par phye bas mkha' mnyam sems can gyi/ /thar pa'i grong khyer sgo mchog dbye bar shog /o badzo rgo ṭa ya u hā swāhā/ zhes bya'o/ /tshems shing thogs la/ rgyal ba'i tshems dkar bzhi bcu la/ /mi gtsang rdul gyis ma gos kyang / /bkur bsti rin chen ljon shing 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i tshems ni dbye bar bgyi/ /oṃ dī bya dan+ta ya swāhā/ dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu tshang bas tshems/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' bsgyur yang / /bdag cag dad pas tshems shing 'bul lags kyi/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra dan+ta sho dha ya u hā swāhā/ bum pa'am dung —83—

chos til mar sku phyis dang bcas pa 'bul/ rgyal ba ye shes sku can la/ /las dang nyon mongs dri bral yang / /'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyang ba'i slad/ khrus gsol bsku mnye 'bul bar bgyi/ /o dī bya gā t+yā ya swāhā/ mtshan dang dpe byad mtha' yas mnga' ba'i sku/ /skyon kun bral zhing yon tan kun rdzogs kyang / /bdag blo dang mtshungs yo byad 'di 'bul bas/ /'gro kun gnyis med ye shes sku thob shog /o badz+ra a ba ya ba ya lha( dha ā hū swāhā/ de'i yan lag tu sbu gri 'breg bcad so mang gsum sbyor bar 'dod na/ sku gzugs chags bral gyi rnam pa can la/ spu gri'i dbu skra 'breg tshul bya zhing /rgya pa khu pe'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bra' yang / /gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spangs phyir/ /dad pas gser gyi 'breg bcad phul ba yis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badz+ra ka tsa mu le ā hu swāhā/ khre bo ma yin pa rnams la sku sen 'breg tshul bya/ zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang / /bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyi/ /sen mo'i 'breg bcad phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog/oṃ badz+ra na kha tshe da dzi na ā hū swāhā/ chags chen gyi cha byad zhi ba rnams la skra bshad phul te/dbu skra rin chen lcang lo ma 'khrugs shing / mdzes shing lta bas mi ngom skyo na bral yang / /bdag blo sbyangs phyir rkyen dang 'tsham pa 'di/ /phul ba'i 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar lha(ga /oṃ badz+ra ba la cwa( dha ya ā hu swāhā/ zhes pa rnams so/ la 'gengs drug pa'o/ /mnga' dbul gyi skabs dang po mchod pa'i mnga' dbul la/ 'gro phan rgyas byed du bris pa nyid kyi rgyas pa la'ang chog rba yin mod kyang / spros pa la dga' na dang / lar nas mchod pa ji tsam —84—

rgyas pa bzang bas/ mchod pa gsar ba mang du bshams shing byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis sngags rgya mang du brjod/ thog mar bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ni/ /o bkra shis lha mo pad+ma can/ /dkar mo dpal gyi be'u 'dzin/ /ye shes lha la bdag 'bul na/ /kun du dge zhing bkra shis shog /oṃ gu ru brnya bo dhi sa twa sa pā ri wā ra ma ṅga la shrī bta phya ā hu swāhā/ o bkra shis lha mo 'jigs byed ma/ /dkar mo gser gyi 'khor lo 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor: kun tu: ma ṅga la tsakra: 'od ldan mje sngon mo pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin/ ma ṅga la ka ma la (〈dza〉 pad+ma ) rnam rgyal ma: mthon ka yid bzhin rgyal mtshan 'dzin ma ṅga la dh+wa dza: mdangs ldan mjo dmar skya rin chen gdugs dkar 'dzin: ma ṅga la tshwa tra ga: dkar sham ma: dmar skya gter gyi bum bzang 'dzin: ma ṅga la gha ṭa: dri med mngu ljang gu g.yas 'khyil dung dkar 'dzin: ma ṅga la sha kha: yid gzhungs ma: margata mdog mtshungs gser nya 'dzin/ /ye shes: kun tu: ma ṅga la kan ka ma ta su: zhes pas mchod do/ /de nas bar 'dir zas mchog dang / byug pa dang so rtsi rnams phul nas/ mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa 'bul ba'i skabs su/ 'chad par 'gyur ba nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun yan chad ji ltar 'os pa bya ste/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /rab gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten rnams la/ /dag byed dri bzang zhal bsil chu rgyun 'di/ /phul bas 'gro kun bde legs thob par shog /o gu ru bud+dhā bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra añtsa ma na pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du tshig rkang gsum pa la/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i dri bcil rdo rje'i chu/ /pā du/ kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel bsangs gtor mchog /pro k+ṣa ṇa/ yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i mchod yon 'di/ /o gu ru brnya bo dhi —85—

satwa sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra titsā swāhā/ zhes bya'o/ /oṃ pa ṭa ha dang cang te sogs/ dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang / /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs rnams/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /sha lta/ 'di chu bzhi nyer spyod dang bcas pa'i spyi 'gro yin/ de bzhin du mchod yon nyer spyod sogs la/ mchod 'phreng spyi 'gro drug las/ dang po ni/chu bo gang gā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /mchod yon rgyun yang mi 'chad pa/ /bla ma lha yi tshogs la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes/ /oṃ sarba ta thā sogs sngags spyi dang 'dra/ 'dab rgyas pad+mo'i tshal bzhin du/ /me tog rgyun yang mi 'chad pa/ /bla ma: thugs rjes pa oṃ sarba: tsan+dan nags tshal ljongs bzhin du/ /bdug spos5 rin chen nyi zla'i 'od bzhin du/ /snang gsalaje hu spun ka'i rgyun bzhin du/ /dri mchog: ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog bzhin/ /zhal zas: ka la ping ka'i dbyangs bzhin du/ /sel snyan bla ma: thugs rjes pa o sogs/ spyi 'gro gnyis pa ni/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gha: de bzhi du mchod yon zhes par me tog nas/ rol mo'i bar du spro wo / sngags kyang shabha'i bar ro//spyi 'gro gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i rig pas byin brlabs pa'i/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /ar+gha de bzhin du rol mo'i bar du sbyar ba'am/ yang na/ 'jig rten 'di'am: kha dog dbyibs legs dri zhim yid 'ong pa'i/ /me tog sna tshogs skye ba'i shing rnams kyang / /rgyal ba: putsho—86—

des 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre bsil zhing dri zhim reg na gdung ba sel/ /yid 'phrog dri chab ji snyed mchis pa yang / /ga rnye: ga bur la sogs legs par sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bdug pa'i spos sprin 'khrigs pa yang / /dh+wa pe lha rdzas las byung rin chen sgron me 'bar/ /phyogs bcu'i mun pa kun du tshul ba yang / /ā lo ke: ro brgya ldan zhing dri bsrung kha dog bzang / /swa sti ka sogs zhal zas sna tshogs kyang / /ni bi mu pi wang la sogs rol mo'i khyad par mang //rnar snyan yid 'ong rom mo ci mchis pa/ shasta: spyi 'gro bzhi pa ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon rnams/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /ar+ghaX sogs sha lta'i bar la sbyar ro//spyi 'gro lnga pa ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /ar+ghaX sogs rol mo'i bar ro/ /spyi 'gro drug pa ni/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang / /mchod yon bkod pas 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun du bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /ar+ghaX sogs rol mo'i bar du sbyar ro/ /de ltar spyi 'gro bdun po de dag las/ gang yang rung ba zhig 'dir bya zhing / gzhan dang gzhan dag mchod pa'i rim pa gong 'og ci rigs pa rnams la sbyar ro/ /—87—

yang nyer spyod lnga dang sbyar ba lha mo'i mchod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor kun du rgyal ba mnyes byed pa/ /mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu nga/nga / /me tog sprungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /tseX( badz+ra pukhre āXhūX swāhā/ tshigs bcad kyi thog mtha' gnyis dang / sngags kyi thog mtha' gnyis 'gre'o/ /yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang / /bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /dh+wa pe: kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu dang / /mar mes gang ba'i rin chen sno do 'dzin ma/ /ā lo ke /gdung sel ljang khu rdo rje dril bu dang //dri mchog blugs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ lha rnye/ zhal bzang sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang / /bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /ni we rkye/ zhes sogs so/ /de nas 'dod yon lnga la'ang rdzas dang / lha mo'i mchod pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /srid pa'i mtsho las rnam par rgyal/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ni/ /sems can kun la bstan par bgyi/ /oX āXbadz+ra ā dar+sha huX/ sngags kyis thog mtha' 'gre'o/ /pi waX bsgreng zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yis/ /gang gi 'jig rten thams cad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/ /oX āXbadz+ra swe ṇi huX/dri byug cing / gang gi sangs rgyas zhing kun dang / /'jig rten pa yi khams kun tu/ /bla med bsam mi khyab pa'i dri/ /rang gi lus las spro bar bya/ /ga rnye/ ro bcud phul la/ gang gi sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /srog chags gyur pa thams cad la/ /lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul nas su ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ āXbadz+ra rā se hūX/ gos zung phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun dang yang / /byang chub sem/sag—88—

dpa' sogs kun la/ /yang dag sbyor ba reg bya'i bde/ /nges par sbyar bar bya ba yin/ /spa snya/ zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa lha mo ni/ sngags rgya snga ma bzhin la/ rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul/ /gzugs mdzes dkar mo me/ long pad+ma'i snod/ /cang te'i sgra 'khro la kha ṭā la brten ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /'og ma/ la rkang pa gnyis pa go brje/ g.yin 'dra ste/ dbyangs snyan sngon mo'i pi wa pad+ma'i snod/ /ces dang / dri ldan ser mo spos khang pad+ma'i snod/ /ces dang / bcud ldan dmar mo bza' btung pad+ma'i snod/ /ces/ dang / bde ldan ljang khu ras bzang pad+ma'i snod/ /ces bya'o/ /sna tshogs bsil khrol snan pa'i sgra ldan ma/ /nam mkha' gang ba sogs 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'kho/ra mchod la mngon dga' ba'i/ /gzugs kyi lha mo mdzes pa'i me long g.yob/ /rnam kun gzugs kyi ngo mtshar dang 'dres pa/ /phyogs dus kun 'gyung mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /tse( rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pu dzi te a hū/ de bzhin du rkang pa thogs mtha' gnyis 'dra ba la/ sgra yi lha mo snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bskul/ /rnam kun sgra yi sogs dang / sha rto/ dri yi lha mo bde spel dri bzang spro/ /rnam kun dri ya: ga rnye/ro yi lha mo ro bda' zhal zas stob/ /rnam kun ro yi ra sa/ reg gi lha mo reg 'jam gos bzang stob/ /rnam kun reg gi sparnye sogs so// /yang na 'dong yon lnga 'i tshigs bcad spyi 'gro rnams sbyar ro/ /bla med kyi cho ga dang 'brel na de ltar bya la/ sa du /pad+ma'i snod ces par/ nor bu'i snod ces dang / gzhan yang sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ rnam mang nyams brgya'i 'gyur ba dang 'dres pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo 'gying sgeg dkar ba'i bzhin/ /zag med bde ba'i snyems nga/ rang 'a myong ma/ /mkha' mnyam —89—

rig ma'i bde bas mnyes gyur cig /oṃ u badz+ra lwa phya hū/ sna tshogs rin chen 'phreng bas lag sbrel ba'i/ /rdo rje lha mo gser mdog mig bsgyur zhing / /rab mdzes 'dzus zhal kun dgar rab spel ma/ /mkha' mnyam rig ma'i bde bas mnyes gyur cig /ma mye/ drug ldan rdo rje'i dbyangs snyan glur len pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo chags lda/na lta na sdug /gzhom med nā da'i sgra snyan rab bskul ma/ /mkha' mnyam rig ma'i bde bas mnyes gyur cig /gī tī/ lang tsho rab brtas sgyu 'phrul gar bsgyur ba'i/ /rdo rje lha mo mar gad rdul 'dzin zhing / /kun rtog 'pho ba'i sgyu thabs rab bcil ma/ /mkha' mnyam n-i khya/ lha rdzas me tog char mang rab 'babs pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo rab dkar zla bzhin can/ /rnam mang mchod pa'i rgyan du rab spel ba/ /mkha' mnyam: pu po bdug pa'i sprin phung mkha' dbyings kun 'gebs pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo mdzes sdug du ba'i mdog /rnam dag tshul khrims dri bsung rab rgyas ma/ /mkha' mnyam: dhu pe/ gshone tshul cho se dbyings snang byed 'od 'bar ba'i/ /rdo rje lha mo pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /mun sel sngags kyi de nyid rab gsal ma/ /mkha' mnyam: ā lo ke /lang tshos rab dregs rnyog bral dris sgeg pa'i/ /rdo rje lha mo mtshar sdug dpyid kyi mdangs/ /ma lus srid pa'i gdung sel bde ster ma/ mkha' mnyam: ga rnye/ zhes pa glu'i sbyor ba dang bcas pas bya'o/ /dpal bde mchog sogs rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'am/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha de gsang sngags nang gi lha yin na/ rig ma bcu drug sbas don dang sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad 'dis mchod par bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ mthon mthing lang tshos dregs pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ /rdo rje rgyud mang bsgreng ba'i rol rtsed kyis/ /sgra —90—

dbyangs rgya mtsho bskul ba la brtson ma/ /rdo rje rig ma'i bde bas dgyes par mdzod/ /ces dang / phyag rgya so sor 'cha' zhing / oṃ u badz+ra lī ṇi hu/ gser mdog zur mig 'dod pa'i mda' 'phen ma/ /rdo rje gling bu bsgyur ba'i snyan 'gyur sgra/ /gzhom med nā da'i dbyangs dang rab 'dres ma/ /rdo rje: 'dre tra/ rab dmar chags pas myos pa'i lus phra ma/ /rdo rje rdza rnga brdung ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /mda' can drag po'i snying gi myos sel ma/ /rdo rje mri ta ge hi mar gad rdul gyis byugs pa'i mig yangs ma/ /rdo rje rnga chen sgrogs pa'i sgra brgya pas/ /gsang chen dhu ti'i rang sgra 'bod mkhas ma/ /rdo rje: murdzi a/ in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs ldan bde sbyin mo/ /rdo rje dril bus sgeg pa'i snyems pa yi/ /mchog dga'i ngo mtshar ston pas rab 'gying ma/ /rdo rje: lwa gya hu/ bim pa ltar dmar kun tu bzhad pa mo/ /ku mud 'dzus zhal kun dga'i zla snang can/ /rdo rje chags pas rab rgod bag yangs ma/ /rdo rje: ha phya tra/ li khri'i rdul chags 'dod pa'i dbyangs mkhan ma/ /mi zad rdo rje'i tshig 'byin drug ldan glu/ /'phrog byed dga' ma'i dbyangs la rab 'jug ma/ /rdo rje: gī ti khyi sngo ljang 'khri zhing gzhon nu'i lus can ma/ /gnyen lcug 'khril ldem rdo rje gar gyi ros/ /'pho ba'i sgyu rtsal kun tu rab 'gog ma/ /rdo rje: ni t+ya ā kha ba dung ltar rab dkar zla bzhin ma/ /zhing kun gang ba'i me tog gsar pa'i char/ /rang byung si rla'i dri bzang dang 'grogs ma/ /rdo rje: pur+sha hu/ dud sprin ltar 'gro a gar dris sgos ma/ /rdo rje bdug pa'i sprin tshogs stug po'i rgyun/ /kun rtog nags tshal bsregs pa las 'byin ma/ /rdo rje: dhū pe tra/ gur gum gzhon nu'i lus can 'od 'bar ma/ /nyi —91—

zla'i rna cha g.yo ldan rin chen sgron/ /sngags kyi de nyid gsal ba las 'char ma//rdo rje: ā lo ke hi 'char ka'i zla ba'i mdog can dris sgeg ma/ /rdo rje ga bur tsan dan sbyar ba'i chus/ /lus kun khyab pa'i bsil bde yongs spel ma/ /rdo rje: ga rnye ā kun+da'i phung po ltar dkar gzugs mdzes ma/ /rab gsal gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long g.yob/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i mig gi bdud rtsi ma/ /rdo rje: rū pa badz+re ṇi hu/ thun mtshams 'od dmar 'char ba'i myos ldan ma//rnam pa kun ldan ro brgya sbyar ba'i g.yos/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i nyams brgya legs ston ma/ /rdo rje: rā sa badzi ṇi tra/ glog phran ltar g.yo du bo'i mdog can ma/ /lha rdzas na bzas rig pa'i bde stob cing / /ci dgar 'khyud pa'i reg gnyen bde mchog ma/ /rdo rje: spar+sha badz+re ṇi khyo ku mud rgyas 'dra sgyu rtsal rtser son ma/ /chos dbyings bde ba'i 'byung gnas phyag rgya ches/ /mi 'gyur 'bras bu'i gnas la rgyas 'debs ma/ /rdo rje'i rig ma'i bde bas dgyes par mdzod//dharmā dh+wa tu badz+re ṇi ā bya spyod rnal /tso rmir rgyud kyi cho ga sogs la brten pa yin na/ mchod lha bcu drug gi tshigs bcad byed pa la/ sbas don dang ma sbyar ba'i tshig g.yin gyis bya'o/ /de yang mchong yul gyi lha la thob mi thob dang 'os mi 'os ma yin gyi 'on kyang lugs de dang de'i cho ga dang 'brel mi 'brel gyi khyad par gyis yin no/ /'di ni gtor ma dang / dam tshig gi rdzas la sogs pa thams cad la go bar bya 'o/ /de nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa byed na/ bde bar g.ye/gas pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen/ sogs dang / lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/ /sogs spyi khyab tu grags pa rnams kyis mchod/ shin tu spros pa la dga' na 'di skad ces bya ste/ dri —92—

med 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser bzang las/ /bsod nams bzo bos mchog tu rnam sprul ba/ /lha mi'i mdzes pa kun las phul byung zhing / /lta bas mi ngoms rdzu 'phrul shugs nyid las/ /rang byung rtsibs stong ta la bdun srid du/ /byung tshe phyogs las rgyal ba mchog thob pa/ /rin chen 'khor lo dam pa 'di phul bas//rgyal byed dran pa'i 'khor lo thob par shog /chu zhing phun tshogs thal dkar zla 'od can/ /mche ba drug ldan dul bas spyod pas mdzes/ /sngon chad legs par byas pa'i mthu nyid las/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la rab 'gro zhing / /mkha' lding sa srungs bu ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /sa chen rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kun tu bskor/ /glang po rin chen phul bas mtshan ma rnams/ /'joms byed shes rab glang po thob par shog /rab mdzes rma bya'i mgrin 'dra'i sbu stug can/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'dod pa yi/ /don kun rdzogs par sgrub byed nam mkha'i lam/ /gus par spyod pa gser gyi rgyal mtshan can/ /cang shes rlud las rgyal ba sprin gyis shugs/ /yid ltar mgyogs pa'i rta mchog 'di phul bas /ma lus chos la mngon shes bgrod pa can/ /brtson 'grus bzhon pa mchog gis 'gro bar shog /kun tu mdog bzang mtshungs med rba zla r+ya/ legs par sbyangs pa'i rin chen cha brgyad pa/ /byed po med cing phun tshogs 'od zer gyis/ /me dang nyi ma'i 'od kyang rnam par gnon/ /dga' mgur 'gro zhing dgos pa mchog ster la/ /'khor kun khyab pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas can/ /bsam pa rdzogs byed nor bu 'di phul pas/ /chos kyi snang ba'i dga' bas tshims par shog /dga' tshal lta yi bu mo'i gzugs mdzes can/ /'dul ba'i cho ga phun tshogs —93—

bstan bcos dang / /bzo dang snyan dngags sgyu rtsal kun shes shing / /'dzum zhing snyan par smra mkhas mtshungs pa'i gzugs/ /reg pa mchog ldan lus sems bde ba'i rgyu/ /ha cang che chung min pa dri bzang gter/ /phul bas sgrib pa kun las rnam thar ba'i/ khren tu sbyangs pa'i bde bas 'tsho bar shog /lag na rdo rje sred med bu yi stobs/ /'jam zhing yid 'ong snyan pa'i tshig kyang 'byin/ /mdzangs shing gsal la yid gzhung lha mig ldan/ khor yug gter gyi bdag po'i don kun byed/ /byams dang snying rje mang ba dge ba'i bdag /'dod dgur 'dzud pa'i mi mchog 'di phul bas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs don/ /kun 'byor ting 'dzin mchog la dbang thob shog /dpa' zhing brtul phod yan lag mchog gi gzugs/ /pha rol dpung 'joms mi mthun med byed pa/ /sngar ldang bsam pa dge zhing lta bas go /ma smad rgyas shing rdzogs pa'i legs byas can/ /'dod dgur 'gro ba'i blon po rin chen 'di/ /phul bas ji bzhin ji snyed chos rnams la/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes dam pa yi/ /rtsol med gnas pa'i btang snyoms thob par shog /'di la pu ru ṣa rat+na zer dgos/ nye ba'i rgyal srid 'bul ba ni/ ral spi nye ba'i rin po che/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'bul/ /bla med byang chub mchog gi chos/ /ye shes ral gri thob par shogakhaṅge u pa rat+na: khang khyim nye ba'i rin po che/ /rgyal ba: bla med: chos dbyings khang bzang thob par shog /kṛ ha u pa rat+na: pags pa nye ba'i rgyal ba: bla med: dga' bde'i gding pa thob par shog twa ka u pa rat+na/ skyed tshal nye ba'i:rgyal ba bla med: rnam 'phrul tshal du spyod par shog bā ṭi ka u pa rat+na/—94—

gzims cha nye ba'i rgyal ba: bla med: bsam gtan bde ba'i yal thob shog/pa rla ga u pa rat+na/ gos bzang nye ba'i: rgyal ba: bla med: rgyal sras khrel yod gos thob shog /bsta u pa rat+na/ 'chil lham nye ba'i2 rgyal ba: bla med: thar lam bde la spyod par shog /mo tsa u pa rat+na: bsdu na/ ral gri khang pa pags pa skyed mos tshal/ /mal cha gos dang 'chil lham rin po che/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun mtha' yas pas/ /rab tu gnas bya'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /sa lta u pa rat+na/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rab gnas lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /ma ṅga la aṣ+ṭa ang ka /rgyas par na/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /sogs bya'o/ /bstod pa'i khyad par yang rgyud sde lnga las gsungs pa'i bstod pa rnams dang / yongs su grags pa'i bstod pa rnams kyis bstod par bya'o/ kha skongs bdun pa'o/ /gsol gdab brtan bzhugs song ba'i/ rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bstod pa de'i rjes su/ khres brjod rmad du byung ba 'di bya ste/ de yang 'di skad ces/phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba//bkra shis des ni skye dgu zhi byed dang po'o/ /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di rni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang —95—

lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o/ /sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po/ /don rnams thams cad grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa/ /tshogs kyi legs skyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' lda/na lha'i/ /gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te/ /dbang bcas lhas bskor ba yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis: lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lu skru'i tshal/ /lha mang dag gis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba/ /bkra shis: grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du//lhum nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmad du grags pa chen po lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam las bde sgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis:dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshul du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /bai ḍūr+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtsa bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: chu bo'i 'gram na tsa rka'i 'phreng bas yongs bskor ba/ khren tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ /klu yi rgyal —96—

pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po brtul tshe sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba/ /bkra shis:sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi tho rangs bdun bzhi po dag rnams btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis: grong khyer wā rā ṇa sir drang srong mchog bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang / /lha yul deng 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa/ /bkra shis: bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa/ /bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa seng ges gang gsungs pa/ /bkra shis: mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang / /'gro la bde ba skyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa rgyal po'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis: 'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs/ /sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mchog tu nyer gshegs pa/ /man da ra yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa/ /lha mchog rnams kyis mngon bstod pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams lajelha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa/ /mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra —97—

shis gang / /bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog kha skongs brgyad pa'o/ /rjes kyi skabs yon bdag bsgo ba dgos na/ de'i shis brjod kyi skabs su/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phul ba sogs/ /tshig lhug pa'i shis brjod de yang rdzas brgyad thams cad la sbyar bas rgyas par 'gyur la/ de nas kun gyi mthar rjes bsdu ba grub pa'i skabs sam/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed na de'i mthar yang rung ste/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rmad du byung bas shis brjod bya ste/ 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dang mtho ris na/ /rin chen rmad byung rgya chen mchog yod pa/ /des ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen la/ /cis kyang grangs dang bgrangs dang char mi phod/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /ji ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na/ /bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /zhi 'gog bdud rtsi shin tu gya nom gang / shwakya thub pas mnyam bzhag thugs chud pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa yod min te/ /de mngon byas na phyin chad mya ngan med/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung : dam pa'i chos kyi rin r+ṣa: ji ltar nga'ingubaden pa'i 'dis ni: rgyal bas gang dag gang zag brgyad gsungs pa/ /de dag rnams ni skyes bu zung bzhi ste/ /sbyin gnas de dag sa steng shin tu dkon/ /de dag rnams la byin na dpag med 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig: ji ltar nga'i: /bden pa 'dis dam pa gtso bo mchog sbyin gya nom pa/ /'od mchog dpa' bo dam pa mchog gi gnas//—98—

shes rab dam pa mchog ni dam pa mchog /mchog min mchog mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chenargyoji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni: ting 'dzin dam pa bar chad med pa gang / /mtha' yas blo ldan de bzhin gshegs gsungs pa/ /ting 'dzin de brtan rdo rje dper byas pa/ /ting 'dzin de dang mtshungs pa'i ting 'dzin med/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad: ting nge 'dzin gyi rin wo: ji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni: ji ltar sgo gtan dam zhing rab dam ste/ /stobs chen rlung bzhi dag gis mi bskyod pa/ /de ltar mkhas pa bden bzhi mthong gnas pa/ /'jig rten smra ba rnams kyis 'dir mi g.yo/ /ngo mtshar shin tu: dge 'dun rin chen ji ltar nga'izobaden pa 'dis ni: thams cad zil gnon kun mkhyen thams cad gzigs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa stobs rnams kun dang ldan/ /kun gyi dam pa 'dzin pa kun dang bral/ /bsam pa kun mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig/ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen ji ltar nga'in+d+rabaden pa 'dis ni: srid pa 'gog cing mi g.yo 'gyur ba med/ /skyon med 'jigs pa kun las rnam par grol/ lken tu 'gag cing gya nom nges par 'byung / /shin tu dri med zhi ba blos mi 'phrog /ngo mtshar shin lco dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen: ji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni: shin tu sdug bsngal ston zhing bde sbyin pa'i/ /bden rnams mthong ste gang dag bag yod pa/ /bden pa rin chen rnams la dogs bral ba/ /de dag skye ba brgyad pa phyis mi len/ /ngo mtshar shin tu: dge 'dun rin chen: ji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni: dam pa rnams —99—

kyis dam pa don dam mkhyen/ /mchog dang mchog min mkhyen zhing don dam brtson/ /g.yin gyis mi 'phrog dam pa thugs chud rtogs/ khren tu sdug bsngal can gyi dpung gnyen mchog /ngo mtshar shin tu: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen:ji ltar nga'i cha bden pa 'dis na 'dun pa skyed nas rnal 'byor ldan gyur zhing / /go tam bstan la rtag brtson rab grol zhing / /gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dag zhing der reg /'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tujedam chos rin chen: ji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni: bden pa mthong bas brjed pa rgya lam na/ /gal te sdig pa 'ga' zhig byas gyur kyang / /de ni de 'chab pa yi 'os min te/ /chos nyid 'di ni mo g.yo gnas phyir ro/ /ngo mtshar shin tu: dge 'dun rin chen ji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni2 lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /sangs rgyas dang ni lhag pa'i mtshungs pa med/ /lha dang mi yi ston pa bla na med/ /ston pa ded dpon smon pa rnams kyi mchog /ngo mtshar shin blu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni: sa ga'i zla ba dang por thub pa yis/ /nags khrod chos kyi dam par rab brnyes pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa'i lhag pa med/ /'di la de reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin lco dam pa'i chos kyi rin chen: ji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni: sdig pa rnying zad gsar du byas med la/ /rims nad med pas 'jigs med mya ngan bral/ /rtsa ba 'gags pas srid pa mi bskyed pa/ /bstan pa mar me bzhin du 'bar bar shog /ngo mtshar shin tu:dge 'dun rin chen: ji ltar nga'i: bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legs shog /ces pa'o/ /—100—

mchod 'phreng tshigs bcad kyi rigs dang / bkra shis kyi rigs rnams gang dang gang du dgos pa de dang der sbyar bas chog pa'i phyir/ gcig tu nges pa med mod/ 'on kyang mi ma/bas pas lhongs su gyur rdzu byas na skabs su ma babs pa'i 'don pa yod pas de 'dra 'gog pa'i phyir dang /'tsham zhing 'os pa la the tshom mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'dir nges can gyi tshul du bris so/ /de yang cho ga 'di dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas byed par 'dod pas/ gnas skabs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chung tso go 'phang zhig ma mtha' yang thob par bya/ de nas rab gnas kyi cho ga gzhung dang kha skong 'di gnyis ka blo la shin tu byang bar bzung / lag len dang go ba la mkhas par bya'o/ /'gro phan rgyas byed nyid rgyud gzhud gi dgongs pa tshang la ma nor ba rgyas pa'i lugs yin pas/ byin rlabs che zhi/ nga / rgyun gyi lag len du de kas chog la/ spros pa la dga' ba'i ngor shin tu rgyas pa yang res 'ga' nges par dgos kyin 'dug pas/ dpe 'dzin phran tsheg tsam la yang rtsegs pa'i glang chung gi snyoms las ma byed cig khren tu rgyas pa la kha skong 'di yongs rdzogs bya/ cung zad rgyas pa tsam byed na ji ltar 'tsham pa byas pas chog gi thams cad nag 'ded rang mi dgos/ dper na yangs pa'i grong khyer gyi shis brjod dang / rjes dran dang sems bskyed tsam kha bskangs bas kyang legs por 'ong ngo 'gro phan rgyas byed du bshad pa de dag cung zad kyang ma chad par bya ste/ cho ga rgyas pa nyid kyi lugs byed pa'i dbang du byas pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /cho ga rnam pa du ma la/ /dgos pa'i ngag 'don mtha' yas las/ /'brel med smyon gtam la sogs spangs/ /bzang po 'ba' zhig sdebs pa yin// //zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bar skabs su brjod pa'o/ /gcig zhus/ ma sge la//—101—

༄༅/ /swasmo dang khang bu brtsegs pa sogs la rab gnas mdor bsdus bzhugs go /oṃ snya sti/ ca dang khang bu brtsegs pa sogs la rab gnas mdor bsdus su byed na/ yo byad rnams tshogs par byas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs/rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'am/ bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i bar gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun bskyed ras bris la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ so so'i lugs kyi dngos gzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang mchod pa yan chad bya/ nang gtor dang bdag 'jug mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'ang ma yin pas/ long skabs dang bstun/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang ma 'brel bar/ maṇ+ḍal tsam la brten nas bsgrubs kyang shin tu go chod/ de'i dbang ltar byas na/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las byung ba'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyi rol tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i zhing khams dam pas yongs su bskor zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa khang bzang dam pa'i nang du/ bhuX las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi gdan bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX ma lus sems can ma'am/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ a mṛ ta'i sngags lta bus bsangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye —102—

stu gyis gdan phul/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad 'di zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod dkyil 'khor gang yin pa de'i sngags brgya tsam bzlas/ slar yang mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ rab 'dra/mas rgya mtsho ma sogs/ tshigs bcad 'os pa'i mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor dgos kyi bstod pa dang / de nyid lnga pa sogs ji ltar 'os pas bstod/ sā tsa'i skabs yin la sngar nā tsa ma btab na skabs 'dir 'jim pa byin rlabs kyi skor rnams bya ba yin kyang / phal cher skabs 'dir byed pa nyung ngo / /rab gnas dngos rni/ thog mar bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig sgrib sbyang ba nges par bya zhing / spro na byur bsal ba yang byed/ sngar dkyil 'khor so so/'i lugs kyi bum pa sgrubs yod na/ las bum gyis khrus gso la bya zhing / gal te bum/ pa ma sgrubs rung / dri bzang gi chus gang ba'i bum pa la a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags nyer gcig tsam bzlas nas/ phyin drug gi tshigs bcad sogs khrus gsol cha chang bar bya/ spro na/ gang la ser sna sogs byon legs kyi tshigs bcad dam/ grwa lnga nas 'byung ba'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis chen mo gang rung gi sgo nas khrus gsol bya/ rten rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhu las de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten yangs shing rgya che bar gyur pa'i bum pa'i nang du/ /o hu tru hi a rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ byang ye du dan yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas skyabs spyin dang g.yem na mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad —103—

kyang rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhug shing / dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa / seng ge glang go rta mchog rma bya/ mkha' lding gi khri rnams la rim par bzhugs pa'o/ /rten gzhan rnams rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de spyi dang 'dra/ de rjes brtan bzhugs kyi bar rab gnas dkyus bzhin byed pa'am/ dbang bskur gyi skabs rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa bya ste/bstod pa'i skabs su tshigs bcad bzhi pa'i bstod pa dang / spro na mchod rten gyis bstod pa gzhan yang 'don/ skabs 'dir cha gsum mam/ phyi rol gtor ma'am/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs btang / de rjes shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /'jim pa byin rlabs logs su byed na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ mngon rtogs bsdus pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa zhig bya/ de nas 'jim pa/ sku phor/ 'khru mar/ nang bzhugs/ brdar bu/ tho ba sogs yo byad rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dzoms par/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ o ā bhu hū las byung ba'i rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi phung po nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dza spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad sogs ji ltar 'os pa sbyar/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga ma sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis 'jim pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i —104—

thugs ka nas sngags kyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung 'jim pa la thim par gyur/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya bsnol ba 'jim pa'i steng du bzhag ste gzungs nyi shu rtsa gcig 'don/ sngags gzhan rnams kyang gsum gsum mam bdun bdun tsam bzla/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha la/ ar+ghaX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di 'jim nga/'i tshogs chen po la gal che dang / spros pa la dga' ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ bsdu na dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi sngags dang phyag rgya kho na'i byin rlabs kyis chog go /man thang dang / rdo lha thor bu dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i mchod rten sogs la'ang / rab gnas dngos gzhi gong dang 'dra/ rigs gsum mchod rten la so so'i sngags kyi byin rlabs re brtan bzhugs kyi rjes la byed par snang / rigs gsum gyi sku brnyan yod na rigs gsum rang du bskyed pa legs so/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge'o/ /zhus dag /༄༅/ /'chi med 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs tre rna /oṃ na maX.ār+ya tā re ye/ rnam bkra'i ye shes 'od brgya yi/ /dra ba 'gyed las gdung sel zhing / /kai la sha yi dpal mnga' ba'i/ /'phags ma'i sku la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /ye shes rgya mtsho 'gro la yid bzhin gyi/ /'chi med nor bu'i dga' ston sbyin mdzad pa/ /gang de'i zhabs sen zla ris bdag cag gi /ral ba'i khri la nam yang bsti bar gyur/ /'phags pa de'i bzhed srol las byung ba'i/ /'chi med ār+ya tā re sgrub par 'dod pas/ bsti gnas mchog tu/ kha shar du phyogs lus —105—

bsrangs te/ rdo rje snying gar bzung nas/ oX a na du dī tsit+ta badz+ra sa tā haX/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badzo da ke huX/ dung phor du chu blug oX ta ste ta ste mahā ta ste swāhā/ ye shes pa dgug pa'o/ /tseX( khyi swahwa rla1 kha/ tseX( khaXsruhwa blo/ gdong / tseX( pa rtiX ga hūX/ yan lag lnga/ tseX( sarba ta thā ga tā bhi sogs kyis lus kun bkru'o/ /tseX( sarba pā paX sa ra ya hūX phaṭa/ khrus khu dor/ tseX( badz+ra satwa bā yu/ rlung g.yas nas dgang zhing / g.yon nas dbyung / tseX( badz+ra sma na huX gis gdan/oX āXthiX gis sgo gsum/ oX āXswāhā bhaṇ+ḍaX/ dril bu/ oX huX swāhā badz+raX/ rdo rje/ oX oX swāhā/mu traX gis lus byin rlabs// de nas rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i snying ga'i 'od kyis lus nga/ med pa'i skyabs/ yul spyan drangs/ oX gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi sa ltu e phya hi/mchod cing bstod nas/ gang gis drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba sa/rnga / /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ oX hūṃ n+ya ta/ rdo rje gsor 'ing / dril bu dkrol la/ hūX lan gsum/ rdor dril 'dzin bzhin du hū ཾ ༷ ka ra'i rgyas phyogs bcings te/ oX in+t+ra ya badz+ra rak+ṣa huX/ a sna ya: ya ma: ni ri t+ya: ba ru ṇa: ba ya bya: yak+ṣa: i sha na prad+ma bṛ shrī: zhes bsgyur/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi rgyas/ oX za na me rak+ṣa skyoX/ yo ga at+pa slar yang rdor dril 'dzin/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bskor zhing bstan la/ oX sarba rak+ṣa ṇaX badz+ra haX/ oX swa bhā ba: kun rdzob kyi snang ba rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa gdod ma'i ring nas/ zhing khams rgya mtsho rnam par snang bar byed pa'i pad zla dri ma med pa'i steng du/ rang sems kyi ngo bo tāX gi nā das/ srid zhi ma lus pa'i rang bzhin gyi mi shigs pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud thams cad spyan drangs/ro mnyam du gyur pa/ rang nyid 'phags ma kai la sha ltar dkar zhing dri ma med pa —106—

zla ba chu shel lta bu/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar tri ltel kya bi dza ya mu dra 'ching ba/ 'og ma zung gis mchog spyin dang bcas pa'i tsin+ta ma ni dang / ut+pal dkar po'i sdong gdang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ ston zla gang ba lta bu'i bzhin ras 'dzum zhing sdug pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing li ba me tog 'phreng bas cung zad bcings shing g.yas ngos su grol ba/ nu 'bur 8'phrang zhing rgyas pa/ sgeg cing lang tsho gsar du rgyas pa'i sku 'khril bag chags shing / rdo rje'i gdan gyis bzhugs nga /ka shi'i ras phran gyis stod g.yogs dang / dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i dar gyi shams thabs can/ sku la tshe spel ba'i nor bu du mas spras nga/ las byung ba'i sil khrol rna ba'i bcud len no/ /g.yas su pang/ zla la ma las dru/ ri cho gser mdog sgeg myo rdo rje dang / a sho ka'i yal ga 'dzin pa༈ rgyan dang cha lus sa gtso mo lta bu/ g.yon du pad nyi la hu las e ka—dza ṭi sngon cho gri gug dang thod nga/ khrag can 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sha rma/sa thabs dang / glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs can/ drag mo ral pa dmar ser lan bu gcig pa g.yon du 'phyang ba/gnyis ka'ang rol pas bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khore gsum ka'ang zhing rab 'byams snang bar byed pa'o/ /gnas gsum du rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya btugs te/ rig pa lan gsum brjod/ rigs gsum byin gyis brlabs/ o ā hūṃ ho gnas ba'i byin gyis brlabs nas/ dza hu ba ho / de bzhin rngo/shegs pa rnams sku 'a zhugs pas/ ye bes 'khor lo sad/ sa bon las 'od 'phros/ lha spyan drangs/ gsol btab dbang bskur chu rgyun ngang / /sdig bral mi g.yo cod pa na dang / /brtan par brjod pa rnam/ pa bcu/ zhes nga/ dbang ste/ snri ngang mthun la/ rigs bdag ni snang ba ma/tha' yas so/ /snyad su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye snya hā/ de nas/ rang —107—

gi lus nang du snod bcud rab 'byams snang ba la sems 'ching ba zhing gi rnal 'byor dang / de dag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas lus thams cad brtan par gang bas/ nam mkha' ji srid bar rkyen gang gis mi shigs pa'i rtag brtan g.yung drung gi dpal thob par bsam pa 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor ste/ de nas rtsod bral kyi yid rtse gcig pas/ o na ma tā re na mo ha re hū ha re swāhā/ zhes dza pa ci nus bya'o/ /de nas mchod cing bstod la/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzlas nas/ badz+ra mu yis ye shes 'khor lo gdod ma la zhugs/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyi rig pa lan gsum brjod/oṃ badz+re badz+re ma he badz+re pra ma tha badz+re ut+pa ko3ha/ lha sku sna tshogs rdo rjer bsams/ bla na meng/ pa'i byang chub la mi dmigs pa nyid kyis dmigs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba lhag par bsngo'o/ /'gro 'di g.yung drung gnas la sngon nyid nas/ /ngang gis 'dug mod tshul de ma rtogs rnams/ /mthar byed sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gyis ngal ba/ /gsal ba'i thabs 'di yi ger gyis shig ces/ /de skad sa skyong bka' yi chu khur gyis/ /kun dga' snying po'i blo gros dbyar skyes sprin/ /rnam par lci las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i char/ /'gro la zhing pa'i bsod nams bzhin du babs/ /'dir gtor ma dang zas kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba dang thun mtshams kyi spyod pa rnams ni bya ba khyad par can spyi las 'byung ba ltar yin la/ gdams pa'i gnad rnams ni rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde las rtogs par bya dgos pas/ ngo/na la ston pa'i sngags pa dag gis nan tan bgyi ba'i 'os so/ /zhes pa 'di ni mkhyen yangs mi'i dbang pos bka' yis bskul ba las/ shākya'i dge tshul kun dga' snying pos g.yar khral du 'tshal ba'o// // shu bha ma stu/༈ bstod pa ni/ o nam mkha' dang mnyam mnyam nyid ro mnyam sku mnga' ba/ /dngos rnams 'gro yang nam mkha' rtag tu 'gro med bzhin/ /'jig dang zhig med 'ong ba med phyir ngo mtshar ci/ /ya mtshan sku mnga' 'phags ma sgrol ma —108—

la phyag 'tshal/ /srid dang srid pa rtag tu med par gzigs mod kyang / /snying rje las byung smon lam dbang gis 'gro la rtag rjes gzigs/ /rnam par 'phrul pa rtag tu 'chad pa med mnga' bas/ khams gsum kun la bde ba chen po spyin phyag 'tshal/ khyod kyi 'od 'phreng thun mtshams babs pa'i 'od dmar bzhin/ /yid 'phrog lha dbang gis btud gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od/ /'dre la rnams 'dud dzā ḍa de yang 'gro kun gyis/ /nyin dang mtshan la lan brgyar phyag bya'i 'os su 'gyu/ra/ /zhes so/ /༄༅/ /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rnam par 'byed pa gsang ba'i sgron ma bzhugs so/ /oX sidha ra stu/ sa du ru shrī man ba dzñā tsār+ya tsa rā ṇa ka ma la na ma stu te/ gang zhig gsung dang sku la pha mtha' mkha' ltar las/ /mkha' dbyings rab mnyam thugs ni ye shes gcig pu ste/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin nyid na'ang brtan dang g.yo kun la/ /go skabs sbyin mdzang/ 'phags ma 'jig rten yum la 'dud/ /srid pa'i 'brog dgon chen por dub gyur gang / /rnam par bcas dang mtshan med ting 'dzin gyi/ /de nyid rnam bzhi'i them skas la 'dzegs na/ /bla med byang chub khang bzang cis mi bgrod/ /de lta bas na thar pa gnyer gang la/ /ci nas lam bzang dga' ston byos shig ces/ /de skad sa skyong bka' yi khur blangs —109—

te/ /rmongs pa bdag kyang cung zad spobs par 'dod/ /de la skal ba dang ldan nga/ 'ga' zhig 'bras bu'i theg pa las brtsams te bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i lam ni 'di yang ste/ de la 'di bya ba'i rgyud rigs drug las pad+ma'i rigs su gtogs pa yin la/ de yang rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pa'i zhabs kyis rnam par bkral ba'i lugs 'di la/ skyes bu phyi rol la mngon par dga' ba la bya rgyud khyad nga/ra can kho na'i lugs dang / nang rnal 'byor la mngon par dga' ba la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud go mtshungs kyi lugs gnyis las/ skabs kyi don phyi ma yin yang / re shig dang po brjod par bya ste/ lam 'di yi tshul la bslab pa'i don du sna/ /de yang spyir bya ba'i rgyud las ji ltar 'byung tshul mdor bsdus na/ 'jug pa'i dang / sbyor ba'i dang / sgrub nga/'i dang / /grub pa'i spyod pa bzhi'i/ dang po ni/'jig rten las 'das ji/'i rigs gsum gyi dkyil 'bor gang rung du dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ gnas 'di tsam la ni 'das nga/'i pra sen sogs kyis sngon gsang sngags/ spyad par shes/ te/ bcom ldan 'ang/sa dam tshig gsum b.lad pa'i cho ga las 'byung ba la sogs pas sdig nga/ byang ba'i mtshan rma/ mthong nas byin gyis brlabs pa dag kyang rung ste/ ji ltar legs par grub pas zhus pa'i rgyud las/ dngos grub myur du thob gyur pa/ /sngags bzlas pa yi 'dul ba nga khrig da/ /sgrub pa gsang sngags thams cad dang / /lha rnams dag ni thams cad dang / /zlos pa bdag nyid chen ngo/ la/ /mkhas nga/sa zhe sdang mi bya'o/ /zhes pa nas/ gsang sngags gzhan du spyad mi bya/ /'gran pa dang ni sad phyir spangs/—110—

zhes pa'i bar ltung ba sum cu spang bar gsungs pa sogs brtul zhugs rnams blang ba ste/ mdor na gang zag sgrub pa dang mi sgrub nga gnyis ka'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs dang dbang blang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba'i spyod pa la/ bdag dang / lha dang / sngags dang /bsam gtan gyi de nyid bzhi'i dang po ni bdag ste/ rang gi sems rang bzhin 'od gsal rang rig pa/ stong pa rnam pa thams cad pa'o /gnyis pa lha drug po rnams dang / gsum pa ni sngags kyi bsam gtan te bzlas brjod kyi de nyid ces kyang bya la/ bzhi pa ni mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams te/ de rnams kyang bsdu na/ lha drug ting nge 'dzin rnam bcas dang / don dam ting nge 'jin gnyis su med pa la sbyor ba dang gnyis su 'du ba las/ de'i don cung zad bshad na/dang po ni/ dgos pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa dpung bzang las dngos grub thob phyir ni rnam pa bcu gsungs te/ sngags pa dang ni rang sngags g.yog dang rdzas/ /brtson 'grus phyogs dang sa gzhi dus dang ni/ /yan lag rdzogs pa'i lha dang sems stobs so/ /gzhan dag kha cig rig 'dzin grogs zhes zer/ /gzhan dag phyogs dang brtson 'grus dus rnams nyid/ /gzhan ni rdzas dang sa gzhi lha dang sngags/kha cig sems stobs yin zhes rnam par smra/ /sgrub phyir de dag bcu dang brgyad dang lnga/ /de bzhin bzhi dang gsum dang gcig nyid ces/ /sngags rig rang rang blo yis rnam par 'chad/ /sangs rgyas rgyud la cho ga gnyis kyis 'grub/ /sgrub po gang zhig rang gi yon tan rdzogs/ /brtson 'grus mchog dang yang dag ldan pa —111—

dang / /gzhan gyi rnyed pa la yang phrag dog med/ /'dod la ma chags las kyi nyon mongs bzod/ /gug skyed klad kor tshang ba zur phyin la/ /gsang sngags dag cing shin tu cho gar bcas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bsten pa yis/ /gnas su gnas na yid 'ong dngos grub thob/ /sngags pa sgrub po/ rang sngags lha/ sgrub grogs g.yog /ldong ros sogs rdzas/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ gan+dha ra dang yul dbus sogs phyogs/ ri rtse sogs sa gzhi/ dpyid zla dang / snga dro sogs dus/ bris sku sogs yan lag rdzogs pa'i lha/ brtul phod pa'i sems stobs te bcu dang / phyi ma gnyis ma gtogs brgyad/ sngags pa/grogs/ phyogs/ brtson 'grus/ dus te lnga/ snga ma gnyis bor ba gsum/ rdzas/sa gzhi/ lha/ sngags te bzhi/ sems stobs gcig nyid de/ de rnams 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams kyi gtso phal ma phyed par dngos grub sgrub pa'i yun ring por 'gyur la/ gang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byon nas bstan pa la ni sgrub pa po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang / gsang sngags dag cing cho ga ma nyams pa gnyis gtso bor bzung / gzhan rnams phal pa'i tshul du gsungs/ dang po go sla la/ zur phyin pa sogs sngags dang / cho ga ma nyams pa lha'i rnal 'byor dang /sngags kyi bsam gto gyi cho ga gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ dang po khrus byas rnal 'byor pas/ /rdo rje'i gdan la 'dug nas ni/ /mchod dang gsol ba lha drug bsgom/ /stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang / /phyag rgya mtshan ma drug tu 'dod/ /de yang / thog mar gtsang sbra khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ dpung bzang las/ lus la sa yi dril phyis byas nas su/ /chu chen rnyog pa med par —112—

zhugs nas kyang / /ji tsam 'dod pa'i bar du khrus byas te/ / byung (〈khyu〉byang ) nas shar ram byang du kha bltas te/ /chu yis lag pa rkang pa bkrus nas ni/ /pus mo phyi rol du ni bstan byas te/ /bar du lag bzhag tsog tsog por 'dug ste/ /sgra med dbu ba med par nye reg bya/ /nye reg gi dmigs bsal ni/so la chags pa lce yis reg pa dang / /sgrid pa byung nas kha yang bkru bar bya/ /rab byung skyes pa bud med gzhon nu dang / /gzhon nu ma dang bram ze rgan mo dang / /de la sngags pas nam yang reg mi bya/ /sngags pas de dag rnams la mi bsam mo/ /sgrub pos de dag rnams la reg gyur tam/ /rgya la de dag rnams kyis reg gyur na/ /slar yang khrus byas mthor 'thung byas nas su/ /de nas phyir yang bzlas la 'jug par bya/ /zhes dang / sa phud bshang sgor lnga ste mtshan la gsum/ /g.yas g.yon gsum ste lag pa gnyis la bdun/ /yang na chu dang sa yis ji srid du/ /dri ma bral ba de srid bar du bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje'i gdan ni bdag dang gnas bsrung ba dang / de nas bris sku mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du rang rigs kyi skyil krung bcas te 'dug nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la mchod pa byas nas/ dang por bdag gi de kho na nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal ba gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes bdag med rnam pa thams cad pa la ring du mnyam par bzhag /de nas bdag gi de kho na nyid las langs te lha drug mngon du byed pa yin te/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ lha yi sku yi gnas de la/ /dang por kho nar mchod nas ni/ /rnal 'byor gnas bcas shes rab can/ /bde gshegs mdun du bsam nas ni/ /phyi nas yan lag rnam grol ba'i/ /mig —113—

'byed 'byed pa rnam par spangs/ /phra ba mi g.yo gsal ba ste/ /blo yi spyod yul mdun na gnas/ /bdag nyid de 'dra bzhag nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nges pa las so/ /de la thog mar bstod pa'i lha/ bdag gi de nyid dang dbyer mi phyed par rang rig stong pa nyid rnam med du mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ mngon sum du gyur gyi bar bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de las langs nas nā da ste sgra'i lha/ gsang sngags kyi sgrar grags pa dang / de las sngags kyi yi ge nam mkhar gnas pa yi ge'i lnga/ de zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ro mnyam du gyur pa 'od zer spro bsdu byas nas lhag pa'i lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bskyed pa gzugs kyi lha/ de nas gtsug tor la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa phyag rgya'i lha/ de nas mnyam bzhag tu yan lag can dang bcas pa'i lha'i sku dam par gsal ba las sems gzhan du mi 'phro ba ci nus par srog rtsol bsdams la bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor bya ba yin te/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/sngags kyi rnam par shes pa bsgoms/ /bsdams nas ting nge 'dzin la gnas//srog dang rtsol ba rab tu bsdams/ /zhes so/ /rjes thob tu yang lha'i snang ba dang ma bral bar sgom pa ni mtshan ma'i lha ste de ltar drug go /gnyis pa sngags kyi bsam gtan ni/ lhar bsgom na sngags bzla ba pos/ rus sbal gyi yan lag bskum pa lta bur dbugs rgyu ba dang sems dbang ngo/'i grong nang du bsdus/ nang na gnas pa phyir lta ba'i tshul gyis mig zim byas nas gdong cung zad stod de/ byang rgod chags sdang dbugs 'byung sa kyi rtog pa sogs spangs pa'i don yin la/ de nas sngags kyi bsam gtan dngos la/—114—

mdun gyi thugs ka'i yi ge la dmigs la/ rang gi de la dmigs pa/ sgra la dmigs pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ sgra sngags 'phreng / sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gzhi sangs rgyas kyi sku rnams dus gcig kho nar dmigs te/ yid bzlas sam shub bu'i bzlas pa bya zhing / bar skabs su rlung rang sor bzhag nas/ de nas dbugs 'byung ba na gsang sngags mi 'gyur pa'i gzhi rang lhar gsal ba la bltas nas dbugs rngub ste mdun gyi sgra sems gzhi gsum la dmigs nas dbugs 'byung ba'i mthar thug pa srog rtsol bsdams la bzlas pa bya/ ngal zhing dub na sgra sems la/ sems gzhi la/ rang gi lha'i de nyid kyang gzhi la bsdus nas/ ring du bdag gi de nyid la mnyam par bzhag nas tha mal ba'i gzugs kyis ldang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ rang lha'i de nyid dang ldan pa'i rlung 'byung rngub bkagamig cung zad btsum kyang yid snang ba dang bcas pas mdun du gtad/ ha cang mi ring pa/ rang las/ cung zad mtho bar sangs rgyas kyi sku'i thugs kar zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bsams la/ rlung rngub pa dang lhan cig tu mdun gyis thugs ka'i zla ba sngags bcas rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rlung phyir 'byung ba na mdun gyis thugs kar bkod de/ mdor na zla ba'i steng gi sngags phreng la dmigs shing zla ste/ ji srid bzlas brjod kyi bar du spro wo sgom la/ mthar sgra sems gzhi ste yan lag gsum dmigs nas ldang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/bzlas brjod yan lag bzhi sngar ltar bsgom/ de nas gzhi de bzhin gshegs pa la bltas nas/ slar yang ltes chu btung ba'i tshul gyis sems kyi rta rlung dang —115—

lhan cig yid nang du phyogs par bya / dbugs 'byung rngub bkag rang lha dang gnyis su med pa dran tsam byas nas/ de'i rjes su dbyibs dang bral ba sgra tsam la sems bzung nas/ yid bzlas bya zhing / dbugs phyir 'byung ba na gzhi sangs rgyas kyi sku la dmigs nas ngag gis shub bu'i bzlas pa bya ba ste/ mdor na gzhi de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsang sngags mi 'gyur ba'i gzhi gcig tu byas te/ bzlas brjod kyi ting nge 'dzin dang po la sgra sems gzhi ste dmigs pa'i yul gsum/ gnyis par rang dang mdun gyi thugs kar dmigs pa ste gnyis / gsum pa sgra gcig pu de gsum snga ma la goms nas phyi ma la bslabs te/ ji skad du/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol/ /gsang sngags mi 'gyur gzhi la gnas/ /yan lag ma nyams gsang sngags brjod/ /ngal na bdag la ngal bso zhing / /mi 'gyur ba ni yi ger ldan/ /gzhi las gzhir 'gyur de bzhin nyid/ /rang sngags phyir ni gang brtags pa/ /yid kyi dag pa bsam par bya/ /slar sdud pa yis bkug nas ni/ /srog dang rtsol ba bsdams pa'i yid/ /gsang sngags rig pa sngags la sbyar/ /yid kyi bzlas brjod brtsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa don dam ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsam gtan 'ba' zhig gis sgrub pa ni/ phub la sogs pa'i gnas su sngar bshad nga/'i gzugs dang sgra dang don dam pa'i lha bsgoms te/ 'on kyang 'dir gzugs kyi lha'i bdag nyid yid kyis brtags pa'i sngags phreng / sgra ni rig sngags nyid kyi yi ge sgra'i rang bzhin/ don dam ni yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa'i ye —116—

shes la mnyam par 'jog pa/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster/ /sgrar gnas rnal 'byor ster bar byed/ /sgra mthas thar pa ster bar byed/ /'di dag de nyid gsum pa yin/ /zhes bsam gtan phyi mar bka' stsal pa ltar/ gsum gyi dang po ni/ bdag gi de kho na nyid mngon du byas nas/ de'i rjes thob sgra'i bdag nyid lha'i de kho na nyid du bsgom la/ de snying gar me lce'am 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa la sems bzung nas/srog rtsol bkag bying rgod spangs te/ bsam gtan du bya ba/ ji srid bkres pa med pa sogs mtshan ma byung ba na/ ji ltar bsam pa sgrub nus pa la sogs pa dngos grub thob kyi bar du ste bzlas brjod kyi 'jug dang / rnam pa gzhan du'ang shes par bya ste/ phyi ma las/ mi 'byed las byung dngos po rnams/ /blo chen gyis ni bdag la bsdams/ /sngags pa yan lag 'das la gnas/ /zhen pa med par bsam par bya/ /sgra zhes bya ba phreng ba sbyar/ /yi ge brgyus la mi 'gyur rnams//dril bu'i sgra bzhin ma chad par/ /yid la cen par sems pa na/ /me yi nang gnas zhi ba ste/ /tshig rnams dag pa yang dag ldan/ /srog dang rtsol ba bkag pa'i bdag /gnyis spangs nas ni rnam par bsams/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi de nyid la gnas pa'i snying gar zla ba rang gi me lce'i nang na gnas pa'am/ zla ba nyid sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ de nas sngags kyi yig gzugs kyi rnam pa spangs la/ sgra'i dbyangs tsam la rtse gcig pas bsam gtan du bya ste/ phyi ma las/ snying gar gnas pa'i phra ba ni/ /dri med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /de nang rab tu zhi ba ni/ /me lce rab tu 'od bzang ba/ /mi 'gyur —117—

gzhi ni der bzhag nas/ /bder 'dug nas ni sgra bsam mam/ /mi 'gyur ba ni yi ger bzhag /sgra nyid 'ba' shig bsams par bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can shin tu sbom po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis tha mal gyi rtog pa spangs/ de shub bu'i bzlas pa'i sgra la dmigs pa rags pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis spangs/ de yang phra mo yid bzlas kyis ting nge 'dzin gyis spangs la de nyid kyang rab tu gsang sngags kyi rnam rtog gi ting nge 'dzin gyis spangs nas/ de tsam yang spangs te 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin la mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ mdor bsdu na sgrar gnas kyi rnal 'byor te/ ting nge 'dzin sems pa la brtan pa thob nas/ sgra mtha' ni de ltar rim pa lngar gsung pa bsdu na/ sgra de gang nas byung / gang du song sogs brtags shing / /de nas de 'dra'i rtog pa yang spangs shing / ci yang ma rnyed pa de'i ngang du yang yang sems 'jog pa ste/ des thar pa ster zhes pa'o/ /de skad du yang / sgra la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan ni/ /'ba' zhig byas pa nyid kyis kyang / /dngos po kun rnams dam pa'i dpal/ /sgrub pa'i skyes bu thob par 'gyur/ /ltos bcas yan lag gyur pa snang / /sgra zhes bya ba yid kyis ngang / /tshig rnams dag pa rig sngags dbang / /yan lag spangs pa rgyal ba'i mkhyen/ /de ltar rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa dang brtul zhugs blangs nas sngags kyi tshul khrims ma nyams pa dag gis bzlas brjod la sogs pa de kho na nyid gzhi la brtson 'grus chen po sgrub na byang chub gsum ci yang rung ba dbang po dang 'tshams pas thob par 'gyur te/ rig sngags de nyid ma lus dang / bdag —118—

gi de nyid cho ga dang / bzlas brjod de nyid mchog shes pa'i/ /mis ni dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bsam gtan phyi ma dang / dpung bzang gis zhus pa las kyang / so ka nags me mched pa'i me lce yis/ /ma sgrib bzhin du tshang tshing kun sreg ltar/ /bzlas brjod me la tshul khrims rlung gis sbar/ /brtson 'grus chen po'i me lces sdig pa bsreg /zhes pa nas/ tshe rabs stong na gnas pa'i sdig pa'i mun/ /bzlas brjod mar mes myur du sel bar byed/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ste/ de ltar dbang po rnon pos dang / dbang brtul gyis ni/ sgrub pa dang grub pa'i spyod pa la yang sbyar bar bya ste/ gsum pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi de nyid la brtan pa thob nas/ rdzas sngags kyi sbyor bas lha la sogs pa'i lus dang / mig sman sogs rdzas dang / rin chen bdun sogs longs spyod de thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'o/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa ni/ dngos grub gsum gang rung ba grub nas rang gzhan gyi don ji ltar spyod tshul dang / 'bras bu byang chub gsum po ste/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ mchog la mchog dang grub pa dang / /'bring la 'bring du nye bar bstan/ /tha ma phran tshegs grub pa ni/ /rgyal ba mchog gis mngon gsungs so/ /zhes dngos grub dang / yang de nyid las/ gang zhig rgyal dang rgyal sras sngags/ /sems can phyir ni gsungs pa rnams/ /gang zhig de thos mngon brtson pa/ /de ni nges par sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gang yang sngags ni bags ma dag/gang zhig zlos pa de zlos byed/ /rang sangs rgyas su yang dag bstsan/ /nges par de yi rigs kyang yin/ /sngags ni tha mar rab zhugs pa/ /—119—

nyan thos dgra bcom gyis bshad dang / /'jig rten ma lus kun la yang / /sngags zlos pa la mngon brtson pa/ /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po yi/ /nges par rigs su de gnas yin/ /mchog dang tha ma bar ma yi/ /der yang las ni rab sbyar bya/ /zhes byang chub gsum du bstan to/ /de ltar mdor na spyod pa bzhis bya ba'i rgyud kyi don kun bsdus pa ste/ rgyas par gsang ba spyi rgyud dang / khro bo legs grub kyis zhus pa dang / dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud dang / bsam gtan phyi ma la sogs par shes par bya'o/ /da ni lam gyi rim pa de dag dang ldan pa'i rje btsun ma 'phags ma'i sgrub thabs nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ nang par tho rangs chu klung gi drung du song ste/ oṃ badzodaka snun huX/ zhes dag byed du byin gyis brlabs la/ chu klung der zhugs nas snyims pa gsum nam mkhar gtor/ oX u rna badz+ra rak+ṣa huX/zhes brjod/ phyogs mtshams kun tu gtor la/ oX sarba ta thā ga tā ka ma la badz+ra ku lī sa pa ri ba rā dzñā ya tsa tur di ga rak+ṣa huX/ zhes dang / rkang pa rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i tshul du byas nas/ oṃ bruX badz+ra bhuX mi swāhā/ zhes phyogs bsrungs te/ oX kā ya bā kyi ta sarba pa la snu na huX/ oX sarba ta thā ga tā bhi ṣe ke ta sa ma ya shrī hūX/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā pad+ma badz+re ṇa spya na badz+ra hūX/ zhes khrus dang nye reg bya/ de tsam ma nus na ril pa'i chus khrus bya ste/ de nas gnas khang gi sgo drung na 'dug ste/ oṃ sarba go 'a pañtsa ka sa ma dzī lo ka ku lī da bā naX ka phywa naX kurba skye/ zhes brjod nas/ sgrub khang sogs kyi dbus su bris sku'am lugs sku sogs bzhugs su gsol/gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bla bre lda ldi sogs kyis brgyan/ phyogs mtshams brgyang —120—

kar mchod pa rnam lnga/ chu bzhi pa re re las mi nyung ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa'i glegs bam dang / rin po ches gang ba'i bum pa bzhi/ 'khru dang / dri dang / sha khar dang / 'o thug dang /mig sman gyis gang ba'i bum pa dang / dur pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa bshams pa rig pa'i bdag po'i sngags kyis bsngags pa'i bsangs chus gtor la/ oṃ las byung ba'i snod yangs par bsams la mchod pa rnams bskyed/ rang rang gi sngags rgya dang / dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ sku gzugs lhar gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstims/ de nas mchod bstod rgya cher byas nas byin gyis rlob par gsol ba gdab/ de nas gdong byang du phyogs pas pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'dug la/ skyabs su 'gro ba sogs byas nas/ bdag gi de kho na nyid la yun ring du nan to du byas te/stong pa'i lha/ oṃ shā n+ya ta stong pa de'i ngang las nā da gsang sngags thams cad kyi sgra dang bcas pa sgra'i lha/ de las zla bar tā bsam pa yi ge'i lha/ de gnyis ro mnyam las 'phags ma dang / de'i thugs ka nas lha mo gnyis spros nas rdul rnyed kyi sprul pas 'gro don mdzad par bsam pa gzugs kyi lha/ 'di las brtsams te thun mtshams su yang lha snang rjes su dran bzhin pa ni mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan ma'i lha/ 'di ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran bzhin pas sku gzugs lhar shes pa'i dbang las/ chu shing gcig stong par shes na thams cad kyang rig pa lta bur snang ba kun+da ltar shes pa'i gnad dam pa'o/ /de nas phyag rgyas lha/pad+ma'i phyag rgya snying gar gtugs te/ rig pa lan gsum brjod/ rang gi sems —121—

dang mdun gyi lha dbyer mi phyed par bsam pa ni/ lha de yang sems su gtogs pa'i thabs te/ de nas dbang gi lha pad+ma'i rigs spyan drangs gsol ba gdab/bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag brtan par byas par bsams la/pad+ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag ste rig pa lan gcig bzlas pa'i cod pan gyi dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rje btsun ma'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags phreng bsgom nas rlung nang du bsdams/ sngags zla ba/ lha sku gsum la rtse gcig tu dmigs la yid bzlas bya/ de nas rlung 'byung ba na/ rang lhar gsal tsam la dmigs la shub bur sngags bzla ste/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/mahā sa tā ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka ya/ ta du thā/ o na ma tā re na mo ha re hu ha re swāhā/zhes bzla/ de la brtan pa thob nas lha'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni rang stong pa'i lha'i ngang las gzugs kyi lhar dmigs la mdun gyi thugs kar sngags phreng sngar bzhin/ bsgoms nas rlung nang du 'jug pa na rang gi snying ga dang / phar 'gro na mdun gyi thugs kar bkod de sngar bzhin bzla/ de la goms nas snga ma bzhin char gcig sgom ste/ sgra tsam la dmigs nas bzla ste bzlas brjod dang / de'i mthar mdun gyi thugs kar 'od 'bar ba'i dbus na sngags phreng tsam bsgom nas gzhan mi bsam par 'byung rngub bkag la yid bzlas bya/ dbugs 'byung ba na ci yang mi bsam par bya ba dang / de brtan nas/ thog mar zla ba la rig pa'i rgyal po bsgoms nas/ de nas ni de yang mi dmigs par sgra tsam la sems bzung ste/ bying rgod spangs nas bsgom par bya ba dang / de yang goms nas/ sgra de lus sems thog mtha' —122—

gang nas byung sogs dpyad na ci yang ma grub pa de'i ngang du ci yang mi bsam par 'jog pa bsam gtan gyi de nyid rnams te/ de nas tha mal pa'i gzugs kyis ldang bar bya'o/ /de ltar bzlas pa la sogs pa gnas skabs gang du sngar bshad pa ltar dmigs gsal gyi khrus dang nye reg sogs brtsams par bya zhing / thun mtshams su gsung rab bklags pa dang / 'byung ba chen po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams la gtor ma spyin pa dang / sā tsa gdab pa sogs bya ste/ ji ltar legs grub kyis zhus pa las 'byung ba bzhin/ cha gsum gyi gtor ma thun mtshams bzhin skyin la/ mi smra ba dang / bsnyung bar gnas pa dang / khrus dang bsreg blugs sogs ji ltar bzod par dka' thub kyang ngo / /zas la 'jug na yan lag lnga dang kha bkrus nas/ sha chang la phug sgog skya ke'u sogs 'byung po'i zas spangs pa'i kha zas gtsang zhing / kha na ma tho ba med pa lus gnas pa'i slad tsam du ji ltar 'os par spyad par bya mod kyi/ rgyags pa dang dregs pa'i don du ni nam yang ma yin no/ /tshul 'dis ni nyer mkho'i yo byad thams cad kyang rig par bya'o/ /de ltar zas zos nas chu klung la sogs par khrus dang nye reg byas nas/ slar ji ltar rigs pa la 'jug par bya ste/ skabs 'dir slob dpon 'dis/ nyal dang ldang dang bya ba la/ /sgrub po gang zhig 'jug 'dod na/ /rig pa'i rgyal po hu lu sogs/ /rta mchog rig sngags chen po rgyal/ /bdag gi lus ni rtag tu bsrung //dbyug 'dzin snying gar gnas pa'o/ /dbyug pa rab bskul ka na ya/ /phyag rgya'i rdo rje de bzhin gnas/ /zhes pa'i mthar rta mchog gi rig pa sogs mdor na/—123—

nyal ba ldang ba/ thun mtshams su 'jug pa rnams kyi tshe bsrung ba de bya bar gsung la/ des na rdo rje'i gdan la zhes gsungs pa gnas dang bdag bsrung ba la bya ste/ de'i dbang las mchod pa'i sngon du'ang bya dgos la/ de lta na yang bya rgyud spyi las 'byung ba'i gnas bdag bsrung ba'i cho ga'i khyad par mi ldan no snyam na/ de ltar zad mod/ spyi'i cho ga de dag ni gang du cho ga mi gsal ba rnams la sbyar zhing / rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par ni so sor spyad par bya dgos te/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel par/'dir ni re shig spyi'i gsang sngags kyi rnam par shes pa sgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /gang kha cig tu rnam pa gzhan du gsungs pa de dag tu yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i nges pa'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po sogs kyi don bdag dang gnas bsrung ba'i tshul de nyid ci snyam na/ 'di lta ste/ rang gi snying gar pad nyi la/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa tā ya/ mahā satwa ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ ta du thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu mahā kro dha bhi khri ṇa mu tī/ kha kha sku hi ji hi/ mahā dgi ka ra/ sa ha sra mu kha/ sa ha sra tsa rā ṇa/ sa ha sra ko ṭi pad+ma bhu dza/ kṛ hā kṛ hā/ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha na/ dwa ru ṇa kā ya/ ha ya kṛ ba/ mahā dā ru ṇa/ tsu ru ti/ ga dzi ti/ sarba nā sa ra lnge //// hūṃ //hūṃ/ / gh+ri /ḍi///sdi spyo//// /// ma in/ hūṃ/bhasma ku asni ya rmi bri shrī// /sde/ /lte / /snye/// —124—

ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'phreng g.yas skor me 'bar ba yongs su gyur pa las rta mchog rol pa rta mgo can ha ha zhes bshad pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ g.yas mchog spyin dang thal mo/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang dbyug pa dkar po o tshugs su byas pa/ dar dang stag lpags dang nor bu dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su bsgom nas rig pa lan drug brjod/ de nas gnas bsrung ba ni/ dbyug pa'i phyag rgya bskul bzhin pas/ ha ya kṛ ba'i rig pa brjod/ gra ha purba rak+ṣa zhes sogs kyi ming bcug nas brjod par bya ste/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas so/ /de nas bkan pa'i phyag rgya phyogs bcur bstan te rigs pa lan gcig brjod/ mdor na de ni bdag dang gnas bsrung ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas nyal ba na yang sangs rgyas rjes su dran bzhin pas snang ba'i 'du shes dang bcas nas nyal bar bya yis/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis ni ma yin no/ /de ltar 'di ni bya rgyud kho na nas 'byung ba'i rim pa ste/ lam 'di la 'bad de/sgrub pa dang grub pa'i spyod pa la sogs pas nye bar sbyar bas dbang po dang mthun par lus 'di'am/ bar dor lha'i lus rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /༈ gnyis pa/ nang rnal 'byor la mngon par gzhol ba'i don du rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang go mtshungs su sbyar ba ni 'di ltar/ mdor na 'chi med ting 'dzin ni/ /sngon 'gro yan lag rnam bzhi dang / /ting 'dzin rnam pa gnyis dngos gzhi/ /mjug dang thun mtshams bya ba'o/ /dang po la/ gzhi dang / rkyen dang / ngo —125—

bo dang / lam gyi yan lag bzhi'i/ dang po gzhi'i yan lag ni/ lus bsrang /kha shar du phyogs te/ o a na du sogs brjod/ de yang sems can rnams kyi sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba 'di ye nas bzhugs pas dang / de nyid 'dir ngo shes pa'i phyir du/ rnam rtog gis ma bcos par gsal 'debs pas na gzhi'i yan lag ces bya'o/ /de la a na di ni thog ma med pa ste/ des mtshon nas tha ma dang bar med la/ de med pa'i dus kyis ma bzung pa'i phyir na yul gyis kyang ma bzung ba ste/ mdor na/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'o/ /a dī ni/dang po dang thog ma dang gdod ma ste/ gsar du grub pa ma yin par thog ma nas 'gro ba rnams la rang rig par bzhugs pa yin la/ de yang bum pa dang bum pa thogs pa lta bur ni ma yin te/ bdag nyid gcig pa'i tshul gyi gshis nyid du gnas pa yin no/ /tsit+ta ni sems te/ de yang / dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin de nyid ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa yin mod kyang / stong pa sems med ni ma yin gyi/'o na ci snyam na/ rang bzhin shin tu dag pa'i 'od gsal ba'i shes pa'o/ /badz+ra satwa ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ sems 'di'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' ste rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes las gzhan ma yin la/ gnas skabs su glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib pa nyid na'ang / rang bzhin 'od gsal de'i ngo bo la ci yang ma gos pa'i phyir na mi shigs pa ste rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /a ha nga'o zhes pa ste/ sngar bshad pa rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ de yang / thog ma med pa/ dang po/ bem stong ma yin pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam pa thams cad pa ni bdag gi de kho na nyid do zhes pa ste/ 'dir smras pa/ nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems ni gdod ma —126—

——ste/ /stong pa chen po rang gi ngo bo gang / /'di ni dam pa'i don de mu stegs kyi//rab brtags bdag tu 'khra/la bar ma bgyis shig /de ltar 'di ni rje btsun byams pas/ dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ /rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ /lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir//zhes gsungs pa'i/ dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir zhes pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /da ni rkyen gyi yan lag las/ kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ zhes pa'i dbang du byas te/ dri ma dag par byed pa khus te/ badzod ke rdo rje'i chu/sems kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin nyid du shes par bya bas na de skad ces bya'o/ /o ta ste sogs kyi lha'i chu bo gaṅgā bkug par bsam ste/ rdo rje'i chu de dag byed du sad nga/ra byas pa bzhin du/ sems kyang dri ma rang dag ste kun nas nyon mongs nyid med par bsgom par bya zho /de nas kha bkrus pas nyon yid dang / gdong bkrus pas yid kyi rnam shes dang / yan lag lnga bkrus pas sgo lnga'i rnam shes dang / lus kun bkrus pas sems byung phra mo rnams dang / khrus khu dor bas kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ glo bur ba rnams med par ngo shes pa'i tshul gyis dag par bsams par bya'o/ /de nas rlung byin gyis brlabs pa ste 'di nas dngos gzhi la ma reg gi bar ni/ rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ /zhes pa'i dbang du byas te/ de la/ badz+ra satwa bā yu ni rdo rje sems dpa'i rlung ste/ de ni sems gzugs sogs yul la g.yo ba'i rang bzhin yin la/ de yang kun gzhi ye shes bag chags dang bcas pa'i dbang 'a sa yul du 'dzin pa'i bag chags de rkyamyo —127—

gyis brtas pa las gzugs la sogs pa snang ba 'byung / de las nyon rmangs 'byung / des las byas/ des kyang sems rgyud bag chags kyis sbags par byed de/ /sa bon dang sdong po dang 'bras bu bzhin du/ lus can rnams 'khor bar 'khor ba dang / bag chags de dag pa na/ bag chags de'i rang bzhin chos nyid ni rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhugs pas na/ rdo rje sems dpa' rlung zhes gsungs pa ste/ 'di shin tu rtog dka' ba'i phyir/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams las/ rlung sems phra mo dang / mi shigs pa'i thig le dang / 'pho ba'i bag chags dang / lus sems kyi 'brel ba'am/ rten brten pa'i 'brel ba sogs rgya cher gsungs par shes par bya ste/ mdor na rlung ni de yin no/ /g.yas nas rngub cing g.yon nas dbyung ba ni/ 'di ltar/ g.yas nas 'byung ba na sa chu me rlung rnams phyi ma phyi ma ring ba ni/ sa chu la thim pa sogs la bsdud rim dang / g.yon nas nam mkha' la rlung chags pa la sogs pa skye ba'i rim pas rlung me chu sa rnams rgyu la/ rlung nang du 'gro ba na de gnyis ka'ang ldog nas 'byung bas/ g.yas nas rngub pa dang / g.yon nas dbyung ba na gnyis ka yang bskyed rim yin pa'i nges pas/ 'chi med sgrubs pa'i thabs kyi snying po can du rig par bya'o/ /de gnyis gyi bar du rlung cung zad bzung nas srog rtsol dgag pa ste/ 'di ni mnyam rgyu ye shes kyi rlung 'gog par byed pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba 'thob par bla med nas bshad pas kyang rig par bya ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rlung zhes bya ba dang shin tu 'brel to/ /—128—

'dir smras pa/ don dam nges pa'i man ngag dang bral ba/ /'di ni rlung sogs bem po'i chos su blta/ /theg mchog rdzogs rim ma nor lag len bcas/ khres par rlo me gang brtags tshe ga zha'i rgyu/ /nyes gang gdod nas med kyang gnyen po yis/ /gsar du dag pa'i tshul chen de shes nas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i mig 'phrul mkhan/ /rlung gi gnad kyang gnas 'dir shes na ko /de ltar rma ni longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rang bzhin du shes nas/ khyad par gsal 'debs pa ni/ oṃ ā hu gis sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs/ de yang longs spyod rdzogs sku bde chen snying rje'i rang bzhin/ de'i sku gsung thugs ngo bo gcig kyang ldog pas phye na sku sems can la dmigs pa dang / gsung chos la dmigs pa/ thugs dmigs med kyi snying rje rnams sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin glo bur rnam dag ste/ rang gi sgo gsum yang rang bzhin der shes par bya ba yin no/ /oṃ ā sogs ni rang gi ngag gzhom med kyi sgra dang o hu sogs kyi sems kyi rdo rje 'di stong nyid dang / bde ba gnyis min thugs rdo rje dang / oṃ oṃ sogs kyis lus 'di'i rang bzhin ni chos nyid kyang / bem chos las 'das pa'i sgyu ma sangs rgyas kyi skur ye nas bzhugs pa de nyid/ 'dir gsal gdab pa ste/ de gsum 'dzin zhes mtshon par rdzas kyi rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa dang 'byud pa'i phyag rgya yang bya'o/ /gong du gzhi'i de nyid tshe rdo rje snying gar 'dzin pa'i gnad kyang des shes te/ yang na 'dir ngag grag stong rnam pa thams cad pa/ sems byang chub sems kun tu bzang po/ lus lha skur dran pa rnams rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de nyid bsdus pa —129—
