sogs las 'byung ba bzhin no zhes dbang po'i dbye bas rig par bya ste/ mdor na dam tshig gsum gyi don no/ /de ltar bshad pas grub pa'i don bsgom bya'i rim pa ni/ gzhi'i yan lag gi skabs su rang sems kyi ngo bo la cher gyi mnyam par bzhag /de las langs nas/ sems 'di rang bzhin gyi dag pa'o snyam du bsgom/ dag byed kyi chu byin gyis rlob na yang / sems kyi dri ma ye nas ci yang ma grub bo snyam pa'i gdangs dang bcas pas/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin chu bo'i rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas sngar bshad pa'i dri ma rnams dag par bsam pa dang / rlung byin rlabs kyi tshe/ thog mar rlung de la sems gtad nas dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag /de las langs te rlung 'di'i rang bzhin ni longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'o zhes rtog pa dang / sgo gsum byin gyis rlob pa na/ o zhes pa'i tshe 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal snying rje dang / ā zhes pa'i tshe snang ba skyu ma lta bu la sems mnyam par bzhag hūṃ zhes pa na/ kun kyang ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i ngang der yul gyi snang ba med par mnyam par 'jog o ā swāhā gaṇ+ḍa sogs gsum ni/ thog mar lus kyi rang bzhin/ ngag gi gdangs/ sem/sa kyi ngo bo rnams la cher gyis bltas/ de nas sngar bshad pa rnams rnam rtog gi tshul gyis dran par bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin cung zad mngon du gyur nas/ ngag gzhom med kyi nā dar shes pa sogs rjes su mthun pa tsam zhig yod na ni de la nan tan du bya yi/ rnam rtog gi don gyi sman yon du 'gyur ba ci/ 'dir smras pa/byis pa'i tshig gi phreng brgyud u dum bur/ /chen po'i mgul brgyan 'os zhes ci tol 'ga'/ /ci tol kho nas rab smra de bzhin gzhan/ /ya mtshan can gyi rang —130—

lugs 'dzin pa'ang mthong / /rnam par ma bslad chos kun gcig gyur pa//lam bzang 'di la ci phyir 'bad mi byed/ /gzhan du gdug pa'i slob dpon rjes 'brangs nas/ /ngal brgyas khyim pa bas kyang dman par spyod/ /e ma mang du smras pas ci zhig bgyi/ /'di na rlung yang 'od gsal sems kyi mdangs/ /yongs su dag sku bde ba chen po ste/ /gzhom med sgra gdangs 'gyur med chu zla'i gshis/ /de ltar don dam pa'i rkyen gyi yan lag bshad nas/ da ni kun rdzob kyi rkyen gyi yan lag ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs/yan lag bdun pa sogs bya ste/ de ni go sla ba'o /de dag ni rkyen gyi yan lag ste/ ci'i phyir rkyen gyi yan lag zhe na/ dag byed khrus ni mi mthun phyogs bsal ba/ rlung byin gyis brlabs pa ni dmigs pa'i rkyen gyi lam dang / sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa de ma thag rkyen gyi lam dang / rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig dran pa bdag rkyen gyi lam ste gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'di'i nges pa ni/longs spyod rdzogs sku la dmigs pa ste/ su yin na/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyis dang / ji ltar dmigs na snying rje gsum gyi tshul ltar dang / gang du dmigs pa ni dam tshig gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin du ste/ mdor na rgyu mtshan nge/'i phyir rkyen gyi yan lag go /'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan khyab bdag longs spyod rdzogs/ /zhing dang sems can spyod pa dang / /mi shigs sku la dmigs med kyis/ /rab tu dmigs pa nyid du bya/ /tha mal rtog pas nam yang ma bsnyengs par/ /yin lugs ma/chog la mnyam par bzhag gyur na/ /lus ngag yid kyi rang bzhin rnam —131—

dag de/ /rang bzhin rnam dag nyid du ngang gis rig /de nas ngo bo'i yan lag ni/ oṃ shā n+ya ta sogs ste/ de'i don stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhi nga yin zheno zhes pa ste/ rang bzhin 'od gsal de nyid rab tu myong zhing rig pa nyid na yang myong zhing rig pa de'i ngo bo'am/ gshis sa/nga du yang grub pa med pas na/ ngo bo'i yan lag stong par bzhag pa yin la/ stong pa de la/ rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / ji skad du/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsal 'gag med mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen du 'char bas na ye shes rdo rje yin la/ de'i rang bzhin zhes pa ni/ rang bzhin dang ni bcos min dang / /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes dbu mar gang gsungs pa ste/ rgyu rkyen gang gis kyang ma byas par gdod ma nas yin pa ste me tsha ba bzhin no/ /su zhe na/ nga yin no zhes pa ste/ gzhi'i yan lag gi skabs su bshad pa'o/ /sgom tshul ni/ hūṃ n+ya ta sogs brjod pa na/ thog mar dngos po thams cad sgyu ma lta bu snang yang ma grub pa'o snyam nga 'i mthar/ rig pas brtags na ci yang ma rnyed pa de'i ngang du mi bsam par mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ snang ba dgag ni mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang sems snang med stong pa gtso che ba yin par rig par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ bden gnyis 'od gsal chu zla'i rol rtsed mkhan/ /brgya phrag ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i zlos gar gyis/ /zung 'jug 'phrog pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' byas/ /ris med kun tu 'char ba sgyu ma'i gshis/ /da ni lam gyi yan lag ni/ bsrung pa'i 'khor lo sogs/ de yang thog mar rdo rje gsor zhing —132—

dril bu dkrol nas/ hū lan gsum glur len te/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum srung ba bdag bsrung ba dang / hu mdzad kyi phyag rgyas in+d+ra sogs kyis phyogs skyong la sogs pa'i bgegs bskrad nas/ phyogs mtshams su rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng du gur/ 'og tu sa gzhi rnams bsgom par bya ste gnas bsrung ba'o/ /skabs 'dir rang rtsa ba'i lha skur sgom pa 'di'o zhes pa ma byung la/ 'on kyang slob dpon nyid kyis 'dir rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rnam par brtag /'khyil ba chen po dam tshig rgyal/ /'byung po'i gdon rnams brlag par mdzad/ /de bzhin khro bo hu ka ra/ /rang gi phyag rgya yan lag bcas/ /bgegs rnams gzhom zhing rtag tu yang / /bdag gnas rnal 'byor rab tu bsrung / /zhes gsungs pa 'di ni bya rgyud dang ma mthun mod kyi/ 'di rnal 'byor bla med go bstun du gnas pa'i phyir na/ rang khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sems dpa'i skyi'/ krung gi bzhugs par skad cig gis sgom nas gnas bsrung ngam/ yang na hu mdzad du bsgom pa ste 'di la 'gal ba med do/ /rdo rje khu tshur kha sprad pa phyogs bcur bskor te/ s+tha na sogs gnas da/nga / snying gar bzhag pas yo ga sogs rnal 'byor dang / dpral bar bzhag pas ut+pa sogs bdag bsrung ba'o/ /rdo rje rtse lnga sogs kyi bdag gnas rnal 'byor bsrung ba thams cad lan gcig yid la byas te brtan par bsam nas/ de mthar bgegs dang / bsrung 'khor/ bar du gcod pa gsum gang yang mi dmigs par bsam te/ don dam gyi srung ba'i 'khor lo yin la/ gong du o s+tha na sogs kyi tshe/ gnas/ rnal —133—

'khya(ra/ bdag bsrung gsum ga dran par bya dgos pa las bdag gnas bsrung ba dngos su byung yang / rnal 'byo ra bsrung ba 'di lta'i gsal kha dngos su ma byung la/ de bas na zla gsang thig le/ tse( ḍā ya na/ rnam par rtsen pa sogs su/ dam tshig gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin rnal 'byor bsrung bar gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yang o ā swāhā/ kaṇ+ḍa sogs rnal 'byor bsrung bar rigs te/ bya spyod las ni gnas bdag bsrung ba tsam las ma gsungs shing / yo7 ga las 'byung ba dang /'dus/ par tshad med bzhi las gsungs pa sogs dang phyogs 'dra ba ni 'dir ma byung ba la/ gzhan yang 'di ni bla med dang cha mtshungs pa'i nges pa las so/ / 'dir smras pa/ sems gang kun gzhi rnam shes kyis sgrubs pa'i/ /tshogs drug brdzun pa'i dug chus myos las slar/ /stong nyid bdud rtsi'i chu bo rtag 'thung bas/ /ris bral dag nga/'i lang tsho rgyas par 'gyur/ /'di ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nges pa'o/ /de nas lha bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ dngos ngo/ra snang ba thams cad rang la bsdu/ rang yang stong par bsams te/ de nas kun rdzob kyi snang ba tha mal pa mi dmigs shing / stong pa de'i gdangs ma bral bar 'ja' tshon ltar stong bzhin du snang ba ni/ dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin nyid pas na de nyid sngar ma rtogs pa deng nas rtogs pa'i slad du ste/ sgom tshul ni sgrub thabs su gsal bas 'dir spro bar mi 'dod la/ zhing khams rgya mtsho sgom pa ni/ zhing sbyong ba yin zhing / tā gi sgras sems can rnams byang chub la bkod nas/ bdud rtsir gyur nas bsdu ba ni sems can smin pa'i slad du'o/ /—134—

rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gshugs nas rig pa lan gsum brjod pa ni/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa/ pad+ma/ rdo rje'i rigs gsum gyi bdag nyid gcig tu byas pa yin la/ o ā hū ho rdo rje bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ye shes rdo rje rnams so/ /de nas ni ye shes sems dpa' sbyan drangs ro mnyam du bsams nas/ dza hu ba ho : zhes brjod/ de nas dbang bskur ba ste rnam pa bcu las/ cod pan ni 'od dpag med dang / brtan par brjod pa ni/su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod pas so/ /de dag ni lam gyi yan lag ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na tshogs rdzogs par byed pa'i lam yin pas na te/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin las/ phyi ma gnyis sngar bshad pa dang / lhag ma rnams dang po ste/ de yang bsrung 'khor ni/ nges par 'byung ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / lhar gsal ba ni rdo rje theg par sems bskyed pa dang / rigs gsum mam/ rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag sogs kyi nges pas/ tshogs kyi lam che chung gsum dang / rdo rje bzhi ni drod la sogs pa sbyor lam bzhi dang /ye shes spyan 'dren ni sa dang po'i mnyam bzhag mthong lam dang / sa bon 'od 'phros sogs ni sa dang po'i rjes thob sogs sa bcu dang / chos mthun pa'o zhes pa ste/ de'i phyir lam gyi yan lag go /'dir skabs su babs pa'i don re shig de tsam la bya ste/ nges pa dang bcas pa'i 'thad pa rgyas par rnams yi ge mangs kyi dogs dang / skabs su ma gyur pas ma bris so/ /—135—

'dir smras pa/ rnam pa kun ldan stong nyid dam pa'i don/ /nges pa'i lha ste gzhan ni dri ma'o/ /de bas res 'jog tshul du ma 'khrul bar/ /stong pa'i ring las lha sku 'dir shes bya/ /zhing sbyong pa dang sems can smin pa'i tshul/ /kun kyang sgyu ma'i rnam rol stong pa'i ngang / dbang po'i gzhu la reg thogs med pa ltar/ /rgyal ba'i sku yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa na'o/ /rigs gsum 'gyur med rdo rje chen po bzhi/ /ye shes 'khor lo de bzhin dbang bskur dang / /byang chub phyogs mthun de bzhin 'od gsal gnad/ /bsdus pa'i tshig la'ang don rgyas rig par byos/ /da ni/ lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir/ /zhes pa'i dbang du byas te/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gnyis kyi dmigs pa ni/ sgrub thabs nyid du bris zin la/ gang dag tu du ba dang smig rgyu sogs kyi mtshan ma sngar brtan por mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pas rang lhar gsal ba'i lus nang du zhing rnams dmigs tsam byas te mnyam par bzhag pa na/ stong gzugs la zhing mang nyung dbang po dang mtshams par dngos su snang la/ de nas 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom par bya ba dang / las dang po pa'i sgom tshul la yang rnam rtog gi rtsol ba yod mod kyi/ de lta na yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnad shes pas/zhing dang 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor la/ gang dmigs bcas yod kyi bar du sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam pa dang / zhing yang rab 'byams te/ che chung phra sbom mang nyung sogs tshad bzung mi nus pa mtha' yas pa shes pa dang / 'chi med kyi mthar/ dmigs med ni gang yang mi sgom par rig tsam snang tsam la ring du mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ skabs 'dir slob dpon gyis/ /mchan khung srog rtsol bsdams dang —136—

bcas/ /sgyu ma'i lam mchog gang mthong ba/ /des ni re shig dmigs bcas pa'o/ /de mthar dmigs pa med gang dang / /'od zer dra'ang ma mthong gang //rtag tu rnam par rtogs pas brtag /zhes gsungs pa'i nges pa las so//rnal 'byor 'di gnyis ka'ang 'chi med sgrub pa'i nges pa las stong pa nyid sgom pa'i rig pa yin la/ de lta mod kyi rnam med dam stong nyid/ med dgag tsam la ni rtag par dam pa'i nges tshig ma zhugs shing / stong nyid rnam pa thams cad pa ste/rnam pa ci yang 'char ba ni rtag pa dam pa yin la/ de yang zhing gi rnal 'byor ni sna tshogs su snang ba rnam pa thams cad pa dang / 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor ni bde ba dam pa dang / 'od gsal gtso che ste/ phyi ma snga ma la/ rten nas 'byung gi g.yin du ma yin no/ /de yang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid las 'od gsal dang 'gyur med bde ba chen po thob pa ni/ bla med kyi rgyud rnams kyi nges gsang dam par shes par gyis shig gu/ de ltar de gnyis kyi phyi mas rang don chos sku dang / dang pos gzhan don gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin la/ de gnyis tha dad pa yang ma yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba'i yon tan zab cing rgya che rnams/ /lhun grub nyid na'ang gsar du thob pa yi/ /tshul de shes nas rnam par rtog med kyang / /'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul 'di'o/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam kun stong nyid dang / /zhu bde las 'das bde chen 'od gsal ba'o/ /nges gsang de gnyis rig na 'chi med dang / /zhing gi rnal 'byor ris med 'khor lo'ang rig /rmi lam dag las bde ba spyin pa dang /brag cha'i glu dbyangs byis rnams yid bde'i rgyu/ /lam bzang mchog kyang de —137—

'drar myong ba las/ /mkha' bzhin kun la go skabs spyin na ko /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams kun rtog med gzigs nas/ /don dam mi 'chi bcud byed rtag rol yang / /rab 'byams zhing du dpag med zlos gar can/ /gdul dka'i zhing du'ang bur smrig thun mtshams kyi/ /des ldan rnams la'ang lhan skyes bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /skabs dbyer gyur bzhin rig par byos a re/ shwe ba'i ring lugs skyong ba'i cher rlo me 'ga'/ /zab cing rgya che'i tshig rnams ma rtogs par/ /las rgya nges pa'i lam dang rim pa ste/ /gong ma'i dbang gsum 'gyur med bde ba bral//de bzhin rtag tu 'dod la brkam pa'i tshig /'jig rten dmod tsam spangs phyir spros med kyi/ /spyod pa gsungs zhes smra mod de lta bu'i/ /phyag chen rtogs pa chig gcong/ tshig tu bas/ /yang smras pa/ ka ye nam mkha'i me tog su yis mthong / /'phrog pa'i grong du gang gi ltad mo sbyin/ /rmad byung don de bla ma'i zhal las dris/ /mi bsrun shing rtar 'jug pa'i ngal bas ci/ /de ltar bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin te/ de nas ldang bar 'dod na/ rang dam ye gnyis med du gsal ba mchod cing bstod pas bstod pa ste/ de la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam sogs kyi don cung zad bshad na/nam mkha' dang mnyam ni dngos po thams cad la khyab pa ste/ gzhi'i chos nyid do/ /mnyam nyid ni lam ste/ /chos nyid de'i rang bzhin stong pa dang snying rje mi phyed pa goms par byed pa/ ro mnyam ni de ltar goms pa'i mthus 'bras bu ste/don dam rnam med chos sku dang / kun rdzob rnam bcas gzugs sku ro mnyam pa'o/ /de'i phyir sku mnga' ba ste/ chos nyid de 'phags ma'o zhes pa'o/ /dngos —138—

rnams sogs ni/ dper na bum nga/ grub pa na/ de thad kyi nam mkha' gzhan du ma song la/ zhig pa na yang gzhan nas ma 'ongs pas bum pa song yang nam mkha' mi 'gro ba ltar/ gzhi lam sogs kun/ bum sogs ngo bo dang 'dra ba dang / chos nyid nam mkha' nga/nga 'dra bar bzhag go /'jig dang sogs nam mkha' dang 'dra bas te/ zhig mi srid pas rma/tshar mod ma 'ongs pa'i phyir 'jig rgyu med nga sa de tsam du ngo mtshar ci/ de ltar na ya mtshan sogs te go sla'o/ /srid dang sogs 'bras bu la sbyar ba ste/ srid pa ste kun rdzob gdod ma nas med par gzigs kyang / sngom/ snying rjes kun nas bla/ ngas te smon lam bgyis pa'i dbang gis 'gro ba 'a/ btang snyoms med par gzigs nas/ rnam par 'phru/la pa yul dus chad pa med pa ra 'byung bas/ khams gsum/ gyi 'gro ba kun la bde chen ste thar pa spyin pa zhes pa'o/ khyod zhabs sogs go sla ste/ khyed kyi zhabs la 'dud pa rnams kyang byang chub chen por nges pa'o/ /de'i phyir phyag 'os so zhes pa'i don no/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas bzad pa gsol/ badz+ra mu ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba ste/ dbyings su thim par bsam/ de nas rig pa lan gsum brjod/ sngar bshad nga/'i rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig dran par byas te/ sku gsung thugs mi phyed par byin gyis brlabs pa'o /o badz+re sogs ni bdag nying/ bsrung ba/ de nas ni dge ba bsngos nas ldang bar bya ste/ thams cad du yang lhar snang dang ma bra'/ bar bya la/ lam 'di la yang yang goms pas lhur blangs pas lus 'di la mchog gi dngos grub ster —139—

bar byed de/ gzhi dang / rkyen gyi yan lag dang / dngos gzhi gtso bor goms pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po skye bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ bden gnyis mi phyed ting 'dzin goms las nam mkha'i gzugs mthong zhing / /gang du brtan zhing yangs par gyur dang thabs mang de tshe'o/ /a re byang phyogs 'di na sde snod spangs shing rgyud sde ring du dor/ /ngal bas gnas kyang ngan 'gro la gzhol kye hud gtum po ltar/ /dman pa las kyang dman pa'i spyod pa 'dzin/ /bzang po yi yang bzang po lta bur rlom/ /brtson pa chen ngo/sa brtson par 'bad mod kyi/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor las thar mi 'gyur/ /de bas na lam bzang ma nor ba gnad ma bcos pa dag la 'bad pa chen pos ci'i phyir mi 'bad/ de ltar na 'di'i man ngag gi gnad rnal 'byor bla med ltar shes dgos/ smra na de ci snyam na/ bshad zin mod kyi/ de ltar na yang rlung byin gyis brlabs pa dang / sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ dam tshig gsum sgom pa/ lha bskyed zin nas rdo rje bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa/ dngos gzhi rnal 'byor gnyis rnams bla med kho na bzhin du yod la/ lha bskyed pa dang / ye shes 'khor lo spyan 'dren pa dang / gshegs pa rnams rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin dang / spyir zab gnad ni/ bzhi'i yan lag /rang bzhin gyi yan lag dag byed 'khrus dang / rlud dang / sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ dam tshig gsum bsgom pa/ rdo rje bzhi'i byin gyis brlabs pa dang / rnal 'byor gnyis rnams so/ /gtor ma dang / zas dang / nyal ba la sogs pa sngar bya rgyud kho na'i lugs kyi —140—

skabs bshad zin to/ /mchod pa byin rlabs ci 'dra bar gtor ma de 'dra la/'on kyang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar 'di ni lta sgom 'bras bu'i gnad rnal 'byor bla med kyi tshul zab cing rgya che ba dang / spyod pa kṛ ya bzhin du gtsang sbra dang / dka' thub dang sbyin bsreg sogs spyad pas/ lus 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob cing / dbang po ches dman pas kyang shin tu nan tan tu byas na 'chi ba med pa'i rig 'dzin thob nas/ rim gyi sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /'dir slar yang de rnams 'di skad ces/ sems can gang dag srid pa la mos te/ /srid pas dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bu byed/ /de ni bde chen lam las gol ba ste/ /skad cig byung nas phyir yang nub par 'gyur/ /'dod dang dga' bde yongs su ma spangs gang / /mtshan ma mthong yang nyon mongs bcas pa yin/ /slob dpon mnyes byas nang gi rnam par 'byed/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid 'dod bde gnas 'thob//rdo rje sems dngos sems kyi rdo rje gang / /rang bzhin nyid de de phyir gzhi'i yan lag /dbang po yul dang lta 'dod rkyen gsum ste/ /de las dbang shes skye bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /'dir yang rkyen gyi yan lag gang gis na/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes mngon gsum pa'o/ /chos kun rang bzhin rdul bral stong nyid de/ /rnam kun de nyid bsgom phyir de skad brjod/ /sems kyi rdo rje dri ma med rtogs pa/ /de tshe bsrung ba med na gnod byed ci/ /de nas sems kyi rdo rje lhar sad pa/ /rigs gsum rdo rje bzhi dag brtas par gyur/ /dbang bskur nas ni sa bcu'i bdag po ste/ /de phyir lam gyi yan lag ces bya'o/ /sgyu lus rab 'byams zhing —141—

gi rnal 'ebyor dang / /don dam bde chen rtag pa 'chi med yin/ /kye ma 'byung po'i ring lugs lhur byed la/ /byang phyogs 'di na kun kyang dga' zhing 'gro/ /tshul de spangs nas thabs mang gtsang sbrar bcas/ /yang dag lam la zhugs dang thar 'dod kye/ 'dir smras pa/ /'od gsal dam pa rtag tu mi 'gyur bdag dam pa/ /dam pa'i ting 'dzin ro mnyam mnyam pa bgrang yas kyis/ /rang gi tshul de rang this rig byas gnas de na/ /dri ma ci zhig thar pa de ci ming tsam gyis/ /rnam par gnar dang 'ga' mgu rangs 'di byis pa'i gnyes/ /bsam gyi mi khyab tshul bzhis 'khyud pa'i rang bzhin sems/ /bla ma'i drin las mkhas pa dag gi gnyug ma'i dngos/ /ring por mi thogs brtson pas bsgrubs na cis mi mthong / kha ba can 'dir deng sang dam pa'i chos/ /ming tsam 'jin zhing phal cher log nga ra mo se/ /rgyal bas gdams pa'i rnam dag spyod pa dang / /zab cing rgya che'i thabs la rnam par smod/ /'dod pa'i dkrugs rnams mthon po'i lta skad kyis/ /yang dag lta ba rtsa ltar 'dor ba mthong / /mgon pos nam yang yon tan sba bya zhing / /skyon rnams mthol ba gyis zhes yang yang gsungs/ /de bas thar pa 'dod rnams kyis/ /rgyu 'bras theg mchog las gsungs pa'i/ /nges gsang thabs mang dang bcas pa/ /sangs rgyas gsungs bzhin sgrub pa'i rigs/ /bde ba'i rdo rje mkha' dbyings dam par chos kun bskyed pa po/ /ma lus shes bya'i bdag po nye dang reng ba min pa nyid/ /rtag cing bde ba rang bzhin dri med dngos kun za ma tog /rigs bral sems kyi rdo rje 'phags ma 'jig rten yum la 'dud/ /ces pa 'di ni gang yang dag pa'i lam 'di skal ba dang ldan rnga/ dag —142—

gis nan tan du bya ba dang / rnam pa gzhan du yid gnyis kyi phyang mo yug tu gyur pa dag dang / nan tan du bgyi ba dag la nges pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ sgrub thabs 'di'i go don rnams yi ger gyis shig ces/ mkhyen yangs mi'i dbang po'i bka' yis bskul ba las/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' snying pos rang gi blo nus dang 'tshams par g.yar khral du 'tshal ba'o// // ma ṅga laX//༄༅/ /bla med dang bya rgyud kyi sngags spyi'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad yod/༈ bla med dang bya rgyud kyi sngags spyi'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad yod/ na mo gu rta khya tā rā dwa rmaX gang gi 'gyur med bde chen pos/ /yid kyi shing rta lhag par 'gengs/ /bla med bla ma'i zhabs pad ni/ /snying gi chu mtshor nges gyur cig /srid dang srid pa'i las ring por/ /gang dag mgron po ltar dub pa/ /de yang la yang ltes dbang gis/ /ji zhig ltar rnyed 'chi med lam/ /gang 'di thar 'dod rnams kyis nan tan du/ /bgyid nga/ra 'os pa nyid dang rnam gzhan du/ /dogs pa'i g.yang sar yun ring lhung rnams la/ /dam pa'i nges pa 'di rnams sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon ji skad bshad pa yi/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa dag la dbang nod nas/ /brtul zhugs dam pa'ang yang dag blang bar bya/ /mi dge bcu dang ser sna dam chos spong / /byang chub sems spong de bzhin gnod sems skyed/ /bcu bzhi 'di rnams rtsa ba'i ltung ba yin/ /rab byung byang —143—

chub sems dpas rtsad nas spangs/ /blo ldan khyim na lhag par gnas rnams kyis/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang log ltas ma gos na/ /dgu po thabs la mkhas pas spang ba'ang rung / /rab byung nyid dam khyim pa yin na yang / /'di dag spangs na 'grub kyi gzhan du min/ /rang gi sems la rang gi ngo bo yis/ khyab brdal mi shigs ngang du mnyam par gzhag /'dir gang sems kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas te/ /ngo shes tshul 'di gzhi yi yan lag go /rang sems rang gi ngo bor mnyam bzhag nas/ /dag byed chu sogs snang ba ma lus pa/ /sems las gzhan min dri ma rang dag dang / /slar yang dag par bsgom pa khrus kyi gnad/ /de ltar gnyis ni theg chen spyi yi tshul/ /rngub cing bsdams dang dbyung ba'i dus nyid na/ /myur 'gro'i ngo bo la ltas dmigs med du/ /mnyam par gzhag nas longs spyod rdzogs skur rig /'di ni kun gyi byed po rlung gi gnad/ /rlung gi rang bzhin lus ngag sems gsum po/ /snying rje gsum du dpal ldan bla mas mkhyen/ /'di ni rlung gi khyad par zhes bya ste/ /mdor na g.yo ba'i sems zhes sangs rgyas gsungs/ /phra rab rdul bral rlung sems phra mo'i sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs zhes 'dus par ste/ /gang yang snying rje rnam gsum sems dmigs dang //dga' ba gsum du pha ma'i rgyud las gsungs/ /'gyur ba'i bde ba mi shigs thig le'am/ /de bzhin rlung gi 'brel ba spang bya ste/ /longs sku 'gyur med bde ba 'bras bur dran/ /gang zhig lus dang ngag sems gdod ma ste/ /'di la srid dang 'i ba bye brag med/ /don dam gdod ma'i gshis la rab brtags nas/ /nā nga rla chog dang rnar/ par rig pa yi/ /stong chen de bzhin sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i —144—

gzugs/ /'di dag rnams su ye nas rtogs na ko /de ltar gnad gsum rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rgyud don zab dang rgya che'i nges gsang ste/ /dag byed la yang phyogs gcig mkhas pas rig /yang na phyi ma rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin shes/ /deng 'dir nges pa gzhan yang gnod byed dang / /las dang srung po gdod nas med rtogs pa/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'di ni dam pa'i don/ /'di ni rdo rje theg pa spyi yi lugs/ /pha rol phyin gzhud las kyang nges par byos/ /rdo rje rnam bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /dbang bskur sa bcu'i rim pa dang sbyor ba/ /de bzhin dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / /rnal 'byor bla med ji bzhin 'di la mdzes/ /de ltar gsum las bar pa cha mthun tsam/ /rnam bzhi'i rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa las/ /ye shes rdo rje 'gyur bral bde ba ste/ /thig ler lta dang rang ngo shes pa'i tshul/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin rnam gnyis/ /zhing gi rnal 'byor dbang po thams cad pa/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid dam pa'i don/ /'chi med rnal 'byor bde ba dam pa ste/ /rang rig rnam med stong pa nyid dbyer med/ /'dir ni mchan khung bsdams pa'i spyor ba dang / /srog rtsol bkag dang lce'u chung sbyor ba dang / /rlud gi gnad kyang rnal 'byor ldan pas bya//dus 'khor rdo rje gdan bzhi sogs dang mthun/ /'dir ni mdor bsdus bshad pa ste/ /mang bas 'jigs pa'i blo ldan la'o/ /'thad par bcas pa rnams gzhan du/ /bris dang rgyud sde rnams su ltos/ /de ltar bshad nas bla ma la/ /'gro 'di 'chi med gnas la dengs/ /bkod ces bdag ni phyag 'tshal zhing / /nga ro ring du 'bod par byed/ /gang la bsnyen pas 'jigs pa kun/ skyobs —145—

mdzad 'phags ma sgrol ma dang / /gang gi lam 'di gsal mdzad pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pa la'ang / /dge 'dis sa skyong rnams kyang rigs pa'i lam zhugs shing / /skye dgu rnams kyang dge bar mos shing rab sbyor la/ /nyer 'tshe kun zhi bde ba'i nyin dang nyin la spyad/ /mi ring bar yang thams cad g.yung drung dpal thob 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong kun dga' snying pos sbyar ba ste 'gro la phan pa'i sle da du'o// //bkra shis/rgyas par dga' na rgyas par rgyud sde las/ /'bring du dga' na gzhan du bris la ltos/ /'di ni bsdus pa dga' ba'i don du ste/ /'chi med rdo rje lam bzang mtshon dpe'o/ /'di rnams myur du bri 'dod yod kyang / le lo'i ngang du ring mor 'khyam pa las/ slar yang myur du gyis zhes bkas bskul ba na/ sngar gyi 'bri 'phro dman ma yang myur du grub par bgyis pa/ legs bshad phra mor gyur pa te por shin te ma nyid du bas pas/ mkhas pa rnams kyi gzigs na sgra don gyi gnas la nyes pa mang du yod mod/ de lta na yang bla ma mchog las man ngag phra mo rig cing / nges pa'i don la cung zad yid phyogs shing go ba rnyed pas/deng sang gi chen po 'gas dpe sna mang po'i tshig bsdus nas/ rang gi byas zhes bris pa dag dug (〈rjo〉 du ma ) bsdus pa'i gos lta bu rnams gzhan la med nga 'i khyad 'phags su 'dod pa rnams las ni mchog go /gzhan yang 'di sems can la gcig tu phan sems kho nas byas pa'i phyir/ /ci nyes yod dam med kyang bla/ /'dzem pa med par smras pa la/ /ma yis bu la bya ba bzhin/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod mdzad rigs// // shu bha ma stu sarba dzā ga ta//—146—

༅/ /de nas 'dir gzhan yang man ngag gi nges pa spyin pa ni/ mchan khung sogs kyi don/ spo khung sbyor ba/ srog rtsol bkag pa'i sbyor ba/ lce'u chung sbyor ba gsum ste/ 'di'i rim pa ni/ rnal 'byor gnyis kyi dang por gsal btab nas/ rlung lan gsum phyir bsal/ rlung sna g.yas nas rgyu na g.yas dang /g.yon nas rgyu na g.yon gyi srin lag gis/ rang rang phyogs kyi sna bug bkag ste/ sna bug gcig shos nas slar yang phyir lan gcig dbyung / de nas yang cig shos bkag nas/ sngar bkag pa'i phyogs nas rngubs pas/ zhing rnams cung zad g.yo bar bsam/ de nas lag gnyis dbus 'byud ltar bsgo pa te/sbar ba gnyis kyis mchan khung drag tu bsdams la/ zhing rab 'byams snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems bzungs/ rlud phyir 'bud pa na/ srin lag gi sbyor ba sngar bzhin la/ yid mi dmigs par 'jog /'di ni dus kyi mtshan ma ring ba dag byung na nyi phyed yan chad du brtson pas nan tan byas pa 'chi bslu nges pa ste/ dus gzhan du lan bdun sogs ci rigs pa'o/ /lte'u chung sbyor ba ni 'chi med kyi rnal 'byor la te rlung lan gsum phyir bsal nas/ lte bar rlud kha sbyar/ lce phugs su bzlog pas lce chung dril nas/cung zad bskyod pa na/ zhing rnams bag tsam g.yo zhing / bdud rtsi 'babs pa sogs sgoms/ 'di yang lan bdun la sogs pa bya la/ srog rtsol bkag pa ni rnal 'byor gnyis kar te/ dmigs pa so so la sems bzung / sngags kyi sgra tsam dran bzhin pas srog rtsol bkag /rlung phyir 'gro ba sngags ngag tu brjod/ji tsam nas sngags kyi sgra tsam la yid bzlas su byas nas/ dmigs me/da du da—

mnyam par bzhag /'di bya spyod dang mthun la/ gong ma gnyis bla med bzhin te/de la dang po gdan bzhir mchan khung sbyor ba zhes gsungs pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo nu ma nyed pa'i sbyor ba zhes gsungs pa dang cha mthun zhing / nges pa yang de dag las rig dgos la/ gnyis a di bzhi ra bdud rtsi lce sbyor zhes kha ṭāX ga yo ga'i yan lag tu gsungs pa dang cha mtshungs shing nges gsang ni de nyid dam/ au khyu na las dzi hwa yo ga zhes gsungs pa las nges dgos la/ mdor na de rnams su rgyas par rtogs 'tshal la/ 'di ni dpe mkhyud du gyur na/ slob dpon nyid rnam par ltung bar 'gyur ba kho na la bsam nas man ngag gi rim pa tsam mo/ /'dir smras pa/ 'pho ba'i bag chags rang bzhin ye shes rlung / /dh+wa ti'i 'tsho ba 'gog par brtson pa gang / /bde chen dam pa'i don chen dpa' bo des//phyogs grol khyim du nam yang bcom par gyur/ /yul la shin tu g.yo dang chags pa ste/ /rdo rje lhung dang dbang po'i grong 'joms pa/ /'jug nas ldang ba'o ye shes rdo rje gang / /lce'u chung sbyor ldan 'gyur bral sa hā dzāX/ /gzhan yang lam 'di'i nges gsang shes 'dod na/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas theg pa kun gyi phul/ /de bzhin dpal ldan 'dus dang dra ba sdom/ /rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen byas mnyam par byos/ /'di zab gnad du bsam nas re shig mi 'bri'o snyam pa las/gnad rnams ma sbas par bris shig ces bka' byung ba'i dbang las bris pa ste/de'ang mgron gyi tshul du bris lags shing / /slad nas dkyus su btsud kyang mi —148—

rungaX ba med par sems/ 'on kyang cung zad gu phya ka to// // zhus so// ka phywa ṇa/ /༄༅/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i chog sgrig legs par bkod pa ngag 'don rab gsal bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so/ /na ma shi zhwa/ badz+ra ya/ lha mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sogs pa/ gza' skar dus spyor bzang ba la/ dben pa'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po bris pa'i lte bar lha rma tshan nam/ /twoXyig dkar po bris pa'i steng du khre'u 'aX malji'i steng du/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bkod pa'i nang du/nas/ til/ gro/ sran ma/ 'bras te 'bru lnga/ gser/ dngul/ mu tig khu men/ byi ru ste rin po che lnga/ tshu dag /dbang lag /sle kres/ kan+ta ka ri/ ut+pa la ste sman lnga dang / ga bur/ dzā ti/ gur gum/tsan+dan dkar dmar/ a ka ru ste dri lnga dang / til lam/ gser/ lan tshwa/ mar/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi ste snying po lnga/ mdor na sman bzang po ci 'dzom bcug /chu gtsang ma srog chags med pas sum gnyis tsam bkang la/ ras sam dar dkar po sna tshang la sogs pa'i mgul 'chings sproki sna khri / pa bya/dpag bsam gyi shing ngam/ 'bras bu can gyi shing rlon pas kha brgyan/ med na lto ring myu gu bcug pa'i dbus su/ dung chos dri bzang po'i chus bkang ba bzhag /rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bkod/ 'di nyid kyi rten bzhugs su gsol/ rten byin brlabs can gzhan yang mang du bca'o//maṇ+ḍal gyi mtha' mchod pas bskor/ rin po che'i snod du dkar gsum las grub pa'i gtor ma zlum —149—

po che chung ci rigs pa gang 'byor bshams la/ dpon slob stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ las kyi slob mas sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams pa la/ oX badz+ra yak+ṣa huX/ gsum brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharmaXswa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las oX las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āXhuX 'od du zhi ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang khyab pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par byed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oX āXhuX ha hoXhriX phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ de nas sde brgyad spyan drangs bar bsam la/ lha dang klu dang gnod spyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bum smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la gtsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /gtor ma'i phyogs 'tshams brgyad du 'khod par gyur/pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ oX de ba/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan dha rgyu/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin na ra/ ma ho rā ga /ma nu bya/ a ma nu bya sa pā ri wā ra na maXsarba ta thā ga te khyoXbi da khyuX sarba thā khaX/ gi skyu/ de spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX/ lhi hā daX ba li rkye swāhā/ 'ji smo gyis 'bul/ oX badz+ra ar+ghaX pra tismo ye swāhā/ pā t+yaX pra tisnro ye swāhā/ lkoX badz+ra tshur+sha āXhuX/ oX dhu pe hūX/ lkoX ā lo ke hūX/ oṃ lha rnye hūX/ oX rkye wi rkye huX/ oX sha lta āXhuX/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la —150—

gang dag gnas pa dang / /rin chen gling na lhag par gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu lding ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang /khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang / /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang / /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang gsum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dres dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung la gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang byug pa dang/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul bas/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis pa mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la bsrungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi gdong grogs mdzod//dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzo/ /'jig lcen bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba bde —151—

legs phun sum tshogs pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /'byung po mthu bo che dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar phyin par mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams/ 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig oṃ sum bha ni sum bha huX huX phaṭa/ 8( gro hā gro hā huX huX phaṭa/ tseX( gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ tseX( āXn ya ho/ bha ga wān bi du rā dzā huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud ta gad tsha/ bsdus pa na gong gi sngags kyis spyan 'dren/ sngags 'bul/ sngags mchod/ 'byung po gang dag nas/ bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod ces pa'i bar byas la/ oṃ sarba bud ta gad gnyis tsha zhes brjod do/ /mchod rdzas rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa huX/ gis bsang / tso rna su bhā wa 8kyi dha sarba dharmāXswa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūX hūX dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i khyad par can bskyed nus pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ pā tuX pra tisnro swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āXhuX/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āXhuX/ oṃ badz+ra ā le( ke āXhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye āXhuX/ oṃ badz+ra rkye we te ye āXhuX/ oṃ badz+ra sha lta āXhūX/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye/ ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saX pra ra co ta/ sgyu—152— mi

sarba bud ta spu ṭa pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pa ra mi ta/ nā ta saX bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hri ta ya/ sa rnyo ṣa ni hūX huX huX ho ho hoX.a khaX swāhā/bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon to phrin las thams cad kyi/ ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o//cho ga tshar re la lan brgya dang brgyad dam/ lnga bcu'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ bdun las nyung bar mi bya/ de nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi ma rdzo rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum bya/ rang skad cig gis sgrol ma dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang sems tāXyig dkar por gyur pa las 'od 'phros/ lus kyi nang dkar mer gang / tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'od phyir 'phros pas/ po ta la nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba la/ bla ma/ 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can gyi gtso mo'i dbu brgyan pa/ mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs/bas rla/ 'a// na glo/ gu ru suX na maX.ār+ya tā re budha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa la khyuX—153—

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad gcig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi//dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /ces phyag byas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ 'o mo gu ru ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tismo pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āXhūX/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ pā s+t+ya/ pukhye/ dhu pe/ ā lo kelha rnye/ rkye we te ye/ sha lta rnams kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs rma/chi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la//byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab grub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces pa lan gcig bya/ oX su bhā wa shudha sarba sto swa bhā wa shurnyo taX/ rang bzhi gyi stong pa nyid du gyur/ oX shā n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa nyid ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paX las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i —154—

dkyil 'khor de'i steng du rang gi sems tā yig dkar po las 'od 'phros/sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ zhi ba'i ngang tshul can gyi dbu la spyan gsum dang phyag zhabs bzhi'i mthil du yang spyan re re ste/ ye shes kyi spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas mchod sbyin dang / g.yon ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i yu ba mtheb srin gyi thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i brdar/ rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum gyes pa/ dbus kyi me tog kha shag bye ba/ g.yas kyi rtse mo me tog bung ba'i 'bras bu dang / g.yon gyi rtse mo me tog kha ma bye ba bum par yod pa/ dar dmar po'i shams thabs dang / dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba/ dbu skra nag po spyi bor bcings shing / rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ gzhon nu'i nyams dang sgeg pa'i rnam pas yid 'phrog cing mdzes par gyur pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang / 'od zer dkar po spro zhing bsdu ba'i sku can/de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ hu gi steng du zla ba'i gdan la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs stong brgyad pa/ mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar twa yig gis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i hū dang twa las 'od 'phros/ po ta la nas rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra ca pū dza me ga sa mu tra spa ra na —155—

sa ma ye ā:hu/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ pā s+t+ya/ pur+sha/ dhu pe/ ā lo keg rnye/ rkye we te ye/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra shasta pū dza me ga sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye u hu/ dgug gzhugs bcing mnyes kyi phyag rgya byas la/ dza / ba ho gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hu dang rta las 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra ru swāhā/ pā s+t+ya pra ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pukhre/ u hu/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe ā:hu/ oṃ badz+ra ā 'o( ke te u hu/ oṃ badz+ra rdo u hu/ oṃ badz+ra rkye we rkye u hu/ oṃ badz+ra shasta u hu/ zhes dbang lha la mchod nas/ oṃ sarba tā tha ga ta a bhi khiñtsa tu ma zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas/oṃ badzir bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hū zhes gsung zhing / bum chus dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan par gyur pa la/ snying ga'i hū las 'od spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ bdag nyid la mchod cing bstod par gyur/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzode/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa rī wa ra ar+gha pra tismo pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye u hu/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā s+t+ya/ put+pa/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ rkye we te/sha p+ta rnams 'don pa spos la mchod/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /bdug spos ji snyed yod pa /༵za/༵/ dzhai snyed ༵ sdo pa rna mas /pa/ /༵dī/ ji snyed rdo pyi sa/ /dhi pa re re/'i/ —156—

mtshams su bcug pas mchod do/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la gshugs te/ /'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gyur pa'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i nye ba'i tāXyig gi g.yas su oṃ/ g.yon du hā/ de'i mthar mdun nas g.yas skor gyi/ ma ma a yu pu rnye dzñā na tshun ku sa rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas g.yas bskor gyi tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā rnams rtsibs re'i steng du/ yi ge re re yod pa/ mu khyud dang po la mdun nas g.yon skor gyi/ a ā/ i yī/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e i/ o au/ aX aX gnyis pa la g.yas skor gyi/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaX gsum pa la g.yas bskor gyi/ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wā/ he dun te khyi ta thā ga to phya ba dad/ te po ni yo ni ro dha e baX bā tī mahā shra ma ṇaX bzhi pa la rdo rje ser po'i phreng ba dang / lnga pa la 'od zer dmar nag gi phreng bas skor ba/ yig 'khru rnams kha dog dkar po/ yig 'bru de rnams las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang bas/ dus dang dus ma yin pas 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsal/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ sgrol ma dkar mo dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi/thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang / 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs snying kar thim pas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ zhes yi ge bar pa nyid myur bul sogs kyi skyon dang bral zhing / gsal la —157—

dag pa/ dmigs pa la sems ma g.yengs pa ci nus kyi cho ga tshar re la brgya stong sogs bzlas nas/ oX tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ ma ma a yu pu bye dzñā na ngu zhi ku ru swahā/ zhes pa bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya'i bar du thun re la 'das( bzlas1pa'i rjes su/ a ā/ i yī/ u mū/ ṛ rwa/ le lī/ e i/ o au/ aX aX lan gsum/ ka kha ga gha nga/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaX zhes lan gsum/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā/ he tun te/ khyi ta thā ga to phya ba dad/ te po〉 yo ni ro dha e baX wā tī mahā shra ma ṇaXlan gsum gyis lhag chad bskang / bsdus par 'dod na/ mdun bskyed/ bstod pa/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor/ /spyod lam zas kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong pa rnams gzhung bzhin bya'o/ /bum bskyed kyi mchod pa la dmigs nas bsangs sbyangs byin brlab sngar ltar byed/ bum pa la dmigs nas/ glu rna badz+ra yak+ṣa huX/ zhes brjod pas bgegs rnams bsangs/ tseX( swa bhā wa shurnya sarba dharmāXswa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ gis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/lha'i gos kyi mgul bcings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang lnga mtshan (〈kyu〉 tshan ) lnga dang / bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i dbus su paX las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil snyen ra de'i steng du tāXyig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar —158— r+sha

——mo yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ zhes pa nas/ 'od zer dkar po spro zhing bsdu ba'i sku can/ zhes pa'i bar gyi bdag bskyed bzhi dam tshig pa bskyed/ de'i dpral bar o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ hū gi steng du zla ba'i gdan la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar tā yig gis mtshan pa/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka'i hu dang tā las 'od 'phros/ po ta le nas rje btsun ma dkar mo la sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ badz+ra sa ma dza o ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra tismo pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā hū/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ ar+gha/ pā s+t+ya/ pur+sha/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke lha rnye/ rkye we te/ shabha/ yi bar gyis ye shes pa mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus bshud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par gyis/ /zhes pas ye shes pa la bstod/ a gu sha dza hruri ba ho gnyis su med par gyur/gyis ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i hū dang tā las 'od 'phros pa/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzapañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra tismo ye swāhā/ pā s+t+ya pra tismo ye swāhā/ o badz+ra pur+sha ā skyo/ lko badz+ra dhu pe ā skyo/ tse( badz+ra ā 'e1 ke te ā hū/ tse ( badz+ra lha rnye ā hu/ myos badz+ra rkye we te ā hū/ o badz+ra shasta ā hū/ zhes pas dbang gi lha rnams la mchod pa phul bar bsam/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams —159—

kyi ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes badzir bha wa ā sgyi khiñtsa huX/ zhes gsung zhing bum chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan par gyur/ pa ni lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su grub pa yin pas/de la rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod cing bstod par bsams nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang / /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūX/de bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ mchod yod gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa dang / /me tog ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdug spos ji snyed yod pa dang / /snang gsal ji snyed yod pa dang / /dri chab ji snyed yod pa dang //zhal zas ji snyed yod pa dang / /rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di//yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang / /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ /ar+ghaX gyi gnas su/ pā s+t+ya/ pu po dhu pe/ ā lo kelha rnye/ rkye we te/ shasta pra ca pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āXhūX/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tu stu re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ zhes sogs nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /bsdu na lha dang lha min cod pan gyis zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ gzungs thag spyi la bkram pa'am slob dpon gyis bzung la/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i yig 'bru rnams las —160—

sngags phreng 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byung ba/ gzungs thag la khril nas bum bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad nas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa cho ga tshar re la khri stong ngam brgya las nyung ba mi bzla/ de nas ma ma a yu rje pu /dang / a li ka li/ ye dharmā rnams kyi grangs gong du bshad pa ltar bzla'o/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ pā s+t+ya pra titsā swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra purmye āXhūX/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āXhūX/ glu( badz+ra ā shwe1 ke āXhūX/ skye( badz+ra lha rnye āXhuX/ glu( badz+ra rkye we te āXhūX/ skye te badz+ra sha rto aXhūX/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi rdul snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par gyis/ /lko mchod bstod nas/ gzungs thag bsdud pa dang bstun la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa huX/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūX/'ga' yar bzlas pas lhag chad kha bskang bar bsam nas/ dung chos kyi bum pa blug la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ bum sgrub 'di ni skabs gas du yang byas la/ bum chu 'thung ba dang 'khrus byas nas phan yon dpag tu med do/ /zhes gzhung las byung ngo / /mdun bskyed byed pa ni/ mchod pa byin brlab sngar ltar byas la/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ tso( badz+ra yak+ṣa hūX/ gis mi gtsang ba dang bgegs rnams bsangs tsho( swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharmāXsu bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ gis stong par sbyangs bar bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar paX las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du/ tāXlas ut+pal dkar po tāXgyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur —161—

'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo/zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i hu dang tā las 'od 'phros/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ji lta ba byas la/ po ta la dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas skor ba spyan drangs par gyur/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma sa /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin brlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' ya sems can tshogs rnams bsgral bya'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur byon tshur byon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan gcig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par —1 62—

bstsal du gsol/ /dza hu ba ho e hre hi/ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra tri ju hobacom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan//bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /mchod yon gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ o sarba 'o/ /lko ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ga ga na sa ma ye hu/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /dung chos sam bum pa nas 'thor yab kyi gtor la/ o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hū/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya byas la/ o sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra pad+ma ka ma la ya stu/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa la bsams nas/ zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na/ /(gha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa rnams/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /lha la sogs pa'i dri yi rdzas/ /phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa/ /sim byed yid 'ong ldan pa 'di/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /phyogs dus kun na bdug spos ni/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /sgrol ma snyen ra dang bcas la 'bul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs rnams na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i rdzas//yon tan—kun ldan sang yod de/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /'jig —163—

rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod de/ /sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /zhes pas mchod/ nyer spyod so so'i mthar sngags dang phyag rgya byas kyang wo / bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par gyis/ /zhes pas mchod nas/ dgugs gzhugs bcing mnyes kyi phyag rgya byas la/oṃ badz+ra a gu sha dzaX oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sbo ṭa baX/ oṃ badz+ra ā be shaXganyis su med par gyur/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bsams nas/slar yang thugs ka'i huX dang tīXlas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga/yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaX pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā kyiX pra titsā swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhuX/ oṃ badz+ra lha rnye āXhuX/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āXhūX/ tsho( badz+ra rkye we te āXhuX/ skye( badz+ra ā 'e1 ke āXhuX/ tso rna badz+ra shag āXhūX/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badzir bhā wa ā bhi khiñtsa hūX/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyi bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi/ gur gum gyi char 'bebs/spos kyi ngad thul/ rol mo'i sgra sgrag bzhin pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan par gyur/ 'di'i mtshams su/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i yig 'bru rnams la —164—

dmigs nas/ yi ge bcu pa brgya la sogs gang grub dang / ma ma ā yu phu bye nyi shu rtsa gcig /dbyangs dang gsal byed/ rten 'brel snying po rnams lan gsum gsum yid ma yengs par myur bul gyi skyon spangs nas bzla'o/ /dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /thang skyes chu skyes chu chen me tog los/ /dri wo yid 'ong ldan pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra tismo pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye u hā/ dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /thang skyes chu skyes chu chen me tog bcas/ /dri zhim yid 'ong ldan pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra pā t+ya pra tisnro pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye u hu/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tā:yig las mchod pa'i lha mo de dang de spros nas mdun bskyed la mchod par bsam/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod 'bul ma//pur+sha dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /thang skyes chu skyes me tog dkon mang bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra pukhye pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye u hu/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i shangs la mchod 'bul ma/ /spos ma dud kha zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lhan cig sbyar dang yongs gyur spos khang bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra dhu pe pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye u hā/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sbyan la mchod 'bul ma/ /dī pa dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /nyi zla rin chen —165—

snang gsal sna tshogs bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā hū/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod 'bul ma/ /dri ma ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /a dkar tsan dan ga bur dung chos bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra lha rnye pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā hū/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod 'bul ma/ /ro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /ro dang bcud ldan lha rdzas zhal zas bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra nai we rkye pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā hu/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i snyan la mchod 'bul ma/ /sgra ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /pi wang gling bu sil snyan sna tshogs bsnams/ /rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mchod pa 'bul/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra sha ltapū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā hū/ 'dzam bu gling ngam gling gzhan na/ /gzugs mchog tshogs kyis gang ba yang / /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ /zhum pa med par byas te 'bul/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra rū pa ka ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te ā hū/ de bzhi du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ sgra snyan/ dri mchog /ro mchog /reg 'jam tshogs kyi bkang ba yang / /rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ /zhus pa med par byas te 'bul/ /zhes pa dang / sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ rū pa'i gnas su/ shabha/ lha rnye/ ra sa/par sha /rnams bcug /'dzam bu gling ngam gling gzha na/ /'khor lo rin chen —166—

bkang ba yang / /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te/ /zhus pa med par byas te 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya u hā/ de bzhin du/ nor bu dang / ma ṇi/ btsun mo dang / wa ṇi (〈pho〉wā sti/ blon po dang / mahā ta/ glang po dang / hasti/ rta mchog dang / tu ra ga a shwa/ dmag dpon dang / kha dha/ rnams bas pas ma sto/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal te/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par gyis/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ma ṅga la aṣ+ṭa ḍa wi pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye u hā/ bdag dang pha mas gtsor byas sems can thams cad lus ngag yid gsum gus pas rtse gcig tu/ mgrin sdebs te/ 'phags ma'i yon tan dran bzhin bstod par bsams nas/ 'khor ba las sgrol ta re ma/ /tu stu ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma/ /mchog spyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog 'dra zhing / /zla ba la ni rgyab rten ma/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan//rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras/ /'dod sbyin kun ni 'chang ba'i yum/ /'phags ma sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar/ /rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad/ /yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can/ /'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la/ /rin chen —167—

me tog mang po bcal du bkram/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /yum gyur sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma/ /lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni/ /bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang / /nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las/ /nus ldan khyod kyi bskyab tu gsol /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /'phags ma khyed la dad byed pa/ /de la rtag tu bu bzhin dgongs/ /bdag kyang khyod la gsol 'debs kyi/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol/ /lha mo sku mdog zla 'dra'i mdog /sgeg cing dul ba'i cha byad can/ /gzugs bzang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /mdzes pa'i dar gyi smad g.yogs can/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan dbus su/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzad/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bag can/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ /lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud/ khyod la bag tsam bstod pa 'dis/ /bdag cag byang chub bsgrub pa la/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi gyur te/ /mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par shog /ces pa brgya stong ngam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ bdun la co mtha' byas pa cho ga tshar re'i skabs su brjod/gtor ma dmigs pa gtad de/ oṃ badz+ra yak+tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āXhuX 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde —168—

ba khyad par can bskyed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āXhūX ha hoXhriX zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rje btsun ma'i ljags 'od kyi sbu gus/ bdud rtsi gtor ma la zug nas gsol bas/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsams te/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te khyoX bi shwa mu ṣe khyuX sarba thā khaX spru tri r+sha de/ spa ra ṇa i maX/ ga ga na khaX/ sgri ste daX ba li rkye swāhā/ zhes gsum mam/lnga'am/ bdun gyis 'bul/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ ngu khyaX pra tisnro swāhā/ skyed badz+ra pu zhe āXhūX/ tsho( badz+ra lha rje āXskyoX/ tso rna badz+ra dhu pe āXskyoX/ tso rna badz+ra ce we tre āXhūX/ oṃ badz+ra ā 'e1 ke āXhuX/ oṃ badz+ra pho/phya āXhūX/ zhes sogs/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyi/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka gceg gis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de nas gtor ma gnyis pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇa u bye nu tra sno twa ta oṃ āXhūX/ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ yul bdag /gnas bdagagazhi bdag /gnyus/ mar gnas pa/ sa pa ri wā ra na maXsarba ta thā ga te spyo bi shwa mu khe khyoX sarba tat+ta spru yin te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX ba li ta khyu hā/ gang dag 'di ni gnas pa'i yul bdag /gnas bdag /gzhi bdag /gnyug/ mar gnas pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma rgyas par bsngo ba 'dod na yang / 'di'i 'das gtor gyi rjes la rang gang byed kyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la sha khrag gis brgyan ba'i gtor ma yang byin brlabs gong du byas la bsngo'o//mdun bskyed la bzlas pa cung zad dang mchod pa rgyas pa/ gtor ma/ 'dod don la gsol ba rnams —169—

byas nas/ bdag 'jug kyang blang ngo zhes gsung pa la rten/ cho ga kha tshang ba dang / dam tshig sor chud cing dngos grub myur du 'byung bas na bdag 'jug bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad du bsams nas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ni/ skye( badz+ra bhu me āXhuX/dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āXhuX/ phyi'i lcags ri khor yug gis skor ba'i dbus su/ huX ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi yi longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/ lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo tha dad ma mchis pa'i drung du/rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin brlab dang / rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gu ru i daX maṇ+ḍa la khaṃ/ nir+ya ta ya mi/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad par bsams nas/ dbang gi don du phyag 'tshal bar mos te/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad gcig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /ces lan gsum/ 'kho ra ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tu stu re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ /tu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan gsum/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen por bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang —170—

dzo bdag la bstsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la bstsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /lan gsum brjod/ rgyas par spro na/rtog pa bsdu ba/ snang ba sbyin pa/rgyun bshags/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ sdom bzung / nang gi sems bskyed/ dam ba 'ag sogs kyang bya gsung / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor zug gas/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sa ngas rgyas byang chub yeng/ kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed/ par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi//'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ ma/dun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma dang tha mi dad pas/ rang nyid sbyangs nas/ rje bcun mar bskyed par bsam la oX swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharmāXsā bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo/ zhes pa nas/ lnga pa la 'od zer dmar nag gis bskor ba zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin mngon rtogs tshang bar gsal btang/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas rang gi gsol ba btab pa ni/ dus gas/ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag cag dus dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal nas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin brlabs dang / rjes su gnang ba bstsa'/ du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas/—171—

bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ nam mkha' la kha ba bu yug 'a zhe bras pa bzhin du byon/ rang gi snying ga'i 'khor lo dang yig 'bru la thim/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang /'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byon/ rang nyid la thim pas/sangs rgyas thams cad dang khyad par rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i byin brlabs zhugs pas/ snying ga'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi lus thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ dus dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa/ bar chad thams cad bsal bar gyur/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ a be sha ya a ā zhes pa lan gsum gsum bya/ spos dang rol mo bya zhing gong gi dmigs pa gsal ba gal che'o/ /rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bsam mo/ /mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob la dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdus pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ badz+ra sa ma dzapañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/ pā t+ya pra tismo swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra purdze u hu/oṃ badz+ra dhu pe u ཿ / oṃ badz+ra ā 'e1 ke ā hū/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye u hu/ oṃ badz+ra rkye we te u hū/ oṃ badz+ra shasta u hā/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchog chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng —172spo

bdag stsole/ /zhes lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba gdab pas/ dbang gi lha de rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi byang sems kyi bkang ba thogs nas/ spyi bor/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tā re tu stu te tu re swāhā/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i rtsa 'dab thams cad gang / lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lus sku rdo rjer gyur/ dbang dang po bum pa'i dbang thob/bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang / sprul sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/yang dbang gis lha de rnams kyi mgrin par/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ de bzhin bdag gi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghu hre a bhi ṣe ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag /ngag gsung rdo rjer gyur/ dbang gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rtsa rlung thig le sgom pa la dbang / longs sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ yang dbang gi lha de rnams kyi snying gar/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lko sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tā re dang / oX sarba ta thā ga ta pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye huX/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo mer gyis gang /yid kyi sgrib pa dag /sems thugs rdo rjer gyur/ dbang gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thabs shes snying rje sgom pa la dbang / chos sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ yang dbang gi lha de rnams kyi lte bar/ ji ltar —173—

bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /zhes sogs nas/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsa shun a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo mer gyis gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /sku gsung thugs mi ched (〈j-i〉 phyed ) pa rdo rje gsum du gyur/ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ rig stong dbyer med sgom pa la dbang / ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad kyi lus phyi nang thams cad gang bas 'phrin las bzhi thogs pa med par grub/ 'chi med che'i rigs 'dzin thob/ chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil ba las/ 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyi dbu brgyan par gyur pa la/ dbang gi lha de rnams kyis rang nyid la mchod par bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āXhuX/ nas shasta yi bar gyis mchod pa ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo / /gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i yi ge bcu pa las sngags phreng mar me gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung / zhal nas thon/ rang gi khar zhugs/ snying kha'i yi ge so so la thim par gyur/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ 'di'i rjes zlos la/ dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang / spyan snga rin po che chos kyi grags pa'i yi ge dang gnyis ka la yang brgya dang brgyad bzla'o gsung ngo / /'di nyid kyi gzhung las kyang yi ge bcu pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i rjes zlos skabs dang bstun nas bya zhes 'thun pa bzhin du/ brgya dang brgyad bzla'o/ /snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin —174—

gyis rlobe sa/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma tha mi dad pas me tog spyi bor bzhag pas bsams nas/ dngos su rang gi spyi bor 'jogs pa yin sgo /bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlo bos/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i byin brlabs kyis/ /mkha' spyod gnas su drangs su gsol/ /'phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo / /dbang gi lha de thams cad rang la thim pas/ rang lus lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par gyur/ pa yun ci gnas su bzhug pa ni/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po mngon du byas/thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo / /'phrin las bzhi'i rjes gnang yang byas chog gsung yang / yig cha khungs ma chod pas 'dir ma bris so/ /dam tshig sdom pa bsgrags pa la sogs pa spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa dang dam tshig thams cad bsrung bar khas blangs par bsams nas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /lan gsum brjod/ o badz+ra bhu me ā hu/ nas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin brlabs dang / rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gu ru i da maṇ+ḍa la ka nir ya ta ya mi/bdag gi lus kyang 'bul bar bsams nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran pa/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yi kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ rang gi dpral bar go mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/—175—

rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa byin brlabs sngar ltar byas nas/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po sgrol ma 'khor bcas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tismo pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āXhuX/ de bzhin du thog mtha' dang 'dra ba la/ mchod yon/gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/sil snyan/ ar+ghaX gyi gnas su/ pā kyiX/ puspe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ rkye we te/ sha p+ta pū dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye āXspruX/ zhes pas mchod/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma/ /dpa' mo tā re tu stu re/ /sangs rgyas zhal gyi pad+mo yi/ /ge sar las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ba/ /mchog sbyin phyag rgya ut+pa la/ /bsnams ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i gzeb las tu stu re/ /grwahwas nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad/ /oX gyis ngo bo nyid kyi ni/ /tshangs pa'i sgo yed khyod la 'dud/ /'jigs pa wo po brgyad las ni/ /'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad / /kun gyi ma dra zla/ra pa yi/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min cod pan gyi/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma la btud de/ /'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstod par 'os pa nas/ mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyis/zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ /zhes sogs nas/ yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar gyi gsol ba bto/ oṃ badz+ra tā re sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra tā re te no pa rnga ḍi rdo me bha —176—

wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra ru sarba karmā su tsa me tsit+ta shri ya ku ru hū/ ha ha ha ha hobha ga wan/ badz+ra tā re mā me muñtsa badz+ra tā re bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa ā lan gsum byas la/ snying kar thal mo sbyar te/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yi ni/ /nyes pa bgyis dang bgyid bstsal ba/ de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang / /cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang / /bdag gis brjed ngas ci bgyis pa/ /de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /nub snga ma rnamasal/ bdag mdun bum gsum gyi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ye shes pa 'khor bcas badz+ra mu rdul tshon gyi dam tshig pa rnams/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yi ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la ya sta/dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ khyod kyi sa la 'khod par shog /nub tha ma yin na/ badz+ra mu zhes ye shes pa gshegs pa'i rjes su/ mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis sngar ltar bya/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ sa phyogs de dag tu shis pa rgyas par bya'o/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar//lhag par lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bdag gis tshe rabs kun tu —177—

bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las ma/ /sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi/ /yum gyur ut+pal bsnams pa'i bkra shis shog /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin brlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnams 'phel ba'i/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang bsrung ma'i byin brlabs kyis/ /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te/ /bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe ring nad med bde dang ldan par shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral don rtogs thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyin ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bde legs shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin brlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin brlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin smon lam 'grub par shog /—178—

'dod don gsol bas dngos grub grub par bsam nas sbyin bsreg byed na sbyin bsreg la 'jug ste zhi ba'i thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i g.yas su bsreg rdzas/ g.yon du mchod rdzas/mdun du rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar la bzhag /kha shar du bltas te skyil krung ngam/ tsog pur 'du/ga la lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas me sbar shing gis thab la g.yas su skor zhing / tā re tu stu re tu re'i sngags lan gsum gyi rjes su dz+wa la raX zhes pas me sbar/ yang dz+wa la gsum gyis dgang blugs kyi mar blug yo ga ltar/ rdo rje gnod spyin gyi sngags rgyas thab dang /yo byad bsangs/ tshod āXswāhā/ 8 do / swāhā/ glu( dzi swāhā/ tseX( ku ru ku ru swāhā/ yo byad dang thab sbyangs/ swa bhā was/ stong pa'i ngang las/ thab paX las pad+ma/ raX las chi ma 'i steng du huX las thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang pa/dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi ror/ kyi grwa bzhir rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ dbyibs zlum pa/ mtshan 'id phun sur/ res sa pa dang ldan par gyur/ yang mchod rdzas bsreg rja sa kyang / swa bhā was/ stsong ri 'i ringalas rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas pas grub ri re ma/jodardzas bsreg rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang nam ra/ba shrī bar sde ri thams cad khyab pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba / re ma ldod nga sdesprin phung lta bu bsam gyi mi khyab par mos la/ ar+ghaX nas/ shaje/)bdi di3 sa blo dhi sgrik+ṣa la sogs pas byin gyis bsas/ de nas thab kyi nang du/ paṃ ra sa 3sdo dang nga las bgrang phreng raX gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur ri ri sa /me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba/ ra skyes re sgon nga /zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon gyi spyi blugs 'jin pa/—179—

gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshoms 'phyang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par mos te/ stug gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna drung du cas la/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ asne ye mahā te dza sarba karmā pra swa da ka mahā bhu ta de wā ri shi dī dza/ sa da ma gra ha/ a hū ti/ a ha ra/ a smin sa ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pasaspyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya stuX gi me tog gtor la gdan la bzhugs par bsam oṃ asne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra ca sruhwas mchod/ pā phya gyi zhabs bsil phul nas/rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhu ta dz+wa la ya bhasmin ku ru sarba sdo yan hūṃ phaṭa/ dra tho dzaXhūṃ baX hoX sam ya stuX gyis dam la bzhag /oṃ badz+ra aX ku sha dzaX la sogasapas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ gong ltar dbang bskur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /'di ni bdag cag gi bgegs zhi zhing / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig oṃ badz+ra satwa āX zhes pas ku sha rtse mo g.yas su bstan te thab kyi phyogs brgyad du bskor zhing / yak+ṣa bzlas pa'i chu dang rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsangs/ de nas me lha'i lce huX las rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/pa'i kha dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la tha bkod de/ oṃ asne ye sruhwas lan bdun mar gyis bkang ste/—180—
