gzar bu kha sbyar la/ oṃ asne ye di byā di byā bi shu khye/ mahā shrī ha byā ka byā bha ya ha na ya hū phaṭa grwahwas mer blugs pa lan gsum gyis/ me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam oṃ asne ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ar+gha la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po kho bos dbang bskur ba/ khres rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /zhi byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ lko asne ye 'ba' zhig gis rdzas thams cad phul nas/ rin po che re re'i mjug tu spel zhing tshig brjod de/ yam shing la gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ mar la 'byor pa/til la dge ba/ zas mchog la bde ba/ 'bras la bsod nams rgyas pa/ so ba la nor dang 'khru/ nas la shugs/ sran ma la stobs/ gro la nad med pa/ dur ba la tshe/ ku sha la bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/spel rdzas so so'i sngags kyis 'bul na/ rim pa bzhin/ lko bo dhi sgrik+ṣa ya swāhā/ oṃ asne ye swāhā/ o sarba pa pa da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba sa bha de swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sdirdzo ye swāhā/ o badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā pā la ye swāhā/ oṃ bhasma ri swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ oṃ u pra ti he ta ya snya hwas phul la/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ bsang gtor dang was bsil phul la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ra gyi me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ de nas thab kyi dbus su bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar dam tshig pa bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs —181—

su gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /lko pa dang / sngar gyi sngags la sogs pas spyan drangs/ ye shes pa gzhug /dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam la oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ga rnye ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis bkang la/ oX 'a ye di bya di bya bi shudhe mahā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na huX phaṭa/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi 'gal rkyen mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad shan+ti ku ru sruhwas mar blugs la lan gsum bya/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ de nas rdzas la/ oX tā re tu stu re tu re snya hwas 'bul ba las/ spel tshig me lha'i skabs dang 'dra la/ til sum brgya la sogs pa mang du 'bul/ gzhan brgya dang re re 'bul/ mthar lan bdun 'bul ba gong bzhin dang / 'og ltar gtor ma btang / 'dod don gsol la bzod pa zhu/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ badz+ra dz+wa la'i sngags kyi mar dgang blugs gsum thab tu blugs la me lha'i skur bzhengs par bsam la/ gong gi me lha'i skabs ltar lhag ma bsreg rdzas nyi shu rtsa re dang / mar byin zan ltar phul lam mchod/ gtor ma lkoX asne'i mthar/ ā ka ro btags la 'bul/ sngar gyi bstod pa'i rjes su/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa dang / /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs —182—

dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan sdus bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsis yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/zhes pas bstod/ 'dod don bsam/ bsang gtor sngar bzhin 'thor 'thung prok+ṣa na pra ca ye srudzo phul la/ bdag gi don dang g.yin gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyi sgrubs kyi gshegs/ /ji ltar gnas su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad bsgrubs/ /tse( asne ye ya hi zhes pa dang / spyan drangs ba'i phyag rgya las/ mdzub mo dang lag pa phyir bskyed de/ me lha gshe/gas su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ lhag chad kha skang ba'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ ston mchog dam pa'i bkra shis brjod/ de nas gtor ma bzhi bshams pa'i dang po rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsangs/ rdo rje me yi phyag rgyas sbyangs/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs tshul dang / a kā ros bdud rtsir gyur/ lha'i ljags rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing snying po'i mthar/ bha ling ta kha kha 'a hi ji hi/ zhes brjod pas 'bul/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/sogs kyi phrin las gzhol/ de nas gtor ma gnyis phyogs skyong / gsum pa 'byung po/ bzhi pa bgegs la cha gsum ltar bsngos la/ mchod bstod/ 'dod don zhu/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / zhes pa la sogs pas bzod par gsol/ o khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /la sogs pa'i mthar/ o u hā badz+ra mu / rang dang mdun gyi ye shes pa gshes sa/ mdun gyi dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ rten yod na gshegs gsol mi dgos bstan bzhugs bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrung / rjes —183—

bsdu'o/ /de dag gi rang bzhin gyi don du lha mnyes pa'i cho ga sbyin bsreg dang bcas pa bstan zin to/ /'phags ma zhi ba rin chen bzhi grags las/ /phan bde chos can mda' chen 'phangs pa nga / /mnyam du blo yi mun tshogs dpung bcoms nas/ /bdag blo thar pa'i grong du 'dren la 'dud/ /rgyal bas chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas kyis/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i snying po rnams las ni/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo man ngag gdams pa mchog /deng 'dir rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /chos tshul ngo mtshar 'thung ba'i pu rje bi dza yis/ /ngo mtshar chos rigs rkang 'thung rtse mo der/ /gsum brtsen lha mi'i rgyal po rnam 'phrul ba/ /mnga' 'bangs bde ba'i sar 'god 'dzum zhal can/ /lugs gnyis mngon par mtho zhing dbang 'byor bas/ /bdag gi phu bo sa skyong dam pa byung / /rnam dkar dad dang lhag bsam 'byor pa'i dpal/ /'di dang phyi mar 'chi med tshe bsgrub phyir/ /rab spel par gyis 'phrul yig 'di bsgrubs so/ /yi ge'i byed po shes rab kun dgas bris/ /sor mo'i zlos gar 'phrul las byung ba'i brkos/ /sgo gsum brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i dpon chen ni/ /bsod nams bstan pa zhes pas legs par bgyis/ /yi ge dag byed bkra shis bzang po dang / /bkra shis byang chub gnyis kyis rnam dpyod legs/ /'dir 'bad dge tshogs 'od dkar gang mchis pa/ /pha mas gtso byas 'gro kun ji snyed dang / /bdag cag mched lcam ma lus 'khor bcas rnams/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob par shog /'di ltar bsgrubs las byung ba'i dge ba dang / rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /tshe ring nad med bde ba thob pa dang / /chab srid dbang phyug rnams ni gong du 'phel/ /rang 'byung pad+ma'i chos tshul rab rgyas nas/ /'phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' ru khyab nas kyang / /'gro kun sems can mtha' yas thams cad kyis/ /skyabs dang skyob pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig/ // shu bha stu sarba dza ga ta/ bkra shis so/ /—184—

tshe sgrub dang bcas pa bzhugs tre sto/ /dge legs 'dod pa'i 'bras stsol ma/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal sbyin ma//srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun sel ma/ /'phags ma sgrol mas shis par mdzod/ /'dir thog mar skyabs sems spyi dang mthun/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogag ṣ+ka jobo'i gsung yin nges kyi yid tshes chog shel 'tshal/ de nas su bhā was stong par sbyas/ stongapa'i ngang las hāX las bsrung 'bor/ paX las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ rang sems ut+na la dkar po tāXgis mtshan pa las/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag g.ya samachog spyin/ g.yon rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pal dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mu tig dkar po gtso bor gyurapa'i dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad 'dab ltar rab tu yangasapa'i spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ gnas gsum du tshe āXguXthugs ka' dbus su tāXye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoXdabang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaX de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyisabadag la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ badz+re bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa huX/ dbang bskuraskugang dri ma dag /'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ spron skabs 'di4yod ba spo bya/snying gar 'khor lo gsal btab la thun gyi thog mtha' gnyis su/ oX tā re tu stu re tu re mam—185—

ā yur pu rje/ dzñā na pu zhi/ ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci rigs dang / bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi yige bcupanyid la byed/ de bzlas pa'i sgo nas tshe bsring pa'o/ /snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las/'od zeradakar po phyogs thams cad du 'phros/ rang gi phyi rol 'doms gang tsam du gurakhyim dkar por gyur pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar bsam/ debazhin du ser pos tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par bsam/ dmar pos thams cad dbang du bsdus par bsam/ /sngon pos dgra bgegs thams cad tsharabacad/ ljang khus las thams cad 'phral du 'gru/ba/ ma cin/ khas 'kha/'grub/ pa la bar chad bsal/ 'od zer 'khor lo de rnams so so'i bar la 'do khogangatsam re yod pa/ bar mtshams thams cad utrul gsar du kha bye bas gang b.rabasam la/ bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ mthar 'od zer 'khor lo phyi ma phyi mnang malathim pa mthar snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la bsdu/ bzung 'khor gyi tshe bsring pa'o/snyingaga'i 'khor lo'am sa bon las 'od 'phros/ 'byung bzhi'i bcud thams cad bdud rtsir bsdus/ rang nyid la thim pas lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten du gyur pas sra brtan rdo rje'i tshe thob par mos shing / bzlas brjod ci rigs bya/ de bzhi du sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang / bsod nams gnod pa med par blangs nas snga ma ltar bya stobacud bsdu bas tshe bsring pa'o/ /snying gar zla ba la tāXlas dbugs phyir 'gro ba'i tshe'od zer spro/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe bsdu/ gnas pa'i tshe tāXl sems gtad pa'i lan brgya phragatsam sgom pa ni rdo rje'i bzlas pas tshe bsring pa'o/ /rang lus kyi dbus su srog rtsa2shel gyi kab btsugs pa lta bu yas sna 'ig le dkar po dang / mas sna thig le dmar pos bkag pa/nang snyingaga'i tāXlas byung ba'i srog gi rlung sngo dmar gyis 'gro 'ong med par gang ba la sems gtad de/ rlung —186—

bum can ci rigs su 'dzin pa ni snying gar tshe phur gdab pa la brten nas tshe bsring pa'o//phyi mabazhi po de gang yang rung bar byas pas chog/snying gar 'khor lo sgom tshul ni zla ba'i steng du 'khoralo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa mtha' mar mu khyud dang bcas pa/lte ba'i dbus su hā tī:oṃ gsu5rdeyas rim gyis brtsegs pas/de'i mtha' la ma ma ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod cig/rtsibs brgyad la tā re tu stu re tu re khyu zhes pa'i yi ge brgyad po thams cad kha nangabaltas mgo gyen bstan/'od zer dkar po 'bar ba sgom pa yin//tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'o//zhus/ dag/ ma sge laX//༄༅smu//gsang ba spyi'i cho ga zhi ba las thams cad pa'i spyin sreg gi cho ga 'bring po bzhugs se(//na mo gu sa 'dir gsang ba spyi'i cho ga las brtsams te/zhi ba las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di ltar bya'o//bdag nyid rdo rje khro bo huX mdzad rdo rje da phro kha bu won par gyur/oṃ suX bha ni suX bha huX/grihā grihā guX grihā pā ya gri snyon g.yo hūX un yoho bha ga wān biṅgā rwadza hūXphaṭa/lan bdun tsam bzlas/rang rang gi lugs ltar sngon la gro gtor ma btang /lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la ba 'gatso rna āXhuX/tso( ha na han ༷kedha huX phaṭa/ces pa lan mang du bzla/de rjes sa gzhi der/brkos thab byed na/stegs bumatho gang gi dpangs dang ldan pa byas la/sgom don dang mthun par rtsig pa dang sa brko dgos shing/bris thab tu byed na/tshang thig zur thig btab/༷bus su thig skud mtho gang gis zlum wa rtse bskor/

de nas sor bzhi pa gnyis rim can du bskor te/thab dang mu ran dang kha khyer rnams so//lte ba nas mu ran gyi mthar gzung ba nyis gyur zur thig gi steng du bya rjes byas pa'i steng nas/phyogs ba'i na gru/bzhin btab/de la slar yang sor gnyis bsnan/dbus su pad+ma 'dab bgyod dang /mur na la ze'u'abru/kha khyer la pad+ma 'dab brgyad rnams 'bri/de dag gi bar rnams dkar po 'gengs//stegs bu ser po zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dkar po/de dag gi bcad mdzes tshon/dbus kyi pa' lte bar rdorje sor brgyad pa/lha gtso bo gang yin gyi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i kha tog can 'bri/'dabamabargyad lamatshan ma ma bkod kyang chog/yang na rigs dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan dbus su brisakyang rung ba yin no//de nas zlum thig nang ma'i nang nas/dri zhim po'i bud shing gis zlu5wang brtsegs/rang gi g.yas phyogs su bsreg rdzas rnams rim can du sgrigs/de rnams kyi bar gyi chanas/ci rigs pa re blangs nas sdod gcig tu bsres/g.yon gyi cha la/mchod yon kyi snod che chungaganyis dang /bsang gtor gyi snod cig spun mas/de'i 'phro mthud nas nyer spyod sogs mchod parnams phyi nang rim pa gnyis kyang bshams/rang dang thab kyi bar du me yol brtsig/me yoladangarang gi bar du dril bu dang /de'i mdun du rdo rje ga 'ag/rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blun kyang bzhag/mar khu dang yam shing yang g.yas phyogs su 'jog ste/ji ltar bde bar yang bya'o//de nas yi dmagang yin gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar bya ste/dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgomasardepa yin na rang la bsdu'o//ku sha nas bzung /bsang chu la dmigs te/tso ( badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+da li ha na ha na hūphaṭa/brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i byin gyis brlabs/nang mchod dgos pa'i rigs yin zhigabadag bskyed kyi skabs grub na des chog ma grub na skabs 'dir rang rang gi lugs kyi nang mchod byin rlabs bya/de nas a khru ta bzla shing /bsang chus gnas khang dang yo byad kun la ge tor/nang 88

mchod dgos pa'i rigs yin na des kyang gtor la/ oṃ āXhuX lan mang du brjod/ de nasararang ni lugs bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ sreg rdzas rnams la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya gtad nas tsho te swāhā/ lan gsum gyis/ ma dag pa bkrus par bsam/ glu( āXsruhwa/ gsum gyis yamashing dang / tso rna shrī swāhā/ gsum gyis zhun mar dang / tseX( dzi swāhā/ gsum gyis 'bru thams cad dang / skye sgo ku rar mi ku ra mi swāhā/ gsum gyis rdzas gzhan rnams byin gyis brlabs/ tseX( āXspruX gisame blangs/ sgron me sbar/ a mṛ tas de la bsang chus gtor/ a mṛ ta bzla bzhin tu thabalagayas bskor bya/ lkoX badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la huX/ zhes me sgron thab nang du gzhug hūX khruX zhes brjod cing / rlung g.yab kyis me sbar ro/ /thab khung a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lha sterjopa'i ngang la hūX las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po khru gang ba/ muran dang kha khyer gyis bskor zhing / stegs bu'i grwa la zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbyibs can/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ de'i nang du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor raX gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zhi ba'i tshe lha dkar po/ phyag g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rang 'od kyi rig ma dang gnyis su med pa/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ me lce dkar po'i 'phreng ba dkrigs shing / ra skyes dkar po'i steng na rdo rje'i skyil krung gisabazhugs pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lto nas me lha ge shi dngabacas pa thams cad spyan drangs te byon par gyur/ skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya lasamathe bong rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po rmu /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni —189—

yang dag bsnyen par mjodi/ /tshe ṭak+ki hūX dza/ zhes spyan drangs/ bsang chu ge tor zhing a mṛ tas bgegs bskrad/ dzaXhūX baX hoX dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ kusha'i chun pos bsang gtor byed pa dang lhan cig tu/ mchod yon kyi snod chung ba nas bzed zhal du blug ste/ oṃ āXhruXpra wa ra sa t+pa rā zeX ar+ghaX pra titsā huX swāhā/ zhe༅brjod/ oṃ badz+ra pu nyu āXhūX/ nas shasta'i bar gyis nyer spyod phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbangamagon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭa ni sa dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab tshang/gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dun/ /ces pas bstod/ oX badz+ra a na la mahā bhā ta dz+wa la dz+wa la sarba bhasmi ku ru sa ma sdospyin hūX phaṭa/ khru khyi dzaXhūX baX hoX sa ma pyu stuX/ sa ma ya ho/ zhes ni gsum gyis dmalabs /de nas/ me lha'i thugs kar huX/ ljags la rdo rje rtse gcig pa raX gyis mtshan pa/ dgang blugs kyi kha la yang hūX gis mtshan par gyur/ o.a pon ye/ ā dī bya ā dī bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha mahā shri ye ha bya ka bya wā hā nā ya/ bdag go sdigasgrib bar chad nad gdon bkra mi shis pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sharnyi ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis dgang blugs 'bul/ de bzhin du sngags de nyid kyis/ yam shing lan gsum phul/ slar yang sngags de nyid lan ji ltar 'os pas/ sreg rdzas thams cad bsregapa de nas ci rigs par 'bul lo/ /tseX( asna ye swāhā/ zhes pas mar blugs gzar gang thabadu phul 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /slar yang bsangs sbyangs/ me lha'i thugs kar rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su zhes/mtshams sbyar nas/ lhag gang la mchod pa 'bul rgyu'i lhag pa'i lha de nyid kyi mdun bskyed mchod pa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du bskyed nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab la —190—

sogs spro yang rang rang gi lugs bzhin du bya/rig bdag rang mas su bsgoms nas/dbang bskur rgyas gdab mi dgos so//mchod yon gyi snod gnyis pa nas/ku shas bsang gtor 'bul bzhinadu/gzed zhal du blug la/lha so so'i snying po'i mthar gong gi mchod yon gyi sngags/sbyar ba༅mchod yon 'bul/me tog nas rol mo'i bar gong bzhi du 'bul ba dang /bstod pa yang so so'i bstod pa sho lo ka re re tsam re byed pa'am/so so'i cho ga las byung ba'i mchod 'phreng rgyas pa yod na/de ltar mchod bstod phul na yang legs pa yin no//de nas sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/thog mar lhag pa'i lha'i sngags rnams kyi mthar rdzas so so'i sngags sbyar la/mjug tu las sngags sbyor ba yin te/dper mtshon na/'phags ma sgrol ma'i rigasngags la bsreg rdzas lan bdun 'bul na/glu( tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/zhes pal na gciga.oṃ 'a ye swāhā/zhes pa lan 'dun/bdag gi sdig sgrib bar chad nad gter na bkra mi shis pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/zhes pa zhag ni khu/lab lta bu'o//de la/oṃ 'a ye swāhā/zhes pa ni mar khu'i sngags so//oXbho dhi prik+ṣa yoswāhā/yam shing gi sngags so//oṃ sarba pā paX da ha na badz+ra ye sru twa til ba tshebadz+ra.ā yu ṣe swāhā/dur ba dang /oṃ badz+ra pu snying ye swāhā/'bras ma thugs pa dang/tshesarba saXpa de swāhā/zho zan dang /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swāhā/ku shad bslo badz+ra bi dza ye swāhā/'bras so ba dang /oX badz+ra mahā be ga ye swāhā/nas dang /thobadz+ra mahwa ba la ya swāhā/sran ma dang /oṃ badz+ra lha sma ri ye swāhā/gro dang /oṃ sarba yi yug sidha ye snyatwayungs dkar gyis sngags so//gzhan yang mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pas mchod par bya ste/snyingapo'i sngags kyis 'bul bar bya'o//de la mar dang yam shing ni med du mi rung ba yin zhig rdzasagazhan de dag ji tsam rnyed pa de tsam 'bul ba ༷na kyang /las thams cad pa la lta ci smos zhi ba

rkyang pa la yang rdzas de dag 'dzom na legs shing /rab gnas dang /rang gzhan gyi zhi bang las spyi 'gro tsam sgrub pa la/sreg rdzas so so re nas brgya phrag re re tsam dang /rdzas sngags kyang de tsatsha'abul ba yin la/che'i bar chad kho na zhi bar byed pa sogs/zhi ba'i las nyi tshe ba la/so so'i rdzas dang sngags sna re re de kho na byed pa sogs yod kyang /dngos grub kyi don dang /bsnyen pa'i khoskongal thog mar mar khu/yam shing mang tsam dang /lhag ma sreg rdzas so so la grangs mnyam pa mang nyung gang 'os re phul ba'i rjes su/snying po'i sngags kho nas sreg par byed pa nyid la ji tsam dgos pho grangs 'dzin pa nyid bzang ba yin no//sreg rdzas rdzogs pa'i mthar/so so'i mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba'i gtor 'bul mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams byas la/yig brgya lan gsum bzlas/gang yang bdag blo rmodza༅rdepa yis//nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa//gang phyir lus can yi skyabs na phyir//mgon khyed de ring bzod mdzad rigs//ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang //gang yang nus pa ma mchis/ pas//'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa//de kun ྅grod kyis bzod mdzad rigs//bdag la dngos grub mchog stsol lags//tinga'adzin kun gyi 'bras bu stsol//sems can kun la ci 'dod par//de gros grub bla na med pa'ang stsol///slar yang gshe/gas par mdzad pa'i phyir//rngengagoganas gshe/gas badz+ra mu zhes ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs shidadam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba'am/gnyis kar yang rang gi snying gar bsdu ba skabs su gang bab sbyorate/'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o//de nas/skye( asna ye swatwa zhes pas marablugs gzar gang phul/mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyi mchod pa gong bzhin phul/tshangs/pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras//me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog/'byung po yongs9

su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags/grus pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i tshe ltaragazi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprulngapa'i theg pa cings/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lhan khyo bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes sa brte/tshe 'gasheram bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las o ā hu las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i gyo 0 chen por gyur/ oṃ u hu ha ho hrī oṃ asna ye ā hi bya/ nag lha hwa nā ya/ a kā ro mu kha sogs sbyar ba lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ yang ar+gha/ nas/ shasta'i bar gyisamachod/ me stobasreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyon gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag nas/ kun 'grub shog gi b.ragyis 'phrin las bcol/ gong bzhin mchod yon phul/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /sogs bzod par gsol/ rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur byon zhing / /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /o.ā badz+ra mu ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshe/gas/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i me'i ngang du thim par gyur/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya/tsher bzhin gyis zhi bar ma gyur kyi bar du/ dkrug par mi bya la/ glo bur du las rjes bsdu stodags pa byung na/ 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chu la/ oṃ ru ru sbu ru dz+wa la ti gi sirnyi lo tsa ni/ sarba ut+pa ga dha —193—

ni swāhā/zhes pa brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas/me la blug/rgyas pa la sogs pa gzhan rnams/la yangacho ga 'dis rigs 'gre la/lha nyung ngu'i dkyil 'khor dang cho ga bsdus pa'i rigs dag sgrubathabs phra mo sogs la/de dang 'brel bar mdor bsdus 'di tsam kho na legs shing ga dzin gong ltar las/dngos gzhi'i skabs rdzas sngags so so byed pa bor ba ni/shin tu bsdus pa'i rigs su gtogs so//gsang ba spyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa la mngon par dga' na/logs su 'bri bar yang 'gyur ro//zhi ba las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdo tsam 'di yang /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// mas lo//༄༅//bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mchod pa'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs tre rdzo//rgya gar skad du/gu ru pū dzo pa yi kā pū dza nī dh+wa nā ma/bod skad du tsho/mchod pa'i cho ga mchod pa'i gter zhes bya ba/bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshalalo//mchod 'os kun gyi gter gyur pa//bla ma'i zhabs pad la bco de//de nyid mchod par mi pa'i thabs//shin tu mos pa chen pos brtsams//de yang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/khren tu khyad paragyur pa nyid//rtag par bla ma la yang dbul//de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la//rtag tu byin panyid du 'gyur/zhes dang /sdom pa 'byung bar/mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas//blamamachod pa yang dag brtsam//de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi//ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs pa thos shing tshe 'di nyid la 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa dag gis/bla ma mchod cing ༷rdos par byed pa la brtson par byed dgos pas/

de'i tshul ni/rang thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs bsal ba ni/lha dang lha mi bye/ gsang ba ba//lus sprul la sogs gang ci'ang rung //lus ngag sems/laganas pa yi//bgegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon//nga ni dpal ldan rdorje zhi ra tsho rwa ri 9ri :sku/:nostabs//bsrung ba 'a snyen ra lo rab sbyor bas//dwo rje 'bar ba 'a skus//lus gsum las skyes bags ༵ra bya/oṃ/gal te kha cag bdag las 'da'/rnamapar brlag 'gyu/ra smu sna'i du na/sa/ āXhūXhraXphaṭa/ces lan gsum na do//zhesapas bka' bsgos la/sna gas 'od kya 'phro 'du las//phyogs kun rdorje 'baraba'i gur//o ba dza tsakar twa 1 dpung 'bar//rab brtan bsrung ba'i 'khorerdelor gyur// badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa sgroX huX/kho pas thun mong ma yin pa'i bzung 'bor stsokhol/gnas khang da/ pa'i zhing du gsal ba 'a dbus su seng khri pad+ma nyi 'a gdan la spyan drangs pa ni/snros mchog gnyis med ye shes spyan can rnams//chos kya sku la gshegs 'byon mnga' 'i'i lha //gzugs sku brtse ba chen po'i rnam ra ge rwa nod dod da gyis//dad ldan rge ge yig pa zhang du gshegs su gsol//rat+na gu ru sa pa ra wā ra badz+ra sa mya dzaXrtsa ba 'a bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang wo po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis / rje dang dril bu thugs kar rim po kau bzung ba/'a rdo rje'i skyilamo krung sa bzhugs pa/dar dang na po tshe' rgyan thams cad kyas brgyan pa/mawo dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing /rang la dgyes pa'i zhalaldom bag dang ldan pa/'od )nga 'od zer gyi r+sās ༵tha' dkyil 'phro~Xskucan/mtha' skor du brgyud pa' bla ma rnams dang / dam da—la 'khong — lha tshogs/sangs rgyas byang sems/'aXgs pa nyan rang /chos skyong bsrungam

thams cad bzhugs par gyur/mgon po 'gro ba'i don la byon pa legag/bdag gi mchod yon 'di nyid bzhes nas kyang //ji srid mchod pa'i bya ba mardzogs par//yid 'ong gdan la bde bar bzhugs su gsol//tshe pa wa rasaka ra ar+gha pra ru swāhā/zhes pas mchod pa phul la/skye rna pad+ma ā bro yon stu/zhes pas gdan la bzhugs par bsam la/yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pas//gang gomatshan tsam dran pas kyang //bdag blo'i rgud pa zhi mdzad pa//dpal ldan blamalaphyag 'tshal//dri med yon tan rab rgyas pas//'gro kun gtsug gi rgyan gyurapa'i//dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che//bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'phro / go/blang dor rtogs pa'i snang ba yis//'gro kun mi shes mun sel ba/khrir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog/bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//bsod nams ye shes bsil zer gyis//phan bde'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad pa/khyim dag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog/bla ma'i zhabs la dam chos bdud rtsi'i sman ༅go/gis//nyon mongs sdug bsngal nad sel ba//thabs mkhas 'gro ba'i sman pa mchog/bla ma'i zhabs la thabs dang shes rab gru chen gyis khrid zhi'i rgya mtsho mthar sgrol pa//stobs ldan 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog/bla ma'i zhabasal gnod pa kun las skyob byed cing //phan pa dpag med sgrub mdzad pa zhi/byams mgon 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig po/bla ma'i zhabs la zhes pas༅/ 4lal/mchod rdzas rnams dang zhing rgya che bar byin gyis brlabs la/mdog bzang dbyibasalegs tshim pa'i dri bsrung can//man+da ra dang ut+pal ku mud sogs//de hrasa'abyor yid kyis sprul pa'i me tog kun//skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i 96

tshogs la 'bul/ /oṃ rat+na gu ru sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra putre pū dza tshe gha sa mu dra sngaraṇa sam ye hu/ rgyu bzang mnams na zhim pa'i dri ngad can/ /a ka ru dang tsas na sprul snying sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i bdug spos kun/ /skyabasamachog: badz+ra dhu pe/ mun sel dngos kun gsal ba'i gzi brjid can/ /sgron me nyi zla lus kyi 'od la sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i snang gsawakun/ /skyabs mchog: badz+ra ā lo ke: dri zhim byug na bde ba'i reg mchogakun/ /ga bur gla rtsi nom pa'i dri la sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis spras pa'i dri mchog kun/ /skyabs mchog: badz+ra ga rnye/ mdog bzang myangs na bde ba'i robacud can/ /'bras chan ka ra gyogatar khu ba sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid kyisasprul pa'i zhal zas kun/ /skyabs mchog: badz+ra nai we rma /don zab thos na snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ /rnga chen dung dang pheg rdob rgyud mang sogs/ /༈ngosa'abyor yid kyis sprul pa'i sil snyan kun/ /skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla mo'i tsho gi/sa la 'bul/ /sha ltas mchod la/ /༈ nyes pa'i skyon kun rab spangs shing / /legs pa'i yon tan kun ldan pas/ /phan bde dpal 'byor kun 'byung ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla mkhyed labastod/ /gdul bya smin zhing grol ba'i phyir/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thamasacad nyid/ /'dren pa'i tshul du rnam 'phrul pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyaga'atshal/ khyed sku sha dang rus bral yang / /ye shes gzugs su snang ba'i sku/ /dad pa'i mig rkyen mchog gyur pa/ /sku yi dbang phyug khyed la 'dud/ /brjod 'dod rtsol ba mi mnga' yang / /yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /zab—197—

cing rgya che'i don ston pa//gsung gi dbang phyug khyed la 'dud/khres dang shesabya'i spros bral yang /khres bya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thugs/snying rje'i gzungs spobs du ma'i gter//thugs kyi dbang phyug khyed yon to cha tsa5'gro kun gyis//bskal par brjod kyang mi zad pa'i//spyan dang rmen shesardzu'aphrul sogs//yon to dbang phyug mthong thos dran pas don si na//bsten nas 'gro ba ci smos pa//lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' bzhi/'phrin las/dbang phyug ces pas bstod//༈dpal 'byor phun tshogs dag pa'i zhing khams na//'khor tshogasayon tan 'phrin las dpag med can//sangs rgyas byang sems du mas rab kangaba'i//phun tshogs zhing khams kun gyis bla ma mchod//rab yangs 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor brtan pa la//bkod legs ri gling khor yug rgya mtsho sbrag/brtan g.ye'i dpal gyis phyur bur gtams pa yi//phun tshogs 'jig rten khams kyis bla ma nyi zla rgyu skar rgyas pa dwangs pa'i mkha'//na bun 'ja' tshon sprin gyis mdzes gyur zhing //nor bu'i mdangs 'phrog kun gyi go 'byod pa zhi/phun tshogs nam mkha'i khams kyis 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin wo ri bodang //rtsi sman rgyas pa'i nags ri gangs ri sogs//dbyibs legs lhun stugaskye bo'i rten gyur pa//phun tshogs ri bo kun gyis dri med rba rlabs g.yo ba'i chuklung dang //yan lag brgyad kyis gang ba'i mtsho rdzing sogs//yid 'o nge rnyogasapa med cing gdung sel ba//phun tshogs chu bo kun gyis g.ya' med mtsho smad nags tshal thang dang ljongs//rwa ba 'obs bcas pho brang yul ge bor jo gos//98

bde zhing nyams dga'i dpal 'byor gyis gang ba'i//phun tshogs bsti gnasakun gyis mu tig man shel dung dang gser dngul sogs//'dod dgu stingaba'i rin chen ji snyed dang //gur gum gi ha tsan+dan dkar dmar sogs/zhusaldan nad sel sman mchog kun gyis mchod//gzhan yang ro bcud ldan pa 'tshoba'i rkyen//'bru bcud rtsi thog lo tog la sogs dang //mdor na snod kyi dpal 'byor mchod 'os kun//blo yis blangs nas mnyam med bla ma mchod/khams gsum dbang phyug tshangs pa brgya byin dang //mi dbang 'khor ra los bsgyurardergyal klu dbang sogs//btsun mo sras sogs mnga' thang rab rgyas pa zhi/yid 'ong skye dgu'i dbang po kun gyis mchod//rigs bzang 'byor ldan blon po khyimobadag dang //yid 'ong klu len khye'u bu mo sogs//gzugs bzang snyan ngagayid gzhungs gos rgyan can//yid 'ong skye bo kun gyis bla ma mchod//ri ngosa'agying ba'i dung seng khyu mchog dang //ri sul rgyu ba'i kriṣ+ṭha e n+ya sogs/khrilargyas mdangs bkrag nges pa'i gom stabs can//yid 'ong ri dwags tshogasakyis bla ma mchod//nags rir snyan sgrogs ri skeg khu byug dang //sa gzhi pho rdergyan gyur ba6da dang khrung khrung sogs//skad snyan skru sdug mdzes pa'i gar stabasacan//yid 'ong bya tshogs kun gyis bla ma mchod//mdor na snod kyis phyogasayid 'ong na//bcud kyi sems can mchod pa gang gnas pa//bdag posagazung dang ma gzung de dag kun//blo yis blangs nas chos rje bla ma lod//'khor 'das phun tshogs ji snyed kun//dam pa'i chos las byung bste//de'angakhyed las byung gyur pa//phan bde'i 'byung gnas khyed la bstod//rdzi lta ji snyed 99

kun mkhyen gyis//nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib spangs pas//rkang gnyis rnamasakyi mchog gyur pa//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyed la bstod/khyed thugs rtogasapa'i dam chos te//gsung gi rgyu mthun lung gi chos//rnam grol lho/ngogasamachog gyur pa//dam chos rin ched khyed la bstod//rang bzhin 'od gsalardemangon gyur zhing //gnyis 'dzin rtog pa las grol bas//bsod nams zhingarab mchog gyur pa//tshogs mchog gtso bo khyed la bstod//'dod pa'i 'chizab kun spangs nas//dri med bslab gsum brtul zhugs can//sdom brtson ngur smig 'dzin pa'i gtso/shwakya'i sras mchog khyed la bstod//stong nyid snying rje'i sems mchogo gis//gcig tu gzhan phan brtson pa can//rgyal sras/semasardedapa' rnams kyi yab//brtse ldan dpa' bo khyod la bstod//smin grol 'a8/larab sbyangs pas//rim gnyis rnal 'byore dbang phyug can//rig pa 'dzin pa kun gyi rje//rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khyod la bstod//da kho mchog ma rdzo dang sems can don bsgrub phyir//bgo namasalongs spyod bcas pa bdag gi lus//skyes mchog khyed kyi bran du legs phulanas//ji ltar bsgo ba'i don kun bsgrub bgyi'o//dri med bi rjer sa gzhi yangasapa la//gser dngul rtsig pa ba gam dra ba can//zin chen ka bas bteg/cingardekhyon yangs pa//yid 'ong pho brang gzhal med dam pas mchod//bla bre rgyalamatshan gdugs sogs steng nas mdzes//dar dpyangs lhab lhub yol ba'i logs nas brgyan/khri dang gdan sogs 'og nas brjid gyur pa zhi/phun tshogs nyer mkhe'i gzims cha kun gyis mchod//thar pa'i rgyal mtshan chos00

gos bur smrig dang / /srab 'jam yang ba'i pañtsa li ka dang / /rgyu bzang dri zhim ka shi'i ras la sogs/ /phun tshogs na bza' kun gyis bla ma mchod/ /rigasardelnga'i dbu rgyan dar gyi con pan dang / /mu tig do shal nor bu'i ga sha dang/ /rin chen 'phra bkod gser gyi gdu bu sogs/ /phun tshogs rgyan mchog kun gyis: bsod nams du ma'i dpal las grub pa'i rdzas/ /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang / /glang po rta mchog dmag mi rin chen te/ /rgyal srid rin chen kun gyis nye bar mkho ba'i 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rdzas/ /nags tshal ral gri khang bzang mal stan dang / /lha yi gos dang sbrul gyi pags pa lham/ /nye ba'i sna bdun kun gyis: skye dgu bde zhing dge bar byed pa'i rdzas/ dpal be'u'akhor lo pad+ma rgyal mtshan dang / /gdugs dang bum bzang dung dkar gser nya ste/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad kun gyis: mdor na 'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpagabasam shing / /ma rmos lo tog yid bzhin nor bu dang / /'chi med bdudarobargya'i zas la sogs/ /longs spyod phun tshogs kun gyis bla ma mchod/ /༈ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pas/ /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi khasapa'i/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog brnyes pa/ /skyabs mchog khyed la phyag 'tshal/bstod/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu rdzogs shing / /nyer bzhi'i rtsa rlung dbang 'dusapas/ /yan lag bcu gnyis rnam 'gags pas/ /sa bcu'i mthar the'e / khyong labastod/ /yod min med min gnyis ka min/ /gnyis ka min pa'ang ma yin pa/ /rnam dag zag med chos kyi dbyings/ /spros bral chos sku khyed la bstod/ /mtshan dang dpe byas dpal 'bar bas/ /dag pa'i zhing gi gdul bya la/ /rtag par—201—

'i mchog chos ston pa//bde r+pā longs sku khyed la gas//shelabya' bsams ci'i/ pa ltar//sangs rgyas rnam 'phru/la dpag med sdo////'gra kun rdo/ rdebades mdzad pa//thabs rtsa ri/sa spru'/ // khyed la bstad//gzugs— rnam phral sna tshogs kyang //dā ya rang ba rmyur med pa//spu sto bral zung 'a she/she bo 'a sku khyed la bstod//rnam dzi she gnas sdir zhang //nyan mangs sgrab pa kun spangs tshe so ri//bzhi༈las/yangasagrol ba 'a//ye shes lnga bdag khyed la bstod//so so ga ba 'a' thugs/mtshan rdebs//stobs bcus bdud kyi dpung bcom nas//mi 'jigs bzhi yis cho se/ge 7rde de 7rde lta bya/ ra tsho de7rde ra tsho sku pe lo de/stan pa/༵/na tan mnga' bdag da 'a bstad//spyad ༷ rtags ༷ sadang //'phra/na las gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'//sangs rgyas yan tan bca brgyad can//mtshungs med sa rnyi khyed la rdzi che//ces pas phyi'i mchoX bstod kau la/rab 'khya/mas phyogs bcu' 'ag rten snyed na/'a dog dbyabs kya gzugasamachog zhes 'os rdzodang//rab mdzes skyes ra kya ras pa ril ra ra pa ka//mgon po sgrab med rdo rje' 'a/ ku zims ma she she rwa ga rwa rdo rdzo pa kā tshagu na lji dza āX'aX/rab 'byams zan dang ma shen sgra sgrib me mchad rdeX༅ge ge//rab mas sgra ya lha mor blos sprul nas//sa spyar ba'i dri mchog ji / sgro tha snyanala'abul//sa dri phri ma rab 'byams lhan skyes sbyar hūṃ/ dra mchog mu sde ge kun//rab mdzes ya lha mor blos sprul nas//mgon po ba med rdo rje' shangasalalpol//badz+ra ga rnye rab bzhes mi dod dod dge ge sde' bza' bca' bco ba'i ro mchon mchod po spri spras med rdo 'os kun//rab mdzes ro ya lha mor /sa sprul nas//mgon po —spras kho rdo

rje'i ljags la 'bul/ /ra sa kā ma: rab 'byams: sems can sems/can min pa'i reg mchog kun/ /rab mdzes rig bya'i lha mor blos sprul nas/ /mgon po sgrib med rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ sparnye kā ma: zag med bdebs myosabyed ma da na/ /stobs skyed go ku la sogs bā la dang / /bcud ldan bi ra shu sogs 'chi med ster/ /gsang ba'i dam rdzas kun gyis bla ma mchod/ gu phya byu dza: phyag rgya bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor ba las/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur lhan skyesabade ba'i ro/ /zag med phung khams skye mched ba rtas byed pa'i/ /mo chogatugasang ba'i mchod pa chen pos mchod/ /a nu ra lto pū dza ā hu/ /༈ bde dang stong pa dbyer med pas/ /thabs shes zung du 'as/pa'i dngos/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyed phyaga'atshal/ khyed sku'i phung po rigs lnga ste/ /'byung ba yum lnga'i lha mo dang / khunga'ajug lhan skyes rdo rje'i sku/ /'gro ba'i dang la mgon khyed phyag 'tshal/ tabangapo rnams ni sems dpa' ste/ /yul drug sems ma'i tshogs rnams dang / khunga'ajug lhan skyes rdo rje'i sku/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon: yan lag rnams ni khro rgyal te/ /bya ba rnam bcu'i khro mo dang / /zung 'jug: 'gro ba'i khyed skrab khams rnams dpa' bo ste/ /rtsa gnas dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams dang / /zunga'ajug 'gro ba'i rtsa ba'i rlung rnams yab lnga ste/ /'byung ba lnga yi yum rnam sadang / /zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i gsung / /'gro ba'i khyed thugs ye shesarang bzhin te/ /snang yul chos kyi dbyings rnams dang / /zung 'jug lhan skyes rdo rje'i thugs/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon khyed la bstod/ /—203—

༈yid 'phrog rme sno dpes spras pa'i 'jo sgeg can//sku mdon sngon mopi waX sgra sgrogs ma//mdzes ma rang 'dra du ma'i tshogs bcas pa'i//yid thongamachod pa dam pas dges par mchod//oṃ bī ni badz+re ni āXhuX/yid 'phrog‘ri yi ri yirimatshan sku mdog ser mo glang bu' sgra sgrogs ma//mdzes ma yad 'ong waX se badz+re ni/sngid dzaX/ ༵ mdog sngon mo rdza rnga'i sgra sgrogs ma//mdzes ma yid 'ong mu rdza badz+re na/ da 'phro/ skuXsdog dmar mo rnga zlum sgra sgrogs ma/mdzes ma sgro yid 'ong mṛ taX badz+re/yad 'phrog sku mdon dmar mo bzhad pa'i phyag rgya mas//ru ma yid 'ong ha gya mu ge ni yid 'phrog / mdog sngon mo 'gyang ba 'a phyag rgya ma//mdzes ma yad 'ong lu phya badzi /yid 'phrog sku mdog ljang gu snyan pa'i glu len ma//mdzes ma yid 'ong girti badz+re ni 'anaX yid kres sku ni yi ser mo mdzes pa'i gar sgyur ma//mdzes ma yad 'ong mṛ ta badz+re /yad 'phrog sku mo don dkar mo tshe tonasnod 'dzin ma//mdzes ma yid 'ong badz+ra stso//yid wog sku gi dag sngon mo bdug spos snod 'dzin ma//mdzes ma yid 'ong badz+rad+ku pe yid 'phrog sku mdog dmar mo snang gsal legs 'dzin ma//mdzes ma ying 'ong ā loka yid 'phrog sku mdog ljang khu dri chab snod 'dzin ma//mdzis ma yid 'ong oX badz+ra ga rnye pū dza āXkhruX /bde gshe/gas snying po'i sa gzhi legs bstarabar//byang chub sems gnyis dri med yon chab gtams//dkar po dge bcu'i me tog sil mar bkram//sdom gsum rnam dag spos sprin bstibs pasamachod//spyan dang mngon shes rin tshe/ rdon me dngar//tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi

dri mchog kun nas 'khyil/ /snyoms 'jug rnam dgu'i ro brgya'i zhal zasaskrungs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sil snyan bsgrags pas mchod/ /thar pa'i ritshaganyis 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor te/ /byang phyogs so bdun ri gling rab mdzesashing / /stong nyid snying rje'i nyi zla cher gsal ba/ /tshogs gnyis khor yug kun nas bskor bas mchod/ /tshe la dbang bcu rin chen gter phye zhing/ /la mo lnga sabacu'i ma rmos lo tog rgyas/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i dpag bsam stong r+ṣa 'khrigs/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yi 'dod 'jo'i ba mos mchod/ /gzungs spobasamatshan dpe'i gos rgyan lhab lhub dpyangs/ /zag med phung po'i 'dod yon sna lnga bkram/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun rgyal srid rin chen mchog /rnam thar brgyad kyi bkra shis rdzas kyis mchod/ /sku bzhi'i tog ldan stobs bcu'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /mi 'jigs bzhi yi rin chen gdugs dkar 'khyil/ /ma 'dres bcobargyad sna tshogs ba dan 'phyar/ /zad par zil gnon rnga yab g.yo bas mchod//rim gnyis gsang sngags dpal gyis rab brjid pa'i/ /dga' ba bcu drugadapa' bo gar byed cing/ /bde stong rnam 'gyur du ma rab ldan pa zhi /stong nyid bcu drug rig ma mdzes pas mchod/ /grub chen brgyad kyi rgyan gyis rab brgyan zhing / /dbang phyug brgyad kyi dpal la dbang 'byor ba/ /'phrin las bzhi yi 'khor bzang gis bskor ba'i/ /mchog gi dngos grub 'bor los bsgyur bsamachod/ /gzhan yang theg gsum gzhi lam 'bras bu yi/ /spangs rtogs/yon tan ji snyed de dag kun/ /dad 'dun blo yis blangs shing sprul byas nas/ /chosakyi rgyal po bla ma mdza par bgyi'o/ /—205—

༈ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med/ kha dang rus pa khrag kyang med/ /namamakha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar/ khyed kyi sku ni ston mdzad 'dud/ /skul bsnyun med mi gtsang med/ /bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang / khyed ni 'ejig rten rjes 'jug phyir/ /'jig rten bya ba ston mdzad 'dud/ /chu zla bzhin du gzung du med/ /cho se rnams gang la'ang gnas pa med/ /nga rgyal med cing miganas pa/ /dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshe/gas dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims/ /spyod lam dag ni thams cad du/ /rtag par mnyam lte par 'jag gyurapa'i/ /dmigs med: sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /rdzu 'phrul tshel rnama'aphrul zhing / /sna chogs min la snyoms 'jug pa'i/ /dmigs med: khams/gsum las ni rnam grol zhing / /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur la/ /'o dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa'i/ /dmigs med: phung po rnams dang khams rnamasadang / /skye mched rnams la mi brten zhing / /phyin ci log las rnam grolaba'i//dmigs rnam rtog med cing kun rtog med/ /thugs ni rab tu mi dzinasal/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ /dmigs: ji ltar na tshamakha' gnasamed cing / /spros med gos pa med pa ltar/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugasamanga' ba/ /dmigs med khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas nang gi mtsho / da kres rnams byas la/ 'gro ba chu yi zla ba bzhin du lta ba dang / /thos pa brag chadang ni mtshungs par yang dag 'ju/ga /sems kyang mya ngan smig sgyu lta bur blta bya zhing//'ji/ ltar bza' dang btung ba dag ni nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /dri ni nam mkhe'i sdimetog mtshungs par mnam pa dang / /yid ni nyi ma zla ba lta bur khyab pa nyid/ /—206—

yang dag gnas pa bde yang ri bo mchog dang mtshungs pa yin/ /gzhon nu ma yi rmi lam ji bzhin rmi bar bya/ /tha snyad dag ni skyu ma mig 'phrul lta bur brjod/ /'di ltar ji bzhin lhan skyes bde 'byung de bzhin te/ srid pa'i rang bzhin bralab bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs/ /rtag tu 'char ba bde legs lam mchog/dag gis mchong / / /༈ zab zhi spros dang bral ba gnyug ma'i don/ /snang dang stong pa gnyisadang gnyis min la/ /e ma ho 'di snyam bral ba'i lnga ba can/ /bde chen lhan skyes rol ba khyed la 'dud/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /bde stong 'dzin pa med pa bde ba'i nyams/ /e ma ho rtsol bral lhug pa'i sgom pa can/ /bde chen lhan skyes: spang blang byar med rang bzhin 'od gsal la/ /gzung 'dzin glo bur dri ma rnam dag pa/ /e ma ho rang bzhin lhun grub 'bras bu can/ /bde chen lhan skyes rol ba khyed la 'dud/ /o sde kho ra nyid kyi tshad dzang byas la/ / ༈ bla ma mgo dang phyag 'os thams cad la/ /zhing rdu5grangs dang mnyam pa'i lus bsad nas/ /yon tan brjod pa'i ngag gis bstod byed cing / /lhag bsam gyus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdas/ gi lus dang longs spyod dge ba sogs/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal 'byor kun/ /phyi nangamachod sprin rgya mtshor blos sprul nas/ /mchod 'os dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogasala'abul/ /thog med dus nas nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /sgo gsum sgo nasarang bzhin bcas pa'i sdig /bgyis dang bgyid stsal yi rang brgyas pa kun/ /gnong 'gyod sdom pa'i sems kyis mthol zhing bshags/ /skyes mchog sras—207—

dang bcas pa'i rnam thar dang / /gzhan yang 'gro kun sgo gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /byas dang byed 'gyur da lta mdzad rnams la/ /rab tu dga' pa'i yid kyis yi rang ngo / /'gro kun phan zhing dge bar bgyid pa'i slad/ /chos kyi rgyalapo sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /gang la gang 'dul zab dang rgya tshe ba'i/ /chos/kyi 'khor lo rgyun du bskor du gsol/ /chos kyi sku la skye 'jig mi mang sna yang/ /gzugs sku zhing gzhan don la mi gshegs par/ /mgon med snyigs me'i 'gro la rjes brtse bas/ /mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par 'tshal/ /'gro kun bla med byang chub thob don du/ /skyabs mchog khyed la rtag par skyabs mo〉zhing / /thun mong khyad par dam tshig sdom pa rnams/ /deng nas blangs te tshulābazhin bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /bdag gi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /'gro kun srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol te/ /dpal ldan blam mchogagis rjes bzung nas/ /kun mkhyen mchog gi dngos grub myur thob shog ces pas yan lag gron pa dang sdom gzung byas la/ yid la 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i zin po ske /mgon po khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ /phan bde'i 'gyung gnas thub bstan dam pa'i chos/ /thos bsam sgrub pas rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /thar pa'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin bzhes gnyen rnams/ /sku la bsnyun med 'phrin lasarab rgyas pa'i/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i bde la'agod par mdzad du gsol/ /dam chos sgrub la brtson pa thams cad kyig /zab lam bla ma'i mos gus mthar phyin nas/ /spangs rtogs mthar son bla mo'i sa thob ste/ /gzhan phan tshad med 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de mthob kyi —208—

gnas skabs thams cad du'ang //bla ma mchog gis rtag tu rjes 'dzin zhing//ra tsho ra tsho tre / ge mi ge ri hwa ri yirilus dang langs skyud da bas mnyas byas ta//ba/mi shes 1 rlabs 'jugardepar mdzad du ma zig/rde/ces ku rib ba btab la/'i tsho/ sa gang bgyi tha pa dbangagyur pas// 'a sam ga nyes spong sa rnams /gang 'a//'a she khyed kyi she sngar spyogs chog khyed ni//sngis sa she rang bzhan ngo she sa par gsal/mi/skyabs mchag da na 'gra ba 'a ka gi lu tha mdzad//chaX kya sku la 'gyur ba sheX 'a //gzugs sku she lus la wo bskyad nas//brtse rjo wo pas dzi gyas mu sbyi gsal//lko'i nga tha'i yong gras tshe ba'i rdobastim mo//bdag blo ༵dro/das sto la//dzo da mchod pa gaXng ba'am rab tu phye//spyo 'a : // rdaX na brtse bas bzad par gsal//dge bas 'gra kun bla med rjes 'an shag/de ltar bla ma sgrub pa'i tshul 'di ni dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lo tsābablo gros dpal gyis dad pas kun nas blangs te sbyar ba'o//zhus dag/ shu r+ghaṃ//༄༅//bla ma ma rdzo pa bde skyegs rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs sa//na mo gu ru ༷rnya bo dhi sa te khyuXbla ma mar pa bde bzhi rabs go byagablam la phyag 'tshal la//sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo dzi 'a nga ba //rtsa ༷sherdetsam zhi//rdol nas//skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla sung thugs kyi thabs//thun mang mdar bsdusatsam bra bar bya//gnas khang bzang por / ༷sung thugs rten la sogs pa bzhugs su

gsol te/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ oX badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā sā bhā wa kyo3haX/ gnas khang bhāX las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal med khang brtsegs mtshan nyid thams ced yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oX las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing gyo tsheb rnams kyi nang du/ huX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/zhabs bsil/ tshe tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chang/ zhal zas/jol mol sogs pa ma ce de rdzas bzang zhing dge ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ tseXṭa badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ tseX( badz+ra ngu yiXsnye swāhā/ myoX(badz+ra pu zhe āXhuX/ tseX( badz+ra dhu pe āXhuX/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ ni we te/ shasta āXhuX/ zhes rol mo byin dab gde nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ de nas/ oX swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar huX yig las byung ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ zlaX las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal/med khang rgyan dang bkod pa phu| sum tshogs pa/ de'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/ sna tshogs pa khru dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan/ de'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje langasku mdog in+d+ra hi 'a ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od can/ phyag gnyis kyis rdorje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gisabartan par bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis bgyon pa/mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/rang snang bi shes rab mchog gi bde bas thugs dgyes pa/ 'od dang 'od zer—210—

dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mdzad pa 'phrin las phyogs bcu dus gsum du khyab pa/ do byengs dngaye shes gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ skra zhi mtha' skor du 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gtso bor gyur pa'i yi dam dkyil snyen ra gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang gotshogs dang bcas pa/ 'og gi cha la mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogasadang bcas pa/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi mchod pa'i bkod pas nye b.rabargyan pa dang bcas te bzhugs par gyur/ rnam dag sku ni skyon bral zhabru wab med/ /phun tsho gis gsung dbyangs shes bya ma lus khyab/ /zab dang gyo che'i de nyid mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /rdo rje gsum dngos dpal lngan bla mar 'dud/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa gtan nas spangs/ /dag pa gnyis ldan yon tan thams cad rdzogs/ /rang gzhan don gyur sku gnyis mngon mdzad pa/ /'bora'adas ma lus sprul par mdzad la 'dud/ /g.yo med sems kyis bsten na skad cig la/ /byin gyis brlabs pas bla med byang chub bam/ /yang na 'o dod pa mchog dang thar pa yi/ /dam pa nges par spyin mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /lhan skyesazung 'jug srid gsum bde chen dngos/ /dmigs med thugs rjes khamasagasum 'gro kun sgrol/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan zad mi sla rma ri/ /chosadabyings rnam dag g.yo med khyod la 'dud/ /nyid kyi ye shes gcig gi rang snangalas/ /ma lus rgyal ba sras bcas sprin spro ba/ /bden pa gnyis kyi rnamatharachad mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor 'dud/ /gang go drin —211—

gyis bde chen nyid//skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang //bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku//rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud//bdag ni skyabs gnas gzhan kun bas//ba sbu'i khung bu gcig la yang //lhag par yang ni dad lags pa/stobs pasam yin rgyu dang bcas//sangs rgyas kun las tshes lhag par//rgyud da sna kun turgyal bas bsngags//mdo sogs kun tu mtshungs par gsungs//rgyal bsanan tan bstod la 'dud//phyogs bcu'i 'dren pa sras bcas kyis//byangasems rdo rje bzhin du blta//thams cad nyin re dus bzhi sa/phyag la nya/mchong/ nas 'di skad du//bdag cag de bzhin gshegs kun gyi//pha ma ston pa khyod ces sgrog/ston pa rdo rje 'dzin khyod la//skyob par bcas pas phyag4phro/lo//grangs med bskal par rgyal rnams la//rin chen zhing mchog phul ba bas/khyod kyi sku la til mar gyi//thigs pas mchod na'ang bsod namasamachog/ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyi//ye shes ma lus khyod las byung//mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni//rje btsun khyod la mchod cing 'dud//rdorje gsum gyi dngos grub tshogs//nyid kyi sku gsung thugs la gnag khyod ni gangala'ang mi gnas te//mkha' mnyam 'od gsal rmad byung che//rtsod pa'i dusa'adir rdo rje sems//dngos su mthong ba'i skal med pas//slob dpon gzugs kyis sgrub rnams la//brtse bas mchod pa len la 'dud//rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor ye shes lnga//'gro ba 'dul phyir phung po lnga//tshad med lha mobardzo dkyil 'bor//ཿnga bzhir ston pa ya mawo rmad//spyan sogs yang ni sems dpa' brgyad//tshig sogs yang dag khro bo bcu//gzugs sogs yang

ni rdo rje ma//ye shes sku la bdag phyag 'tshal//skye 'chi can gyi sku'o zhog/log par bzung ba gnong zhing 'gyod//de bas bsam pa thag pas bshags//bdag kyang khyed ltar mngon gyur cig/byang chub phyogs chos sum cu 'dun//bcom ldan sku yi cha shas lags//cod pan rigs lnga ba sbu rnams//dgra bcom lags te de bas 'dud//'jig rten lha rnams khyod kyi gdan/khrid gsum bla ma khyod nyid lags/khyod ni dkon mchog gsum lags shing//zin chen gsum gyi byed por gsungs//g.yo rgyu tshig tsam ma yin par//deng nasabyang chub snying po'i bar//bsam pa thag pas skyabs su mchi//lhag par dad pas phyag 'tshal lo//dmangs rigs nyis stong bram ze gcig dang mnyam//de bzhon bram ze dge slong rdul med dang //ye shes ldan rnams stong phrag gnyisaganyis su//bsgres pa'ang slob dpon gcig dang zhing mnyam par//gsungasardephyir mgon po rdo rje slob dpon khyod//kho gi rab mchog phul du dbyung ra pas//rgyal khyod mnyes par byas na kun mkhyen mchog/ye shes bla med thob par yang yang gsungs//slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa' mchod pa des//bsod nams kun byas dka' thub thams cad bsten//sdig 'joms sdug bsngal zhi mdzad srid pa yi//rgya mtsho'i 'jings las sgrol mdzad la phyag 'tshal/khyod larje mthun gus pas yon phul na//rims sogs gnod pa mi 'byung phyogs bstoyi//rgyal ba kun la phul bar 'gyur bas na//dngos grub mchog ni nges parathob par gsungs//bdag gi dus gsum dge ba lus longs spyod//yongasasu 5 bzung ba med pa'i mchod rdzas dang //smon lam sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzen gosbiri

gyis/ /rab bsgrubs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ khyod la brnyas parabyed pa kun/ /rgyal po me dang dug dang rims/ /log 'dren rnams kyis bsad nas kyang / /rtag tu dmyal bar 'tshed par gsungs/ khyod la brnyas shing smad na ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la brnyas shing smad/ /gzims cha stan dang lha mdangagadugs/ /'gom shing co 'dri byed pa ni/ /don ring dpal nyams nad kyisathebs/ /sku yi grib ma la 'gom pa/ /mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs/de 'dra bgyis gang so sor bshags/ /snying nas slob dpon smod pa ni/ /rmi lam du yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /slob dpon yon tan gzung bya yi/ /skyon ni nam yangam yin no/ /yon tan bzung na dngos grub ste/ /skyon brjod pa las de gros grub nyams/ /bdag gi sgo gsum bag med pas/ /nyes par bgyis kun mthol lobashags/ sdu zhe kyi ba sbu nyag re yi/ /bsod nams la yang dus gsum gyi/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las thams cad kyi/ /char yang bsgrun par mi nus pag /nyid dang nyid kyi rjes gzung dang / /nying/ la mchod dang phyag 'tshal sogs/ /bsod nams mi zad byed pa la/ /lhag par dang bas yi rang ngo / / bskal pa bye bar mdo rgyud la/ /thos bsam sgom la rab sbyangs kyang / /bla ma'i man ngag med pa yis/ /byin rlabs rim pa mi rnyed gsungs/ /bla ma'i lung thob de ngos grub mchog /'bad med thob par 'gyur bas na/ /bdag sogs 'ching ba las grol phyir/ /zab mo'i 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'od gsal lhan skyes bde ba che/ /thams cad stong pa bla ma yis/ /drin gyis gsal bar 'gyur bas na/ /bdag byin brlabs pa ma rnyed na/ /ngal ba 'bras med de bzhin du/ /blams—214ske sna popo

'phongs pa sngags dang ni//sbo ri rgya rnyed par mi ྅ri geng bas//mya ha mi 'da' bdag 'a 'debs//mtho ris gnas su lha yid ba~X /'a/sgyus lam par ṭa ziX/bsgyur gā nyad/she/ ge ge' gdengs can bdag poX tshul// ni gtsang maXbyed she/skya baX bla ma pha ma dzon//she kau mgan dung byed pa dang //skyan ra khe yan tan kun sngi gnas//rdu she rnal stir ho labod//'i she ye shes brtan ༷/ya can//'gra ༷ med par a smad kyi pa/skye bu' khyu mchag/ thub dbang pa//dbul dang mgan med thams/cad rde/skyob pa yid bzhin nor bu la//mi zad 'khor ra bas 'jigs pa bdag/waṃ phyi rta snye/ hūṃ)'u ngeb/sde/rderderderdeye du ye'//sgo zo tshi dad 'a khyod bar+sā no//rdo rje shelaslab dpan ba//nga ba na//dzo rna 'a gya rtsa bar yang yang gsungs/ri/gsardes she pa mchod mi rigs ngon me tha//mar dang bral na 'bras med kya dzi/ḍā/tang bas 'igs pa tshi med de lta bur//slob dpon she zo.irting dan 'grub//de phyar 'a ga kun las khyad par du//rtsa ri dpan dmarna 'bad nas bzung rdar 'i//dus dang ye skaX// 'a na thams ngo du//dpal ldan mi ma' won las bsgrub par ye khyod nyi/mnyedagyesapa de sgrub na// mnyes byed pa thams cad spang bar shag khyad dgyesadros gyur na bdug ༵ga rnams//sa chub mchog thob dzos kyaX ye pa nyad//ma bye pa chis mnyes na tshe 'ad la//byang chub thab kyang dan/ snye/rde'aga' ma (5sa//dang ri dus dro ge gi dge ba ma lus pa//gcanatu—sngus pa' stobs las tshe 'ad la//mchog/ dngos grub dam pa mngon 'gyu/ra

zhing / /rtag tu bla ma mnyes shing mchod byed shog /bdag cag 'khore ba'i bsto rar chud rnams la/ /'dren pa khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /mo se gus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rjes g.yel ba med par gzigs su gsol/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku dang bdag go lus/ /dbyeramed rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis slobs/ /dpal ldan bla ma (〈rdza〉mas )ci gsung bsgrub pa dang / /gsung ngag dbyer med rdo rje'i gsung thob shog /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang / /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis slobs/ /bde stong zung 'jug stong nyid snying rje'i ngang / /yos shes dbyeramed bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mchog /skye med 'od gsal mngon sum mthongazhing rtogs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos khyod dang mtshungs par shog /bla masangs rgyasadangos su mthong ba dang / /zhi lhag dbyer med ting 'dzin rab 'byams can/ /sgo gsum spyod pa rnam dag dri med kyis/ /gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i gnas lasagrol bar shog /bsam yas brjod bral rlabs chen thabs mchog dpag med pas/ /da lta nyid du mchog gi dngos grub sku bzhi'i bdag /nam mkha'i mthar thug 'gro rnams theg mchog la bkod nas/ /myur du phan bde'i zhing kun khyab par byin gyis rlobs/ spyo dang / mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang/ /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab rgyas shing / /mchod yon sna tshogs ca du bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla ma mchod/ /rma gu rubadhabo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaX pra titsā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī huX/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ sna nga —216—

gsal/dri mchog//zhal zas/sil snyan phal chen ri/sogs brjod/ar+ghaX gyi ḍā tu/smi5༷/pu zhe/dhu pe/ā lo ke/ga rnye/ne wi te/shu sta rnams bas nas thog mtha'i sngags gong bzhi/srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos//mi bskyod rdo rje'i skul gsol//miyi mi skye rdi sterdephyed dad pas bdag 'bul na//bdag kyang rdo rje' sku thob shog/gu ru bud+dhābo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra wasta ye āXhūX swāhā/mgon khyod bkres skyem mi mnga' rnying //'o thug bur khu bdud rtsi'i chu/rdo/za' sa bca' ba gre po/kha dog — dang ro ldan pa//thams cad sbyar ba 'a bsgo(sa kya mchog/kun bzangabade wo bgo su gsol//ge sgor lo nor bu btsun mo dam pa dang//glo po glang po rta mchog dmag dpon te//rgyal srid rin chen sna ba/rden dpag med kyang //mngon par sprul nas bla ma mchog/ la 'bul//ral pags pa skyed tshal khang khyim dang //gzims cha gos dang mchil lham rin po che//blatshadakyil 'khol ra lha tsho gos bcas la 'bul//bzhes nas bdag la byin gyisabarlab tu gsol//rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul//gzug༅sgradriro reg bya'i bde ster ma//me long pi' wang spos khang bza' bco snod//wophran bzang dang pad+ma bhañdza nāX//cang te' sgra sgrog kha ṭāX la brten ma//'asngoser dang dmar dang ljang ba 'a gzugs//gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dro ldan bcud ldan ma//bde ldan lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma//nam mkha' rdegang na gī ma lha tshogs ma sgo//bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs gsawam//pa waX glang bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can//rgod dang sgeg dang glu len bro gar mkhan//me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog ma//gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos 'byung

ma/ /bcu drug dga' ma'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma/ /rdo rje rig tshad ga' bsarol ba 'di/ /he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes ma sgo/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang / /reg na bde ba lha yi gos/ /mkha' lding khyu mchog rma bya dang/ glang po rta sogs theg pa'i mchog /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ma rmosa'akhrungs nga 'i lo tog dang / /dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu'i mchog/buwabazang nam rma kha' gang bas mchod/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba kun yang 'bul/ /gser dngul mu tig biḍar+ya/ /rin chen zhingarnams bkang nas 'bul/ /dbang sngon rdo rje pad+ma dmar/ /margad byu ru dzam bu'i gser/ /zla shel rin chen bdun gyi ri/ /zhing gi rdul snyed dbul bar bgyi/ /ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ /dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /tshe tog ko rtse kar dang/ /mā li ka dang yu thi ka /me tog kā ra lī ra yang / /bsam gtan stobs kyis khyed la 'bul/ /mi 'jigs seng ge rin chen khri/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mchog dang / /rna rgyan dang ni gdu bu'am/ /mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang / /gser lasabyas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /dbu rgyan dar dpyangs do shal bcas/ /rgyawamatshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang nag dang ser skya dang/ /de bzhin kho/sa ni sna tshogs dang / /me tog 'phreng ba du ma dang / /bla bre dag dngadaradapyangs pa'i/ /mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas mchod par bya/ /gser ni brgya stong du ma dang / /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dpa/ /glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang / /chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ /ga pho ༅ mo—218—

sring mo dang / /blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul b.rabagyi/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso/ /nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing / /bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga/ ṣe/sa rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ ā hu/ thabs shes lhan cig sbyor ba las/ /rang bzhin snang ba yongs dag pa'i/ /zhu bdes khams/gsum kun khyab pa/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi/ /bar 'dir bla ma spyidagasgos kyi gsol 'debs rnams dang / brtan bzhugs la sogs pa'i rim pa ci shes bya'o/ /de bzhin du rgyun bshags dang / yan lag bdun pa sogs gang 'grub bya'o/ /bla ma'i skra/las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas/ /bdag lus gang bas bum pa'i dbang bskurathob/ /byang chub sems rgyun mkha' sgo'i lam nas thim/ /bdud rtsi myangs/pasagasang ba'i dbang bskur thob/ /sku las rig ma spros te bdag la 'khyud/ /bde ba skyes pas sher dbang thob par bsam/ /bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim /dbyer med gyur pas bzhi pa thob par bsam/ /bsam med ngang du cung zad klod de bzhag /ma bcos so ma rang shar lhan ne ba/ /lhun grub 'bad rtsol med pa'i ngang du btang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dang bdag gi lus/ /dbyer med rdorje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ldan bla ma ci gsung bsgrub pa dang / /gsung ngag dbyer med gsung gi rdo rjer shog /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dang / /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma dgos pa'i bya ba kun bsgrubs nas/ /mdzad pa 'phrin las mtshungs par byin gyis phros//—219—

mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang //lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin //po/tugasangasngags rgyal po bzla//yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog/de nas tshos mi sgo byad byin gyis brlabs shing tshogs kyi cho ga ni gzhung bzhin bya'o//yi ge brgya pas nyams chagasabaskang zhing /ye dharmas brtan bzhugs bya'o//mjug tu bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par byas te/de ltar yang dang yang du bla ma mchod pa ni/rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod par 'gyur ba'i phyir/bsod nams kyi phung po tshes cher 'phel ba yin no//bla ma rdo rje 'chang wo mnyes byed was//mdo tsam nye bar bkod pa gang yin 'di//tshogs gnyis rgya cher spel ba'i thabs mchog ske khrid zhi'i dpal 'byor mchog tu rgyas byed yin// //zhes bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bde legs tha rgyas zhes bya ba 'di/sa skyong gzhon nu 'gur chen zhes bya bas nye bar bskul te/tā ra nā pos nye bar sbyar ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig gcig zhus/mas lo//༄༅༅//sku skyes bcu bzhi'i bkra shis bzhugs/'i na sgo gu sa bkra shis gang zhig dpal ldan spyod pa'i rdo rje zhes//'dzam glang 'ad na ma sbas gsal bar yongs grags pa//rnal 'byoja dbang phyug/nagapo spyod pa'i bkra shis gang //bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol//ra snye mu bha la nges sa spyod pa shugs lwa/nga skyong //rong zom lo smo sgra bsgyur mkhas pa' phul du phyan//'bab rom dar ma phyag rgya che lasamagayos la//bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogaso stsole//a wa dhū tī ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la ༷zhugs//zhang ston 'khrul zhig dgra

bgegs tshar gcod drag las bsgrub//gnyos pan ras chen sna tshogs rten 'brel mig 'phrul can//bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol//sa sgo bha dra lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol//'jam dbyangs chosarje gzhung brgya'i chos kyi zha bor lo bskor//chos kyi nyin byed gnas lnga zin pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta//bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol//'jamamagon bla ma grub pa'i dpa' bo'i mtshan 'chang ba//dpal ldan kun tu dga' ba rang grol mchog gi rje//blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde zhes 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gtso//bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol//chos bzhin spyod pa rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs nas//mtha' dag 'gro la chos kyi dga' ston spel byed pa//lnga mtshar mdzad pas sa skyong kun gyis grub par bsngags//bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol//'jam dbyangasagazhon nu mkhas kun dga' bar byed pa gang //snying po'i don ston bkra shisachos sgo 'byed pa'i phul//thar pa'i rgyal mawo dpal yon bzang po stsolamakhas pa//bden pa des kyang gnas 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs stsol// //ma ṅga la//

༄khya /bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bzhugs so/ /na mo gu sa tshogs mchod ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyas/stong pa'i ngang las tshogs rdzas rnams kyi 'og tu yaX las rlung / raX las me'i dkyil 'khoragyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba kyi rnams nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i tshogs rdzas zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lkoX āXhuX ha hoXhiX gags/ na mothabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po/ rangabazhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabasakyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a tshu ta ga na tsakra pañtsa 'a hi na mo sogs/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa lo zhe las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched lcam rdo rje sbun grogs rnams kyi zhal du pañtsami 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang / /mos gus gzhom med pho brang du/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje/ /rnam 'phrul mkha' dilasprin bzhin 'thibs/ /'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /gnas khanga'adi la byin phob la/ /tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnawa—222—

wor 'jig cag ༵//ma rdzo ye na moX ngos grub dzi//stugaX kaukyims she pa da//dpaX ba ge de ge ge zhe ge ge la tshod dod dod dod niXtshe ༵rdes//'a yo lashe pa migayo sngi ༷sa//'dad 'a 'a rda rja 'ad dpag da she//rnam lnga༈rgasags/ khor lo sdom pa'i bde skyed yum rdo/no/dag ༷ bad stad ༷ni' dzhai/da gnas//lhor la sdam ༷ bdang du sa//rda byo 'a ma mkha' hūṃ/dho //she//rnam 'phrul sogs/dzo la spyad ༷kla ༷ga 'a mchag/nya shu rtsa ba sherdeshe//sgrub la das grub mgo dang tshog//gnas gsum /pa' ba ba ྅ rgo ye /wo/zi~Xkhrul gos/bdud bge kun ྅la she laXb /dur khrad 'i ye ye brgyad ༷sa//bags 'jams 'dad dan sda/ bsgrub pa//sher sbying srung snra 'a dzos kyang /rnam 'tsho/sgo snya/sa gyi co dam mkha' 'gra' gas//gas kya cad pan ldems se ldem/di/ṭa'u be khu go glu ༵da/rgyana~Xmang po she~Xlo//krum sde ro mang po a ye/glun gar byad khyugs preng ri/'bar chags 'bum she ra ra/bying ba rangasnang rjen ne ne//gtad med gas pa sal la la//brjad med dbyangs su thal/la la//bde ba r+pā po khril li li//byin gyis bas phyir bzhes su gsol//sa sa she she she shebagegs dang log 'dre bye phab la//sdib mchaXrde bdag la 'a gru~X /rdzo//bags dang lag ḍaki snrur chad sal//'kha/ra gsum gnyas su da para'adres//gu ru de ba ḍa dzñā na a be sha ya a rlu/de kau laX)kau gas khashagayas ༷ //rti mar g.yon du thogs te/rdo~Xrde~Xs/kya/'a~X'3masabazang par ltas//'du / sa pa rnams la da//bram khye dang sa tal pa

phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /a ho mahā su khaX/ bde gshegasachos la rin thang med /'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /a ho mahwa su khaX/de nasardzos phud 'bul ba ni/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang / oX gu ru tsakra saX bha ra bsgo gi ni bzhi bo dhi satwa ḍā ki ni mahā ka la ya sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs kyis 'buga.oṃ āXhūX ha hoXhiX h+pha/ oṃ badz+ra a ralbi ho/ dzaXspyiX baX hoX badz+ra ḍaki ni sam ya stuX/dra khyi ho/ lkoX kha kha ji hi sku hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa ga dh+wa ta preta pi shā tsa ur+sha rded a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki rgyu da ya/ i daX ba li gra : skye sa rmo ya rak+ta bh+yo/ mams sgo sirnyesme pra ya:skyo / ya thi baX/ ya thi giX/ bhañdza tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gha tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka rba yaX/ sa rlu khaX/ bi shudha / sa ha yi kā bha wan+ta hūXhūX phaṭa phaṭa grwa sma zhesardzo gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ mchod do/ / dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing/nas/ bde ba chen po mnyes gyur cig de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kha zas kyis chi/rjes/ tshogs lhag bsdus la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha hoXrnyiXlngo gsum dang / a kā ro zha gsum/ phyi rol sgo drung na gnas pa'i lwa/snang po le'u/ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga lta bar mi dbang ba rnams la sbyin no/ /rdo rje thegapa la gsang ba mchog gi sgor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig tshe urdetsi ni ba li ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ oṃ sum bha ni sogs dang / rdo rje'i glu sogs stse////ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas so/ / gcig zhus/ bkra shis par gyur cig /—224—

༄//bla ma'i rnal wor dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs/oṃ snya sti/tā ma'i rnal wor dngos rdza stigs pa'i lcags kyu kho bya ba/bla ma dam gshe zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/gi/yid ma yengs pas 'di rang gi don bsam par bya ste/chas/ rnams thams cad rang sems snang tsam//rangatsisems kyang rang ris sanga~Xzhes//thob meng tshe tha' 'adz+ra myongasashar yang //rang ga skad ga 'ad las g.yo ba med// shā n+ya twatswa na badz+ragabhā ba at+pa lko haX/rang sems dag pa'i snang ba rdzo min zhing //zhi rdze'i che she sprerdo de tres/lte gri nyi zla pho re sne steng rderdedrin ca su mu da khang pas mas//zib zing nga med sko dod gser gyi//dzo can / ye ze bla 'a dam pa mgyir//ga brjad dpag zhi gser spru pa'adra//'ad ra nyam ༷bum gi phyog tha dang ldan//'a la dgyes/pa zhal ras ༷dzu pa sa tsho hūṃ/ya//steng phyags la ༵rgyud paX bla zi rnam gakhyusnyul bkad pa da sa shes ye /spra/ ma~Xg tsho rnamasacad sprin 9 du//dzhai ruka dang rda rja da she// 'a tshags thamakha' tha ༷ / ngasacad na ltar 'i ngag/she/ngas chas byang smos phyags bcu' sheX' shespo'/tsho///la pa dgra bcam sa gzha dzi pa dang //mkha' 'gra ༵sa skyang ni bcathartsama' sa 'a kyang//bzhing na sgrub pa/ra dang rdzu 'phru/la dpag bcas/rde//bka' la nyan zhang gsung ban sgrub pas bzhugs//gang la gang 'du ste la sprulda/

pa pho nya'i tshogs//glog ltar 'byug cing bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin//sa dang bar snang ri klung med par khyab//thams cad sku ni bkrag mdangs 'od dngaldan//gsung ni theg chen dam pa'i chos sgra sgrogs//thugs ni 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang //mdzad pa 'phrin las ma nges cir yang ston//kun kyang rje btsun bla ma'i sprul pa ste//gzhan yang 'khor ra 'das snang ba ma lus pa//mtshan ldan bla ma'i ye shes cho 'phrul tsam//bdag gi lus dang longs spyod tsi mchisadang //dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ci yod dang //phyogs bcu'i zhing na bdag pos ma bzung ba'i//mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed mchis pa dang //dgra gnyen bar mas bsdus pa'i sems can ni//'gro drug nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs ji snyed dang //srid pa gsum gyi longs spyod gang mchis dang//bdagagi yid kyi sprul dang smon lam mthu//sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bcas//dus gsum phyogs bcur byung ba thams cad kyi//ye shes rangasnang las grub mchod pa'i tshogs//grangs med tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa//mchog tu brdzid bag chags pa'i tshul dang bcas//bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med pa//skye med cho se sku'i cho 'phrul tsam du bsgom//sangasargyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che//dam chas kun 'dus chos rje rin po rmu/dge 'dun kun 'dus 'dren mchog rin po che//bla ma kun 'dus gcig chokargyal po khyod//yi dam thams cad khyod kyi sku la tshang //mkha' 'gro cho rtse skyongathams cad pho nyar sprul//rdo rje 'chang chen khyod la gsol ba 'debs//mosapa'i bu la da lta byin gyis tsos//stug po bkod pa'i zhing du rdo rje 'a zang//6

drag po 'dul tshe he ru ka dpal sku/ /chags bral rnams la shākya thub par bstan/ /dka' thub can la drang srong tshul 'dzin zhing / /theg gsum lam du zhugs pa'i sems can la/ /byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos tshul du ston/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug 'dod lha dbang po dang / /dbang phyug la sogs lha yi gzugs su'ang ston/ kha cig tu ni rgyal srid spyod la dgyes/ /gzhan du rigapa'i brtul zhugs spyad pa spyod/ /la lar ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyanga' myong / /gang la gang 'dul sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems can kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin du/ khyod kyi bstan pa 'di yang bsam mi khyab/ /rdzi ltaramakha' la sprin dang 'ja' tshon sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs brnyan snang na yang / /nam mkha' las byung nam mkha'i ngo bo dang / /nam mkha'i ngang du thimapar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /spros bral ci yang ma yin chos kyi sku/ /'bad rtsol med kyang lhun grub 'phrin las can/ /gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa spyir bstan yang//rang rig rang gsal spros bral dbyings kyi ngang / /skye 'gag med cing 'gro 'ongaganas dang bral/ /don dam sku can khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtag tu gusapa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyod la skyabasasumachi/ /mchod pa thams cad dbyer med ngang du 'bul/ /rang bzhin med kyangasdig kun mthol lo bshags/ /'khor ‘sna das dge ba kun la rjes yi rang /grags stong brjod bral gsung la chad pa med/ /chos kyi sku la skye 'chi mi mnga' yang / /chos 'bor rgyun mi 'chad par bskor ba dang / /'gro ba'i don la rtagatubazhugs su gsol/ /thugs yid dbyer med don du bsngo bar bgyi/ /bla med —227—

byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyid//rje btsun nā la ba'i mgon po khyod nyid kyis//sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis slobs pa dang //dbang bzhi rdzogs par da lta bskur du gsol//lus la lhan skyes bde chen bskyed pa dang //nga gal rigasngags nus pa brtan pa dang //sems la 'od gsal ye shes 'char ba mā/mtshan ldan bla mas da lta byin gyis rlobs//bla ma'i dpral mgrin thugs kalteb las//'od zer byung nas bdag gog nas bzhin thim//sku gsung thugasardedang ye shes rdo rje yi//byin gyis brlabs shing dbang bzhi thob par gyur//slarayang bum pa'i chu yis bum dbang bskur//byang chub sems kyis gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhing //mnyam sbyor bde bas shes rab ye shes dang //won med phyag chen bzhi pa'i dbang yang bskur//re sa gzhan na med do cho so kyi rne/skyabs gnas gzhan na med do rin po che//chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med cing //'bral med gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs//bla ma byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu//rtsa 'khor bzhi po gang bas dbang bzhi thob//blaslarang sems dbyer med chos sku'i ngang //rtsa bral lhun grub chen po'i ngang du bzhag/ces pa 'di ni mchog tu gyur pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor te tshe gcig lus gcig lasangasargyas ster bar the tshom med do//rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la dpal bzang ldan du bris pa'o// bkra shis//8

༄༅//gdon 'grol gyi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//na mo gu sa 'dir gdon 'grol gyi cho ga shin tu bsdus pa la/sdom ni/dang po yo rma tshogs par byas//gnyis pa lha yi sgrub mchod yin//gsum pa gdon gyi bya ba dang//bzhi pa rjes kyi cho ga'o//bris sku'am maṇ+ḍal bshams nas ni//mchod gtor spun mas shing dkyil 'khor 'bri//bum pa bcas la klu gzugs bshams//klu gtor rtsi sman bum pa dang //glud gzugs gzugs 'gros sna tshogs bshams//mchod dang cha gsum gtor ma'o//gnyis pa bdag mdun bskyed pa dang //bum sgrub rdzas rnams byin rlabs dang //klu yi dkyil 'khor cho ga'o//gsum pa dgunamachod bkru byabs dang //mchod dang bsrung ba bya ba nyid//bsgrub bya la yang bkru sbyongs dag/gdon la mchod cing bsrung bar bya//gtor sogs btang nas shis brjod byed//rjes ni klulabazod gsol dang //gshegs gsol byin rlabs mdun bskyed mchod//dngos grub blangs te yig brgya bzla//bzod gsol gshegs gsol bdag bsrung dang /smon lam dang ni bkra shis bya//zhes pa'o//de la bgoms ni/seng ge sgra'i bris sku yod na bgram/med na maṇ+ḍal steng du tshosabuzug mas pa mañdzi la bkod//rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal byed srol yang yod/de'i mdun du mchod padangadakar gtor gcig bzhag de'i g.yas su bum pa spyi dang mthun par bca'/g.yon du rdul chogagyidakyil 'khor gru bzhi'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bgyod bya/gru bzhi mu khyud sprul gyi rang bzhin/phyogasabazhi'i dbus su mgo snol zhing /zur bshin mjug ma snol ba'i tshul du bya/de'i dbus su pad+ma'adab brgyad pad 'dab kyi phyi gru bzhi'i nang du chu ris 'bri/'dab ma brgyad la kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i tshom bu 'god//dkyil 'khor 'di ras rdoX ༷ byas kyang rung ste/de'i tshe 'dab ma la klu dgu

zhal phyag tu byas kyang legs/de'i steng du mañdzi la klu dgu'i rten gyi gtor ma bshams dgos te/zangs gshod ngam gtor gzhong gtsang ma'i nang du/gru bzhi bang rim gnyis brtsegs kyi steng du/grubazhi mkhar stabs rtse mo phyogs bzhin glang gi mgo re phyir bstan pa/dbus su glang gi mgo gyen du bstan par byed/'di chu bdag wa ru ṇa'i gzugs yin gsung /bang rim dang po'i phyogs mtshamasardebargyad la sbrul re re/bang rim 'og ma sbrul sbal lcong nya sogs srog chags gnyan dgu'i gzugs/'god/ras dmar po'i gdugs chung ngu zhin bang rim dang po'i rgyab kyi phyogs zhig tu 'god/de la srad bu dmar po zhig kyang btags/de'i mdun du'ang mchod pa rnams bskor ba'am/phreng la sgrigapa gang bde yin/snod che ba gcig tu dkar gtor bshams la bldag/klu sman sna tshogs kha bta0pas gang ba'i bum pa rtsi sman gyi bum par grags pa dang /'o mas gang ba'i bum pa dang/ka to ra gcig tu mtheb kyu gang mang dang /yang gzhan zhig/ tu phag/bya khyung /gla ba/rma bya bzhi ma gtogs rdepa'i srog chags sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'gros 'tshogs tshad bcug pa rnams go skabs gang yangs pa zhig tu bzhag/rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma yang phyogs bzhir bzhag/cha gsum gtor ma yang phyogs gang 'os zhig tu bsgrigs/rdo dril la sogs pa yo byad gzhan dgos pa rnams kyang tshogs/par bshams/gnyis pa lha'i sgrub mchod la/dang por mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/skyabs 'gro sems swed sngon du 'gro bas/rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du hi de'i 'od kyis lus gang /lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/sdig sgrib sbyang gi phyir 'phrosate rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang rje btsun seng ge sgra 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzan mo gu ru khyu na mo bhaṭa rā ga sidha nā tha khyo na masarba bzhi bo dhi sa te bh+ya.oṃ sidha na dā sa pā ri wa ra ar+gha nas/sha p+ta pra titsā sruhwa'i bar gyis mchod/da rkan mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs lan gsum/tshad med bzhi spyi dang 'thun/hūṃ n+ya 20

tas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du/ seng lasaseng ge dkar po nyal stabs mgog yas su phyogs shing / gdong pa gyen du phyogs pa/ ral pa dmar ser thur du 'phyang zhing rin po che'i dra bas g.yogasapa'i steng du/ a las zla ba la dhīXdakar po de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go'aphangs la bkod/ tshur 'dus hiXl thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcag phyag gnyis phyag g.yas mchog spyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas kyi steng du brkyangs shing / g.yon rgyab kyi charagadan la brten pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing ral pa'i thor tshugs can/zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan spangs pa dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa dang ldan pa/ daradamar po'i sham thabs dang/ ri dwags nag po'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ sku'i g.yas logs su tri shu la ljang khu la sprul dkar pos dkris pa dang / g.yon logs su me tog pad+ma'i steng du thod pa me tog sna tshogs kyis gangab dang / pad dkar gyi sdong po snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes gra kyi ral gri me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la hruX de las 'od 'phros rje btsun seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i bskor ba oX badz+ra sa mā dzaXsto ltaramar/ dzaXhuX baX hoX yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaX.oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri lha ra ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams/—231—

cad kyis bdag la yi rme lha par rges cha bsdir ba tshi du gsol/spya/ ni / zhon btab lha pas sgyu ye/dbang — lha zur/ 'a bltams pa tsamakha //zhol dri ma nas/ 'a huX zhes gsungs shang /bum pa' chus dbang mu ge spre/sku gang/ ṅgidag/rta zamasang nga pa nga pas ya 1 sa la : | 1 ku ye she kyas she brgyan/ dbyib tu rnam ra ri /dpung pa g.yas she la she pa/g.yan la 'ad dpag med/da ri phro zhi shā par na 'byung/g.yan par dan grub rnams sprul ༵ sna 〉 ci/med pa 'phro nga bzhugs par gyur/bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ āXrdoX nā da huX ye/'a po ci lbob dang /na mo rat+na ge mu ya/na mo ār+ya rnyi wa lo te sdo raya/ba dha satwa ya/mahā satwa ya/mahā ka ko ḍā) ka ya/ta du thā/ a ka ṭi/ ka ṭi/ni ka ṭi/ka ṭi ka ṭika ro ṭi/ka ro ḍi/bi bye zwa smags sa nyishu rtsa mugardertse ra ra snorerdebazlas/mdun bskyed a sra taX bsangs/swa bhā was sbyangs/stang pa 'a las/zhes pa nas/bzhugs par gyur gya bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra gyis byi/ra~X nyad stse lo storo//ar+ghaXsne ma pa ni na gri blo / brgyang/sangs rgyas smo zi sa bya na sa brlabs//yon tan dam pa kun bros brgyan/she/spyan ras gzi 1 gas zhes mtshan gsol ba//rtagapar ba ni rje na 4 ) lha 'tshal bta//bar rtse ges bzlas pa ci tsob rdo/slar yang di 'a pa'abul ba ni/rten nga 'brel par 'byung ba ya//lha rdzas dam pa chod yon 'a//bcom lda~X 'a//seng nang pa ril ra//bzho/ nas 〉 pū bdag la dgo dhoram ljadi// āX dha nā da sa pa wā ra a duX pra —ts+tsha pū dza me gha sa ma ye ye huX/de bzhi du zhabs bsil dang /smi5༷/de bzhi dzi tshe bar du sbyar/༅ṣ+ka t+yā rdzomachod yon phal cher ma dang /rab 'byams rgya mtsham sogs spyi 'gro gang bdesardzo
