mi kyil 'kho thogs med seng ge'i khri steng du//rnam sa ri sa gsal zla chadal 'khor ra mdzes//sku mdog dkar dkri / spre/gangs 'phung po 'dra//rje nga pes seng ge spru la sdig ltol lo//bdud g.yul bzlog spyan shesaXskom blo ci ze spras//mas sku stang nyaXkyi nam ba / sgra lta bu la//she sku 'gra ba 'a dan du ra yang sprul//dpa' ba seng sgra la phyag 'tshal/ la//phyag ga lda/sartsegasum rgyal rigs sbrul gyis dkris//g.yon pa thod pa ral gri 'bar ba yis//de rwa ra ra ge ma ra 0ri ge go'u grirdesgrub rnyi na la dngas grub lngi rdo/ ba 'a //dam pa stso sto mchag da la skulas/de ba gshe/gas pa zhes spra //slob dpon 'a dpag med par dbulaXrgyan//cha skye sgo ge' ngang mu nge rab sdug bsngal zha bar sgo ji gi/rje btsun thugashe sarja can gā ba 'ad dang rabs thams cad du//grang chadang yul ljaXs/snrings pa' sar//bag med nyal dang spyod lam thams cad du/khre btsun rga kyas thugs rjes bzung du gsol//go bstod/skabs 'dir bum bskyed ni gongagomadun tsod sgrub tshul des rigs 'gre/yang mdor bsdus pa'i tshe na mdun swed dang bum swed phyogs gcig tu sgrub pas chog ste/maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ba yo dkar po tshom bu can zhig bya/phyogs 'a yang rung bar bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshaXs/ma rdzo par byin gyi tha gtor gang lo bsgrags/bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas she ldi dang mthun par na kau steng dang bum 'a bum pa dang cas pa bsangs sbyangs/stang pa'ang nga las maṇ+ḍal gya tsi pa 'berdomapa' nang du paX las mi sgyu 'a 1 hūṃ/ nas/dbu brgyan gyi bar gong bzhin/rten 'brelarde'abyu/nga sogs kyis ma rdzo/ 'gas thogs med sogs kyis bstod cing gsol ba cwabanas/maṇ+ḍal dang /bum pa'i lha la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/de gnyis la thun mong du

gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/gzungs ring gi sruhwa'i gongadub li ta kha kha ji hi 'a hi bcug pa lan lngas mdun bskyed bum pa gnyis char 'damigs nasa'abul/ar+gha la sogs pas mchod/chos sku mnyam nyid ngang las tshagayos kyang//mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi ba'i phyir//klu 'dul byams pa'i rangabazhin gzugs skur bstan//'phags pa seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo//zhe༅stsod/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la//sogs 'dod don gsol ba cwagamachod yon phul bas bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/dam tshig pa 'od du zhu bar bsam/bar 'dir rgyal wo bzhi'i gtor ma gong bzhi byin gyis brlabs nas/rangagosnying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po wo po sdebazhi'akhor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur/oṃ e hre hi tsa dur mahā rā dza sa pa riwā ra badz+ra sa mā dza zhes brjod/oṃ sbyi ta ra : ya/bi dra ḍā/ ka ya/bi ru pak+ṣa ya/bai shra wa ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra khyu na masarba ta thā ga ta sgro nas/ga gan kha gro rte/ da bā ling ta swāhā/zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/spro na re re'i mtshan sngags la nam mkha'ardemadzod kyi sngags rgya sbyar la lan gsum gsum gyis phul na shin tu legs so//tsa tun5 mahwa rādzas pa ri wā ra ar+gha nas/shasta'i bar gyis mchod/rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa//mar gad mdog can pi wa 'dzin//dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur pa zhi/yulalubor bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo//dpa' bo wo po stobs po che/kha shegatso po ral gri 'dzin//grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i//'phags skyes po laphyag 'tshal lo//mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/kha dog dmar po sbru lnga zhagasa'adzin//klu yi tshogs la dbang mig mi bzang la ded de tho/ chen po gser4

mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang : rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong zhing//sgrub la brtson pas byang chub thugs su chud/ /thabs mkhas snying rjes chogasaganyis rdzogs mdzad pa/ /bdag dang gzhan don 'byor ba khyed la 'dud/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod/ sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sto/ nas/kun 'gru/ba cwa(ga gi bar gyis phul/ de nas tsho cha gsum gtor gru/ gtong / rtsi sman gyi bu5pa ladamigs nas/ oṃ de bya a rmi te na pra titsā na ma swāhā/ zhes pa nyer bsti gtsam dag oru ru slu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa nai sarba a the swa dha ni swāhā/ zhes ci gosang twas la byin gyis brlabs/ mtheb skyu dang gzugs 'gros la rgyas par na sngags drug phyag rgya drug dbābasdu na/ na ma sarba tā tha ga ta lco bi shwa sogs nam ma/kha' mdzod kyi sngags dngu༅/rgyal na gsum gsum dang / kha 'bar ma'i sngags gsum gsum gyis byin gyis/ brlabs/ klu'i mchod pabyin rlabs kyang spyi dang mthun par byas la/ maṇ+ḍal dang rten gtor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa/'i ngang las chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus rin po che'i gzhal med khang gi nang du pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la na yig rnams las 'ong zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su chu bdag wa ru ṇa/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ shar lhor pad+ma/ sto ru nor rgyas/ lho nub tu dung skyong/ nub tu'ajog po/ nub byang du pad+ma chen po/ byang du mtha' yas/ byang shar du rigasaldan/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po lha'i lus can/ phyag spos thalamosbyar ba/ sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdeng ka dang sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ dar dang rin po tshes brgyan pa'o/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od —235—

zer 'phros/ klu'i rgyal po rnams 'khor dang bcas pa e hre hi nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaX zhes lan gsum 'dod rgyal gyis phyag rgyas bkug dzaXhuX baX ho~X rangagothugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur te 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas ma rdzo pa ni/ rten cing 'brel 'byung mo'i tshigs bcad la/ klu rgyal 'khor ra dang bcas la 'bul/ /zhes 'don rmetro/ sngags7kyi skabs/ /oṃ wa ru ṇa/ pad+ma/ karkoṭa/ ba su ki shadapyal/ tan ka mahwa pad+ma/ku li ka a nan+ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaX sogs sbyar la rol mo'i bar du 'bug yabasngags de nyid la/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ gdengs ka nor bu 'baraba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa thams cad sel mdzad cing / /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bstod pa 'bul/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /bdag dang bsgrub bya 'thorabacas la/ /nad med tshe dang sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir klu gong gyirigs shes tshad btang bas kyang legs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa gdon gyi bya ba la/ bris sku dang rten gsum yod na khrus gsol spyi dang mthun largyas bsdus gang rigs shig bya/ sku khrus gsol ba'i khrus chu de yang bum par blug la bzhag /rang/gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i tshogs dang / 'dod pa'i rgyal po sogs pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ sa bdag klu gnyan gyi rigs thams cad dang / khyad par du bsgrub bya la gnod cing lan chags pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan sogs gdon thams cad gnod sems zhi ste phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur te/ gnas 'di nyid du bkug cing 'ongs par gyur/ hod rgyal—236—

gyi phyag rgya bos la/bden brdar rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa brjod la/bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gdon thams cad dang /rtsa ri 0rikhyad par du yang 'i ris bya 'ad zhes bya ba la had zhi 'a lan chags pa dang sha 'kho ne gnyer ba 'a gas su gyur pa thams cad ba 'a sems dang ldan pas skad cig thang cig yud tsam la mchod pa'i gnas 'dir mchis par gyur cigayi dam gyi snying po'i mthar/oX sarba nā ga nāX nā go ni naX/nā ga kul naX/bhū mi pa nyisapa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaXṭak+ki hūX dzaXzhes lan gsum mam/lnga'am/bdun la sogasapas dgug/da dung zhe gnan pa rnams mi khugs pa srid pas/rang gi snying ga nas rdorje khrobo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bkug par gyur/oṃ tsu ru kun+da tsu ru kun+da sarba nā ga ā kar+ṣa ya huX dzaXzhes pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dgugs rba nā ga : mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/gyis dam la bas bang rim 'og ma'i gzugasarde'agros rnams la thim pas de rnams dngos su gyur/sarba nā ga bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra khyuXzhes pa thams cad kyi mgor sbyar te/ar+ghaX nas/sha lta'i bor gyis mchod/namamakha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/sa bdag klu gnyan la cho me/sapa'i gdon thams cad dang /bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba la gnod cing lan chagasapa dang sha 'khon rigs rnams mchod gtor rgya chen po 'dis tshim par mdzod la/phan pa dang bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas/bsgrub bya 'di zhes/bya ba'i nad gdon sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/sogs gong bzhi 'dod don gsol ba bton slarayang me long la klu rnams kyi gzugs 'char bar byas la/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyisarde

sogs kyi mthar gzung sngags dang snying po lan gsum gyis mthar/sa bdag klu gnyan rnams kyis sdig sgrib thams cad shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/nad thams cad yan lag nyams pa thams cad dbang po nyams pa thams cad longs spyod nyams/pa tham/sa cad gnas khang nyams pa thams cad 'khotshor g.yog dang nor nyamasapa thams cad gnad du phog pa thams cad lus sems la sdug bsngal/b.ragyur pa thams cad shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/zhes bkru/shan+ti ku rba zhig nas sa a pun ya bcug pas byabs/de nas snod gtsang ma zhig tu sngar gyi gzugs 'gros ci rigs pa dag mthebaskyu ci rigs pa bcug/'o ma'i bum pa dang /rtsi sman nas blug nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngagasarba rjod cing bsgrub bya'i lus lag yas bskor du bskor/klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnamasadang /sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs pa gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang/khyad paradu yang bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba la gnod cing lan chags pa dang /sha mkhon gnyer ba'i rigs rnams gzugs brnyan sna tshogs pa'i glud gzugs 'di dag dang /sman dang gtor ma dang mchod yon rgya chen po 'di dag 'bul ba gal na chags byang bu lon khyer/mkhon rnams zhi ste/gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ma lus pa spangs te/phan pa dang bde ba sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol//lko brjod nas klu'i rten gtor gyi snod der blug/tshul des lan bdun nam bcu gcig gam nyi shu rtsa yi gog/gang rung la gzugs 'gros dang mtheb skya rdzogs par byed/rtsi sman lhag ma cung zad gcig 'ongabar bya/de'i phyed gnod byed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i tshul gyis/ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang /yi dam gyi snying po dang rtsa sngags dang /oṃ wa ru ṇa pad+ma karkos zhes pa nas/kuli ka a nan+da ya swāhā/zhes klu dgu'i sngags dang /oṃ in+d+ra ya zhes pa nas/a tshwa pyithi8

wi swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar cha gsum gyi phyogs skyong gi mtshan sngags ltar brjod nas/ sa sprin gdu kha pra sha ma na a bhi ṣañtsa hu zhes brjod cing / klu'i rten gtor gyi mtha' la rtsi sman ldags/de 'dra lan gsum bya/ 'dis klu'i nad gdon rtsa ba nas dag par 'gyur ba yin/ slar mi ldog po'i don du shan+ti ku rus gnas su rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bcug la rdo rje rgya gram 'jog tshul byas pas bā grung sprigo/de nas snod gcig tu glud gzugs bcug la/ de'i mgo steng du bsgrub bya khrus byas pa'i khrus khu 'dor du bcug /byabs pa yang de la bya ste/ bsgrub bya'i nad ga ngon sdig sgrib thams cad de la thim par mos su gzhug /bkru byabs kyi ngag 'don yi dam gyi sngags 'don pa spo ba ma gtogs tshe co me/ dang 'dra/ glud gzugs khrus khu dang bcas pa de/ phung khams skye mched yongasasurdzogs pa'i skyes bu'i lus su gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brgya lan gsum gyisaganod byed klu rnams la phul bar bsam/ klu gtor gyi mdun du ba6ga /de nas bsgrub bya'༈bsrungab bya ste bkru byabs kyi rigs 'gre/ de nas sngar gyi rtsi sman gyi 'phros de 'gro phyogs su gtor te/chu bdag chen po wa ruṇa/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma dang / khor rgyas dung skyonga'ajog po dang / /pad chen mtha' yas rigs ldan rnams/ /rigs bzhi gdugapa'i sna khri/sa bcas dang / /gzhan yang gdol pa'i rigs rnams dang/ khyad parabasgrub bya 'di nyid la/ /gnod par byed pa'i klu gnyan dang / /sa bdag ge don gyi tshogs thams cad/ /mchode pa rgya chen dpag med dang / /dam rdzas kun gyi bskong zin gyis/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi bar mdzod/ /thams cad dges shing chi'o/ byas nas/ /rang gi dam tshig la gnas te/ /'di la bde legs/mdzad pa dang / /so so'i gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /bcings pa thams cad grol b.ragyis/ /bzung ba thams cad btang bar mdzod/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang //—239—

tshe dang bsod nams stobs rgyas mdzode/ /gal te bka' las 'das gyur na/khyed rnams dmod pas nyams par 'gyur/ /ci ste phan pa'i sems ldan na/ /blamed bde ba'i gnas thob shog /ces brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang cas nas klu'i rten gtor dang mchod gtor sbrags pa gtsang sbra dang bcas te rab tu mtsho'am chu bo chen por skyel/de dag thag ring na chu phran rdzing bu chu mig sogs su skyel/ thang stong du sa dong brus nas sbas kyang grongango / /lam gyi bzhi mdor bskyur ba dang / bya rog dang khyis za ba sogs mi legs par ba ched do/ /de nas bsgrub bya de ras dkar sogs stan gsar pa la 'bru dkar gtor ba la ba 'ag gang 'i/ser sna rnams chags pa sogs dang / gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod/ gtsang sbra can gyi dga' ston bya'o/ /bzhi pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ de nas yig brgya lan gsum bzla/ ma 'byore ba dang sogs/de nas klu'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyis bris pa yin na/ o sarba nā ga badz+ra musu gsol nas dkyil 'khor bsdu'o/ /ras bris yin na gshegs su mi gsol bar/ su sta༅rdebartan bzhugs byas nas sgril/ de nas yi dam gyi gtor ma khang thog tu skyal la/ mchod pakhagasos/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsolkatsho me bu yin na gshe/gas gsol/ bris sku sogs la brtan bzhugs/ rang gi gnas gsum byin gyin/ brlabs pa sogs bsrung ba rnams dran par bya/ bum chus bkru ba sogs rang la'ang bkru byangs srung gsum byed pa dang / smon lam dang bkra shis rnams byas te chog gzhan gyis rigs 'gre'o/ /de'i nyin mo rab tu lus ril po bkru/ de min yang gdong dang kha lag bkru/ khyad par bzang btung gi rjes su kha lag 'phral 'phral 'khyud/ dkar rdor byed pa gal che/ ma mtha' yang chog hril/ma song ba la de rnams mi bya ba'i thabs med/ seṅge sgra'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa'am/ ma mtha' yang snying po —240—

la zhug bdun ma gcig song na/byin rlabs yid ches rtags thon ma rang yong nges so//zhes pa waṃ yang dad ldan kun si pa'i don du/cho ga zor yangs pa'i bya ba gtso bor ston to//tā ra nā.asmras pa'o// ma ṅga laX/ zhus dag/༄༅//klu gtor ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga bzhugs so//oṃ snya sti/klu gtor gtong bar 'dod pas/rin po tsho snod du chu gtsang ma 'o mdang salapal klu sman dang dar zab sna ༵gas rin po che sna lnga 'bru sna lnga sogs btab pa bshams te/skyabasasems sngon du btaX sa/ shā n+ya ༷ dha rdzo/ na 'ing swa bhā waX at+pa rka3taX/bdag dang snangab thams cad stang par gyur/stang pa ngang las pa las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil ge rgor gyi steng du/rang gi sems nyid hruXyig dkar po ring mtshegasdi)rdo sde/lju|drag dang bcas pa dzu 5 'phags pa mchod/chang cha can gab sbyangs/musaXl ma/de yongs su cig pa la 'a nyad 'phags pa sdin ras ge ge sde ge zur/ sku maXb / ri dkar po zhal gcag phyag chog sbyin/'a gnyes/ga tsho ༷nya stabs kyas ༷'a/gas pa/phyag g.yas mchog —na ༵ phyag gyodang/g.yan rdo ༵rdog pad+mā dkar pa' rtsa ba mu sgo ge ge kar bzung nas snyan thad kar kha bye ba/ 1 po tshe' rgyan sna tshogs kyas brgyan pa/ras bzang skyo yi shamathabasadang /ri dwags kyi pags pa3 si ma bkab pa/de'i pas ri bo/mgrin para.āXthugs kar hūX/mu ge ge ka' hūX snyel bsgo gi dod dod dod ri 'od 'phros pas/ bo wi ta la nasan+dhebatsun spyan ras gzags la/bla ma ya /ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa

tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra ya sa pa ri lhar ar+ghaX sogs kyis ma rdzo/ dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ko'i hūXlas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mya dzaX oṃ pañtsaku la sa rwa ri wā ra ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyisamangon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyisaye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi ྅ kata sa ma ya shrī ye āXhūX/ bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri mdag khre'i lhag ma yar lud pa las// 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbangagolha rnams rang la thim pas/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du spyiXyigagi mthar yi ge drug mas bskor bar bsam/ oX ma ṇi pad+me khruX zho' / rigs bslagaslar yang gong bawo mchod la/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ yi dam gying a gan par bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ āXspyiX hoXzhu ba las/ gnas yid du 'ong ba rin po che'i brag bya skyibs can mkha' lding gi gnod pa mi 'byung ba dang / mtshodang rdzing bu dang ne'using dang / pho brang dang skye da mos tshal la sogs pa rnams su/ lha klus longasaspyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / klu nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang bar gyur/ dkar gsum mngar gsum yid 'ong mtsho/ /metog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ /klu'i pho brang yid 'ong bar/ /dbus su pad sdonga'adab ma brgyad/ /phuXdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ni/ /klu rgyal chu lha dkar po ni/ /sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs kas mdzeg /—242—

phyag gnyis/ thal sbyar 'dzu ma bag can/ /lha lus rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ khri/smad sbrul mjug 'byil ba'o/ khar du mtha' yas sngon po dang / /lho ru pad+ma dkar (〈dzaX〉ser )po dang / /nub tu 'jog po dmar po dang / /byang du nor rgyas ljang khu dang / /me ru dung skyong dung mdog dang / /bden bral rkerkos ljangadang / /rlung du rigs ldan sngon po dang / /dbang ldan pad wo ser po sogag /thams cad sbrul mgo'i gdengs kas mdzes/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis thal mosbyar/ /lha lus rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil bzho /'khor du klu rigs kun gyis bskor/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hruXyig ngab/ /de rnams sku las 'od zer 'phros/ /klu chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs so/ /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing / /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'bor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gzhan yang klu dang sa bdagasogs/ /zha bo dang ni 'theng po dang / /rgur po yan lag mdze can dang/ ltongagasum gling gsum 'dzam gling dang / /ma dros gtsang po khron pa dang / khye shinganags tshal skyed mos tshal/ /g.ya' ri gangs ri rdza ri dang / /spang ri ni gsengal sogs pa'i/ /rang rang gnas nas spyan 'dren gyis/ /dug gsum gdugapa'i sems bor la/ /dga' dang gus pa'i bsam pa yis/ /mchod pa'i gnasa'adir gshe/gas su gsol/ /oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūXbaXhoḥganyis su med par gyur/ pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ khyad par bdag dang sbyin bdagal/ /gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa yi/ /klu dang sa bdag ma lus pa/ /pu du'i —243— na

gdan la 'khode par gyur//klu rnams mtha' 'od kyi lcags ris bskor bar gyur zhes dzang/des gtor ma bsngo ma:na gyi bar la phyi la yan 'gro sa med par bsam/oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha sogs kyis mchod/mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya thos la/phyag g.yas mchogardesbyin mthil du ni//a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng //hi las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas//gtor snod khengs shing phyir lud pas//sa bdag klu gnyanatsho gos rnams kyis//'thung zhing legs par khrus byas pas//lus dang yan lag nyams pa rnams//gsos shing lha lus thob par gyur/oṃ bā su te ma swāsmabargya ྈ sogs ci rigs bzlas shing /oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li phru phu swatwa gsum/oṃbhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sam tiṣ+ṭha rju zhu phu hu swāhā/ni snyun sogs kyis phul ga legaga.oṃsarba nā ga rā dza smya a kā ro btags/oṃ sarba nā ga ra rnyi bya tshe u kā rdo tshesarba nā ga ku mā re smya slo a ka ro nas/oṃ sarba na ga ku mā ri snum lo kā jo she chasarba nā ga pri rnye smya o a kā ro oṃ sarba nā ga spra rnye snum a kā ro tshesarba nā ga kulibharma a kā ro oṃ sarba nā ga ku li bya tshe a kā jo sna btospyo༅te phug tshe klu rgyal/mtha' yas nor rgyas bu//'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu//pad+ma pad+ma go modang //dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan dang //lha mo lha mo r+pā po dang //zla ba'i spyi gtsus/ spyi gtsug che//dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin wo po dang //sog ma med dang hu luṇ+ḍa//dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo//rgya mtsho rgya mtsho wo po dang//tshab tshab wo po dang //dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che//rin wo 'od dang pogasardemadzes dang //gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang //lto 'phye chen po shī lidang //shi li wo po rnams dang ni//klu wo 'khor bcas gtor ma ba lkog/44

mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma 'di/ /mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che/ /rin chen phreng ba'i them skas can/ /klu'i gnod pa skyob byed pa/ /mthun pa'irdzas su 'di gyur cig /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /klu las gyurapa'i gnod pa ni/ /mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug /bsam ha dug dngakhaslangs dug /de la sogs pa'i dug rnams kun/ /yud tsam gyis ni zhi gyur cig/bdag las gces pa'i rdzas khyer la/ /bdag la gnod pa ma byed par/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /pha ma lta bu'i sems kyis ltos/ /denas/chos/rnams gang dag rgyu las byung / nas/ rigs su skyes kyi bar gyi chos sbyin byin/klu rnamasakyisgrib pa sbyong ba'i ched du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ka kā ni kā ka ni/ ro tsane ro tsane/tro ṭa ni hro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni tra sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ dzo karma pa ra pa ra ṇi me sarba sa tu nañtsa swāhā/ rtsi nus bzlas/ sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kyi/ /lusakyi na tsha gsos gyur cig /sems kyi sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /yan lag nyams dang nying lag nyams/ /nyams pa'i lus rnams gsos gyur cig /mkha' las bye tshan 'bab pa dang / sha khrag bu chung gcer bus 'jigs/ /gnod pa de rnams zhi gyur cig /sdug bsngal nad kyis zin pa la/ /sman gyi mchog tu lo de gyur cig /'jigs shing skrag pas dngangs pa la/ /mgon skyabs mchog tu'adi: dbul zhing phongs pas mnar ba la/ /'dod dgu'i dpal du snya:bkres shing skom pas gdungs pa la/ /bza' btung mchog tu 'di: 'gro dusalam ngan rnyed pa la/ /lam mkhan mchog tu 'di: ma rig mun pas 'thibs pa la/ /snang gsal mchog tu 'di: gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la/ /tshu〉med —245—

mchog tu 'di gyur cig /mdor na gang la gang dgos pa/ /rgyun chad med para'abyung bar shog 'di yan byed na/ klu yi rigs ni khyed rnams kun/ nas/ runano/ /rgyas par byed pa dang gshegs pa bstun no/ /klu gnyan sa bdag khyed rnams kyi/ /gnas dang pho brang bzhig pa dang / /sa gnyan rkos dang rdo gnyan bsgul/ khrengaganyan bcad dang brag gnyan bta/gas/ /ne'u gsing brus dang chu mig bsubs/ /nya sbal bsad dang grog tshang bshig /yan lag breg dang rwa rmig gnad/ /mi gtsang dri ma phyog pa sogs/ /nyes pa'i skyon gyi khyed rnams la/ /nad dang sdug bsngal ci mchis pa/ /mchodi spyin gtor ma rgya mtsho yi/ /bdud rtsi'i sman 'dis gsos gyur cig khyed kyi gnas khang nyams pa na/ /rin chen sna lnga'i bdud rtsi yis/ /gnas khang nyams pa gsos gyur cig /gnas khanganyams pa gsos nas kyang / /klu rnams mdangs dang ldan pa dang / /nad med dpal 'byor rgyas par shog /ces pa rigs pas sbyar ba'ang bsdus kyang rung ngo / /'o ma rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi yis/ /chu mig nyams pa gsos gyur cig/snyug ma ser po'i bdud rtsi yis/ /shing rnams nyams pa gsos gyur cig /nā ga pus pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /dbu skra nyams pa: rgya mtsho lha ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ /klad pa nyams pa gsos gyur cig /ut+pal sngon po'i mig gi dbang tho gur gum pri yangakuyis ni/ /sna dang rna ba ut+pal dmar pho lce yi dbang : mgron bu dkarapo'i bdud rtsi yis/ /so yi nad rnams zhi gyur cig /thal kar rdo rje6 pagasapa nyams pa gsos gyur cig /dbang po lag pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ yan lag nyams pa: chu srin sder mo'i: nying lag nyams pa: pu shel rtse'i rtsa rgyus—246—

nyams pa dung dkar g.yas 'byil rus pa nyams pa ma phro/dkard chu'i bdud rtsi sha khrag nyams pa snying bu zho sha'i bdud rtsi snying nind rnamayomakhal ma zho sha'i bdud rtsi mkhal ma'i nad rnams zhi gyur cig/li khrid marapo'i bdud mchin pa'i nad rnams zhi gyur cig/'om bu btsod kyi bdud rtsiyis//rgyu ma nyams pa gsos gla gor zho sha'i mtsher ba nyams(pa stogangadakar po'i bdud rtsi yis glo ba nyams pa g.yu sgong 'bar ba'i lgang ba'i nad rnams zhi gyur cig/gi ha ser po'i tshad pa'i nad rnams ni dza ti pha la'i rlung gi nad rnams zhi dri zhim spos kyi bdud rtsi mi gtsang dri ma dgagyur cig/snying po lnga yi bdud rtsi yis//bkres skom sdug bsngal zhi sman snalnga yis nyon mongs dug lnga zhi 'bru sna lnga yi longs spyod phun sumatshogasagyur cig/dar tshon sna lnga'i gos sogs skyabs dang ldan gyur cig/sa bdag klu gnyan khyed rnams la//bsad cing gnad nas rgol ba dang //'khon zhida'agras pa ci mchis pa//de ring 'khon sel 'gras pa sdum//mchod spyin 'di yis tshim gyis la//klu yi rigs ni khyed rnams kun//sems dang shes pa gsal gyur cig/drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la//bka' dang dam lasama'ada' bar//shin tu khros pa zhi gyur cig/dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul du//mkho dgu'i longs spyod thams cad ldan//nyams pa'i lus rnams gsos shingargyas//yan lag thams cad bde gyur cig/ngan song gsum las thar nasakyang //tshangs ba'i bde dang ldan gyur cig/chos spyod dbang po phul nas kyang// sa na rdo rje'i zhal mthong shog/sngags dang sman sogs byin rlabs kyis//4

nad dang nyer 'tshe kun spangs nas/ /drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la/ /klu rnarnams rang rang gnas su gshegs/ /byang chub sems dang ldan par gshegs/ /skabs 'dir 'od kyi lcags ri mi dmigs par sgom/ rgyal rigs dkar po shar du gshegs/ /rje rigs ser po lho rtsa dmangs rigs dmar po nub ca bram ze sngon po byang du: gdol pa nag po mtshams bzhir: sa phibadag po sal: sne bdag po chu la: o nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ru gzhan yang las la grub pa yi/ /bka' dang dam las ma thogs pa'i/ /gdug pa can gyi klu rnams kun/ /rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs/ /bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ ga rus ha sa he tsaletsa le swāhā/ zhes pas dkar phyogs kyi klu rnams gshegs su gsol/ nag phyogs kyi klu rnams bskrad nas/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor bar bya'o/ /dug gsum klu'i sdug bsngal dang/ /dug gsum klu'i nad zhi nas/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis/ /sku gsum rdo rje 'dzin thob shog /ces smon lam bkra shis ci rigs bya'o// // klu khorardeji ltar bya ba'i cho ga tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /ma ṅga a/ gcig zhus//—248—

༄//gtor ma brgya rtsa'i ngag 'don bzhugs so//skyabs 'gro sems tsod sngon du btang /rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer loga'ajig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor mgron thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX na mo bde gshegs snying po 'a kun yongs la khyab//sems ni rgya/na mchog tu rab bskyed de//'gro ba 'ad dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu//'a na snod min sems can gang yang med//bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bstortsa ri lbo sku/ 0ri rnga ri 0rimanga' ba 'a lha//〉grang klo 'da' thugs 'a 'a gas zhi///sems/dz+wa/ don la dgongs pa dkon mchog gsum//yad kyas sprul bshamasapaganas 'dir sa/gto pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po la//spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas si gshegs su 3sol//rgyal ba sras bcas rang rgyal nyan thosadang //lha sde brgyad 'gro drug sems can rnams//bgegs rnams/gtan/ pa med pa'i mchode spyin la//spyan 'dren 'khotshor dang bcas te ga khri skye/gas supor cha ge//shā she ja tshogs shing lag yi ༵di bshams la/thams cad spyi mthun du/ badz+ra a mra ta kuṇ+ḍa ha na ha na hūX phaṭa/ ༵ bhā wa 8spo gi sarba dharma su bhā wa 8spyo sgroXta/gisastong par sbyangs/zan bsto chus sbyangs la/ āXspyiXlan gsum gyis byin gyis bu'i bas/na maXsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/༷༷ saX bha ra saX bha ra skyoX/go zha nye brtag 'a/rtsa 'i sna tsho' la ce klos sangs rgyas dra ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang/ya dam dkyal 'khong ra gya lha sa sangaX rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'phags

pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul lo//bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyorab dang bcas pas gtso byas sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/oṃ badz+ra ar+gha swāhā/oṃ badz+ra pa byas twa slo badz+ra pukhre rngo u hā/oṃ badz+ra dhu pe u hā/oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke u sku o badz+ra garnye āhū.oṃ badz+ra sna wi rkye u hu/oṃ badz+ra shasta u hu/bzhi pa yan chad la sngags nyer ga khrig resabasngo ba dang /nge ma na chad la bdun bdun bsngo/thog mar 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis bugs/ padang /bzhi pa yan chad la ar+gha la sogs pa' mchod pa yang gong gis rigs 'gre bar byas nas/khyad par so so laganyis pa ni/sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/rdo rje mkha' 'gro/rin chen mkha' 'gro/pad+ma mkha' 'gro/sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ste/dpa' bo mkha' rde'agro'i tshogs thams cad dang /rdo rje nag po wo po dang /dpal lha mo kholdedang bcas pa rnams dang /lha chen brgyad/klu chen brgyad/phyogs skyong bcu/gza' chen brgyad/rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/'jigs byed dgu/rgyal po chen po sde bzhi ste/dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcasapa rnams dang /lag na rdorje lnga brgya la sogs te dkar phyogs skyong ba khyad paracan bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la dbul 'o //sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang /bdag cag chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/gsum pa ni/rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams dang /dge sbyong dang /bram zedang /lha'i drangasrong ma/ngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa ngag tshig gi mthu grub pa rnams la dbul lo//sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang /sems can la bde skyid 'phel ba 0

dang /bdag cag la 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang /mthu rkyen 'grub pa'i smon 'a8/bzang po gdab tu gsol/bzhi pa ni/bdag cag 'gro ba rnams kyi lhan cigaskyes pa'i lha dang /rnam thos sras la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang/bsrung skyob mdzad pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dbul lo//nad dang dbul 'phongs zhi zhing /'jigs pa las bskyab pa dang /tshedapadapal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/'di man chad la ar+gha la sogs pa ma chad pho dod du/de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin ga tha/gas pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin g.ye/gas/pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshe/gas pa 'jigs pa thams(cad dang yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo//wo brjod dgos shig lnga pa ni/rdorje gdan gyis gtso byas 'dzam bu'i gling gi gzhi bdag rnams dang /khyad parabod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/sgos yul phyogs 'di nyid laganasapa'i gzhi bdag rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i/sde brgyad mthu bo che thams cad ladabul lo//'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su 'beb pa dang/nad dang muge dang 'khrug pa rnams zhi ba dang /khyad par du bdag cag gi mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i gnas po bzang po mdzad du gsol/drug pa ni/gnod spyin gyi ded tswa3 wo po nor bu bzang po dang /'brog gnas mched lnga dang /phyogs mtshamasabasrung ba nyi shu rdza'i gi rtsa brgyad/stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis/'phrog ma bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa sogs gnod sbyin mthu bo che 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo//sems can la gnod che'i bsam pa zhi ba dang /

bdag cag la bar chad bsrung zhing / bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub paramadzad du gsol/ bdun pa ni/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ nad bdag rims bdag la sogs pa gnod sbyin thamasacad la spyin no/ /deng phyin chad bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba dang/gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar gyur cig /bdag cag la phan sems mchog dang ldan par gyur cig brgyad pa ni/ 'gro ba gas drug /lamargyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no//rigs drug so so'i lan chags bu lon byang zhing / sdug bsngal mtha' dgadangabral nas/ pha rol du phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig gu'/ yidwags kyi gtso mo kha la me 'bar ma la sogs te yi dwags kyi tshogs thams cad la sbyin no/ /so so'i mdun du zas skom bdun rtsi'i char chen po babs nagabade bar longs spyod pas tshim par gyur cig /ser sna'i sdig sgrib byang zhingadabul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar gyur cig bcu pa ni/ bdagacag la tshe rabs snga ma nas lan chags pa'i mgron bu lon ma khyer ba dang tshe 'dir yang thugs zur dang / sku zur dang spyan zur la phog pa rnams dang/gnod byed kyi gdon ngos ma zin pa rnams le sbyin no/ /lan chags byang zhing bu lon khyer bar gyur cig khyed rnams gtor ma 'dis tshim zhing / re ba thamasacad skongs bar gyur cig ra ri gcig pa ni/ mdang da nang bsad pa shi ba da lta srid pa bar dor 'khyams pa'i bar do'i sems can thams cad la spyin no/ /b.rado'i 'jigs pa las grol nas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku myur du thob par—252—

gyur cig bcu gnyis pa ni/ ma thob pa ma sleb pa khas zhan cing dbang chung ba/lhag ma la dbang ba rnams dang / glo bur du lhag pa rnams la sbyin no/ /so sorazas skom gyis tshim pa dang / myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig pa a sdi hū/ bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan rosagazigs su gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /phyag nas 'bab pa'i 'o rgyun gyis/ /yi dwags rnams ni tshims byas nas/ khrus byas rtagatubasil bar shog ma ṇi nyer gcig dang / oṃ urnyi hu/ zhes chu sbyin/ o dzol midasarba pre ta khyu swāhā/ sa gtsang sar chu blugs/ se gol gcig gtogs/ bdag/bsamaṣepa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / lto/ sa kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang / /cemasacan kun la phan btags phyir/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /dedagathams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams 'di ma lus par/ /thegs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /chos rnams gang dag nas/ nges par grol gyi b.radagachos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzupadu med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyatshamed byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ khams gsum dag pa'i zhing/ khrid gsum snying rje'i mgron/ /ma lus khyab pa'i rdzas/ /chos nyid rtogs pa'i mthus/ /mi zad gter du bsngo/ /gtor ma mi zad pa'i gter la longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /bsod nams 'di yis sogag dge ba —253—

bsngo/oṃ badz+ra muXye shes pa rnams gshegs/mchod spyin gnas 'ar gangalhags ye//'byung gā sa 'og rgyu ba dang /'i/gang yang sa steng god pa dang//sablar zhabad pa gang 'a pa//ma yi bar gyas la rang gnas su//bi zan snyes tsa thams cad 'gro bar gyas//sarba bhū ta ga smosarba pre ta gas sarba rna ru/oṃ a mṛ te huX phaṭa/dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun//sogs smon lasang bas ganga'os bya// //gtor ma brgya rtsa'i ngag 'don rgyal khams pa tā ra na thas smras pa go/bkra shigazhus/ dag/༄༅//bsur gyi lag len zhes bya ba bzhugs so//oṃ spru sti/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo//bsur gyi lag go hod pas/skyabs sems sngon du 'a nas/oX swa lbo rdo / sngi kyi / spra rdo / / lha da rdo rdo swā / ྅haXrde/gis tī par sbyangs/stong pa' ngang las bhūX las byung ba 'a bsur snod yangs—sprang rgya ho che ba 'a nang du oX las byung ba'i bsur lha rdzas las grub pa/kha dog dri ro regabyā phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/oX āXkhruX gsum stsod par rmiX dho/ saprata su ra phug pa swāhā/zhes ni bdun/na maXsarba ta thā ga ta skawa lo /te/oX sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūX/spyo zhin ga the/de bzhin gshe/gas pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo//de ba na gshe/gas pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshalaṣalo//de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang /ngas su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo//

brjod la/ bsur 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa 'di ṣ+ka/ dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can/dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa la sogs pa dri za zhing dri la longs spyod pa'i rigs su gtogs pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /dri'i 'dod pas tshim nas ge nod 'tshe med cing gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /gzhan yang sems can mdang da nang shi ba bsad pa/ lcebs pa srid pa bar do na gnas pa/ lus snga lus bor nas/ phyi lus ma lon pa rig pa gtad med du 'byams pa/ bar do'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba rnams la bsngo go /bar dorabaza' btung longs spyod char bzhin babs nas lus gzugs sku rnam gnyis dang / sems chos skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig /semasacan thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig /ngan song sdugabasngal ma myong zhing / / dka' ba spyad pa med pa yang / /lha bas lhag pa'i lusakyis ni/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni gos 'ad cesapa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel/ zhus dag /༄༅/ /chu gtor 'jam dpal ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /tso rna snya sti/ dug rigs med pa'i sman rnams dang / dkar gsum mngar gsum 'brug dgachu gtsang ma bshams te/ skyabs sems byas la/ skye( su bhā wa hwa khri sde sarba dharmā ga bha wa —255—

ts+tsha3haX/sngu pa'i ngang sheX las phri dang /a las s+ho ba'i dmigo~X kyā steng du/ ge maX she 'ad zer spyo mi pa mgo/semasango dan dzi slar 'dun she yangs sbya sdog/ge ge des/rang nyad 'a rdo 'jam dpaswāsku mdag dkar pa dzol ga'i snrog gnyas g.yas kya phyag she/pusatshabarten pas utrula'i sdo tshuXgya3ge ge ge de ge ge ye ge chi ba'o : ///g.yan pa gdan laban pas utrul 'a sdang pa she kyā thad 'is kha bya ba 'an pa/shes/ zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ri/྅sna rgya dzol tshe re / pa ral ba di ge mu las g.yas ral gyas bar durdemagri/dar dang pa rgyaXn thaXms she sbo brgyun pa/she~X'i/mgran par āXthugs ka~Xhū/hu las 'ad ra 'phra/sa pas phyags/ nga rgyas dang byang chub mas zi ye ge 'did/prer thim yang snying ge'ilagya she par she ༷ mā dzñāXrdoXrteXrdobaXhaXsga ris sa la ku ༷ra ma/yangasang spyiXlas 'a~X /rngam/mu gas she gas lnga zhabar dang bcas pa shesamā dzaXshe rngams kyas ༵dag la mngan par dhi na ska bskur ba rdi/ du sku sprod dod spro ri gsal//zhes gsal ba btab/ sarba ta thā ga ta a ṣe ka ta sa ma ya ye guXzhes/gsungs shing dbang bskur bas/rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/oṃ wā gyi shwa rinaX/mu ci ri i rna 3spya :ngordesnyang po gas bzlas/ ār+ya mañdzu sa pa wā ra ar+ghaXgrwa smanas/a'i ta / 'ji/drang pa par sde ge ba sa sde sde sde /snang ba po//ye zhes sgron mes rab ba༅ she//'ag rtan gsum gya mun la ba//'jam pa' dbyangs la phyag 'tshal/lka/lko bro stod do//de nas gtor ma sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis sbyan gyis brlabs pa ni/chos smi rnam dag gi phyag rgya ni/thal mo khong stong snying gar /ra ba dang / su bhā wa shu smras bo sto snya

bhā wa 8)sgron haX/zhes pas ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs nas/stong pa nyid du bsas zhing/namamakha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya ni/thal mo sbyar ba las tshigs bar pa gsum bcag pa dpral ba ru dgan maXsarba ta thā ga te smyo bi shwa mu khebh+yaXsarba tha khaX.ut+pa te spa ra ṇa imaX ga ga na khaX swāhā/zhes pas mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad rnams ni nam mkha'i khamasathams cad khyab par bsam zhing /bdud rtsi 'byil ba'i phyag rgya ni/thal mo phyir bskyed mthe bongabasnol la kha'i thad du dang /oṃ badz+ra a rdzita kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na spyiXphaṭa/ces pas tha༅sacad kyang sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i 'dud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam zhing /rgya chenashugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya ni/g.yon khu tshur dal steng du bzhag/g.yas khu tshur sdigs mdzub byasapas snod la bstad pa dang /na maXsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te/tshesam+bha bsam+bha rahuX/zhes pas 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang /sems can rnams kyi spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa ཿnga bar bsam snyo /ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya ni/g.yas khu tshur/g.yon snying gar 'degs tshul byas pa dang /rma ston a wa lo ki te na maXs man+ta spa ra ṇa ra smi bha wa sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūX/zhes pas lus zhing ni rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes shing /sems can rnams kyang yo byad la rtsod pa med cing mthun pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par bsam wo /dbang twar 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni/sor mo nang du pas la ba spyi bor bas pa dganamaXs man+ta ja khyu nāX gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza na mahā sa ma ye swāhā/zhes pas thams cad yodam tshig la gnas pas phan pa dang bde ba'i 'phrin las 'ba' zhig sgrub par bsam zhing /phyag/rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum la sogs pa'i brjod par bya'o//de nas/na mo bde gshegs snying po 'gro kun /༷sa la khyab//sems ni rgya r+pā mchog

tu rab bskyed de/ /'gro ba ma lus 'di dag sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis ni/ /sems can don ladagongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /yid kyi sprul zhing bshams pa'i khas 'a sa /gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po la/ /spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcasate gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras nyan thos rang rgyal dang/ /lha phrin sde brgyad 'gro drug sems can dang / /bgegs rnams gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin la/ /spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /zhes pas mi drangs te/ pad+ma ka ma la stu gyis gdan phul la/ ar+gha la sogs pas mchod/ na mtha' bta thā ga smyo bi shwa mu khebh+ya sarba thad kha ut+pa te spa ra ṇa i ma ga ga na kha gro ste da ba ling ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'khor 'das kyi mgron thams cad la ye shes kyi 'dud rtsi nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rgya che ba rgyun mi 'chad pa phul bas dgyes shing tshims par bsam/mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyuracig /dam can thugs dam skongs gyur cig /rigs drug gtor mas tshi5gyuracig /sha 'khon bu lon khyer ba dang / /bla med byang chub thob par shog /o badz+ra mu zhes pas 'phags pa rnams gshegs su gsol zhing / mchod spyin gnas 'i der gangalhags pa'i/ /'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang / /gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang//sablar 'khod pa gang yin pa/ /mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su/ /thams cad thams cad 'gro bar gyis/ /sarba bhu ta ru zhes 'byung po rnams rang gi gnas su btang la/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ ā hu/ bkod la bdag bsrung zhing bsngo ba dang smon las bku—258—

shis bya'o// //chu gtor ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /zhus dag/ bkra shis//༄༅/ /dkar gtor cha bzhi bzhugs so/ /oṃ khyu sti/ dkar gtor cha bzhi ni/ tho rangs la sogs pa bza' btung ma byas pe'i sngon du mdzad pa'i lag len yin/ gtor ma lcog zlum gsum dang zan ril gnyis bshams/ chu gtsangagis bran/ gtor ma dang po/ oX a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na huX phaṭa kyis bangs/ oṃ gabha wa shudhaXsarba dharmāXsu bhā wa shurnyo3haX gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oX āXspyiXlas byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma ye shesakyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhūX rdzo gsum gyis byin gyis brlasanarang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun gtum po sngon po khro rgyalamigayo 'bor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka mal ye stuX/ oX tsaṇ+ḍamahā ro ṣa ṇa spyiX phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam bdun bzlas nas/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā roṣa ṇa skyoXphaṭa/ 6brdaX bā ling ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ lan gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas phulka.oX ār+ya a tsa la sa pa ri lda ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puspro āXspyiX nag shap+ta.āXhūX gi bar gyis mchod/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen pos 'gro bkun sgrol zhing / /srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad de/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems shing bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon/ /rab brjid migayo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan khro rgyal mi gos bag—259—

bdag cag gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bdag cag bdud bzhi'i g.yulalas rgyal nas/ bdag cag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ /gtor ma gnyis pa yang / a mṛ tas bsangs pa nas/ glu tshe āXhuX lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar gong bzhi byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phrog lho phyogs ri bo po ṭa la nas rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX po ṭa la yi gnas mchog na/ /tāXyig ljang khu legs zhabrungasashing / /tāXyig 'od kyis 'gro ba sgrol/ /sgrol ma 'khor bcas gshegasasugasol/ /oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wā re e hre he/ pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ na maXzla ca budha bo dhi satwa nāX/ ā pra ti ha ta shā sa nāX he he bha ga wa te mahā sa tā sam ba dha a wa lo gī te/ mu : laX ba mā bi laX ba/ i daX bā ling gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX huX sarba bi pañtsa re swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pas gtor ma phul/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pāriwā ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ pukhre nas/ shasta'i bar gong bzhi/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la bcan de/ /'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag dang sems can ma lus pa/ /blo rjegs/chen brgyad dang bcu drug las/ /rtag tu skyob cing bsrung ba dang / /gzhan yangabar chad kun zhi zhing / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal bskyed nas/ /'gro kun dbang du bsdu ba dang / /srid dang zhi ba'i dngos grub kun/ /gegs med yid bzhin stsal/ du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab bo/ /gtor ma gsum pa gong bzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ yang na rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya —260—

dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa huX/ mo'i phyag rgya dang / hūX badz+ra dz+wa la ā na la ha nad ha pa tsamathabhañdza ra ṇa huX phaṭa/ rdo rje bsdams pa dang / oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharma ṇaX u bya nu chu / twa ta/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya thos la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ klu rgyalapo 'khor ra dang bcas pa rnams oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ brta li brta li mahā brtaX li gyuXhūX dza dzaX spyo lngo gsum dang / oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /le dron po dngani stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma pad+ma wo po dang / /dung skyong dang ni rigs tha dang / /lha mo lha mo chen po dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyuga'adzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang hu lun ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / / tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang/ /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /gzugs mdzes chen po sprul bzang dang / /lto 'bye wo po tshi li dang / /tshi li r+pā po rnam dgani/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ā ga smo u gas mahwa nā ga.a dhi pa ta ye/ sarba snur bhu waXphruX phuXhūX swāhā/ pad+ma ka mal ye stuX/ oX nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gro ste daX ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ oX nā ga sogs de kho na bzhin sbyar ga pu spre nas/shasta swāhā/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong sgrengs pa'i khu tshuralagayas pa'i lag mthil gtad de sor mo rnams bskyod pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ hi li hi limahā hi 'i kyi phruX phuXswāhā/ zhes brjod cing / se gol gtogs pa lan gsum la sogs pa byasalka.oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sam ya tiṣ+ṭha dzuX phruX phuXhūX swāhā/ lan gsum nas bdun gyi bar gyisagator ma phul/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he du rnye blo ta thā ga to phya ba da ta/ te phra snga1 ni ro dha e waX bā dī mahā shra ma ṇaX sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sur—261—

tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyasabastan pa yin/ /lus kya sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams/cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las rnam par grol/ /chosarnams gzugs brnyan lha bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /ngo bo nyid kho gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyamamed byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /spyo chos bshad/ klu mu po bgyod kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang / khyad par du bdagacag rnams la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim zhing dgyes par gyur cig / gnod sems dang gdug pa'i bsam pa nye bar zhi nas/ phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyuracig /mdze nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sa pā ri wā ra ga:spyi zhes se gol phyi she khri/ byings rnams rang gnas su dzin gas par mos/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang / o ga ru ḍa ha sa he tsā le tsā le swāhā/ zhes pas nag phyogs kyi klu rnams bsgrad par mos/ /gtor ma bzhi pa/ oṃ u pho lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ mthar se gol gdab pa dang thos/ sngags 'dis gtor ma sbyin no/ /na ma':rupāya ta thā ga ta ya/ a rta he sa myakla ba khyu ya/ ta du thā/ oṃ su ru sus pra su ru khra sus ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ sa dhar pā ya sa ster pā ya/ sarba pre ta nā swāhā lan gsum nas nyer gcig gi bar ji ltar 'os pab rdon/ a pa sa—262—

ran+tu/༷a pa tā ḍi/sarba pretak+ṣi kho/she mya haX/tshi/ 'a dh+wa tu wa sti nāX/gī ta nā ma hā ra swāhā/ya dwags thams cad gcing tshi~X/ zhang /'thab /da la sags pa med par/bde bar longs spyod nga pa thob par gyur cigs bo pre ta gas kho se gol gtogs//dkar gtor cha bzhi dngo~X ni de yan chad yin la/de'i steng du/gzhi bdag gtor ma~X nga bro(tshon pa'i lag len yin pas/ badz+ra yak+ṣa sogs dag hāXbadz+rasbyo la soXgs dang / ༷a kwa ro nas/twa/ /rmi b.raX gong bzhi byin gyis brlabs/oX a kā ra mu nga gi sarba dharma kyi a bya na yan ga sto 'a she āXhu phaṭa swāhā/ni pa' rno nyidaXyon na rdzo gang snra ji phul/di gyi khams kun gyi ba spege tan lnga dang ldan pa she /phyagasardegling gi rnyis rten she khams sti sngi gzha bcar bis shā/she /sgas ye 'a 'a bdag pa/'a sgas bad kha ba ༷na gya kri rta bdabartsa ga/ bad khaXs skyang ba 'a brtan ma bcu gnyas//dge ga tshe mthu shes gi gnas bdag gres /khyad par ngh+ru yang /yul phyags dang sa phyags 'ad dag gnas bdage rdzogagazha bdag grang bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'dra/la la//bdagacag rnams kyi yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'gru/ba pa dang /mi mthun pa'ir ra 0ri tres/༵gas thams cad zhes bsding ༷nga /bar chad tham 1 sa she go shel ba dang/mtsho she na ka gi cad sgrub mu she dang 'a daX 'a pa dhi/nga pa sa 'a she/bdag she bsdum dro' pe mi she dang na//dā bzhan gas pa' sbyan yesadang //rdzus kya dbyangs kya stabs rnams phyir//ye pa rnams la ma chad pa dang //gas drug kun la kau 'a ra//jig rten gang ni ma lus kun//de dag thams cad rags 6par//'ag na khams ma lus

par/ /thogs pa med par 'grub gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /dzam bha la ser nag gi chu sbyin byed par 'dod na/ gtor snod kyi 'gram du/ dzaX las 'phags pa dzam bha la ser po rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yasashing thog bi dza pu ra ka dang / g.yon gter gyi ne'u le'i 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol ba'i stabs kyis dung dang pad+ma lasogs pa gter chen po rnams la zhabs brten pa/ 'khor gnod spyin nor lha phomo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zera'aphros/ 'phags pa dzam bha la 'khordo ra dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX pad+ma kamalaye stuX/ dzaXhuX baX hoX rang gi lag mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i zlaX hūX aX dzi khaXrigs lnga'i rang bzhin rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyu| du gyur/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len dra ye swāhā/ lan brgya rtsa bgyod kyis chu sbyin phul/ oṃ cwatha5 dzam bha las pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tisnro nas/ sha p+ta āXhūX gi bar gyis mchod/nor gyi dbang phyugarin chen gter mnga' zhing / /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byangaphyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam bha la/ /do dros grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyaga'atshal bstod/ /ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdung ba bdag /skye ba skye bar khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /rin chen gter gyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad dbul 'phongs las grol zhing / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub gegs med par stsa'/ du gsol/yang rang gi snying ga nas huX spros pa/ gtor snod kyi steng du yongs su gyur—264—

pa la/ 'phags pa dzam bha la nag po gcer bu rigs ngan gyi cha lugs rna ba maphug pa/ g.yas thod khrag dang / g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ gcer bu khro bo'i mabyad can sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rtags bsgreng ba/ pad nyi nor bdag gos dan lagayon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na gnasapa'o/ /ba las rmyo byung ba'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang bar gyur/oṃ in+d+ra ya ṇi mu kha bh+ra ma ri swāhā/ lan bdun gyis zhal byin gyis brlabs/ o swāhā/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu sbyin phul/ gong ser po'i skabs bzhin/ ar+gha la sogs pas mchod/mgon po nam mkha'i mdzod can nor gyi char 'bebs pa/ /ma skyes rang bzhin dag pas sku mdog sngon por bzhugs/ khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid de bdagamachod do/ /rtag tu yid la re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ser sna'i lasakyi zhes pa nas/ stsal du gsol gyi bar gong bzhin no//thams cad kyi thun mong du yig brgya lan gsum bzlas la/ oṃ badz+ra mu smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa brjod do/ /zhes pa la pa tār nā thas smras pa'o/ / gcig zhus dag/ ma ṅga la//—265—

༄༅/ /gtor ma chen po'i cho ga bar chad kun sel bzhugs tre rgo /tseX( snyu sti/ 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ bla ma ba ri bas bal yul du byon nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta cig spyanadrangs nas byon pa dang / gser med nas pu hrangs su phyin nas btsad po rtse sde dang mjal nas/rgyal po la dbang bskur byas/ chos bshad pas rgyal pos gser srang brgya phul skad/ de rnams paṇ+ḍitas tshags byas nas bla mas bdag la bag tsam zhig/ gnang ba zhu byas pas/ ma phyin par slar yangargol ba dang khro ba la sogs pa byed du byung bas/ shin tu sun te paṇ+ḍi ta bal yul du skyel du phyin skad/ de nas bal yul du sleb pa'i lam du mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta gcig dang 'phrad nas/kho nagekhyod kyi nga yi lotsā ba gyis la bod du 'gro dgos zer nas byung skad/ de la bla mas mi byed byas pas/kho na re ngas mu stegs kyi chos mi 'chad par/ sangs rgyas pa'i chos 4zhad zer kyang bla mas mgasan pas/ kho na re/ khyod la mthu byed zer ba la/ ngas khyod la nyes pa ma byas par mthu bya ba'i (〈rdza〉 byas pas ) sha gas med byas nas/ rgya gar du byon skad/ de nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal nas chos gsan gyi yod tsa na/ rdo rje gdan pa na re/ khyod la mu stegs kyi gnod pa yong bar 'dug gsung bas/ /mi yong byas pas 'ong bar 'dug gsungs pas/ 'o na bal yul du mustegs skal ldan rgyal po bya ba dang 'phrad nas 'di ltar byung lags zhus pas 'o na de ka'i yin gsung nas/ bla mas bha ya na'i sngags bzlas/ gtor chen lan gsum btang bas tha ma la shi skad/des na 'di byin rlabs che ba yin gsung / rdo rje gdan pa/ bla ma ba ri ba/ bla mchen go waṃ lo—266—

rgyus dag pa yin gsung / bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams srid mtsho las bsgral zhes/ /blo chen dad ldan bla ma dang / /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug lka/btun de gtor ma'i cho ga bri/ /ngan rtog smra ba'i dri bral zhing / /phan pa byin par byed pa 'i de/ /gang zagaganas dus yo byad dang / /cho ga phan yon sdom drug yin/ /de la gtor ma gtong ba'i slob dpon dang / bum pa la bzlas pa byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa gnyis ni/ dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan zhing khro bogang yang rung ba'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas bya'o/ /gtor g.yog kyang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ‘yā zhing srung ba dang ldan pa ste/ de ltar bzhi ka gtor ma'i bya ba ma tshar gyi bar du ngag bcang/ par bya zho/gnyis pa ni/ mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pas dben pa/ gtsang ba/ sgo la gtor snod shong bo'i sader phyag dar legs par bya ba dang / me tog la sogs pa dgram par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gza' dang skar ma bzang po 'dzom pa'i tshe bya'o/ /bzhi pa rten gyi dkyi' 'khor phyogs re la khru ba'i bzhiyod pa gru bzhi pa/ de ma shong na yang khru gsum las chung ba mi rung / ba byung lnga dang tsan+dan gyis legs par byugs la/ de'i nang du chos 'byung rtse mo phar phyogs bsgrub bya'i phyogs su bstan kla /dbus su gtor snod wo po rdza'am zangs gzhong du wo ba chon rtsi re kha dkar pos bris pa rdo rje'i stegs la bzhag /mchod pa ni me tog sogs lnga'am bdun slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du g.yon nas rim pa bzhin du bsham mo/ /gtor ma'i yo byad ni/ yul gang yin gyi bres brtsal bo'i srad phyed legs par sprus la/ phyed chan du btso/ /phyed zan du bya'o/ /de ma 'byor nabre bcu gnyisal snga ma bzhin bya'o/ /zan la mtheb skyu brgya rtsa brgyad du bya zhing / chan la'ang de bzhin du mnyam por snod gcig gis gzhal zhing bya'o/ /bum pa ni zag rdol med pa chu bre gsum shong ga de ma yin na yang chu bre gang shong pa de lam gul bcings sogs bum rdzas dang chus bkang bgegs bsal la/de slob dpon gyi g.yas su dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs par bum mchog pa'i mdun du bzhag /bum pa —267—

lamachod pa rnams kyis skor/ bzlog glud ni rjen phye btsos pa la 'bru sna tshogs kyis bgyon te/ nad pa la sogs pa bsgrub bya gang yin gyi gru gang pa byas la/ lung thang gi mig dang / 'gron bu'i so dang /skra tshab dang / nor bu la sogs pas brgyan dang / zhwa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de chos 'byung ni rtse morasnod kyi nang mthong ba tsam du bzhag go /gzhan dag byed kha byed pa sogs yod na/ rang go 'khor du yod pa la zan kham re gtad la bsrung ba bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor mchod pa bshams/ gtor ma'i yo byad bshams pa dang / busapabazlog pa'i glud bshams pa/ rnam pa lnga yi yo byad bshams/ lnga pa ni/ gang zag bzhi yis legasapar byas la/ slob dpon stan bde ba la 'dug /gtor g.yog gnyis bde chas su gzhug slobadapon dang bum chog pa gnyis kas bdag bskyed lhan cig rnam 'joms bsgoms/ gzungs tsirigs pa bzlas/ mchod bstod gtor bsdus bya/ de nas bum chog pas bum par lha bskyed bzlasapa sogs cho ga ltar byed cing / de nas g.yas kyi gtor g.yog gis 'bru chan blugs/ g.yon gyi gtor g.yog gis zan dang argas bkang / slob dpon gyis 'di la spyin dang mi sbyin pa'i dmigasapa gang yang mi bya bar/ mdun gyi gtor ma chan sogs la dmigs nas/ lag g.yon rdo rjedangabacas snying gar khu tshur bcangs/ g.yas dril bu dang bcas gtor ma la brten mchog sbyin phyag rgyal mthe bong dkyil du bkug nas srin lag gi rtsa ba non pa'i chos sbyin gyi phyag rgya bya/ sems kyisalag g.yas mthil du raX dmar ro/ /de'i steng du a dkar po raX las me 'bar a zhu nas sa dud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam/ sam+bha ra'i sngags bdun re brjod/ lag pa g.yas kyi phyag rgya sngar gyi de kha phul la/ mchod pa rnams la rim pas reg ring so so'i sngags dang dharma ra ṇi ta brjod/ de bzhi gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan nas brjod pa med/ de nas gtor g.yog chan blugs pa ngos kyi snod chen por blugs la bshal lo/ /de lta bu lnga bcu rtsa bzhi btang la/ glud de snod de'i nang du gzhug /de —268—

rto yang lnga bcu rtsa bsnya bar spu tang nas/de nas sdung gzugs //rtsa brgyud bla tshos dzis cad/sa/dpang ༷ra 'a she la 'a su 'a//'a skyod kyi rgyu ye pal ce bcas yi / tha sdo kya//bdan she daXbs tsho 'grub gyur rdaX//ya~X/dala'abar lha ses rnams//dpang ༷ra sags ga gsum rti/phyags lte she ༷ngasardergyas byang she rnams sa ga rna//dpang par ra sna rbegos rdzo/dpa' ba mkha' 'gra khro tshaXrdesarmyums/nga sri par sgri sde/dpal mgan bdun gī rtsa 3 sheXr sags/kho da lha brgyad rdzo rnams/dpang par 'a/bad 1 ga chi ta/skyungardzo mthu she//dpang par she/༵sa da gzha 'ekho/'ekho rdzo'is/'dzin pa da/mna' na / ) /tha cong mkhan le// nyes/ /༵rdordekyā skyungs zin pa/sring/sa dzi kun lce ༷ gcad mkhan//shegasakya rjas ༷ye pa/she/da pa' zhal gcad pa she/lte ge/rdadagacag ye ye ye she/yang sgo/rgyu ge rngu lhor nga 'a~Xspru / tse/lha ru kron ༵she suX rda/ mi ri//lag ḍi ba bcu dang /de/tsem chen lhag(dang nga tsha la yad bsgam// gas ngan pa' las kun spangs//ban brgya dang ldan pa lags//ma wos sdig can 'di pa ni//spyir gyi dge ba'i chos/she 'a da shel smad/sna/rten phung dre mod drag zis ba cha//rdzun dang g.ya sgyus ra gzhan bslu/'i/'ag rtan phung sded ma gags 'a/mi/mthu rtsal dzon snye rtse mu(rtagasardephyung shag/bdag ༵ga 'i dang bcas pa ya/she/ye 'ja/// pa' dusalabab//bar chad la ba 'a dus la zhi ri bye/rde//'ge sgruX pa snyes lab ba//ces rol tshig dang 4sa te/dpon slob baX/kun gyas mnyes pa' dpang gzugs bya/glud

rabs/glud bshad/glud rdzongs/bskul sogs spros pa byed na sdebs gcig la skabs 'ar mi pa thob thang yin par 'dug go/gtor bsngo'i sngon la byed pa ni mi legs/yang na 'og tu de na brdar gyi gong la byas na'ang wo ngo //glud rabs ni/kyai glud byung dang po gang nas byung //dang po lha'i yul nas byung //lha dbang brgya byin snyung gis zin//bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis//dar gyi glud chen btang ba yis//lha dbang brgya byin snyang las thar//glud byung bar pa gang nas byung //bar pa rgya gar yul nas byung//rgyal po dar ma 'dun rgyal ni//mi snyung de ni dgu ru snyung //rje btsun byams pa mgon po yis//glud chen btang bas snyung las thar//glud byung thamagang nasabyung //tha ma bod kyi yul nas byung //rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis khrid chen rgyan dang ldan pa 'di//slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/khrebargyad rnamasalabatang ba yis//bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas//da lta sngags 'chang bdagacag gis//spyin pa'i bdag po'i glud chen 'di//'dre srin rnams la bsngos pa yis//nad dang gdon las grol bar 'gyur//gnam sa gnyis la srin pa'i glud//glud kyi de ni pha smos pa//gnam gyi de ni ka yang rtse//glud kyi de ni wasmos pa//sa la srog mo glud kyi yum//de las dar gyi glud chen byung//kyi snangasrid lha 'dre tshur gson dang //spyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas la//lan chags bu lon snyegs pa yis//sde brgyad 'dre srin thams cad kun/glud chen gzugs mchog rgyan ldan 'di//'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i glud//ting 'dzin rgyal pos dbang bskur bas//spyin pa'i bdag po'i glud du gtong //de skad deni bgyis pa las//glud mchog gom gsum phar 'phar nas//slar yang leg0

ste 'di skad smras/ /sngags 'chang rgyal po tshur gson dang / /'bru mchog dar gyi mi po che/ /mi yis glud du gtong lags na/ /'byung ba bzhi dngang/bang po lnga/ /yan lag lnga dang tshogs drug dang / /phung khams skye mched kun dang ldan/ /gosadang rgyan dang dkor cha sogs/ /de rnams bdag la 'tshal lags na/ /skye'agro'i glud du 'gro bar bgyi/ /de skad de ni zhus pa las/ /sngags 'chang rgyawapo'i zhal na re/ /dar gyi glud chen tshur nyon dang / /'byung ba gzugs sogasakhyod la tshang/ /sha med 'byung ba sa la byas/ khrag med 'byung ba chu la byas/ khrod med 'byung ba me la byas/ /dbugs med 'byung ba rlung la byas/ /dung phoradakar por rus par byas/ /rdo rgyus byang bal rgyas nga/ra byas/ /reg 'jam de ni lpags par byas/ /chag tshang ku ba khyod kyi mgo /mgo bsgyur de ni shigs se shigs/ /zer mo 'phan bzang khyod kyi skra/ /skra lo de ni shigs se shigs/ /lungathang 'bar ba blta ba'i mig /nag dang de ni hrigs se hrig /snyan chabazangamosnyan du byas/ /sgra snyan de ni lhangs se lhang / /ka kol dri bsrung snom pa'i sna/ /dri bsrung ngad pa byings se byings/ /leb rgan dmar po smra ba'i lce/ /smras mkhas de ni thol lo lo/ /'gron bu thod dkar bzhad pa'i so/ dkar dngas de ni khrigasase khrigs/ /dbang po lag pa g.yob pa'i lag /sor bcu de ni khrabasasokhrabs/ /rkang pa thabs shes zangs lcags byas/ /'gro mkhas de ni shamasaseshams/ /mon lug brla sgang khog pa'i snying / /dran pa de ni rgya cher ldan/ /gla gor zho sha glo bar byas/ /mkhal sran dre bo mkhal rme/ra byas/ /pho long lgang pa mtshan mar byas/ /rnam shes brgyad dang tshogs drug dang / khams dang skye mched —271—

khyod la tshang/ /gos dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /mi nor sna dgu rgyab tu khur//sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /'di 'dra'i glud mchog ya mtshan can//sgang bu de ni mtho mtho nas/ /gsung dbyangs de ni kyu ru sa /bshod bu de ni dma' dma' nas/ /'gro mkhas de ni shams se shams/ /lcags thag de ni brdar brdar nas/ /skyes pa dmag la chas pa 'dra/ /rgyan charang po pur rus /mo btsun bag mar mas pa 'dra/ /de tsam de ni 'tshal bas na/ /skye 'gro yongasakyi glud du song / /kyai snang srid lha 'dre tshur nyon dang / /de ring bden pa'i pre/nyon la/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas la/ /lan chags bu len rnyog pa yis/ /'dre srin 'byung po'i tshogs bcas kun/ /glud chen gtor ma dza do longal/ /'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /lam dang yul bstan pa ne/ sdebargyad 'gyung po'i tshogs bcas kun/ /dar gyi mi chen zhal na re/ /'gro ba'i lam dang yul ston zer/ /kyai lto mkhan rgyal po'i zhal na re/ /dpyid zla gsum dang dbyarazla gsum/ /rlung dang char zil lto yi lam/ /ston zla gsum dang dkun zla gsum/ /lo tog gtsang chab lto yi lam/ /stong lam shul ring lto ba'i lam/khyod kyi lam yang de ru bstan/ /glud chen 'dre srin der song zhig khres sngo ṣ+kayul bstan pa ni/ phyogs phyogs bya ba pha gi na/ /nyi ma shar phyogs pha gon/ khri/layang shel gyi yul la byas/ /mkhar yang shel gyi mkhar la byas/ /mi yang shelagyi mi la byas/ /smra re mkhas la ngag re 'jam/ /shel gyi rta chung rgo ba tsam/ /'gro re mkhas la bang re mgyogs/ /lha 'dre'i tshogs pa de na che/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi/ khyim sgo lam 'phrang 'di kun du/ /'dre srin sdod pa'i —272—

gnas ma mchis/ /de phyir dpon shong lags kyang g.yog mi shong / /rta bshodalags kyang sga mi shong //mdzo shong lags kyang khal mi shong / /da rgyug de ni 'gro re ran/ /nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na/ /yul yang gser gyi yul la byag /mkhar/yang gser gyi mkhar la byas/ /mi yang gser gyi mi la byas/ /smro re mkha/salangag re 'jam/ /gser gyi rta chung rgo ba tsam/ /'gro re mkhas la bangaremagyogs/ /lha 'dre'i tshogs pa de na che/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor: khyimasgolam wong : 'dre gdon sdod pa'i: de phyir dpon shong ngu rta shong la kha kyangangumadzo shong lags kyang : da rgyug de ni 'gro re ran/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na/ /yul yang zangs kyi yul la byas/ mkhar yang zangs kyi mkhar la byag /mi yangazangs kyi mi la byas/ /smro re mkhas la ngag re 'jam/ /zangs kyi rta chung sgob tsam/ /'gro re mkhas la bang re mgyogs/ /lha 'dre'i tshogs pa de na mre /spyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi/ khyim sgo lam 'phrang 'di kun du/ /'dre srin sdod pa'i gnas ma mchis/ /de phyir dpon shong lags kyang g.yog mi shod /rta shongalags kyang sga mi shong / /mdzo shong lags kyang khal: da rgyug: nyi wa byangaphyogs pha gi na/ /yul yang g.yu yi yul la byas/ /mkhar yang spru / yu/yi mkhang ri0/byas/ /mi yang g.yu yi mi la byas/ /smra re mkhas la ngag re'ang5ma/ /ba khri/ yi rta chung rgo ba tsam/ /'gro re mkhas la bang re mgyogs/ /lha blu'i5 sbyin parmikhyim: 'dre gdon: de phyir dpon: rta 4skong : mdzo dzang: da rgyug: phragadog rgyal po'i sde la 'bul/ /nad gtong ma mo'i sde: 'dod tsong lha yi: rke mug klu'i sred len gnod sbyin: nga rgyal btsan gyi: bas pa rmu yi: sa srong—273—

gza' yi: ser sna yi dwags sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong / /sal gnas pa'ilha 'dre kun/ /glud chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rgyu sbyor yon ma min snye borabacas la/ /gnod dang 'tshe ba ma byed cig khrag gi glud 'di chul ge tong/ khrul gnas pa'i lha 'dre kun/ /glud wo gtor ma: rgyu sbyo6 go nod dang :drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong / /me la gnas pa'i lha: glud cen:rgyu spyo pa gnod dang : dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la gtong / /rlung la gnas pa'i lha dre 'asdi kun/ /glud chen: ga rgyu sbyar: gnod dang : sems kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong / /mkha' la gnas pa'i lha 'dre kun/ /glud chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ khyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /gnod dang 'tshe ba ma byed cig /ces yul gnad no/ /kha'abar ma'i glud rabs/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad par grags kyang / 'di 'dra'i rigs bon chung ma pas 'dra dpe blangs/ de gsar lugs la sbyar ba yin kyang / bod kyi sdebargyad mgu bar byed pas skyon med do//bskul ni/ huX spyoX byams mgon thugs rje shākya thub pa yis/ khri kha / kyithu bo par bu'i nang du sbas/ /gdung bas blang nas srog gi snying po phul/ /bka' gnyan kha 'bar chen mo las la sbyoX sku mdog sngo nag du ba'i mdog 'dral//bzhin 'dzum mi sdug khro gnyer mdzod sbur bsdus/ /dam nyams dgrabagegs thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /'jigs byed kha 'bar chen mo: skumadog dmar mo bye dza'i mdog 'dra zhing / /bzhin 'dzum mi sdug khro gnyer: nad dang gnod dang dgra bgegs brlag par byed/ /brlag byed kha: kha nasatshe'abar rgya mtsho gting nas skems/ /mig nas thog 'dzag ri rab thal par rlog/skad cig tsam la khams gsum dbang du bsdud/ /gyad mo kha 'bar chen slo las —274—

la smyo dbu skra ral pa khams nag brdzu sa pa yis/ /'jig rten lha chen brgyad rnams 'dar bar byed/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bgrad nas bzhugs pa yis/ /'jig rten klu chen brgyad rnams zil gyis gnon/ /zhal nas rngam pa'i nga ro sgrogs pa yis/ /gdon chen bco brgyad tshogs rnams 'bar bar byed/ /bdud dang 'dre rnams skad ngan tse re re/ /stobs wo kha 'bar wo:shangasanas yam dang nad kyi du ba 'thul/ /sbar khyim sdang nas dgra bgegs srogartsagacod/ /za byed mche ba drag tu gtsigs pa yis/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs srog rtsa myur du gcod/ /srog gcod kha 'bar chen mo las la bh+yo hu bh+yo bkaspru nyan pho nya lnga brgya las la lco legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma/ /dam tshig can la mthu dang sdong grogs mdzod/ /chos skyong kha' bar: spyibh+yogatsang rigs dpal mgon rnams kyi ded dpon mdzad/ /smon lam dbang gisasangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung / /'phrin las dbang gis sgrub la dngos grub ster//gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod yon lnga/ /bzhes nas kha 'bar: hu bh+yo bka' yi gtor ma rgya chen 'di bsnom las/ /'dren pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /phyogs dus kun du dar zhing rgyas pa dang / khams gsum sems can ma lusathams cad kyi/ /bla med byang chub thob pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /dza me ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrungaspel dang / /gtsug lag 'khor bzhi chos byed skyong bar chad/ /da dungasangasargyas bstan pa ma nub pas/ /sngon gyi dam bcas khas blangs ma 'dor cig /rnal 'byor zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /las kyi 'bras bu myur du grus—275—

par mdzod//hū smyo bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la//yas kyi bdud g.yosathams cad bzlog/mas kyi sri langs thams cad bzlog/pha rol rbod yong dam sri'i bar chad thams cad rmi lam ngan pa thams cad mtshan ma rtsub pa thams cad ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa ba ni gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu ye logasu5brgya drug cu dus na 'chi ba rnam dgu drang srong dmod ha lhor ba phurapa'i dbal khra 'phen pa yungs kar thun zor 'phen pa skyes pa'i mda' zora'aphen pa bud med dmod zor 'phen pa the'u rang tshe la rkub mu stegs b.rachad byed pa nad kha rims kha dal kha snga dgra dar ba thams cad phyi dgra sems pa thams cad bdud kyi tho ngan byed pa btsan gyi rta drel 'a༅/ pa klu'i byad du bcug pa lo sgeg zla skeg zhag skeg chags che nyamasang thams/cad mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog go bsgyur ro dgra la bsgyur//log 'dren bdud dang bar chad dang //ltas ngan dgra bgegs bar chad rnams//'di yis bzlog par mdzad du gsol//bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnamasasgrubs//mchod pa rnams dang zan dang a rgyu'i lhag ma thams cad snod der blugs lka bdagagi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni//de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyin stobs dang//chosakyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis//don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun//dedag thams cad ci rigs pa//'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa//thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur cig/ces bden stobs lto gsum brjod de/khyad par du klu'i nad sel na/klu'i sman sna tshogs dang ba'i 'o ma gung du bshams la/'bras yos dang yos mar sbyarab6

blug go /gzhan bgegs gang gnod kyang snga ma'i chog go /de nas slob dpon gyis 'khor rnamasalabasrung ba byas/ gtor ma phyi la gtong bar bya ste/ de'ang gtor ma'i sngon du dung la sogs pa'i sgra 'gro/ gtor ma khyer ba dang bum chog pas g.yas ngos nas rang gi khro bo'i sngags drag tu bzlos shing / bum pa'i chu sgreng zhing 'gro'o/ /slob dpon gyis phyis nas rdo rje gsor zhing / dril bu sil zhing / na ma tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dh+wa ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha rnga/ bhan+ta bhan+dha/ ha na ha na a mṛ te skyoX phaṭa/ ces sngagasabazlas shing / rkang pa khro bo'i 'gros kyis 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas gnod pa'i bgegs yod pe'i sa'am/ dgra'i yul mthong ba'i sar sleb pa dang / bum chus chos 'byung bris pa'i steng du gtoraslabazhag ste/ slob dpon gyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsab dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla mdam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi: lung dang rtogs pas bsdusapa'i dam pa'i chos rnams kyi: theg pa gsum la gnas pa'i 'phags pa'i dgo'adun rnams kyije de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /rdorje dang / /zin po tshe dang/ /pad+ma dang / /las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi: snying po dang phyag rgya dang gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi lha tsho gis rnams kyi: don datshachos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/rnam 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ /rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi khyad par du ra yangardorje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi: dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong—277—

ba'i bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa/rdzu 'phru/la gyi zhabs dang ldan pa mthurdestobs kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams kyi las byed 'jig rten pho nya drag po'i mthurtsal nus pa can rnams kyi bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi mu lter smos nas/dgra yin na/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra/dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra/dam pa'i chos kyi smod dgra/dge 'dun tshogs kyi sdang dgra/skye 'gro sems can yongs la 'tshe ba rnams dang /khyad par du rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khoradangabacas pa dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa dang /sbyin pa'i bdagapo'akhor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed cing /bas5sbyor phyin ci log byed pa'i byad ma 'di zhes sam/snga dgra lag tu khyer ba/phyidagra yid la sems pa/da lta dngos su sbyor ba'i las ngan gyi dgra bo bsam pa ngan pa sbyor ba rtsub pa phod 'dzugs pa/do bsdo ba 'di rnams kyi pho lha/dgra lha/zhang lha/yul lha/lhan cig skyes pa'i lha/srog gi lha/bsrung skyobos rgyud bskul ba'i 'jig rten 'das ma 'das gang yin yang rung /mtho srid pa'i rtsemonas/dma' dmyal khams yan chod/bar stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khamasardephyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gang na gnas pa thams cad nyon cig/ces padadand yam sogs bgegs yin na/bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod rnams kyi gnasalus longs spyod 'khor tshogs dang /chos spyod dang /dpal 'byor bde skyid laganod par byed pa dang /bstan pa dang 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa'i 'byungapo gdon bgegs/lha klu gnod sbyin/lha ma yin/rgya lnga 'gong bdud/btsan/ma mo dal yams kyi bdag mo la sogs pa/snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi 8

rigs gang yin yang rung / lko 'don pa spo/ mchod spyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa 'di dang / bzlog glud phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang dbang po drug dang / yan lag nying lag don snyingathams cad tshang zhing / gos rgyan sna tshogs dang bcas pa 'dis tshim par gyis la/ khyed rnams gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor nye bar zhi nas rang gog nasasu 'gro bar gyis shig /gang dag bsam sbyor ngan pa de dag mi gtong na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas mgo bor bsnun zhing bskal pa'i mes tshig par gyur cig/bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod rnams kyi lus la gnod pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu/ nad yams dal kha thams cad phyir bzlogapar gyur cig /sngon kyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa 'khon grib ltas ngan byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig /pha rol kyi mthu dang byad kha mnan gtad 'brula'akhor la sogs pa'i rbod gtong thams cad phyir: des bzlas pa'i sngags dang byad kha rbad 'dre thams cad de nyid la bzlog par rmi lam ngan pa dang/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg za ma'i skeg chags che nyams nga ba bkra mi shis pa thams cad phyir: gzhan yang sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs gza' dang rgyu skar/ dmu dang bdud/btsan dang gzhin rje/ klu gnyan sa bdag /rgyal 'gong the rang / dam sri sen sho 'e rigs kyi gnod pa thams cad phyir: mdor na bdag dang yon bdag—279—

'khor dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi nyon mongs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig /med par gyur cig /zhi b.ragyur cig /mi 'byung bar gyur cig /dkon mchog bslu ba med pa dang/ /chosanyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog pa dang/ /bsrung skyobs mthu dang ldan gyur cig /oṃ sarba du yan pra tshan ra phaṭa/ rak+ta rak+ṣaku ra me swāhā/ zhes gtor ma drag tu 'phangs/ lhag ma ma lus par bya/ gtor ma kha phub ba 'a ༄ sa/pa g.yon pas mnan stangs tsam bya/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma shuṇ+ḍa/ badz+ra pa na ye/ mahāyak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro bhā ya/ mahā rbur+sā/ ka ṭa bhi ra lha ya/ a simus la/ ba ra shu pa hasta ya/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha' hi kha shi hu lu hulu/ rnga nga/ bhan+dha bhan+ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ ga pas rna/bi spos ya bi spo ṭa ya/ sarba sdisnrin/ bi nā ya kā na/ mahā ga na pa ti/ dzi wi ta/ an+ta kar ya spyiXphaṭa swāhā/ lkoX a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzlas go /dgra la byed na/ mkhar ngos la rgyag /klu'i gnod pa bzlog na/ chu bor skyal lo/ /de nas kun gyi phyi mig mi blta bar slob dpon gyis rting mnan te/ bsrung ba'i sngags bzlos shingalog la/ gong gi bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa phyung la mchod bstod bsdus pa byed/ ma phyung par rnala'abyor bla med ltar byed na/ rang nyid la mchod bstod byas la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya bci rigs bzlas nas/ ma 'byordo ra pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs bzod gsol dag ye shes pa phyung na/ badz+ra muX nam mkha'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegagarang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX snying gar huX/ dge ba 'de yis myur du bdag/rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs dang / ston mchog dam pa —280—

sogs dang /zhi ba chag/sa bral sogs//tshogs kyi dam pa sogs bkra shis bya go/dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi rjes mi ma rga par bya'o//phan yon ni nges par 'chi ba bslu ba dbāgazhan gyi rbod gtong phyir bzlog pa dang /gdug pa'i klu'i gnod pa sel ba dang /rims nad lasogs pa bsrung bar nus pa dang /sdang ba'i dgra brlag par byed pa la sogs pa phan yon dpa gtu med kyang /'dir gtso bor rang gi gnod pa bsrung zhing /gzhan gyi gnod pa bzlog pa yin no//de ltar gtor ma'i cho ga gsal bar byas pa yis//dge ba 'di yis 'di byed skye bo ma lus rnams//gdug pa'i gdon las rnam grol tshe ring nad med dang //bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bumyur 'byin shog/don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis nan gyis bskul ba la brten/kha 'bar ma'i gtorachen gyi cho ga ba ri ba'i man ngag/slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos sbyar bar grags pa la yiganor dang lhad du mngon pa tsho spangs/cung zad kha bskongs byas pa ni kun dga' snying pos yin no// //ma ṅga laX// gcig zhus/ dag/༄༅//ja mchod bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas dang rigs kun khyab bdag bzhugs/ theg//oṃ snya sti/ja mchod bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/bla ma la phyag 'tshal/lko/rnam dag yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che//tha mal 'khrul ba'i snang ba rab sbyangs shing //ye shes chen po'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs//ting won sngagasaskyer+shadang phyag rgyas rgya cher spel// āXguX 'di ni yid la bsams pas kyang 'grub go/rab 'byams nam mkha'i ma/tha' klas ༷ra//lha rdzas mchod pa dpag med sprul//

tshad med mchod sprin gsang sngags dang //yid sprul smon lam stobs lasabyung //bdag pos yongs ḍi ma bzung dang //bdag no/zhan longs spyod thamasacad kyang //mtshan 'dzin — ma kun spangs nas// kun gang bar byasate'abul//kun bzang rnam 'phrul rjes 'gro ba/kha dog dri ro reg bya'i mchog/spros bral zung 'jug bde ba'i ro//ye shes mchod yon bla na med/khyab bdagarje btsun chos kyi rje//rtsa ba'i bla mar mchod pa 'bul//yi dam sko〉/'thoralnga tshogs dang //mchod 'os rgya mtshor bzhes su gsol//mchod bya mchod byed ma dmigs kyang //gnyis med ye shes rang snang du//zag med bde chen 'phelab dang //tshogs gnyis 'byor ba'i gtso bor shog/ces pa'ang rang ni slo pa bzang pos bskul nas/tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes drug la ding ri glang bskoradu'o//dge legs 'phel//na mo gu sags kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang //'khor lo sdom pa 'bar ba'i gtso//ye shes bdud rtse'i mchod pa 'bul//mchog dngas mongadangos grub sngo//spyod pa'i rdo rje bha hu la//rong zom lo smo wo ma'i pa//ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//a wa hūṃ ti zhang ston rje//gnyos chen sa ṅgha bha dra'i zhabs//ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchad pa 'bul//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//'jam dbyangs chosarje paṇ+ḍi ta//grub pa'i dpa' po sa skyong mtshan//ye shes bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul//mchog dang thun mong dngos gruX stsol//srid zhi'i dpal gyur 'gro ba'i

phiX/ra/lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal she 'dzin//'jam mgon ca da lta snyang pa' zhabs//rtsa brgyud bla mar mchad ༷ 'bul//rgyal ba sa yisnashe cad dang //spyan srung she caX rga she //ye shes grod ༷rtsa mchad pa 'bul//mchag dang thun mang dngas grub stsal//// ma ṅga la//༄༅//bsangs mchod bzhugs so//zugs sba dri roXphaṭa/swabha was de'i sgrong par sbyangs/hūX las byung ba'i 'asa~Xrdzo gzugs spra ro reg bya 'dod pa' yon to lnga dang ldan pa bzang she bi ba nam mkha' khams thams cad ga~X bar gyur/na maXsarba ta thā ga ta snu shwa mu khe khyuXsarba thā khaX ut+pa te spa ra ṇa maX ga ga na khaX swāhā/zhes lan gsum gyisabyin gyis brlabs/tsā na mo rtsa brgyud she spra zhaXr bcas ḍi~X //yi dam dkyil 'khor lha —sa dang //mkha' 'gra tshos skyang srung ma' gas tshogi///sangs rgyas she sems dpa' dang //nyan thas rang rgyal 'phags sa bcas//lha klu gnad spyin dri za dang //sde brgyad ཿnga po'i tshogs rnams kun//ma rdzo i gyomatshoyi ri 0ri ke rna ‘ri rtsa ri hūṃrgo'ad rges ri she par yul phyags 'dur gnas pa'//ga bdag ma yisnochen 'ad zhes pa//'bar she rnams la mchad par 'bul//gzhan she gzha bdag gnas bdag dang //grang bdag ༷khug spege mu sa tshim pa she //yeralhags pa thams cad kyang //bsangs skyi 3 'ad yas ma par shag/dngas

bshams 'di la brten nas kyang //dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs dang//chos nyid bden pa'i mthu stobs kyis//dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung b.rashog/mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra//dri zhim bdud rtsi'i ro mchonabargya//sna tshogs reg bya'i bde mchog brgya/khang bzang yul 'khor skyed mos/tshal//sna tshogs zas dang sna tshogs gos//g.yog 'khor rnam pa mang po dang//bang mdzod nor dang 'bru la sogs//rkang 'gro nor dang grogs la sogag/srid zhi'i mgron po khyed rnams la//gang la gang 'dod longs spyod ni//khyi srid 'khor ba ma stong bar//mkho dgu thams cad 'byung bar shog/gnod pa thamasacad zhi gyur cig/nyams pa thams cad gsos gyur cig/mthu stobs bzhi brjid rgyas gyur cig/bde skyid thams cad 'phel gyur cig/mi gtsang grib sogs dag gyur cig/'khon dang 'khrug pa zhi bar shog/mdor na dpala'abyor gong 'phel bas//myur du sangs rgyas thob gyur cig/bdag can dpon slob yon mchod kyi//mi mthun bar chad kun zhi zhing //tshe dang bsgo de namasalongs spyod dang //dbang thang yar ngo bzhin du 'phel//log par lta ba'i dgrabagegs rnams//rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/khyad par dpal ldan glam yi//bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar//rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas/padang //yul phyogs bde skyid 'phel ba dang //chos grwa dge 'dun longs spyod sogs//rtag tu 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs//gnod pa thams cad sel ba dang //lo tog la sogs phun sumardetshogs//nad med bde ba'i gdong grogaX mdzod//yid la bsam pa'i don kun
