'dir gshegs su gsol//spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang//gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin zhing /khyad par can gyi 'phrin lasacho so skyong ba'i//gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la /bdegashegs bka' lung gtsor mdzad bstan pa bsrung //rang don dor nas snyenaraba'i nags tshal du//gzhan don sgrub mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug go/dmabacas thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs//dge bsnyen skyabasagasol bden pa'i tshigs mnyan pa//dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bringamachis so 'tshal//bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na//'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol//mtshungs med blta bas mi ngoms shing //gser gyi mdog can mdzesapa'i sku//zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung bzhugs//sa gnon mnyam gzhagardemadzad phyag 'tshal/ rdza 〉 /bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang //bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs//thub pa'i bka' lung gtsor mdzad cing //lha mi'i bar de nams dpal zhing du//bzhugs shing dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i//bden tshigamanga' ba khyod phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i sku tshe /bstan pa rgyas pa pa khri yaX kuyigling na ni//'phags pa gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin//dgra bcom stong dngartsig brgyas bskor//rin chen srog zhu 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la//'phags pa gnas brtan lam phran brtan//dgra bcom stong dang drug brgyas bskor//phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyaga'atshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa shar rdo lus 'phags gling na ni//bha ra dh+wa dza

bsod snyoms len//dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor//glegs ba lhungabazed 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa /lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsumarden//'phags pa gnas brtan lam brtan ni//dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyasabaskor//glegs bam chos 'chad mdzad phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa /riyi rgyal po ngos yangs la//'phags pa gnas brtan klu yi sde//dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor//bum pa 'khar gsil 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i bstan pa /ri yi rgyal po bi hu lar//'phags pa gnas brtan sbed byed ni//dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor//phyag gnyis glegs bam 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa /gangs can ri yi rgyal/po la//'phags pa gnas brtan mi phyed pa//dgra bcom stong phrag gcig gis bskor//byang chub mchod rten 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa /gangs ri chen po ti sel//'phags pa gnas brten yan lag 'byung //dgra bcom stong dang sumabargyas bskor//spos phor rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i/bstan pa drang srong ri yi ngogs nags na//'phags pa gnas brtan ma pham pa//dgra bcom brgya phrag gcig gis bskor//phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyaga'atshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa /lom bdun pa'i ri phug na/ta phags pa gnas brtan nags na gnas//dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor//sdigs mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa /'dzam bu glingagi zangs gling na//'phags pa gnas brtan dus ldan ni//dgra bcom stong dang chig brgyas bskor//gser gyi rna bskor 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan 9

pa /sing ga la yi gling na ni//gnas brtan rdo rje mo yi bu//dgra bco5stongaphrag gcig gis bskor//sdig mdzub rnga yab 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i bstan pa /chu bo ya mu na gling na//'phags pa gnas brtan bzang po ni//dgra bcom stong dang nyis brgyas bskor//chos 'chad mnyam bzhag mdzad phyaga'atshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa /gnas mchag kha che'i yul na ni//'phags/pa gnas brtan gser bes/dgra bcom chen po lnga brgyas bskor//rin chen zhags pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i bstan pa nub kyib 'ang spyod na ni//bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog/dgra bcom chen po bdun brgyas bskor//phyagaganyis mnyam bzhag mdzad phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa khyang gi sgramisnyan na ni//'phags pa gnas brtan pa ku la//dgra bcom chen po dgu brgyasabaskor//phyag gnyis ne'u le 'dzin phyag 'tshal//bla ma'i /bstan pa /'phags pa'i dge bsnyen dharmā ta//ral pa'i thod bcings glegs bam khung//snang ba mtha' yas mdun na bzhugs//rnga yab bum pa 'dzin phyag 'tshal//blama'i /bstan pa rgyas par /brtson par go gon mthu stobs ldan//sangs rgyasabastan pa legs skyong ba//shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi//rgyal chen bzhi laphyag 'tshal lo//bla ma'i /bstan pa rgyas par /spyo so/kha65ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bco pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shwakya thub pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs sumachi go/byin gyis brlab tu gsol/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa dam pa'ichos skyong zhing lha mi kun gyi bsod nams bsags pa'i dpal gyi zhing du/de 40

sgrub thabs sna tsho gi/sa kyi skor bzhugs/bzhin gshe/gas pa shākya thub pas bka' bsgo se te/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' b.ra'ajig rten na mngon sum du bzhugs shing / /bka' lung go rjes su sgrub pa 'phags pa'i tshig nges pas zhal gyis bzhes pa/ gangs ri chen po ti sela'aphags pa'i gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung 'khor dgra bcom pa stong sum brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de phug du sbyar te/drang srong ri'i ngogs nags na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa 'khor dgra bcom pa brgya phrag gcig gis bskor te ri nags kyi ngogs lotshabadun pa zhes/ bya ba'i ri phug na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs zangs gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po dus ldan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i: sing ga la'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan wo po rdo rje mo'i bu snyen ra dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la: chu bo ya mu na'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bzang po 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te sa bzhugs pa' kha che'i yul na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po gser be'u 'khor ra dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i nub kyi ba lang spyod na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dzag ser can 'khor dgra bcom pa 'dun brgyas bskor te bzhugasapa'i byang gi sgra mi snyan na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ba ku la 'khoradagra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i pri yang ku yi gling na —341—

'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin 'khor dgra bcom pa stong drug brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'phags pa'i gnasabartan chen po lam phran brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong drug brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i shar gyi lus 'phags gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugasapa'i lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lamardebartan 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i ri'i rgya lnga po ngos yangs la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i ri'i rgyal po bi hu la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan wo po sped byed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i gangs can ri'i rgyal po la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen pomiphyed pa 'khong dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharmā ta la 'khor dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/zhes gsol ba btog de nag mu ni mu ni mahā mu na ye swāhā/zhes mang du bzlas/sangs rgyas sprul pa dag bcomarde'aphags pa'i tshogs//'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa//dkon mchonagasum dngos gnas brtan bcu drug gis//bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs//thugs rje'i bdag nyid gnas brtan bcu drug gi/'khor tshogasasrid mtsho las brgal nyon mongs med/khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogasarde4

rnams kyis/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems can kun gyi gsos gyur dgra bcom pa/ /rig dang zhabs ldan skye dgu'i sbyin gan/sache/ /'phags pa'i gang zag chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /bstan pa yun ringaganas par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gis da/ge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus / /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lusarab spangs nas/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog //bsod nams rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par dag 'gyur cag /yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun rdzogs nas/ /'jig rten kun las khyad par 'phagasartapar shog /chogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yis/ /'phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med/ /skal ba nyams pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med bla ma mchos/ gis bkra shis lha(ga /dus gsum rgyal ba srasabacas thugs rje yis/ /nyan thos tshul bzung srid pa ji srid bar/ /bstan pa skyong zhing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shisartse/ga /gzhan yang tshe dpag med kyi gzungs mdo dang / 'od zer can gyi gzungs mdo sogasa'adon par 'dod pas kyang / so so'i bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas 'don par bya'o/ /gal te nyin zhag gcig la thun mang du byed na/ thun dang po la bstod pa'i phyag 'tshal doraba'i yan lag bdun pa dang / thun bar pa rnams la bzang spyod dang gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyunabashags bya/ thun tha ma la gong du bshad pa ltar gyi yan lag bdun pa 'bring po de bya zho /thunaganyis sogs la'ang de'i rigs 'gre'o/ /tshogs pas gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas kyab yan lag sa dun pa dang / sems bskyed sngon du song nas gtor ma btang ste/ mjug tu smon las dang —343—

bkra shis ci rigs su brjod do//kha zas kyi bya ba la 'jug pa'i sngon rol du dkon mchog gsu5rjes su dran pa'i mdo 'don te/de yang /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu 'dulaba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/bla na med pa/lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyasabacom ldan 'das so//de bzhin gshegs pa de ni bsod nams dag go rgyu mthun pa/dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams chud mi za ba/bzod pas brgyan pa/bsod nams kyi gter rnams kyi gzhi/dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis spras pa/mtshan rnams kyi me rtag rgyas pa/spyod yul ran par mthun pa/mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/dad pas mos pa rnams la mngon par dga' ba/shes rab zil gyis/mi gnon pa/stobs rnams la rdzi ba med pa/sems can thams cad kyi ston pa/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yab/'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyal/po//mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'gro ba rnams kyi ded dpon/ye shesadapag tu med pa/spobs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/gsung rnam par dag pa/dbyangs snyan pa/sku byad blta bas chog mi shes pa/sku mtshungs pa med pa/'dod pa dag gis ma gos pa/gzu / gas dag gis nye bar ma gos pa/gzugasardemed pa dag dang ma 'dres pa/sdug bsngal las rnam par grol ba/phung po dgalas rab tu rnam par grol ba/khams rnams dang mi ldan pa/skye mched rnams/bsdams pa/mdud pa rnams shin tu bcad pa/yongs su gdung ba dag la 'a/rnam par grol ba/srid pa las grol ba/chu bo las brgal ba/ye shes yongs44

su rdzogs pa/'a ༵ ༷nga ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sa so/lha/stosaldan 'das sa kya sa shas la gnas pa/mya ngan las 'das pa la ༷tanasapas/yang dag pa nyad kya ste' ldu 'a pa/sems ye mas cad la 'a~X 'a zi la bzhugs pa /'ad she na sangs 'i she sdo ni thog mar dgo kya sku ba 'a yan tan yang dag pa she sa//dam de troni chas bsgyu na thag ༷ra dag brdzo/b.rangh+ru dge ba/she mar ye ba/dan bzang pya/ sgyu cu ye/'a she~Xgs pa/yangs su dag pa/yangs su snging ba/bca~X/'di 'dasakyas chas/ gas par gsungs pa/ge mu dkyi par she ba/nad pa/dusa'iXshe/rang gis rig rnga/'ad mthang ye la dan yod sa/mkhas pa sa she kyas sa sa rang sa rag par bya ba/bcam ldan 'das kyas po'i bsapa' mas 'dul ba legs mim ston pa/'a par 'byung ba/rdzogs pa byangachub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mthun pa zhi cang /'dus pa 'a pa/ba r+ṣa pa yod pa ri ba bcad pa'o//theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun na/legs parashe pa/ kri ༷ra zhugs pa/drang por 'a she/mthunaXzhin kho kyi/thal ma gyi zhi ba 'a skya sngi gyur pa/she bya rda' ye sna 'a pa/bcwa na kho dpal ra spyi/'a su sbyang ba chan ༷༷/da pa' gnas ye/ra pa/kun tu ༵nga na pa' mu ge zing shad dge ge char ge ge sam mi khab/go so//sangs rgyas/yan tan bsam khyab//chos/ kya yon tan bsam khyab//dge 'du sten yon tan bsamardemi khyab//bsam mi khyab la dad byas pa'i//rnam par smin pa'ang bsam/mi0ri lha skye sgyu ra tsha nyusne rna ma yirikhyab//rnam dag zhang du bar shag 4rtses brjod la/ āXgu ru budha rdeb dha satwa

badz+ra ni we kyi hūX/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX/ a du nu tra nā twa da/ tshe 'phroṭaswāhā/ zhes pas zas phud phul/ oṃ ha ri s+t+ya swāhā/ oṃ ha ri te mahā yak+ṣi ni ha ra ha rasarba pā paX ni cha swāhā/ oṃ a gra pa'i a shi khyuXswāhā/ zhes pas 'thar/sbyin nas/ dranapamanyam par bzhag pas bza'o/ /zos zin pa na/ oṃ u tsit+ta piṇ+ḍa a shi khyeXswāhā zhes pas lhag ma'i chang bu byin zhing / kha bkrus nas/ na maXs man+ta pra bha rā dza ya/ ta sprug twa ya/a rta te sam mya ka saX bud+dhā ya/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ ku mā ra bhā tā ya/gegs twa ya/mahā satwa ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ ta bya thā/ oṃ ni ra laX bhe/༄ni ra bha ge dza ya dzaya/ la zhe mahā ma ti/ dak+ṣi dak+ṣi ṇi/ me pa ri shodha ni zwaspya gangs bdag lakhazas byin pa de dag thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba thob par gyur cig /gangagis bdag la skom blud pa de dag dang / gang sa bdag la rim gro byas pa dang / bkur sti byas pa dang / stobastang byas pa dang / mchod pa byas pa dedagathams cad kyang nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba thob par gyur cig /gang dag bdagalami bde bar byed pa dang / brdeg pa dang / mtshon gyis 'debs pa dang/ rnam pa thams cad du srog gcod pa'i bar du byed pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub kyi bde ba thob cing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa 'di yis ni/ /'gro ba'i nang du rang byung sangs rgyas shog /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgralaba'i/ /skye bo srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo//gzhan yang grong khyer gnas pa dag /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bde dang ldan gyur cig /gang gi sbyin pa gang la byin/ /spyin pa ji ltar mi —346—

dmigs pa/ /sbyin pa mnyam pa de nyid kyis/ /sbyin bdag de la yongs rdzogasashog /spyin pas 'byung po dbang du 'gyur/ /spyin pas dgra rnams med paragyur/ /pha rol gnyen yang sbyin pa nyid/ /de phyir spyin pa gtso bor brjod/ /sbyin pa 'jig rten rgyan yin te/ /sbyin pas ngan 'gro ldog par byed/ /sbyin pa mthoris skas yin te/ /sbyin pa zhi byed dge ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i longasaspyod rnams/ /mi zad nam mkha' lta bu gang / /longs spyod de ni thob bya'i phyir//sbyin pa de ni yang dag spel/ /brtsams par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /drangs rgyasabastan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /rme tshe bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ / chos 'du wa'i de la spyod gyur pa/ /skye ba'i 'kho7ra ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang rung zhig brjod nas/ mdo 'don pa sogs bya'o//thun rnams kyi mjug tu dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod par bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar/ 'gro kun dge rtsa ji snyed yod pa dang / /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang / /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ /kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig /'jig rten thams cad ma lus sems can rnams/ /ji snyed rgyal ba kun gyis thugs chud pa/ /kun kyang mkhas pa kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /kun tu bzang po de bzhin 'gyur bar shog /phyogs rnamasatshalus kun du ci byas pa/ /skyes bu dam pa de ltar yongs su bsngo/ rdo/ rje'i rgyalamatshan rgyal bas gang gsungs pa/ /yongs bsngo dam pa mchoge dang phul yangayin/ /de bzhin zhing rnams thams cad ma lus par/ khyu bzhin kun kyang khong—347—

du chud byas te/ /sems can ji snyed thams cad ma lus par/ /de dag kun kyangakun du bzang gyur cig /sbyin pas yongs bsngo ji bzhin red gyur cig khrikhokhrims kyis kyang bsngos bzhin red gyur cig /brtson 'grus stobs kyis bskalapar mi ldog cing / /bzod pa 'khrug pa med pa'i yid gyur cig /bsal gtan gyis kyang rtse gcig yid ldan zhing / /ting 'dzin kun gyi spyod yul shes gyur cig/shes rab dus rnams gsum po thams cad du/ /'jig rten dag tu mtharadamigs med gyur cig /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams thams cad kyang/ rnamapa kun du rnam dag mkhas gyur cig /spyod pa de dag thams cad ma lus par//kun kyang kun du bzang po red gyur cig /ji ltar chos dbyings rlom pa'i stse a/med cing / /de la spros dang chags pa med pa ltar/ /mya ngan 'da' dang sgrib pa med pa dang / /de bzhin sems la rlone/ sems med gyur cig /ches mkhasayongs su bsngo ba gang brjod pa/ /de ni rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bsngo ba ste/ /mkhas pas spyod pa ci nas 'grub 'gyur bar/ /dge ba de yang de yis yongasasubasngo/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis 'di la bslabs pa ste/ /ji snyed gang yod thams/cad ma lus par/ /mkhas rnams kun kyang yongs su bsdu byas te/ khri nas bde gshegs stobs la 'jug par bsngo/ /zhes rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i snying po dbāgazhan yang smon lam mang du btab/ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag mtho ris na/ /rin chen rmad byung rgya chen mchog yod pa/ /des ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen la/ /cis kyang grangs dang bgrang dang char mi phod/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'jig rten mchog /dzi—348—

ltar nga'i 'di de bzhin bden mchog na//bden pa 'dis ni shin tu bde legasardeshog/zhi dgos bdud rtsi'i shin tu gya nom gang /shwakya thub pas mnyan khab 'anathugs chud pa//chos de dang ni mtshungs pa yod min te//de mthon byas na phyin chad mya ngan med//ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dam pa'i cho so kyi zin chen dziltar nga'i bden pa 'dis ni rgyal bas gang dag gang zag brgyad gsungs pa//de dag rnams ni skyes bu zung bzhi ste/ /spyin gnas de dag sa steng shin tu dkon//de dag rnams la byin na dpag med 'gyur//ngo mtshar shin tu smad byung dpag med de//dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig ji ltar nga'i bden pa 'di4dam pa gtso bo mchog sbyin gya nom pa//'od mchog dpa' bo dam pa chag niganas/khres rab dam pa mchoge/ ni dam pa mchog//mchog min mchog mkhyen/ 'di ni bcom ldan gcig/ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasarin wo ji ltar nga'i bden pa 'dis ni ting 'dzin dam pa bar ra kho pa gang //mtha' yas blo ldan de bzhin gshe/gas gsungs pa//ting 'dzin debartan rdo rje dper byas pa//ting 'dzin de dang mtshungs pa'i ting won pho//ngo 'tshar shin tu rmad ting nge 'dzin gyi rin wo ji ltar pho bden pa 'dis ji ltar sgo gtan dam zhing rab dam ste//stobs chen rlung bzhi dag gis mi bskyod pa//de ltar mkhas pa bden bzhi mthong gnas pa//'jig rten smra ba rnams kyis 'dir mi g.yo//ngo mtshar shin tu dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig ji ltar nga'i bden pa 'dis ni thams cad zil gnon kun mkhyen thams(cad gzigs//thams cad mkhyen pa stobs rnams kun dang ldan//kun gyi dam 49

pa 'dzin pa kun dang bral//bsam pa kun mkhyen 'di ni bcom ldan gcig/ngo mtshar shin blu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen ji ltar dza sgo bden pa srid pa 'gog cing mi g.yo 'gyur ba med//skyon med 'jigs pa kun las rnamapar grol/lken tu 'gag cing gya nom nges par 'byung /tshen tu dri med zhib blos mi 'phrog/ngo mtshar dam pa'i chos kyi rin wo rdzi shi bden pa shin tu sdug bsngal brta na zhing bde sbyin pa'i//bden rnams mthong ste gang dgabag yod pa//bden pa rin chen rnams la dogs bral ba//de dag skye ba brgyad pa phyis mi len//ngo mtshar dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig ji ltar nge sgo bden pa dam pa rnams kyi dam pa don dam mkhyen//mchog dang mtshog/min mkhyen zhing don dam brtson//gzhan gyis mi 'phrog dam pa thugs chud rtogs//shin tu sdug bsngal rnams kyi dpung gnyen mchog/ngo mtshar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen ji ltar bden pa 'dun pa bskyed nas rnal 'byoraldan gyur cing //go tam bstan la rtag brtson rab grol zhing //gzhan gyi midakri ba dag zhing der reg/'di la nge/ reg grangs su phyin mi 'gyur//khromatshar dam chos rin chen gang zhig ji ltar bden bden pa mthong bas brjed pa rgya lam na//gal te sdig pa 'ga' zhig byas gyur kyang //de ni de 'chang/ pa yi 'os min te//chos nyid 'de ni mi g.yo gnas phyir ro/tho/sung dge nin ji ltar bden pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten tham/sa cad na//sangs rgyasadang ni lhag pa'i mtshungs nga med//ldo dang mi yi ston pa bla na med//ston pa ded dpon sman pa rnams kyi mchog/ngo mtshar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas:rdzi ltar

bden pa: sa ga'i zla ba dang por thub pa yi sa/ /nags khrod chos kyi dam pa rab brnyes pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa'i lhag pa med/ /'di la de reg grangasasuphyin mi 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar dam pa'i chos kyi rin wo: ji ltar nga'i: bden pa:sdig pa rnying zad gsar du byas med la/ /rims nad med pas 'jigs med myangan bral/ /rtsa ba 'gags pas srid pa mi bskyed pa/ /bstan pa mar me bzhin du 'bar bar 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar: dge 'dun: ji ltar nga'i: bden pa rdzes ni shin tu bde legs shog /gzhan yang bkra shis kyi chigs bcad ci rigs par bya ba ni/ rgyal mnan ce moradabang gi rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /sgrub pa poladangos grub mchog stsol pa'i/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /tshogs gnyis/ mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /'phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med// /skal pa mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i//mnyam med bla ma mchog ṣ+ka/ngu phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jigarten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+mo rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /deyis nye bar bstan pa'i mchoge rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'i de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldon thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i dzin ga /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dgo—351—

—ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o//che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med//cho so rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis//bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi nas//rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog/chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med//dam chas bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi ga/nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi nas//rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog/dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba//rgyasasras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis//nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogasardernam par 'phel//rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog/mi 'gyuralhun po sku yi bkra shis shog/yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog/mtha' bral don rtogs thugs kyi bkra shis shog/rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog/sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang //bzod pa sgotshazhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang //mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtags pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog/ston pa 'jig rten khams su 'byon pa dang //bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang//bstan 'dzin phu nu bzhin du mthun pa yi//bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shisashog/bar 'dir spro na thun mong ma yin pa'i bla brgyud sogs dang /gong gi phyag 'tshal la gon pa bsgyur te/yi dam gyi bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod/rgyal ba sras bcas bsod namasamathu dag dang //lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsam pa dang //gsang sngagasarig sngags kun gyi mthu stobs dang //bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshigagis//bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang /khyud ni nyi zla bzhin du

gsal ba dang / /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa yi/ /bkra shis des/ kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshangs dang lha dbang bsrung ma'i byin brlabasadang / /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur pa'i/ /bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing/ /semasacan re ba bskong mdzad pa/ /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis sgo(ga /bgegs/rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang / /mthun pa bsgrub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang denga'adir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang / /tshe ringand med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga sa /chos bzhin sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad srung zhingaskyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zab cing rgya cher gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor bsrung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mibazang dang rnam thos sras/ /rgyal chen bzhi yi bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la'ang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi deng 'dir stsol/ de 76du nyin mo bde legs tshig gsum gyis mthar/ dam chos rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /dgo'adun rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /tshangs pa yis kyang deng 'ji/ra stsol/ /lha yi dbang pos deng 'dir stsol/ /'jig rten skyong bas deng 'dir stsol/ /dkar—353—

phyogs skyong bas deng 'dir stsol1//zhes pa la sogs pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs par brjod do//'di bris pa yi dge bas kyang //mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi/sgrib sbyangs tshogasaganyis yongs rdzogs te//rgyal ba'i srid la dbang 'byor shog/las dang po ba'i rim pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni shin tu mang po la phan par mthong zhing /don gnyer 'gas kyangabaskul te/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas khrigs chags su bsgrigs pa ste rang lo so lnga pa 'go/'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/dge legs 'phel//༄༅//gso spyong gi cho ga dus bzang mchod pa dang bcas pa bzhugs so//lkoX snyu sti/sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal nas//las kyi mtha' las 'tsho bayang //skyabs 'gro sems bskyed blangs gyur pas//cho ga 'di la 'jug par bya//tshes brgyad dbābacu bzhi dang /bco lnga dang /gnam stong la sogs pa dus bzang po rnams la/dkon mchonagasum gyi rten rnams bkram/khyad par sangs rgyas gyi sku gzugs dang /bka' rtsod med kyi po ti gcig 'byor na nges par gal che zhing /'byor rung ma 'byor rung maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa gcig bkod/mchod yon gyi snod kyis sna drangs pa'i mchod pa rgya cher bshams/dkar gtor 'brang rgyas lta buzhig dang /zas sna mang po dang bcas pa dang /srung ma rnams kyi gtor ma zhig kyang bshams//lusardethams cad bkru ba'am/kha dang yan lag lnga dbang po'i sgo rnams bkru/skye( sarba ta sprul/ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/zhes bzla/snod gtsang mar dri bzab ni chu bluganyerma amri te hūX phaṭa/brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ku sri 5 4 gnas dang yo byad gang zag rnams la hor/na

mo sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang/chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i stobs las/ dmigs pa'i rten 'di tsasalabarten nas sa'i phyogs 'dir 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad 'byon zhing bzhugs pa'i gnas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa bde ba can lta bu rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang / gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad du yongs su rdzogs pa/ rdo rje rin po che seng ge'i khri dang /rin po che'i pad ma la sogs pa gdan gyi bkod pa phun gsum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ phyi nang thams cad du 'phags pa kun du bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bus yongs su gang ba rgya dang tshad yongs su chad pa med pa/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / 'phags pa chos skyong pa ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams dang / dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung b.ragyur cig /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung b.ragyur cig /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i zhing khams thams cad gang zhingargyas par gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig lko sarba bid pu ra pu ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya ho o badz+ra spa ra ṇa kha/ rol wo dang bos/ na mo bha gawa te/ badz+ra sarapra ma rdan ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa myakla ba/ ya/ ta bya thā/ tse( badze badz+ra mahābadz+re mahā te dza badz+re mahā bya badz+re mahā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi ma sgro pa sa kra ma—355—

ṇi sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swāhā/de ltar mchod pa byin rlabs tshar gsum khya/de nas 'grub na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la dmigs nas phyag 'tshal ba dang /bshags pa rgyasapar bya/gzhan rgyas pa ma 'grub kyang phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pa ni nges par bya dgos te/de rjes bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/byang chub snying por mchis/kyi bar//sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi//chos dang byang chub semasardedapa' yi//tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi//ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshe/gas kyis//byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang //byang chub sems/dpa'i bslab pa la//de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar//bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du//byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing //byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la'ang /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi//lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed blangs/de nas yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso spyong blang ba ni/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//'phags pa spyan gzigs dbangaphyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo//ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/rta cang shes lta bu/glang po chen po/bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/khur bor ba/rang gi don rjes su thob pa/srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/yang dag pa'i bka'/legs/pararnam par grol ba'i thugs/legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de rnams kyis/sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang /phan par bya ba'i phyiradang /grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang /nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang/mu go med par bya ba'i phyir dang /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pa/tsā 6

bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges parartogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag minga'adi zhes bgyi bas kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /deng nas srogagacod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor ni blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa zhi /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ khri gdan tshe mtho mi bya zhing / /de bzhin du ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /rdzi ltaradagra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spongs/ /bla med byang chub gnas thob shog /sdug bsngal rangadakrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ldogasus 'di/oṃ a mo gha shwe la sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ (〈j-i〉 mahā shu khri sde/) satwa pad+ma bi bhu ṣe ta/ bhu dza dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta / a wa lo gi te hu phaṭa/ 'a sa lobasadag gi gzungs 'dun nam nyer gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing/ /zhes sogs smon lam gdab bo/ /de nas spyan 'dren pa ni spos sbar zhing / ma lus sems/can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha//dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcasaganas 'dir gshe/gas su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du mas/'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya cher dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos—357—

dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams sgrol ba'i phyir/ /yongs dga'akhor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa shākya'i tog /rgyal sras rig pa'i lha mo tshogs dang bcas/ khro bo'i rgyal po bka' sdod pho nya sogs/ /thams cad ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /thugasarjes 'grom ba'i don du gshegs nas kyang / /'dir bzhugs mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag rnams la dngos grub mchog stsol zhing/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra udzidzñā.ā ga tsā bha ga wān/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka e phya hi/ lan gsum/ o a rdzi te hu phaṭa/lan bdun gyis mi ma/thun pa rnams sbyangs/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa leg/ga /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gis mchod yon bzhes nasakyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /o ga ga na sam a hā/ dziltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus sol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /o sarba ta thugata a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye skyo/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ khugs/rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta: bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyi na/ /de srid bcom ldan ༵ sni/sa/ rlo ba ༵ga/ ༵/ ḍi nā kā sna ༵rmi spya/ ༵ rdo sna / ba/dhi lngas ni shwa ga 4 rtsam༈sprugyo tshirdo—358—

pa'i sangs rgyas yum tshogs bcas/ /gsang ba'i bdag po la sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ /skyon rje gshed sogs khro bo'i dbang po dang / /rdorje ma so kha byangachub sems ma'i tshogs/ /gaṇ+ḍa ri dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ /rig pa'i khromograngs las 'das pa sogs/ /g.yas kyi phyogs su 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /lha mo bzhi dang sems dpa' grangs med bcas/ /g.yon phyog༅rdethugs rje wo po 'jig rten mgon/ /'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs 'khore gyisabaskor/ /mtha' bskor ye shes mgon po lcam dral dang / /rgyal chen bzhi dang 'jig rten skyong ba bcu/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi yongs bskor te/ /bdag la rab tu dgyes pa bzhugs par gyur/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ chu bo gang gā'i rgyun bzhin du/ /ar+ghaṃ) rgyun yangami chad de/ /bla med mchod pa 'di 'bul na/ /thugs rjes dgongs te bzhesasugasol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+gha pra rti6mas twa dri zhim reg na bde ba yi/ /zhabs bsil rgyun yang mi chad de/ /bla med mchod pa ḍādi'abul na/ /thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /o sarba ta thugata shākya mu ni sa pa ri lha ra pru5 pra tismo swāhā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshe/gas kun khrus gsol ba/ /de ltar bdag gis lha rnams la/ /gtsangardema'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ /o sarba de ba badz+ra a rtsi ta a mṛ ta sru sma snatshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyura'agyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin wo bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa datshapa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra waṇ+ḍa ye swāhā/ phreng ba rin —359—

chen se mo do shal dang //rgyan gyi dam pa ma lus phul ba yis//byang chub mchonagi rgyan dang ldan gyur nas//bla med theg pa mchog la gnas par shog/oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra a lang ka ra swāhā/theg mchog bla re mgon skyabs gdugs dngaldan//bdud/ bcom rgyal mtshan ba dan ting 'dzin 'phan//bdag dnga'agroba'i don du 'bul lags kyi//dbang mchog dam pa dus 'dir stsal du gsol//oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra u pa sba na swāhā/sna tshogs rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dag dang//lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i glu dbyangs kyis//rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pararab brgyan pa//theg pa mchog gis nges par bgrod par shog/oṃ sa bo de ba badz+ra spyo ra na da swāhā/gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/lha rdzas bzang po'i dri'adi dag/bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi//bzhes nas bdagaladagyes par mdzod//oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra ga rnye swāhā/ā ha ra ā ha ras thobi bya dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi//lha rdzas bzang yi tshe toga'adi//bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi//bzhes nas bdag la dgyesapar mdzod//lko sarba de ba badz+ra pur+sha swāhā/ā ha ra ā ha ra sam bi du/khri yi rgyas pa lha yi rdzas//nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di//bdag gis dad pasa'abul lags kyi//bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod//oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra dhu pe swāhā/ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba sab bya dha ra pū dzi te swāhā/sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong //sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag/bdag gyis dad pas 'bul lags kyi//bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod//oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra nai we tu swāhā/ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bi du dha ra pā rdzi te grwa twa gnod pa 60

'joms shing bkra shis pa/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di/ /bdags dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzode/ /o sarba de ba badz+ra ā lo ke swāhā/ ā lo ka ā lo ka sarba bi du dha ra pū dzi te swahā pi wa mdangagling bu ma/ /rdza rnga ma dang rdza rnga che/ /ba 'ad ma sgeg mo glu gar ma/ /me togo mdang spos 'chang ma/ /mar me ma dang dri chang ma/ /tshe long ma dang ro 'dzin ma/ /reg bya ma dang chos ldan ma/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dkyila'akhordo ra lha tshogs mchod par bgyi/ /o na na a ra tsi ta spa ra ṇa kha/ mthon mthing 'od chags rdo rje pi wa ma/ rgyud mang snyan pa'i skad kyis yid sgyur byed/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyesamadzod/ /o sarba de ba badz+ra bī ni swāhā/ mchog gi gser mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma/ /snyan rgyud rin chen gling bu'i sgra dbyangs can/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol pa 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /o sarba de ba badz+ra wa se swāhā/ bi spa ltar dmar rdo rje rdza rnga ma/ /skad snyan lha rdzas bzang po'i rdza rnga 'khrol/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol pa 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcasardorje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra mu ra dzes hā/ margad slab|mtshungs rdo rje rnga chen ma/ /rnga zlum cher sgrog nam mkha' phyogs kun 'gengs/ /rdorje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /o sarba de ba badz+ra mṛ tang go swahā/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs can ba tsā pa go /'dzum zhal rgyas pas gzhan gyi kun dga' bskyed/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /o sarba de ba badz+ra—361—

ha su swāhā/ mthon ka chen po'i 'od can rab sgeg ma/ /rdo rje la 'thad kurabarten snyan pa'i tshul/ /rdorje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba srasabacas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra la phya snya hā/ btso ma'i gser mdog rdo rje glu dbyangs ma/ /shes rab dbyangs can rna ba'i bcud len mkhan/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyesamadzod/ /oX sarba de ba badz+ra gyi ti swāhā/ rma bya'i spu ltar sngo ljang gar mkhan ma/ /mnyen lcug yan lag mchog gus khro gar bsgyur/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oX sarba de ba badz+ra nirti swāhā/ ston zla ltar dkar rdo rje me tog ma/ /lha rdzas me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs byed/ /rdorje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oX sarba de ba badz+ra puspro swāhā/ sngo skya dud sprin lus can bdun pa ma/ /mkha' khyab dri zhim bdug pa'i spos sprin can/ /rdo rje lha mos mchode pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oX sa bo de ba badz+ra ga pe swāhā/ gur gum gzhon nu'i lus can snang gsal ma/ /rin chen snangabs phyogs bcu'i mun sel byed/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oX sarba de ba badz+ra dī paX sprusma'achar ka'i mdangs ltar dmar skya byug pa ma/ /legs sbyar dri mchog dgobasartog pa sel/ /rdo rje lha mos mchod pa'i rol ba 'dis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod/ /oX sarba de ba badz+ra ga rnye swāhā/ kha ba dung ltar rnam dkarogazugs brnyan ma/ /rnam dag zin chen dngul dkar me long g.yon/ /rdorje lha —362—

mos ma3 pa'i rol ba 'dis//rgyal ba sa rdo rje yid dgyes mas//pyoX sarba de ba badz+ra rū ste' swāhā/rgu sna rtsa༈ra lus she rdo si 'a/she 'a bcud ldan sras bcas rdo rje~Xn/da/sa mara~Xrdo rtse ge rje dge ge de po shes 'das//rgyal /ba sras bcas rda da dgyas mad//sa sarba da ba badz+ra rāsaswāhā/dur ji' she ltar she she 'a sdi mo rdzo//chas pa' bde ba ༅go/sterahūṃ das 'a~X//padzod masarba de pa' ral ba ru rtse//stob sa sa larderda rja ༷pad )sa mad// sarba ba badz+ra spar sha swāhā/kun du ku a she/ye spo )dzis ma//mur ba kun bskyed skye gnas / ga gig rgyu can//rda dzhai sna ma~X mam/ba badz+ra dharma dha tu tha//bde bar ljobar gshe/sa rda rje yad she//sherin ba greng dharma dh+wa tu sri//gā bar spranas pa thams cad sa kyi//'khang rilan chen 'di phul ༵sa//dpa' 'khor lo rgyun go nas//chos 'boralobaskor baX |/ba ri/ sarba de dro badz+ra tsakra rat+na swāhā/pho pas pa rgyun chad nas༅cad la//nor bu rin chen 'ad phul ba~X///dbul pha pas ma / shā pa rgyun chad nag/'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog/ sarba de ba badz+ra ma phaṭa grwahwa btsun rmorin r+ṣa 'di phul bas//ma rig mun pa rgyun chad nas/khas ba dbyings kyi ge lar tsho sdo zhe/ rnga bye ge tsho skye sne rna 1de/ 3lho dan rtags te//tro rimacho mu rab 'al greng mi ge ge / sarba ba badz+rawarat+na swāhā/blon po na wo 'ad phul ni kho//phya she gsang gsum theg gsumardedzi//༵sam yas bstan par bldan //po rin zhi 'a cad yā parashag/ 'a de ba badz+ra zhes ta rat+na swāhā/glang pa na she 'a phul ba ga/ltangan rnams na rab bsal zhang //bla so 3 theg pa rab zhan nas//thams/go

mkhyen grong bgrod par shog/oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra skorat+na swāhā/rta yon 'a wo 'di phul bas//srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol zhing //rdzu 'phruwa mchokagi shugs thob nas//sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog/oṃ sa bo de ba badz+ratu rwar+sha a shwa rat+na swāhā/dmag dpon rin wo 'di phul bas//nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur te//phas kyi sgol ba tshar bcad nas//bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog/oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra kha dha rat+na swāhā/kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan//phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis/rnam ga/mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na//bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol//oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra rū pa kā ma gu na snyasma phyogs dusakun na zin dang ma zin pa'i//yon tan tshig mchog sgra dbyangs ci mchisarnams//mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na//bzhes shig bla med grub mchog rtsal du gsol//oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra shasta kā ma gu na swatwa phyogasardedus kun na tsan dan sprul snying dang //a kar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams//mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na//bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol//oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra ga rnye kā ma gu na snyam phyogs/dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i//lus sems brtas byed ro mchog tsimachis rnams//mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na//bzhes shingablamed grub mchog stsal du gsol//oṃ sarba de ba badz+ra kā ma gu na grwa twa khyogs/dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'brel chags pa//reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshitshabyed rnams//mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bzhes shig bla med oṃ sarba de ba 64

badz+ra pa ra kā ma gu na swāhā/ /bar 'dir spro na/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ brtul zhugs mchog la'ang phyag 'tshal 'e1/ /zhes pa'i bar yang brjod/ de nas bro stod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /sogs dag mgon po thugs rje sogs/ dkon mchog gsum dang / rigs gsum po'i bstod pa sogs 'o don/bsdu na de tsam gyis chog /shin tu rgyas pa la spro na/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can sogs dang / 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs dang / rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bstod pa sogs dang / mnyam nyid migayo ma dang / thub pa'i dbang po dang / 'jam dbyangs dang / spyan ras gzigs dag sgrol mo pho sgos kyi bstod pa sogs dang / de bzhin du mtshan yang dag pa sogs kyang 'don par bya'o/de nas gtor 'bul ni/ oṃ a mṛ te huX phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharma sla bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bhuX las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta spyo bi shwa mu khe khyuX sarba thā khaXs gi dha gli te spa ra ṇa i maX/ga ga na khaX swāhā/ lan shekyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX a du nu tshen twa ta oṃ ska hāX phaṭaswāhā/ lan mang pos phul/ bar 'dir yi dam dang / chos skyong dang gzhi bdag sogs sgosakyigator bsngo byed par spro na/ ji ltar skabs su bab pa yang bya/ spyi gtor 'brang rgyas de'i phrad phulkalhag ma rnams tsa dra'i bza' bar longs spyod/slar yang mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ gong bzhin byin rlabs tshar gcig byas na legs/drimed yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon ni/ /bcom nga ge ye dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mjodi/ /chibadangagyochen zhing gzhan dang / /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang skyes yid byung—365—

rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /phyogs bcu kun na bdugaspos ni/ /lha rdzas spos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid thong dang ldan pa/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bston/ /zin chen mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod pa/ /thub dbang srasadang bcas la 'bul/ /lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas/ /phyogs bcu kun na gangayod pa/ /tshim byed yid 'od dang ldan 'di/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcasala'abul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu na/ /lha dang mi la sogs pa'i zag/yon tan kun ldan gang yin de/ /thub dbang la ni dbul bar bgyi /de las/gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /zhes sogs dang / na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sarasogs kyis rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma rnyed yongs sutshatshang dang / /'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa/ /'di kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i de hrasagrub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon paramadzad du gsol/ /oṃ dza ya dza ya/ swa sti swa sti/ ga smo ga tsā ga bha wa naX/ 'as/tusmon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyi'i mchod pa bya tshul yin la/ sgos kyi mchod pa ni/ rang rang gi gzhung bzhin shes parabyawo / 'di dang sgos mar rnams sbrel bar 'dod na/ spyi'i ma rdzo pa ni song / tsa rtse mji pam phul ba'i bar der/ sgos kyi cho ga rnams bya'o/ /dus bzang mchod pa'i bya bgi /theg pa chen po'i khyad chos yin/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi thun mong yin/ /sngagasalazhugs pa min yang sla/ /dkyil 'khordo ra mthong na mchog tu bsngags/ /gus pa'i —366—

byang chub bsngo//zhes pa dus bzang mchod pa'i rim pa 'di yang/rgyal khamasapa tā~Xnāthas smras pa'o//ma ṅga laX/dus bzang nyin zhag phrug kha pa'i sbyo/rel//'a mas lus bzang rab mdzes pas//dkon mchog mchod pa' rken phunga'adar//'bad las byang chub mchog thob shog/ zhus dag/

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon spyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung rga'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i sbun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
